hedRegUICustomFunc.name: hedRegUICustomFunc

hnlRunPinChecker.name: hnlRunPinChecker
hnlRunPinChecker.syntax:
hnlRunPinChecker(
t_lib 
t_cell
t_view
[ ?checkAms { t | nil } ]
[ ?useHDLPackageSettings { t | nil } ]
[ ?compilerOptionFile t_compilerOptionFile ]
)
=> t / nil
hnlRunPinChecker.desc: Runs the Pin Checker tool from the SKILL interface without launching Virtuoso or the Hierarchy Editor. This is especially helpful when you want to automate the launch of Pin Checker functionality before netlisting or running any simulations.

gdmAddSpecToSpecList.name: gdmAddSpecToSpecList
gdmAddSpecToSpecList.desc: Adds a gdmSpec object to a gdmSpecList. This function automatically increases the size of the gdmSpecList object to add more gdmSpec objects, if required.

gdmcancel.name: gdmcancel
gdmcancel.desc: Cancels the checked-out status of the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always canceled as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

gdmci.name: gdmci
gdmci.syntax:
gdmci(
{ G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } 
[ g_description ]
[ x_gdmOptions ]
[ g_xtra ]
)
=> t / nil
gdmci.desc: Checks in the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always checked in as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

gdmco.name: gdmco
gdmco.syntax:
gdmco(
{ G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList } 
[ g_version ]
[ x_gdmOptions ]
[ g_xtra ]
)
=> t / nil
gdmco.desc: Checks out the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents. Co-managed files in a view are always checked out as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

gdmCreateSpec.name: gdmCreateSpec
gdmCreateSpec.syntax:
gdmCreateSpec(
t_libName | emptyString | nil
t_cellName | emptyString | nil
t_viewName | emptyString | nil
t_fileName | emptyString | nil
t_namespace
[ x_gdmOptions ]
)
=> G_gdmSpecId / nil
gdmCreateSpec.desc: Creates a gdmSpec object, a user-defined type of SKILL object, according to the options you specify. You must specify at least one of the first four arguments-a library name, cell name, view name, or file name. If you specify a cell name, you must also specify a library name. If you specify a view name, you must also specify a cell name and a library name.

gdmCreateSpecFromDDID.name: gdmCreateSpecFromDDID
gdmCreateSpecFromDDID.desc: Creates a gdmSpec, a user-defined type of SKILL object, from a ddId object.

gdmCreateSpecList.name: gdmCreateSpecList
gdmCreateSpecList.desc: Creates a gdmSpecList object, where you can add gdmSpec objects later with the gdmAddSpecToSpecList function.

gdmdelete.name: gdmdelete
gdmdelete.desc: Deletes the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents from the workarea and the default configuration.

gdmexport.name: gdmexport
gdmexport.syntax:
gdmexport(
{ G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList }
g_destination
[ g_version ]
[ x_gdmOptions ]
[ g_xtra ]
)
=> t / nil
gdmexport.desc: Exports the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents from the design management system data repository to the destination you specify.

gdmhistory.name: gdmhistory
gdmhistory.desc: Returns information about the version history of a file.

gdmInspectSpec.name: gdmInspectSpec
gdmInspectSpec.desc: Extracts and returns the library name, cell name, view name, and file name from a gdmSpec object, if they exist. The information returned will be in the name space you specify in t_namespace.

gdmIsSpecId.name: gdmIsSpecId
gdmIsSpecId.desc: Checks whether an object is a valid gdmSpec object.

gdmNextFromSpecList.name: gdmNextFromSpecList
gdmNextFromSpecList.desc: Takes a gdmSpecList object and returns a gdmSpec object from it. The first time you call this function, it returns the first gdmSpec object in the gdmSpecList. Each successive call gets the next gdmSpec object.

gdmObjIsCreated.name: gdmObjIsCreated
gdmObjIsCreated.desc: Checks whether a view or file has already been created by another user in the same DM.

gdmRemovename.name: gdmRemovename
gdmRemovename.syntax:
gdmRemovename(
G_gdmSpec
[ g_version ]
[ g_name ]

)
=> t / nil
gdmRemovename.desc: Requests that GDM removes a name from the specified files.

gdmResetSpecList.name: gdmResetSpecList
gdmResetSpecList.desc: Resets the gdmSpecList so that you can obtain gdmSpec objects from it with successive calls of the gdmNextFromSpecList function.

gdmSpecListp.name: gdmSpecListp
gdmSpecListp.desc: Checks whether an object is a gdmSpecList.

gdmSpecp.name: gdmSpecp
gdmSpecp.desc: Checks whether an object is of type gdmSpec, a user-defined type of SKILL object.

gdmSpecType.name: gdmSpecType
gdmSpecType.desc: Returns the type of a gdmSpec object. A gdmSpec object can be one of the following types: lib, libCell, libCellView, libFile, libCellFile, libCellViewFile, directory, or file.

gdmstatus.name: gdmstatus
gdmstatus.desc: Returns the design management status of the library, cell, view, directory, or file that G_gdmSpec represents.

[ g_xtra ]
)

gdmsubmit.desc: Submits the files G_gdmSpec represents for the release. Co-managed files in a view are always submitted as a group; co-managed set behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

gdmupdate.name: gdmupdate
gdmupdate.syntax:
gdmupdate(
{ G_gdmSpec | q_gdmSpecList }
[ g_version ]
[ g_name ]
[ x_gdmOptions ]
[ g_xtra ] 
)
=> t / nil
gdmupdate.desc: Makes files in the workarea available for reading. Co-managed files are updated in the same grouping in which they were checked in; co-managed behavior applies only if G_gdmSpec consists of library elements.

ccpGetAutoRename.name: ccpGetAutoRename
ccpGetAutoRename.desc: Gets the current status of the auto rename feature. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, the ccpSetAutoRename function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

ccpSetAutoRename.name: ccpSetAutoRename
ccpSetAutoRename.desc: Sets the status of the auto rename feature to on or off. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, this function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

lmgrAddMenuItems.desc: Appends the named objects to the specified menu. An item can be another menu. Each menu item or menu can be added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in every pop-up menu. Menus cannot be added to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. Pop-ups cannot be added to menus.

lmgrAddToolBarItems.name: lmgrAddToolBarItems
lmgrAddToolBarItems.desc: Adds menu items with the specified names to the Library Manager toolbar and optionally appends additional items with multiple calls. Item icons can be set using lmgrSetObject.

) 
=> t / nil
lmgrCreateMenuItem.desc: Creates an instance of a menu item, which should be populated into a single menu. Once this menu item is created, you can install it into a menu using lmgrAddMenuItems().

lmgrDefineInits.name: lmgrDefineInits
lmgrDefineInits.desc: Defines the initialization action to perform when the customization code begins (after parsing the extension file) and the termination action to perform immediately before Library Manager terminates. You must define the callback in the Virtuoso program before it starts. Otherwise, you get an error. No arguments are passed to either callback.

lmgrDeleteMenuItems.name: lmgrDeleteMenuItems
lmgrDeleteMenuItems.desc: Deletes the named objects from the menu/pop-up hierarchy. The object can be either a single item or an entire menu. There is no recovery or undo from this operation. If you merely wish to temporarily disable the view of an object, consider using lmgrManageMenuItems() instead.

lmgrDisplayMessage.name: lmgrDisplayMessage
lmgrDisplayMessage.desc: Displays a string in the Message area on the Library Manager form and appends it to the Library Manager log file. If desired, the message can be written just to the Library Manager log file and not echoed to the user. Ensure that the string is terminated by a newline character, or the string might be confused with the output from other Library Manager commands or other calls to this function.

lmgrGetObject.name: lmgrGetObject
lmgrGetObject.desc: Returns a list describing the state of the single named object or nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list will be variable length list of tags (strings) paired with matching values that are either a string or Boolean value.

lmgrInsertMenuItems.name: lmgrInsertMenuItems
lmgrInsertMenuItems.syntax:
lmgrInsertMenuItems( 
t_menuItem 
t_popupSet 
l_names
) 
=> t / nil
lmgrInsertMenuItems.desc: Inserts the named objects into the menu directly before the indicated menu item. An object can be an entire menu. Each menu item or menu can be inserted or added to only one menu. Likewise, any menu item can appear at most once in each pop-up menu. Menus can not be inserted (added) to a pop-up. Pop-ups must remain a flat structure only. You cannot insert or add pop-ups to menus. This function is similar to lmgrAddMenuItems(), except in the meaning of the first argument.

lmgrLogShowPopup.name: lmgrLogShowPopup
lmgrLogShowPopup.desc: Restores the context for popup menus for Library Manager replay. This function is only intended for supporting replay and cannot be called from other SKILL engine programs. You do not need to use this function directly.

lmgrManageMenuItems.name: lmgrManageMenuItems
lmgrManageMenuItems.desc: Manages the named objects (enabling the display of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

lmgrMenuSubsInPopup.name: lmgrMenuSubsInPopup
lmgrMenuSubsInPopup.desc: This API is used only in the Library Manager's cdsLibMgr.il file for menu customization. The named menu may be placed into a sub-menu of a popup menu, which appears on clicking the right mouse button (RMB) in the Library Manager's window that lists the library, cell, and view items being browsed. This will be placed in a sub-popup if the boolean value was set to be true. In addition, menu items tagged for adding to the popup menus are displayed within its menu's sub-popup (if any). Sub-popup menus may be hierarchically nested per menu as they have been setup/defined through the customized menus' hierarchy.

lmgrQueryNamedObjects.name: lmgrQueryNamedObjects
lmgrQueryNamedObjects.desc: Returns a list containing the names of all menu items in the Library Manager menu named t_menuName.

lmgrRemoveToolBarItems.name: lmgrRemoveToolBarItems
lmgrRemoveToolBarItems.desc: Removes the specified items from the given toolbar that were previously added using lmgrAddToolBarItems.

lmgrSensitizeMenuItems.name: lmgrSensitizeMenuItems
lmgrSensitizeMenuItems.desc: Sensitizes the named objects (enabling the active state of named objects) inside their menu hierarchy and pop-up sets. Objects can be either a single item or an entire menu.

lmgrSetObject.name: lmgrSetObject
lmgrSetObject.syntax:
lmgrSetObject( 
t_objName 
l_attrList
t_iconName
) 
=> t / nil
lmgrSetObject.desc: Accepts a list describing the state of the named object. Returns nil if the object does not exist. The format of the attribute list is a variable-length list of tags (strings) paired with matching string or Boolean values.

lmgrShowToolBar.name: lmgrShowToolBar
lmgrShowToolBar.desc: Displays the specified toolbar when the Library Manager is launched and returns the previous show state specified.

lmgrValidateIcon.name: lmgrValidateIcon
lmgrValidateIcon.desc: Checks whether an icon file exists in the Library Manager for the specified icon name before creating a menu item.

lmgrVerbose.name: lmgrVerbose
lmgrVerbose.desc: Aids in debugging the callbacks registered in the cdsLibMgr.il file. It is possible to get additional informational messages to be shown inshown in the CIW.

psConfigLoaded.name: psConfigLoaded
psConfigLoaded.desc: Indicates if the.cdsplotinit is already loaded.

psLoadCdsPlotInit.name: psLoadCdsPlotInit
psLoadCdsPlotInit.desc: Indicates if the .cdsplotinit has successfully loaded or not.

psQueryPaperSize.name: psQueryPaperSize
psQueryPaperSize.desc: Returns the dimensions of the specified paper size.

psQueryPaperSizes.name: psQueryPaperSizes
psQueryPaperSizes.desc: Returns the paper sizes (such as A size) and offset of the paper that the plotter uses.

psQueryPlotters.name: psQueryPlotters
psQueryPlotters.desc: Returns a list of plotter names from the loaded .cdsplotinit files.

psQueueStatus.name: psQueueStatus
psQueueStatus.desc: Displays the plot jobs in the spooling queues.

geChangeCellView.name: geChangeCellView
geChangeCellView.syntax:
geChangeCellView( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ t_libName ] 
[ t_cellName ] 
[ t_viewName ] 
[ t_accessMode ] 
)
=> w_windowId
geChangeCellView.desc: Opens a design in an existing window.

geChangeEditMode.name: geChangeEditMode
geChangeEditMode.desc: Sets the mode of a design, allowing you to edit or view the design.

geDiscardEdits.name: geDiscardEdits
geDiscardEdits.desc: Discards all edits made to a design.

geNewWindow.name: geNewWindow
geNewWindow.desc: Makes a copy of a window.

geReturn.name: geReturn
geReturn.desc: Returns to the previous (parent) level displayed in a window before a descend, edit in place, or switch was done. This function does not support figGroups.

geReturnToLevel.name: geReturnToLevel
geReturnToLevel.desc: Displays a list box containing the levels to which you can return.

geSaveAs.name: geSaveAs
geSaveAs.syntax:
geSaveAs( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ t_libName ] 
[ t_cellName ]
[ t_viewName ] 
)
=> t / nil
geSaveAs.desc: Saves a design under another name.

geSaveHier.name: geSaveHier
geSaveHier.desc: Saves a design hierarchically starting from the edit cellview of the specified window to the specified depth. The geSaveHier function works only on maskLayout views.

geGetDisabledMenus.name: geGetDisabledMenus
geGetDisabledMenus.desc: Given a windowId, returns all the inactive submenus for all banner menus on that window. If menuList is specified, only the inactive submenus on those banner menus are returned.

geGetEnablePredicate.name: geGetEnablePredicate
geGetEnablePredicate.desc: Returns the enable predicate of the menu for the application named appName or nil if undefined.

geGetWindowStatus.name: geGetWindowStatus
geGetWindowStatus.desc: Returns the status for the application named appName on the window windowId.

geSetEnablePredicate.name: geSetEnablePredicate
geSetEnablePredicate.desc: Sets the enable predicate of the r_menu for t_appName to n_enablePredicate.

geSetWindowStatus.name: geSetWindowStatus
geSetWindowStatus.desc: Sets the status for w_windowId and t_appName to n_status.

geUpdateWindowMenus.name: geUpdateWindowMenus
geUpdateWindowMenus.desc: Updates the enabled status of all the menu items in the window's banner menu hierarchy and all of the window's fixed menu items.

geCrossSection.name: geCrossSection
geCrossSection.desc: (Layout MXL Only) Invokes the Cross Section command in the specified window. The cross section viewer is displayed and a cutline appears on the canvas. The cross section of the area under the cutline is displayed in the viewer.

geCrossSectionAddLayerThickness.name: geCrossSectionAddLayerThickness
geCrossSectionAddLayerThickness.desc:
(Layout MXL Only) Specifies the thickness to be used for displaying the given layers in the cross section viewer. By default, all layers are displayed using the same thickness.
This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

geCrossSectionAddLayerToSkip.name: geCrossSectionAddLayerToSkip
geCrossSectionAddLayerToSkip.desc:
(Layout MXL Only) Specifies the layers that should not be displayed in the cross section viewer. 
This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

geCrossSectionAddLayersToMerge.name: geCrossSectionAddLayersToMerge
geCrossSectionAddLayersToMerge.desc:
(Layout MXL Only) Specifies the layers that should be displayed on the same line in the cross section viewer. 
This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

geCrossSectionAddMaterialToSkip.name: geCrossSectionAddMaterialToSkip
geCrossSectionAddMaterialToSkip.desc:
(Layout MXL Only) Specifies the material to be skipped. Layers made of the specified material are not displayed in the cross section viewer.
This SKILL function is used in a loading environment; you cannot run it from the CIW. You can define this function in the configuration file that you want to use for customizing the cross section viewer. The function is run when you load the configuration file by using geCrossSectionLoadConfig.

geCrossSectionClearConfig.name: geCrossSectionClearConfig
geCrossSectionClearConfig.desc: (Layout MXL Only) Unloads the configuration file from the memory so that it is not used for displaying the cross section of a layout.

geCrossSectionLoadConfig.name: geCrossSectionLoadConfig
geCrossSectionLoadConfig.desc: (Layout MXL Only) Loads the specified configuration file for displaying the cross section of a layout in the cross section viewer.

geClearIgnoreProp.name: geClearIgnoreProp
geClearIgnoreProp.desc: Deletes the ignoreCheck property for all objects given in the list. The name of the property is ignoreCheck*, where * is a numerical value.

gec.name: gec
gec.desc: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited. This function is a shortcut for the function, geGetEditCellView.

geClearNetNameDisplayFilter.name: geClearNetNameDisplayFilter
geClearNetNameDisplayFilter.desc: If the specified cellview is editable, clears the net name filter setting currently saved for the cellview.

geComputeQueryBbox.name: geComputeQueryBbox
geComputeQueryBbox.desc: Takes a point as parameter and returns a corresponding bounding box. The point that is specified is the center of the bounding box. The lower-left and upper-right corners of the bounding box are based on selectionAperture.

geCopySelSet.name: geCopySelSet
geCopySelSet.syntax:
geCopySelSet( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ l_sourcePt ] 
[ l_destPt ] 
)
=> t / nil
geCopySelSet.desc: Procedural interface to copy the selected set.

geDeleteSelSet.name: geDeleteSelSet
geDeleteSelSet.desc: Deletes all selected objects in the specified window.

geDispWinEnvProps.name: geDispWinEnvProps
geDispWinEnvProps.desc: Lists all the window environment variables that can be set using the envSetVal function or stored inside the .cdsenv file.

geEditSelSet.name: geEditSelSet
geEditSelSet.desc: Displays and edits the properties of each object in the selected set in a cellview.

geEditSingleObject.name: geEditSingleObject
geEditSingleObject.desc: Displays and edits the properties of an object.

geEditToWindowPoint.name: geEditToWindowPoint
geEditToWindowPoint.desc: Translates coordinate values when you are using edit in place. geWindowToEditPoint applies the top-level cellview's coordinates to the cellview being edited; geEditToWindowPoint does the reverse.

geEnableNetNameDisplay.name: geEnableNetNameDisplay
geEnableNetNameDisplay.desc: Enables the display of net name labels on shapes that are big enough to display a label. This SKILL function is supported only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

geEquivWindow.name: geEquivWindow
geEquivWindow.desc: Returns the ID of the window that has the same edit cellview as the specified window.

geEquivWindowSet.name: geEquivWindowSet
geEquivWindowSet.desc: Returns a list of all windows that have the same edit cellview as the specified window.

geFindPathToCellViewInst.name: geFindPathToCellViewInst
geFindPathToCellViewInst.desc: Returns a hierarchical path of one of the references to a particular master in a cellview. This function returns the closest reference with the fewest levels of hierarchy.

geGetCellViewWindow.name: geGetCellViewWindow
geGetCellViewWindow.desc: Returns the ID of a window in which the specified cellview is displayed.

geGetEditCellView.name: geGetEditCellView
geGetEditCellView.desc: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited.

geGetEditCellViewWindow.name: geGetEditCellViewWindow
geGetEditCellViewWindow.desc: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the edit cellview.

geGetEditRep.name: geGetEditRep
geGetEditRep.desc: Returns the ID for the cellview being edited. It is an alias for geGetEditCellView.

geGetHierMemInst.name: geGetHierMemInst
geGetHierMemInst.desc: Returns a list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place to arrive at the cellview in the window.

geGetInstHier.name: geGetInstHier
geGetInstHier.desc: Returns a string describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window.

geGetInstHierPath.name: geGetInstHierPath
geGetInstHierPath.desc:
Similar to geGetInstHier but returns additional information for mosaic instances. 

This function returns a list of list describing the hierarchy of instances that have been descended into or edited-in-place in the current window to arrive at the cellview in the window. The list contains the following information for each instance:

(dbinst memInst row column)

geGetNetNameDisplayFilter.name: geGetNetNameDisplayFilter
geGetNetNameDisplayFilter.desc: Returns the net name filtering settings currently in use for the given cellview.

geGetObjectSelectedSet.name: geGetObjectSelectedSet
geGetObjectSelectedSet.syntax:
geGetObjectSelectedSet( 
[ d_cellview ] 
) 
=> list(
	list(d_selectedObject
		list(
				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column))
				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column))
				...
		)
	list(d_selectedObject
		list(
				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column))
				list(d_instId x_memInst x_row x_column))
				...
		)
	...
)
=> l_selectedSet
geGetObjectSelectedSet.desc: Returns a list of lists describing objects selected in the hierarchy of the given cellview. If the cellview is omitted, the current edit cellview of the current window is used. For each object in the selected set, the path to it consisting of the instance ID, the member instance, the row, and the column is given.

geGetSortedSelectByLine.name: geGetSortedSelectByLine
geGetSortedSelectByLine.desc: Returns the sorted list of the crossed objects by the line.

geGetTopCellViewWindow.name: geGetTopCellViewWindow
geGetTopCellViewWindow.desc: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview.

geGetTopLevelCellView.name: geGetTopLevelCellView
geGetTopLevelCellView.desc: Returns the ID of the top-level cellview displayed in a window.

geGetWindowBox.name: geGetWindowBox
geGetWindowBox.desc: Returns the lower left and upper right coordinates of the current window display.

geGetWindowCellView.name: geGetWindowCellView
geGetWindowCellView.desc: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window.

geGetWindowRep.name: geGetWindowRep
geGetWindowRep.desc:
An alias for geGetWindowCellView. Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window. 

This function returns nil if the current window is empty or if no current window is defined. The cellview being displayed in the window can be different from the cellview being edited, as returned by geGetEditCellView, if you are currently editing a cell in place.

geIsGraphicalWindow.name: geIsGraphicalWindow
geIsGraphicalWindow.desc: Tests if the specified window, or by default the current window, is a graphical window.

geIsNetNameDisplayActiveOnWindow.name: geIsNetNameDisplayActiveOnWindow
geIsNetNameDisplayActiveOnWindow.desc: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is supported for the given window ID.

geIsNetNameDisplayEnabled.name: geIsNetNameDisplayEnabled
geIsNetNameDisplayEnabled.desc: Checks whether the Net Name Display functionality is enabled for the given window ID.

geMenuForObjectsUnderPoint.name: geMenuForObjectsUnderPoint
geMenuForObjectsUnderPoint.desc: Creates the (De)Select Under Cursor menu for the specified window and point.

geNetNameDisplayOptionForm.name: geNetNameDisplayOptionForm
geNetNameDisplayOptionForm.desc: Opens the Net Name Display Options form. This SKILL function is supported only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter.name: geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter
geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter.desc: Saves the net name filtering settings that are currently applied on the given cellview after the geSetNetNameDisplayFilter function is called. After you call geSaveNetNameDisplayFilter, the settings will be reloaded automatically when you open the cellview in a new Virtuoso session.

geSelectNextInSelSet.name: geSelectNextInSelSet
geSelectNextInSelSet.desc: Selects an object from the selected set of objects in the specified cellview.

geSelectPreviousInSelSet.name: geSelectPreviousInSelSet
geSelectPreviousInSelSet.desc: Selects the last selected object in the specified cellview.

geSelectToggleObject.name: geSelectToggleObject
geSelectToggleObject.desc: Toggles the state of the selected objects in the specified window. This means that the function deselects the selected objects and selects the remaining objects.

geSetNetNameDisplayFilter.name: geSetNetNameDisplayFilter
geSetNetNameDisplayFilter.syntax:
geSetNetNameDisplayFilter( 
d_cellview 
t_mode
l_netNames
)
=> t / nil
geSetNetNameDisplayFilter.desc: Sets a net name filtering on the given cellview. You can control which nets are displayed or not by the net name display feature.

geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle.name: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle
geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle.syntax:
geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle( 
d_probeId
g_trueColorProbeVal
g_probeHighlightVal
) 
=> t / nil
geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle.desc: Sets the trueColorProbeVal and probeHighlightVal options of the specified probeId.

geWindowToEditPoint.name: geWindowToEditPoint
geWindowToEditPoint.desc: Translates coordinate values when you are using edit in place. geWindowToEditPoint applies the top-level cellview's coordinates to the cellview being edited; geEditToWindowPoint does the reverse.

gtc.name: gtc
gtc.desc: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview. This function is a shortcut for the function geGetTopCellViewWindow.

gwc.name: gwc
gwc.desc: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window. This function is a shortcut of the function geGetWindowCellView.

geRefresh.name: geRefresh
geRefresh.desc: Redraws all areas of all windows that have not been updated since the last redraw and need redrawing.

geRefreshCellView.name: geRefreshCellView
geRefreshCellView.desc: Redraws a cellview when necessary. If a bounding box is specified, only the specified area is redrawn.

geRefreshCellViews.name: geRefreshCellViews
geRefreshCellViews.desc: Displays a form that shows all cellviews from the specified cellview that have been modified by another process but not reread from disk. You can then select which ones should be refreshed. The top-level cellview is also checked for modification.

geRefreshWindow.name: geRefreshWindow
geRefreshWindow.desc: Refreshes a window. If a bounding box is specified, only that area is refreshed.

geDeleteAllAreaViewLevel.name: geDeleteAllAreaViewLevel
geDeleteAllAreaViewLevel.desc: Removes all area view levels from a window.

geDeleteAllInstViewLevel.name: geDeleteAllInstViewLevel
geDeleteAllInstViewLevel.desc: Removes all instance-specific view levels from a window.

geDeleteAreaViewLevel.name: geDeleteAreaViewLevel
geDeleteAreaViewLevel.desc: Removes from a window all area view levels located in l_bBox.

geDeleteInstViewLevel.name: geDeleteInstViewLevel
geDeleteInstViewLevel.desc: Removes all instance-specific view levels associated with an instance ID.

geGetAllAreaViewLevel.name: geGetAllAreaViewLevel
geGetAllAreaViewLevel.desc: Retrieves all area view levels set for a window. The view levels are returned as a list with the start level and stop level for the areas.

geGetAllInstViewLevel.name: geGetAllInstViewLevel
geGetAllInstViewLevel.desc: Retrieves the start level and stop level assigned within a window. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If no start level and stop level are defined, then nil is returned.

geGetAreaViewLevel.name: geGetAreaViewLevel
geGetAreaViewLevel.desc: Retrieves an area view level overlapping a bounding box. The view level is returned as a list with the start level and stop level for that area. If more than one area overlaps the given box, the first area found is used.

geGetInstViewLevel.name: geGetInstViewLevel
geGetInstViewLevel.desc: Retrieves the start level and stop level of an instance. The start level and stop level are returned as a list of integers. If start level and stop level are not defined for the chosen instance, nil is returned.

geSetAreaViewLevel.name: geSetAreaViewLevel
geSetAreaViewLevel.syntax:
geSetAreaViewLevel( 
[ w_windowId ] 
l_bBox 
[ n_start ] 
[ n_stop ]
)
=> t / nil
geSetAreaViewLevel.desc: Sets display start and stop threshold levels for an area independently of the window levels.

geSetInstViewLevel.name: geSetInstViewLevel
geSetInstViewLevel.syntax:
geSetInstViewLevel( 
w_windowId 
d_instId 
n_start 
n_stop 
)
=> t / nil
geSetInstViewLevel.desc: Sets display start and stop threshold levels for an instance independently of the window levels.

geRestoreWinView.name: geRestoreWinView
geRestoreWinView.desc: Restores the view saved with geSaveWinView.

geSaveWinView.name: geSaveWinView
geSaveWinView.desc: Saves the current view of w_windowId to t_name.

geEditInPlace.name: geEditInPlace
geEditInPlace.syntax:
geEditInPlace( 
w_windowId 
t_accessMode 
d_instId 
x_iteration 
x_row 
x_col 
[ g_cancel ]
)
=> t / nil

gePush.name: gePush
gePush.syntax:
gePush( 
w_windowId 
t_accessMode 
d_instId 
x_iteration
x_row 
x_col 
[ g_cancel ]
)
=> t / nil

geSwitch.name: geSwitch
geSwitch.syntax:
geSwitch( 
w_windowId 
t_accessMode 
d_instId 
x_iteration 
x_row 
x_col 
)
=> w_windowId / nil

geSwitchInContext.name: geSwitchInContext
geSwitchInContext.syntax:
geSwitchInContext( 
w_windowId 
t_accessMode 
d_instId 
x_iteration 
x_row 
x_col 
[ verbose ]
)
=> w_windowId / nil
geSwitchInContext.desc: Switches into an instance by using the view name specified in the hierarchy manager configuration context. If the correct configuration context is not found, this function uses the geSwitch command to perform the switch.

geCenter.name: geCenter
geCenter.desc: Pans the display so that the edit cellview is centered in the window.

geGetScrollPercent.name: geGetScrollPercent
geGetScrollPercent.desc: Obtains the percentage used by geScroll when shifting the drawing.

geScroll.name: geScroll
geScroll.syntax:
geScroll( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ t_dir ] 
[ g_zoom ] 
)
=> t / nil

geSetScrollPercent.name: geSetScrollPercent
geSetScrollPercent.desc: Controls the percentage of the drawing currently visible that is shifted when geScroll is activated.

geShift.name: geShift
geShift.desc: Shifts w_windowId in the direction t_dir.

geZoomToGrid.name: geZoomToGrid
geZoomToGrid.desc: Zooms in on a subject up to the last point at which the major grid is still visible.

geAdvWireSelection.name: geAdvWireSelection
geAdvWireSelection.desc: Allows the user to select route elements and the adjacent routes. Its behavior is based on the initial state of the selection and the number of consecutive calls to geAdvWireSelection().

geAddSelectBox.name: geAddSelectBox
geAddSelectBox.syntax:
geAddSelectBox( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ g_partial ] 
[ l_bBox ] 
) 
=> t / nil
geAddSelectBox.desc: Implements the add mode of area selection. With no arguments given, it prompts you to enter the area to be selected in the current window. Partial selection is performed only when the window environment variable partialSelect is set and the stretch command is active. Partial selection lets you select an edge, vertex, or endpoint of an object to stretch.

geAddSelectPoint.name: geAddSelectPoint
geAddSelectPoint.syntax:
geAddSelectPoint( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ g_partial ] 
[ l_point ] 
) 
=> t / nil
geAddSelectPoint.desc: Implements the add mode of point selection.

geAdjustPoint.name: geAdjustPoint
geAdjustPoint.desc: Returns the point after applying the adjustment associated to the window ID provided. Adjustment is defined using gravity, the current snap grid, and any snap mode defined in the window interface.

geCyclePotentialSelectNext.name: geCyclePotentialSelectNext
geCyclePotentialSelectNext.desc: Cycles the potential selection to the next object.

geCycleSelectNext.name: geCycleSelectNext
geCycleSelectNext.desc: Cycles to the next object at the current selection point.

geDeselectAll.name: geDeselectAll
geDeselectAll.desc: Deselects everything in the specified window. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

geDeselectAllFig.name: geDeselectAllFig
geDeselectAllFig.desc:
Deselects all objects in a cellview. 

Does not use the selection filter, so all objects are deselected.

geDeselectAllObject.name: geDeselectAllObject
geDeselectAllObject.desc: Deselects everything in the specified cellview.

geDeselectArea.name: geDeselectArea
geDeselectArea.desc: Calls geSubSelectBox to deselect objects within the specified bounding box in the specified window.

geDeselectFig.name: geDeselectFig
geDeselectFig.desc: Removes an object from the selected set if the object passes the selection filter.

geDeselectFigs.name: geDeselectFigs
geDeselectFigs.desc: Deselects figures from a specified list of figures.

geDeselectFigPoint.name: geDeselectFigPoint
geDeselectFigPoint.desc: Removes vertices from the selected set if they pass the selection filter.

geDeselectObject.name: geDeselectObject
geDeselectObject.desc: Deselects the specified object at the specified hierarchical path, if it passes the selection filter.

geDeselectObjectNoFilter.name: geDeselectObjectNoFilter
geDeselectObjectNoFilter.desc: Deselects the specified object at the specified hierarchical path.

geDeselectObjectPoint.name: geDeselectObjectPoint
geDeselectObjectPoint.syntax:
geDeselectObjectPoint( 
d_figId 
l_path 
l_points 
)
=> t / nil
geDeselectObjectPoint.desc: Deselect the specified vertices of the specified figure if it passes the selection filter.

geDeselectPoint.name: geDeselectPoint
geDeselectPoint.desc: Calls geSubSelectPoint to deselect the figure at the specified point in the specified window. This might deselect just a vertex or edge, or the whole figure, depending on the state of the partialSelect window environment variable. Use the F4 key to toggle this variable. You can see the state of partialSelect in the window banner.

geDeselectProtected.name: geDeselectProtected
geDeselectProtected.desc: Deselects all the objects that are marked protected in the specified cellview.

geDSAFreeze.name: geDSAFreeze
geDSAFreeze.desc: Toggles between the freeze and unfreeze states of the Dynamic Selection Assistant (DSA).

geGetPotentialSelection.name: geGetPotentialSelection
geGetPotentialSelection.syntax:
geGetPotentialSelection( 
[ w_windowId ]
[ g_ignoreSelect] 
[ l_point]
)
=> ((d_figId l_path) g_isAllSelected [l_selArray]) / nil
geGetPotentialSelection.desc: Returns the figure ID of the object which can be selected, hierarchical path of the figure, and indicates if the figure is fully or partially selected.

dbGetDatabaseType.desc: Returns the database type supported by the current executable. The function returns CDBA when called from a regular CDB executable, and OpenAccess when called from an OpenAccess executable.

dbDeleteObject.name: dbDeleteObject
dbDeleteObject.desc: Deletes one of the following objects: shapes, nets, terminals, instance terminals, pins, instance pins, mosaics, instances, mosaic instances, properties, groups, and group members. Any other object type produces an error.

dbCreateSigNetExpr.name: dbCreateSigNetExpr
dbCreateSigNetExpr.desc: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression and a signal id in d_sigId, this function attaches the inherited net expression to the given signal and adds the signal to the set of signals having inherited net expressions.

dbCreateTermNetExpr.name: dbCreateTermNetExpr
dbCreateTermNetExpr.desc: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression and a term ID, in d_termId, this function attaches the inherited net expression to the given terminal and adds the terminal to the set of terminals having inherited net expressions.

dbCVHasInheritedSig.name: dbCVHasInheritedSig
dbCVHasInheritedSig.desc: Checks if there is any inherited signal in the given cellview.

dbCVHasInheritedTerm.name: dbCVHasInheritedTerm
dbCVHasInheritedTerm.desc: Checks whether there is any inherited terminal in the given cellview.

dbCVHasNetSetProp.name: dbCVHasNetSetProp
dbCVHasNetSetProp.desc: Determines if the netSet property is set on a cellview.

dbDeleteSigNetExpr.name: dbDeleteSigNetExpr
dbDeleteSigNetExpr.desc: Given a signal IDin d_sigId, this function deletes any existing inherited net expression associated with this signal and removes it from the set of inherited signals.

dbDeleteTermNetExpr.name: dbDeleteTermNetExpr
dbDeleteTermNetExpr.desc: Given d_termId, this function deletes any existing inherited net expression associated with this terminal and removes it from the set of inherited terminals.

dbFix.name: dbFix
dbFix.desc: Fixes data corruption in inherited connectivity, rectangle, and instance header. This is a no-op function.

dbGetCellViewInheritedSig.name: dbGetCellViewInheritedSig
dbGetCellViewInheritedSig.desc: Retrieves from the given cellview all signals to which inherited net expressions are attached.

dbGetCellViewInheritedTerm.name: dbGetCellViewInheritedTerm
dbGetCellViewInheritedTerm.desc: Retrieves from the given cellview all terminals to which inherited net expressions are attached.

dbGetSigNetExpr.name: dbGetSigNetExpr
dbGetSigNetExpr.desc: Retrieves any inherited net expression found attached to the signal.

dbGetTermNetExpr.name: dbGetTermNetExpr
dbGetTermNetExpr.desc: Retrieves any inherited net expression found attached to the terminal.

dbIsValidSigNetExpr.name: dbIsValidSigNetExpr
dbIsValidSigNetExpr.desc: Given an inherited net expression in the t_netExpression associated with a signal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global, nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

dbIsValidTermNetExpr.name: dbIsValidTermNetExpr
dbIsValidTermNetExpr.desc: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression associated with a terminal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

dbIsSigInherited.name: dbIsSigInherited
dbIsSigInherited.desc: Given a signal id in sigId, this function checks if there is an inherited net expression attached to it.

dbIsTermInherited.name: dbIsTermInherited
dbIsTermInherited.desc: Checks whether there is an inherited net expression attached to the given terminal.

dbReplaceTermNetExpr.desc: Replaces any existing inherited net expression already associated with the terminal. If none exists, t_netExpression is attached to the given terminal and adds the terminal to the set of terminals having inherited net expressions.

dbSetUndoHandle.desc: Sets an undo handle with the specified name on the current undo checkpoint. If there already exists a handle with the same name, you can optionally specify that the existing handle is moved from its current position in the undo stack and associated with the current undo checkpoint.

dbUndoToHandle.name: dbUndoToHandle
dbUndoToHandle.desc: Invokes undo back to the given handle. If no handle name is given, rolls back to the last labeled checkpoint.

dbGetUndoHandles.name: dbGetUndoHandles
dbGetUndoHandles.desc: Returns a list of handles in the undo stack.

dbGetRedoHandles.name: dbGetRedoHandles
dbGetRedoHandles.desc: Returns a list of handles in the redo stack.

dbRedoToHandle.name: dbRedoToHandle
dbRedoToHandle.desc: Invokes redo up to the given handle. If no handle name is given, it rolls forward to the next labeled checkpoint.

dbEnableUndo.name: dbEnableUndo
dbEnableUndo.desc: Enables undo and redo operations in a Virtuoso session.

dbGetFluidShapeByName.name: dbGetFluidShapeByName

dbAbutIsReAbutGroup.desc: When called during abutment event 3 (un-abutment), the SKILL function indicates if re-abutment of Pcell instances will be triggered immediately after un-abutment. If the SKILL function returns true, the PDK SKILL function can store relevant information, if needed, from the current abutment group.

dbSetFigAbutName.name: dbSetFigAbutName
dbSetFigAbutName.desc: Assigns a unique abutment name to the figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment names specified for the figure ID.

dbSetFigAbutRefName.name: dbSetFigAbutRefName
dbSetFigAbutRefName.desc: Assigns an abutment reference name to the specified figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment reference names specified for the figure ID.

dbGetFigAbutRefName.name: dbGetFigAbutRefName

dbUnabutGroup.name: dbUnabutGroup

When this flag is set to true, the name of the text display will be visible. The isValueVisible flag sets the text display value visibility. When this flag is set to true, the value of the text display will be visible.

dbConvertArcToLine.name: dbConvertArcToLine
dbConvertArcToLine.desc: Converts an arc to a line. A line is defined as a number of connecting segments.

dbConvertDonutToPolygon.name: dbConvertDonutToPolygon

dbConvertEllipseToPolygon.name: dbConvertEllipseToPolygon
dbConvertEllipseToPolygon.desc: Converts an ellipse to a polygon.

dbConvertPathToPolygon.name: dbConvertPathToPolygon
dbConvertPathToPolygon.desc: Converts a path to a polygon with the same number of points as the path.

dbConvertPathSegToPolygon.name: dbConvertPathSegToPolygon
dbConvertPathSegToPolygon.desc: Converts a pathseg to a polygon based on the boundary list.

dbConvertLineToPath.name: dbConvertLineToPath
dbConvertLineToPath.syntax:
dbConvertLineToPath( 
d_line 
x_width 
[ t_pathStyle ] 
) 
=> d_path / nil
dbConvertLineToPath.desc: Converts a line to a path.

dbConvertRectToPolygon.name: dbConvertRectToPolygon
dbConvertRectToPolygon.desc: Converts a rectangle into a polygon.

dbCompressPointArray.name: dbCompressPointArray
dbCompressPointArray.desc: Compresses collinear points in a list of points.

dbCreateSimpleMosaic.desc: Creates a simple mosaic in the cellview from the master d_masterCellView.

dbFindMosaicByName.desc: Returns a mosaic ID if a mosaic with the given name is found in the cellview specified.

dbCreateProp(

g_value 
)

dbCreateProp.desc: Creates a scalar property for an object. If a property named t_name already exists on the specified object, it returns nil.

dbCreateRangeProp.name: dbCreateRangeProp
dbCreateRangeProp.syntax:
dbCreateRangeProp( 
g_object 
t_name 
t_propType 
g_value 
g_lBound 
g_uBound 
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbCreateRangeProp.desc: Creates a range property for an object.

dbCreateEnumProp.syntax:
dbCreateEnumProp(

t_name 
t_value 
l_string 
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbCreateEnumProp.desc: Creates an enumerated property for an object.

dbCreateHierProp.name: dbCreateHierProp
dbCreateHierProp.desc: Creates a hierarchical property for an object.

dbFindProp.name: dbFindProp
dbFindProp.desc: If a property of the given name is found on the object specified, d_propId of the property is returned; otherwise, nil is returned. This function has the same functionality as dbGetPropByName.

dbGetPropByName.name: dbGetPropByName
dbGetPropByName.desc: If a property of the given name is found on the object specified, d_propId of the property is returned; otherwise, nil is returned.

dbReplaceProp.name: dbReplaceProp
dbReplaceProp.syntax:
dbReplaceProp( 
g_object 
t_name 
t_propType 
g_value 
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbReplaceProp.desc: Replaces a scalar property for an object. Calls to dbReplaceProp for abutment groups must be made before calls to dbReplaceProp for pcell properties.

dbReplaceRangeProp.name: dbReplaceRangeProp
dbReplaceRangeProp.syntax:
dbReplaceRangeProp( 
g_object 
t_name 
t_propType 
g_value 
g_lBound 
g_uBound 
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbReplaceRangeProp.desc: Replaces a range property for an object.

dbReplaceEnumProp.name: dbReplaceEnumProp
dbReplaceEnumProp.syntax:
dbReplaceEnumProp( 
g_object 
t_name 
t_value 
l_string 
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbReplaceEnumProp.desc: Replaces an enumerated property for an object.

dbReplaceHierProp.name: dbReplaceHierProp
dbReplaceHierProp.desc: Replaces a hierarchical property for an object.

dbCopyProp.name: dbCopyProp
dbCopyProp.desc: Copies all the properties of one database object to another database object.

dbCopyPropList.name: dbCopyPropList
dbCopyPropList.desc: Copies all the properties from the database object given in the first argument to the database object given in the second argument in a single, atomic, copy operation. Properties with the same name in the destination object are overwritten. If the given database objects are pcell instances, then pcell evaluation happens once after all the properties are copied.

dbResetPropList.name: dbResetPropList
dbResetPropList.desc: Resets a list of properties on a given object with the specified list of properties.

dbDeletePropByName.name: dbDeletePropByName
dbDeletePropByName.desc: Deletes a property from an object.

dbCopySingleProp.name: dbCopySingleProp
dbCopySingleProp.desc: Copies a single property to a destination object.

dbMergeSingleProp.name: dbMergeSingleProp
dbMergeSingleProp.desc: Merges a property with a destination object without overwriting the property if it already exists.

dbReplacePropList.name: dbReplacePropList
dbReplacePropList.desc: Replaces the specified list of properties (l_params) in the given object. dbReplacePropList will trigger Pcell evaluation once as an atomic operation.

dbAddObjectToGroup.name: dbAddObjectToGroup
dbAddObjectToGroup.desc: Adds a database object to a group.

dbChangeGroupType.name: dbChangeGroupType
dbChangeGroupType.desc: Changes the type of a group.

dbCreateGroup.name: dbCreateGroup
dbCreateGroup.syntax:
dbCreateGroup( 
d_cellViewID 
t_groupName 
l_groupType 
[ t_groupDefName ]
) 
=> d_group / nil
dbCreateGroup.desc: Creates a group of the specified group definition in the specified cellview. If a group definition is not specified, a traditional, unrestricted group is created, which allows all types of objects and all types of groups as members and can exist in any database.

dbDeleteGroupByName.name: dbDeleteGroupByName
dbDeleteGroupByName.desc: Deletes a group and its members from a cellview.

dbDeleteObjectFromGroup.name: dbDeleteObjectFromGroup
dbDeleteObjectFromGroup.desc: Deletes an object from a group.

dbGetGroupByName.name: dbGetGroupByName
dbGetGroupByName.desc: Returns the database ID of the group specifed by name.

dbGetGroupsWithDef.name: dbGetGroupsWithDef
dbGetGroupsWithDef.desc: Returns a list of groups in the specified cellview and of the specified group definition name.

dbMoveGroupMember.name: dbMoveGroupMember
dbMoveGroupMember.desc: Moves group member d_groupMem1 immediately after group member d_groupMem2.

dbDeleteGroupMemberFromGroup.name: dbDeleteGroupMemberFromGroup
dbDeleteGroupMemberFromGroup.desc: Deletes a particular group member from the group to which it belongs.

dbTransformCellView.name: dbTransformCellView
dbTransformCellView.syntax:
dbTransformCellView( 
d_cellViewId 
f_mag 
f_angle
) 
=> t / nil
dbTransformCellView.desc: Scales (magnifies) and/or rotates all shapes in a cellview.

dbTransformPointList.name: dbTransformPointList
dbTransformPointList.desc: Transforms all points in an array in the same way as dbTransformPoint does with a single point. This function does not modify the original array, and returns the transformed array.

dbConcatTransform.name: dbConcatTransform
dbConcatTransform.desc: Merges two individual transformations into a single new transformation.

dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform.name: dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform
dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Canonicalizes composition of the given transformations into a pair of orientation angles and a non-negative acute angle. Transformations are either numbers representing counter-clockwise rotation in degrees or strings representing orientation. The effect of transformation by the composition of the transformations in the return value is the same as effect of transformation by the composition of all input transformations.

dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY.name: dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY
dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Converts orientation-based representation of an orthogonal transformation into an MY-based representation. Orientation-based representation is a pair of DB orientation and any-angle rotation with the rotation applied first. The MY-based representation is a pair of any-angle rotation and an optional reflection over a Y-axis with the reflection applied first.

lowerLeft.name: lowerLeft
lowerLeft.desc: Returns the lower left point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and assumed to be correct.

upperRight.name: upperRight
upperRight.desc: Returns the upper right point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

leftEdge.name: leftEdge
leftEdge.desc: Returns the lower left point's X coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

rightEdge.name: rightEdge
rightEdge.desc: Returns the upper right point's X coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

bottomEdge.name: bottomEdge
bottomEdge.desc: Returns the lower left point's Y coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

topEdge.name: topEdge
topEdge.desc: Returns the upper right point's Y coordinate of the figure's bounding box.

centerBox.name: centerBox
centerBox.desc: Returns the center point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

isLocation.name: isLocation
isLocation.desc: Validates that the given point is properly defined.

isBBox.name: isBBox
isBBox.desc: Validates that the given bounding box is properly defined. This function should not be used with Pcells.

dbOpenBag.name: dbOpenBag
dbOpenBag.desc: Opens the library, cell, or view property bag in the given mode.

dbReOpenBag.name: dbReOpenBag
dbReOpenBag.desc: Reopens the given g_bagId for the given mode.

dbGetBag.name: dbGetBag
dbGetBag.desc: Opens the property bag in read mode for the given ddId object.

dbGetBagOwner.name: dbGetBagOwner
dbGetBagOwner.desc: Returns the owner of the specified property bag. The owner could be a library, cell, or view.

dbCloseBag.name: dbCloseBag
dbCloseBag.desc: Closes the property bag in the given mode. If closing for append or write, the function decrements the write count.

dbPurgeBag.name: dbPurgeBag
dbPurgeBag.desc: Forces a property bag to close and removes it from virtual memory.

dbRefreshBag.name: dbRefreshBag
dbRefreshBag.desc: Refreshes the virtual memory image of the property bag by the one from the disk. If the disk file does not exist and the bag is in edit mode, then the virtual memory is truncated.

dbMakeBagCurrent.name: dbMakeBagCurrent
dbMakeBagCurrent.desc: Refreshes the given property bag if it is out of date relative to the one on disk.

dbSaveBag.name: dbSaveBag
dbSaveBag.desc: Writes the virtual memory image of the property bag to disk.

dbIsBagReadable.name: dbIsBagReadable
dbIsBagReadable.desc: Checks if the property bag exists on disk for the given ddId object and if the user has read access for that property bag file.

dbIsBagWritable.name: dbIsBagWritable
dbIsBagWritable.desc: Returns the UNIX file permission of the file that contains the property information. For example, basic is a system owned library, dbIsBagWritable will always return nil on its property. If you own a library, and its prop.xx has write permission, even if the bag is opened in r mode, dbIsBagWritable will still return t. A new property bag that exists only in VM is not considered writable.

dbGetBagTimeStamp.name: dbGetBagTimeStamp
dbGetBagTimeStamp.desc: Returns the last time that the bag was modified.

dbFindOpenBag.name: dbFindOpenBag
dbFindOpenBag.desc: Finds an opened bag in virtual memory for the specified d_ddId.

dbGetBagDdId.name: dbGetBagDdId
dbGetBagDdId.desc: Returns the ddId associated with the specified bagId.

dbGetOpenBags.name: dbGetOpenBags
dbGetOpenBags.desc: Returns a list of the currently open property bags.

dbIsBagId.name: dbIsBagId
dbIsBagId.desc: Returns t if the specified ID is a valid bagId, otherwise, it returns nil.

dbLayerAnd.name: dbLayerAnd
dbLayerAnd.syntax:
dbLayerAnd( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2 
[ x_numVertices ]
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerAnd.desc: Returns a list of objects derived from the overlap of objects on the input lists. This function generates the areas common to both input lists. The resulting objects are created in the specified layer and cellview.

dbLayerAndNot.name: dbLayerAndNot
dbLayerAndNot.syntax:
dbLayerAndNot( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2 
[ x_numVertices ]
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerAndNot.desc: Returns a list of new objects derived from areas of the first input list that do not overlap any area of the second input list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

dbLayerOr.name: dbLayerOr
dbLayerOr.syntax:
dbLayerOr( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
[ l_dbIdList2 ]
[ x_numVertices ]
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerOr.desc: Returns a list of new objects that encompass all areas on input lists and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

dbLayerXor.name: dbLayerXor
dbLayerXor.syntax:
dbLayerXor( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2
[ x_numVertices ]
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerXor.desc: Returns a list of new objects derived from those portions of either input list that do not overlap the other list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

dbLayerSize.name: dbLayerSize
dbLayerSize.syntax:
dbLayerSize( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
n_value
[ x_numVertices ]
[ g_mfgGrid ]
[ x_conicSides ] 
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerSize.desc: Performs an oversizing or undersizing operation on the object specified in the input list.

dbLayerTile.name: dbLayerTile
dbLayerTile.syntax:
dbLayerTile( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerTile.desc: Fractures edges of the specified object on the input list into vertical trapezoids.

dbLayerStraddle.name: dbLayerStraddle
dbLayerStraddle.syntax:
dbLayerStraddle( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerStraddle.desc:
Returns a list of new objects from those shapes on the first layer that straddle shapes on the second layer. A shape is straddling, if part of its area is covered by part of the shape on the second layer and part is not. The return list also includes copies of shapes that are touching these straddling shapes.
Butting and coincident edges do not affect this function.

dbLayerNoHoles.name: dbLayerNoHoles
dbLayerNoHoles.syntax:
dbLayerNoHoles( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerNoHoles.desc: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the original shapes of the input list without holes. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

dbLayerHoles.name: dbLayerHoles
dbLayerHoles.syntax:
dbLayerHoles( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerHoles.desc: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the holes in shapes of the input list. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

dbLayerInside.name: dbLayerInside
dbLayerInside.syntax:
dbLayerInside( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerInside.desc: Creates a new merged object for each overlapping object on dbIdList1 that is completely enclosed by an object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object/objects created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered inside if its entire area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. If both shapes are coincident on all sides, then each shape can be defined as being inside the other.

dbLayerOutside.name: dbLayerOutside
dbLayerOutside.syntax:
dbLayerOutside( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerOutside.desc: Creates a new object for each object on dbIdList1 that is not enclosed by any object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered outside if none of its area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. Butting edges are considered outside.

dbLayerEnclose.name: dbLayerEnclose
dbLayerEnclose.syntax:
dbLayerEnclose( 
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
l_dbIdList1
l_dbIdList2
[ g_mfgGrid ]
) 
=> l_dbIdList
dbLayerEnclose.desc: Returns a list of shapes on the first list that enclose shapes on the second list. A shape is enclosing the other if the entire area of a second shape is covered by first shape.

dbPointArrayAnd.name: dbPointArrayAnd
dbPointArrayAnd.syntax:
dbPointArrayAnd( 
d_cellViewId
l_pointList1
l_pointList2 
[ x_maxPoints ]
) 
=> l_pointList / nil
dbPointArrayAnd.desc: Returns a list of point lists derived from the overlap of shapes in the two input point lists. This function generates the areas common to both the input lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

dbPointArrayAndNot.name: dbPointArrayAndNot
dbPointArrayAndNot.syntax:
dbPointArrayAndNot( 
d_cellViewId
l_pointList1
l_pointList2
[ x_maxPoints ]
) 
=> l_pointList / nil
dbPointArrayAndNot.desc: Returns a list of point lists derived from the area of the first input point list that does not overlap any area of the second input point list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

dbPointArrayOr.name: dbPointArrayOr
dbPointArrayOr.syntax:
dbPointArrayOr( 
d_cellViewId
l_pointList1
[ l_pointList2 ]
[ x_maxPoints ]
) 
=> l_pointList / nil
dbPointArrayOr.desc: Returns a list of point lists derived from the union of shapes in the two input point lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview. If the second input point list is not specified, the first input point list is returned.

dbPointArraySize.name: dbPointArraySize
dbPointArraySize.syntax:
dbPointArraySize( 
d_cellViewId
l_pointList
n_value
[ x_maxPoints ]
) 
=> l_pointList / nil
dbPointArraySize.desc: Returns a list of point lists derived after performing an over size or under size operation on the shapes specified in the input list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

dbPointArrayXor.name: dbPointArrayXor
dbPointArrayXor.syntax:
dbPointArrayXor( 
d_cellViewId
l_pointList1
l_pointList2
[ x_maxPoints ]
) 
=> l_pointList / nil
dbPointArrayXor.desc: Returns a list of point lists derived from portions of both the inputs lists that do not overlap the points in the other input list.

dbSetTermSoftConnect.name: dbSetTermSoftConnect
dbSetTermSoftConnect.desc: Sets the softConnect attribute of the specified terminal to the given value.

dbGetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer.name: dbGetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer
dbGetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer.desc: Returns the connectToLayer of the softConnect terminal as a layer number.

dbGetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer.name: dbGetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer
dbGetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer.desc: Returns the pinlessTerminalLayer of the softConnect terminal as a layer name or number.

dbIsTermSoftConnect.name: dbIsTermSoftConnect
dbIsTermSoftConnect.desc: Checks the softConnect attribute value of the specified explicit, single-bit terminal.

dbSetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer
dbSetSoftConnectTermConnectToLayer.desc: Sets the connectToLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal.

dbSetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer.name: dbSetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer
dbSetSoftConnectTermPinlessLayer.desc: Sets the pinlessTerminalLayer attribute of the specified softConnect terminal. You can specify both the layer name or layer number of the terminal.

dbSoftConnectTermHasConnectToLayer.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasConnectToLayer
dbSoftConnectTermHasConnectToLayer.desc: Checks if the given terminal has the softConnect connectToLayer attribute set.

dbSoftConnectTermHasPinlessLayer.name: dbSoftConnectTermHasPinlessLayer
dbSoftConnectTermHasPinlessLayer.desc: Checks if the given terminal has the softConnect pinlessTerminalLayer attribute set.

dbDebugStats2.syntax:
dbDebugStats2( 
[ d_cellViewId ]
[ x_segNum ] 
[ g_objName ] 
[ g_outputFileName ]
)

dbDebugStats2.desc: Lists memory used by every cellview in virtual memory, memory used by a specified cellview, content of a specified segment of the cellview, and number of objName objects in the specified segment or cellview.

dbGetBuildInfo.name: dbGetBuildInfo
dbGetBuildInfo.desc: Returns the OpenAccess release number, the tarkit revision number, and the date and machine on which the database was built.

dbGetFileDatabaseType.name: dbGetFileDatabaseType
dbGetFileDatabaseType.desc: Returns the t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName database type.

dbGetVersion.name: dbGetVersion
dbGetVersion.desc: Returns the OpenAccess database version number.

dbSetNIMsgMode.name: dbSetNIMsgMode
dbSetNIMsgMode.desc: Turns on/off the not implemented message.

dbCreateLayerHalo.desc: Creates a layer halo blockage object of the specified type.

)

=> d_boundaryId / nil

dbCreateSnapBoundary(

dbFindBusTermDefByName.name: dbFindBusTermDefByName

dbFindVectorInstDefByName.name: dbFindVectorInstDefByName

dbCreateCluster.desc: Creates a cluster in the specified cellview.

dbDisableCellViewCounter.name: dbDisableCellViewCounter

dbEnableCellViewCounter.name: dbEnableCellViewCounter
dbEnableCellViewCounter.desc: Enables updating of the cellview's timestamp counter.

dbGetCellViewCounter.name: dbGetCellViewCounter
dbGetCellViewCounter.desc: Gets the timestamp counter value for the cellview.

dbGetFileTimeStamp.name: dbGetFileTimeStamp
