dbRegPostSaveAsTrigger.name: dbRegPostSaveAsTrigger
dbRegPostSaveAsTrigger.desc: Allows users to register a trigger function that is called after a postSaveAs or Save Copy operation.

dbRegPostSaveTrigger.name: dbRegPostSaveTrigger
dbRegPostSaveTrigger.desc: Allows users to register a trigger function that is to be called after dbSave. If dbSave fails, this trigger will not be launched. This trigger will be called only after saving the db cellviews. The post save trigger will be called with the db cellview ID.

dbRegSaveTrigger.name: dbRegSaveTrigger
dbRegSaveTrigger.desc: Registers a SKILL preSave trigger. The trigger function does not need to exist at the time of register, a warning will be issued though. If the function is bound, it is called before the cellview is saved.

dbReopen.name: dbReopen
dbReopen.desc: Changes the mode of the specified cellview to the given mode.

dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile.name: dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile
dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile.syntax:
dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
)
=> d_cellviewID / nil
dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile.desc: Restores and opens the auto-saved file for the specified cellview.

dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile.name: dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile
dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile.syntax:
dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
)
=> d_cellviewID / nil
dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile.desc: Restores and opens the panic file for the specified cellview.

dbSave.name: dbSave
dbSave.syntax:
dbSave(
d_cellview
[ d_destCellView | t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ]
)
=> t / nil
dbSave.desc: Saves the changes made to a specified cellview opened in write or append mode. By default the cellview is saved to the same database ID; however, you can optionally specify a different destination cellview ID or create a new cellview in a different library. A cellview opened in read mode can only be saved as a new cellview with the different name.

dbSearchCDF.name: dbSearchCDF
dbSearchCDF.desc: Sets and un-sets a flag that will cause CDF to be searched for parameter values.

dbSetAutoSave.name: dbSetAutoSave
dbSetAutoSave.desc: Enables or disables the automatic save feature.

dbSetAutoSaveCallback.name: dbSetAutoSaveCallback
dbSetAutoSaveCallback.desc: Enables a user-defined callback function to control the frequency at which large designs are auto-saved. When set, the user-defined callback function is called just before the design is about to be auto-saved.

dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel.name: dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel
dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel.desc: Sets the data compression level for designs that are saved to the specified library ID.

dbUndefineProc.name: dbUndefineProc
dbUndefineProc.desc: Changes the parameterized cell specified by the d_cellView to be a regular cellview.

dbUnregPostSaveAsTrigger.name: dbUnregPostSaveAsTrigger
dbUnregPostSaveAsTrigger.desc: Allows users to unregister the trigger function called after a postSaveAs operation

dbUnregPostSaveTrigger.name: dbUnregPostSaveTrigger
dbUnregPostSaveTrigger.desc: Un-registers the post save trigger function from dbSave.

dbUnregSaveTrigger.name: dbUnregSaveTrigger
dbUnregSaveTrigger.desc: This function unregisters the SKILL preSave trigger function specified by the given name.

dbUnsetLibDataCompressionLevel.name: dbUnsetLibDataCompressionLevel
dbUnsetLibDataCompressionLevel.desc: Removes the data compression level of the specified library.

dbWriteSkill.name: dbWriteSkill
dbWriteSkill.syntax:
dbWriteSkill( 
d_cellViewId 
t_fileName 
t_mode 
t_release 
[ g_conn ] db
[ g_ref ] 
[ g_lppString ] 
) 
=> t / nil
dbWriteSkill.desc: Creates a file that contains all the SKILL commands needed to recreate a cellview, so that the design can be recreated in the current or previous release by loading the file in the current or previous release, respectively.

dbWriteSkillWithLib.name: dbWriteSkillWithLib
dbWriteSkillWithLib.syntax:
dbWriteSkillWithLib( 
d_cellviewId 
t_fileName 
t_mode 
t_release 
[ g_conn ] 
[ g_ref ] 
)
=> t / nil
dbWriteSkillWithLib.desc: Creates a file that contains all the SKILL commands needed to recreate a cellview.

dbCreateInst.name: dbCreateInst
dbCreateInst.syntax:
dbCreateInst( 
d_cellView 
d_master 
t_name 
l_point 
t_orient 
[ x_stopIndex ] 
[ g_physOnly]
) 
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateInst.desc: Creates an instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient. This function creates a named object and has a ROD ID associated with this object.

dbCreateParamInst.name: dbCreateParamInst
dbCreateParamInst.syntax:
dbCreateParamInst( 
d_cellView 
d_master 
t_name 
l_point 
t_orient 
[ x_numInst 
[ l_params 
[ g_physOnly ] ] ]
) 
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateParamInst.desc: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

dbCreateExtParamInst.name: dbCreateExtParamInst
dbCreateExtParamInst.syntax:
dbCreateExtParamInst(
d_cellView
d_master
t_name
l_point
t_orient
[ x_numInst
[ l_params
[ g_physOnly ] ] ]
)
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateExtParamInst.desc: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient. The parameters in the l_params list may be CDF parameters whose values match the CDF parameter defaults.

dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName.name: dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName
dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName.syntax:
dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName(
d_cellView
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_name
l_origin
t_orient
[ x_numInst
[ l_params
[ g_physOnly ] ] ]
)
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName.desc: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, for each parameter the function creates an explicit local user property on the instance, even if its value is the same as the default on the master.

dbCreateXformPCell.name: dbCreateXformPCell
dbCreateXformPCell.desc:
Creates a new Pcell supermaster with the additional parameters: mag and angle. The new Pcell is used in emulating magnification and any-angle rotation of instances. If the source cellview is maskLayout, the Pcell cell name is same as that of the source cellview, with _xform appended to it, otherwise, the viewName is similarly renamed.
This Pcell creates an instance of the source cellview, flattens it, and then transforms all the resultant shapes by adding the parameters mag and angle.
If the Pcell supermaster already exists, it is opened as read-only, and the cellview ID is returned.

dbDumpPcDefinePcell.name: dbDumpPcDefinePcell
dbDumpPcDefinePcell.desc: Writes out three lists to the file specified: The first list is a list of library names, cell names, and view names of the given cellview ID; the second list is of the parameter value; the last list is the SKILL procedure attached to the given cellview ID.

dbCheckParamCell.name: dbCheckParamCell
dbCheckParamCell.desc: Checks if the specified cellview is a valid parameterized cell. If there was an error during the reading, binding, or evaluation of the specified cellview, a description of the error is returned.

dbEvalParamCell.name: dbEvalParamCell
dbEvalParamCell.desc: Evaluates the supermaster; the parameters on all the instance headers are fixed, and the submasters are evaluated.

dbFixParamCell.name: dbFixParamCell
dbFixParamCell.desc: Fixes the parameterized cell for which the reading, binding, or evaluation has failed, by re-defining it with a different SKILL procedure defined in t_fileName.

dbFreeze.name: dbFreeze
dbFreeze.syntax:
dbFreeze( 
d_topCellViewId
t_regLibName
t_pcellLibName
[ g_cleanUp ]
)
=> d_figGroupId / nil
dbFreeze.desc: Freezes a Pcell design hierarchy into a non-Pcell design hierarchy by converting a Pcell instance into a static instance and converting a Pcell customVia into a static customVia. If t_regLibName and t_pcellLibName are different, regular and Pcell frozen instances will be put into two different libraries.

dbHasInstance.name: dbHasInstance
dbHasInstance.desc: Checks whether the specified cellview contains any instances.

dbIsCellViewModified.name: dbIsCellViewModified
dbIsCellViewModified.desc: Checks whether the specified cellview has been modified since the last open or last save.

dbReplaceParam.name: dbReplaceParam
dbReplaceParam.syntax:
dbReplaceParam( 
d_cellViewId
t_name
t_type
g_value
) 
=> d_prop / nil
dbReplaceParam.desc:
Add or modifies a cellview parameter if the cellview is a Pcell super master. If the cellview is not a super master, dbReplaceParam gives a warning stating that it cannot define a parameter for a non super master, and quits.
This function is only used on Pcell super master cellviews.

dbReplaceInstParamList.name: dbReplaceInstParamList
dbReplaceInstParamList.desc: Atomically replaces all the Pcell instance parameters with the given parameter list. The resulting Pcell subMaster is evaluated only once.

dbFindMemInstByName.name: dbFindMemInstByName
dbFindMemInstByName.syntax:
dbFindMemInstByName( 
d_cellView 
t_name 
) 
=> ( d_inst x_index ) / nil
dbFindMemInstByName.desc: Retrieves an instance or mosaic and returns its member index.

dbGetHierPathTransform.name: dbGetHierPathTransform
dbGetHierPathTransform.desc: Returns the concatenated transform of all instance or mosaic IDs present in the nested list passed as the parameter. The nested list represents the path to an object, such as the lists returned by dbGetTrueOverlaps or dbGetOverlaps.

dbGetInstByName.name: dbGetInstByName
dbGetInstByName.desc:
Retrieves an instance or mosaic.

dbGetInstByName is maintained only for backward compatibility; you should now use dbFindAnyInstByName.

dbGetInstanceByName.name: dbGetInstanceByName
dbGetInstanceByName.desc:
Retrieves an instance or mosaic.

dbGetInstanceByName is maintained only for backward compatibility; you should now use dbFindAnyInstByName.

dbGetInstNameNumInst.name: dbGetInstNameNumInst
dbGetInstNameNumInst.desc: Retrieves the number of instances of an instance or mosaic

dbGetInstTransform.name: dbGetInstTransform
dbGetInstTransform.desc: Returns the concatenated transform of all instance or mosaic IDs present in the nested list passed as the parameter. The nested list represents the path to an object, such as the lists returned by dbGetTrueOverlaps or dbGetOverlaps.

dbIsAnyInstBaseNameUsed.name: dbIsAnyInstBaseNameUsed
dbIsAnyInstBaseNameUsed.desc: Check if the name is used as instance basename in the cellview.

dbCreateInstByMasterName.name: dbCreateInstByMasterName
dbCreateInstByMasterName.syntax:
dbCreateInstByMasterName( 
d_cellView 
t_libName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
t_instName 
l_origin 
t_orient 
[ x_numInst ] 
[ g_physOnly ] 
) 
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateInstByMasterName.desc: Creates an instance (of cellview-t_libName/t_cellName/t_viewName) in d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

dbCreateParamInstByMasterName.name: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName
dbCreateParamInstByMasterName.syntax:
dbCreateParamInstByMasterName( 
d_cellView 
t_libName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
t_name 
l_origin 
l_orient 
[ x_numInst 
[ l_params 
[ g_physOnly ] ] ]
) 
=> d_inst / nil
dbCreateParamInstByMasterName.desc: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, when you create a Pcell instance and pass a parameter, with the same value as the default value, dbCreateParamInstByMasterName() does not create an explicit local user property on the instance because the value is the same as the default. If the value is different from the default, the function stores the value as a local property on the instance.

dbDumpPcell.name: dbDumpPcell
dbDumpPcell.syntax:
dbDumpPcell( 
d_cvId 
t_outputFile
t_pCellFile 
) 
=> t / nil
dbDumpPcell.desc: The dbDumpPcell function is used in the implementation of the keepPcell option, during streamIn and streamOut. Pcells are preserved by writing the Pcells to SKILL files (during StreamOut) which are loaded back into CDB/Virtuoso (during StreamIn).

dbDumpPcellWithLib.name: dbDumpPcellWithLib
dbDumpPcellWithLib.syntax:
dbDumpPcellWithLib( 
d_cvId 
t_outputFile
t_pCellFile 
) 
=> t / nil
dbDumpPcellWithLib.desc: Same functionality as dbDumpPcell, which preserves Pcells through StreamIn and StreamOut by writing the Pcells to SKILL files. dbDumbPcellWithLib does not directly write the library name in the SKILL code, instead writes a SKILL variable, dbD_NewLibNameForDump whose value can be set to the name of the target library before loading the SKILL file.

dbCreateViaShapeArray.name: dbCreateViaShapeArray
dbCreateViaShapeArray.syntax:
dbCreateViaShapeArray( 
d_techCVId 
g_viaLayer 
[ d_netId ] 
f_x 
f_y 
f_xPitch 
f_yPitch 
f_w 
f_length 
x_row 
x_column 
) 
=> l_xy / nil
dbCreateViaShapeArray.desc: Creates an array of via shapes (rectangles) on the given layer in the technology cellview and adds all the shapes to the given net.

dbSetInstHeaderMasterName.name: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName
dbSetInstHeaderMasterName.syntax:
dbSetInstHeaderMasterName( 
d_instHeader 
t_libName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
) 
=> t / nil
dbSetInstHeaderMasterName.desc: Sets the master of individual instance on the instHeader to the new master. All the instances are removed from the old instHeader and move to the new instHeader, which may exist or not. When an instHeader is empty, meaning it does not have any instance on this instHeader, the instHeader is removed and the ID is no longer valid.

dbIsSameMaster.name: dbIsSameMaster
dbIsSameMaster.desc: Determines if two instances or mosaics are instantiated from the same cellview master.

dbIsObjectBound.name: dbIsObjectBound
dbIsObjectBound.desc: Determines whether or not an object is bound. If the master cellview of the object is opened, the object is bound. Otherwise it is not bound.

dbGetCellViewSymmetry.name: dbGetCellViewSymmetry
dbGetCellViewSymmetry.desc: Returns the symmetry of the specified cellview.

dbSetCellViewSymmetry.name: dbSetCellViewSymmetry
dbSetCellViewSymmetry.desc: Sets the symmetry (or orientation) on a cellview (for which the ID is specified). The symmetry of the cellview can be set to a string value, such as X, Y, XY, any, or none, where X mirrors the cellview about the x axis and Y mirrors the cellview about the y axis.

dbGetCellViewEEQMaster.name: dbGetCellViewEEQMaster
dbGetCellViewEEQMaster.desc: Returns the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the cellview.

dbSetCellViewEEQMaster.name: dbSetCellViewEEQMaster
dbSetCellViewEEQMaster.desc: Sets the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the specified cellview.

dbIsInstTransparent.name: dbIsInstTransparent
dbIsInstTransparent.desc: Checks if the specified instance ID is set to be transparent to the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL binder.

dbSetInstTransparent.name: dbSetInstTransparent
dbSetInstTransparent.desc: Sets an instance as transparent to the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL binder.

dbCreateNet.name: dbCreateNet
dbCreateNet.syntax:
dbCreateNet( 
d_cellView 
t_name 
[ d_parentNet ] 
) 
=> d_net / nil
dbCreateNet.desc: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, returns nil.

dbCreateNamedSubNet.name: dbCreateNamedSubNet
dbCreateNamedSubNet.desc: Creates a subnet with the specified name. The behavior is different from dbCreateNet because when a root net ID is specified. dbCreateNameSubNet creates an explicitly named scalar net with the specified subnet name.

dbMakeNet.name: dbMakeNet
dbMakeNet.syntax:
dbMakeNet( 
d_cellView 
t_name 
[ d_parentNet ] 
) 
=> d_net / nil
dbMakeNet.desc: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, it returns the dbObject of the net.

dbMergeNet.name: dbMergeNet
dbMergeNet.desc: Merges one netId2 into netId1. The pins, terminals, connections, figures, properties, and signals of the merging net (netId2) are merged into the surviving net (netId1), and member nets of netId2's signals become members of netId1's signals. Both of the nets may already be attached to a terminal; both nets must have the same number of bits. If the two nets are in the same net hierarchy, netId1 must not be a descendant of netId2. If the merge is successful, netId1 is returned; otherwise, nil is returned.

dbCreateUniqueNamedNet.name: dbCreateUniqueNamedNet
dbCreateUniqueNamedNet.syntax:
dbCreateUniqueNamedNet( 
d_cellView 
t_prefix 
x_numBits 
) 
=> d_net / nil
dbCreateUniqueNamedNet.desc: Creates a new net with a unique name.

dbSetNetNameDescend.name: dbSetNetNameDescend
dbSetNetNameDescend.desc: Sets a mode, descending or ascending, which determines the direction of the net name vector expression.

dbIsNetNameDescend.name: dbIsNetNameDescend
dbIsNetNameDescend.desc: Checks if the net name descend mode is set or not.

dbNetIsSig.name: dbNetIsSig
dbNetIsSig.desc: Tests whether the specified net ID is also a signal.

dbDeleteAllNet.name: dbDeleteAllNet
dbDeleteAllNet.desc: Deletes all nets from a cellview.

dbCreateTerm.name: dbCreateTerm
dbCreateTerm.syntax:
dbCreateTerm( 
d_net 
t_name 
t_direction 
[ x_unused ]
[ g_physOnly ]
) 
=> d_term / nil
dbCreateTerm.desc: Creates a terminal for a net.

dbCreateInstTerm.name: dbCreateInstTerm
dbCreateInstTerm.syntax:
dbCreateInstTerm( 
d_net 
d_inst 
d_term 
) 
=> d_instTerm / nil
dbCreateInstTerm.desc: Creates an instance terminal on the instance d_inst for the master terminal d_term.

dbHasShortedTerminals.name: dbHasShortedTerminals
dbHasShortedTerminals.desc: Checks whether the specified cellview contains nets that are connected to multiple terminals.

dbCreatePin.name: dbCreatePin
dbCreatePin.syntax:
dbCreatePin( 
d_netId 
d_figId | nil
[ t_pinName | nil ] 
[ d_termId | nil] 

) 
=> d_pin / nil

dbCreateConn.name: dbCreateConn
dbCreateConn.syntax:
dbCreateConn( 
d_net 
d_inst 
d_term 
) 
=> d_instTerm / nil
dbCreateConn.desc: Identical to dbCreateInstTerm, except the net d_net defines a valid net to be connected to the instance terminal of a master terminal d_term.

dbCreateConnByName.name: dbCreateConnByName
dbCreateConnByName.syntax:
dbCreateConnByName( 
d_net 
d_inst 
t_name 
) 
=> d_instTerm / nil
dbCreateConnByName.desc: Similar to dbCreateConn, except the master terminal is defined by t_name instead of being specified by the master terminal's dbObject.

dbCreateConnByNewName.name: dbCreateConnByNewName
dbCreateConnByNewName.syntax:
dbCreateConnByNewName( 
d_net 
d_inst 
t_name 
) 
=> d_instTerm / nil
dbCreateConnByNewName.desc: Similar to dbCreateConnByName, except t_name can refer to a master terminal to be created in the master cellview of instance d_inst.

dbSubFigFromNet.name: dbSubFigFromNet
dbSubFigFromNet.desc: Removes the given figure object from the net object with which it is already associated.

dbAddFigToNet.name: dbAddFigToNet
dbAddFigToNet.desc: Assigns the given figure object to a specified net object. If the figure is already associated with a different net, the figure will be detached from that net before being assigned to the given net object.

dbGetNetVoltageRange.name: dbGetNetVoltageRange
dbGetNetVoltageRange.desc: Returns the minimum and maximum voltages on a net.

dbSetNetVoltageRange.name: dbSetNetVoltageRange
dbSetNetVoltageRange.syntax:
dbSetNetVoltageRange(
d_netId 
n_minVoltage
n_maxVoltage
)
=> t / nil
dbSetNetVoltageRange.desc: Sets the minimum and maximum voltages on the specified net.

dbUnsetNetVoltageRange.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRange
dbUnsetNetVoltageRange.desc: Resets the minimum and maximum voltages on a net to their default values.

dbGetNetVoltageRangeSource.name: dbGetNetVoltageRangeSource
dbGetNetVoltageRangeSource.desc: Returns the voltage range source of the specified net ID.

dbSetNetVoltageRangeSource.name: dbSetNetVoltageRangeSource
dbSetNetVoltageRangeSource.desc: Sets the voltage range source on the specified net ID.

dbUnsetNetVoltageRangeSource.name: dbUnsetNetVoltageRangeSource
dbUnsetNetVoltageRangeSource.desc: Resets the voltage range source of the specified net ID to its default value.

dbGetCellViewNetVoltageRange.name: dbGetCellViewNetVoltageRange
dbGetCellViewNetVoltageRange.desc: Returns the default minimum and maximum net voltages on the specified cellview ID.

dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange.name: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange
dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange.syntax:
dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange(
d_cvId 
n_minVoltage
n_maxVoltage
)
=> t / nil
dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange.desc: Sets the default minimum and maximum net voltages on a cellview ID.

dbIsCellViewNetVoltageRangeSet.name: dbIsCellViewNetVoltageRangeSet
dbIsCellViewNetVoltageRangeSet.desc: Ensures that the voltage range is set on a cellview.

dbUnsetCellViewNetVoltageRange.name: dbUnsetCellViewNetVoltageRange
dbUnsetCellViewNetVoltageRange.desc: Resets the voltage range on a cellview to its default value.

dbGetNetPowerDomain.name: dbGetNetPowerDomain
dbGetNetPowerDomain.desc: Returns the power domain associated with the specified net. A power domain can be a single string or a list of strings.

dbSetNetPowerDomain.name: dbSetNetPowerDomain
dbSetNetPowerDomain.desc: Sets the power domain for the specified net.

dbGetPowerDomainClusters.name: dbGetPowerDomainClusters
dbGetPowerDomainClusters.desc: Retrieves SKILL list of clusters in the specified cellView. Only clusters with clusterBoundary having power domain attribute are returned. Each entry contains the cluster name, cluster boundary name and voltage value.

dbRenameNet.name: dbRenameNet
dbRenameNet.desc: This function changes the name of the net pointed by netId to the newNetName.

dbIsCellViewPhysicalOnly.name: dbIsCellViewPhysicalOnly
dbIsCellViewPhysicalOnly.desc: Checks whether the connectivity detail of a cellview is visible only to the block domain or to both the block domain and the OpenAccess module domain.

dbUnsetCellViewPhysicalOnly.name: dbUnsetCellViewPhysicalOnly
dbUnsetCellViewPhysicalOnly.desc: Unsets the physical-only attribute of the specified cellview, allowing connectivity to be visible in the OpenAccess module domain.

dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity.name: dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity
dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity.syntax:
dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity(
d_termId
[ g_all ]
)
=> d_groundTermId | l_groundTermId / nil
dbGetAnyTermGroundSensitivity.desc: Returns ground sensitivity terminal information for the specified terminal. This terminal can be a multi-bit terminal.

dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity.name: dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity
dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity.syntax:
dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity(
d_termId
[ g_all ]
)
=> d_supplyTermId | l_supplyTermId / nil
dbGetAnyTermSupplySensitivity.desc: Returns the supply sensitivity terminal information for the specified terminal. The terminal can be a multi-bit terminal.

dbIsAnyTermGroundSensitivityConsistent.name: dbIsAnyTermGroundSensitivityConsistent
dbIsAnyTermGroundSensitivityConsistent.desc: Checks whether all the bits of the specified terminal have the same ground sensitivity terminal.

dbIsAnyTermSupplySensitivityConsistent.name: dbIsAnyTermSupplySensitivityConsistent
dbIsAnyTermSupplySensitivityConsistent.desc: Checks whether all the bits of the specified terminal have the same supply sensitivity terminal.

dbSetAnyTermGroundSensitivity.name: dbSetAnyTermGroundSensitivity
dbSetAnyTermGroundSensitivity.desc: Sets the ground sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the ground sensitivity value on implicit bits. The ground sensitivity values on explicit bits are not affected.

dbSetAnyTermSupplySensitivity.name: dbSetAnyTermSupplySensitivity
dbSetAnyTermSupplySensitivity.desc: Sets the supply sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the supply sensitivity value on implicit bits. The supply sensitivity value on explicit bits are not affected.

dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime.name: dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime
dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime.desc: Checks whether the equivalent connectivity time is set on the specified cellview.

dbGetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime.name: dbGetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
dbGetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime.desc: Retrieves the equivalent connectivity time that is set on the specified cellview.

dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime.name: dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime.desc: Sets the equivalent connectivity time on the specified cellview.

dbUnsetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTim.name: dbUnsetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
dbUnsetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTim.desc: Removes equivalent connectivity time information from the specified cellview.

dbDeleteEmptyNet.name: dbDeleteEmptyNet
dbDeleteEmptyNet.desc: Deletes a net that is not associated with other objects.

dbFindNetByName.name: dbFindNetByName
dbFindNetByName.desc: Retrieves a net in a cellview.

dbFindTermByName.name: dbFindTermByName
dbFindTermByName.desc: Finds a terminal in a cellview.

dbFindSigByName.name: dbFindSigByName
dbFindSigByName.desc: Finds a signal in a cellview.

dbFindSigByAlias.name: dbFindSigByAlias
dbFindSigByAlias.desc: Finds a signal in a cellview by an alias.

dbGetMemNetSig.name: dbGetMemNetSig
dbGetMemNetSig.syntax:
dbGetMemNetSig
dbGetMemNetSig( ( d_net x_index ) ) 
	=> d_sig / nil 

dbGetMemNetSig( d_net x_index ) 
	=> d_sig / nil
dbGetMemNetSig.desc: Retrieves the signal carried by bit number x_index of net d_net.

dbGetMemNetSigName.name: dbGetMemNetSigName
dbGetMemNetSigName.syntax:
dbGetMemNetSigName
dbGetMemNetSigName( d_net x_index ) 
	=> t_name / nil 

dbGetMemNetSigName( ( d_net x_index ) ) 
	=> t_name / nil
dbGetMemNetSigName.desc: Similar to dbGetMemNetSig, except it returns the name of the signal instead of the signal object.

dbGetNetTerms.name: dbGetNetTerms
dbGetNetTerms.desc: Returns the IDs of the terminals attached to the specified net.

dbGetSigNameMemNets.name: dbGetSigNameMemNets
dbGetSigNameMemNets.desc: Lists the member nets within the cellview that contain the signal.

dbIsSigNameGlobal.name: dbIsSigNameGlobal
dbIsSigNameGlobal.desc: Tests if the signal t_name is a global signal.

dbGetMemName.name: dbGetMemName
dbGetMemName.desc: Retrieves the name of the x_index member from t_name.

dbExpandToMemNameExpr.name: dbExpandToMemNameExpr
dbExpandToMemNameExpr.desc: Expands a bundle name to a list of member-name-expression strings.

dbGetMaxNumBit.name: dbGetMaxNumBit
dbGetMaxNumBit.desc: Returns the maximum width allowed for a net.

dbGetNameNumBit.name: dbGetNameNumBit
dbGetNameNumBit.desc: Parses a string and returns the number of bits in the net, terminal, or instance named.

dbMergeSignal.name: dbMergeSignal
dbMergeSignal.desc: Merges two signals into one signal.

dbMoveChildNet.name: dbMoveChildNet

dbGetOverlaps.name: dbGetOverlaps
dbGetOverlaps.syntax:
dbGetOverlaps(
d_cellView 
l_bBox 
[ l_layerPurposePair | tx_layer | g_value {t | nil} ]
[ lx_level ] 
[ g_doRowCol ]
) 
=> ld_fig / nil
dbGetOverlaps.desc:
Returns a list of all the objects (such as, vias, shapes, instances, and mosaics) in a cellview that overlaps the area specified by l_bBox. 
If the object comes from a lower level in the hierarchy, instead of from the specified cellview, the object is represented by a list (potentially a nested list, if it comes from more than one level down). Each level of the list has the ID of the instance in the corresponding level in the hierarchy. 
For example, if there is a rectangle in a master cellview two levels down, for this rectangle, in the top cellview, dbGetOverlaps will return a nested list. The output of this function is same as that of dbGetTrueOverlaps.

[ lx_level ]
[ g_doRowCol ]
)
=> ld_fig / nil
dbGetTrueOverlaps.desc:
Returns a list of all the objects (such as, vias, shapes, instances, and mosaics) in a cellview that overlap the area specified by l_bBox. 
If the object comes from a lower level in the hierarchy, instead of from the specified cellview, the object is represented by a list (potentially a nested list, if it comes from more than one level down). Each level of the list has the ID of the instance in the corresponding level in the hierarchy. 
For example, if there is a rectangle in a master cellview two levels down, for this rectangle, in the top cellview, the function will return a nested list. The output of this function is same as dbGetOverlaps.
You can switch the output syntax of dbGetTrueOverlaps between the new and legacy format by setting the noDetailedRow .cdsenv environment variable.

=> ld_shape / nil
dbProduceOverlap.desc: Returns a list of all the shapes in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding the overlapping shapes.

dbProduceOverlapInst.name: dbProduceOverlapInst
dbProduceOverlapInst.syntax:
dbProduceOverlapInst( 
d_cellView 
l_bBox 
[ lx_level ] 
) 
=> ld_inst / nil
dbProduceOverlapInst.desc: Returns a list of all the instances in a cellview that overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding instances.

txCreateFigSet.name: txCreateFigSet
txCreateFigSet.desc: Creates an empty FigSet with the specified name in the given cellview. If the name is not specified, it will be generated automatically. If a FigSet with the specified name already exists, an error message is issued.

txGetFigSetData.name: txGetFigSetData
txGetFigSetData.desc: Returns the nth object from the specified FigSet. This object is either a dbObject (CDB figure) or txObject (a FigSet or a transient shape).

txAppendObjectToFigSet.name: txAppendObjectToFigSet
txAppendObjectToFigSet.desc: Appends an object to the end of the specified FigSet. The object can be a figure or a FigSet.

txClearFigSet.name: txClearFigSet
txClearFigSet.desc: Clears the contents of the specified FigSet.

txCloneFigSet.name: txCloneFigSet
txCloneFigSet.desc: Makes FigSet1 a clone of FigSet2 by replacing the contents of FigSet1with equivalent entries from FigSet2. It creates references to the objects; it does not make copies of the objects. The name of FigSet1 is preserved.

txConcatFigSet.name: txConcatFigSet
txConcatFigSet.desc: Appends the contents of FigSet2 to the end of FigSet1.

txCopyFigSet.name: txCopyFigSet
txCopyFigSet.desc: Copies each figure from the source FigSet and applies to it the specified transform to create a new FigSet with an automatically generated name.

txFindFigSet.name: txFindFigSet
txFindFigSet.desc: Searches for a FigSet with the given name in the specified cellview. This function also searches for a FigSetGroup with the same name and automatically resurrects the corresponding FigSet from it, if required.

txDeleteFigSet.name: txDeleteFigSet
txDeleteFigSet.syntax:
txDeleteFigSet(
T_figSet
[ g_deep = nil ]
)
=> t / nil
txDeleteFigSet.desc: Deletes the specified FigSet. If the optional argument g_deep is set to true, then the FigSets referenced by the specified FigSet will also be recursively deleted.

txGetCellViewFigSets.name: txGetCellViewFigSets
txGetCellViewFigSets.desc: Returns the list of FigSets in the specified cellview.

txGetFigSetBBox.name: txGetFigSetBBox
txGetFigSetBBox.syntax:
txGetFigSetBBox(
T_figSet @key
(onlyTheseLayers l_onlyTheseLayers)
(onlyTheseLPPs l_onlyTheseLPPs)
(notTheseLayers l_notTheseLayers)
(notTheseLPPs l_notTheseLPPs)
(onlyTheseTypes l_onlyTheseTypes)
(notTheseTypes l_notTheseTypes)
)
=> l_bBox / nil
txGetFigSetBBox.desc: Calculates the bounding box for the objects in the specified FigSet. The caller can optionally specify included and excluded layers, included and excluded layer-purpose pairs (LPPs), and included and excluded object types. The bounding box values are returned in user units.

txIsFigSet.name: txIsFigSet
txIsFigSet.desc: Determines whether the specified object is a FigSet object.

txMakeFigSet.name: txMakeFigSet
txMakeFigSet.desc: Creates a FigSet from the given FigSetGroup in the specified cellview.

txMoveFigSet.name: txMoveFigSet
txMoveFigSet.desc: Moves each figure in the given FigSet using the specified transform.

txPrependObjectToFigSet.name: txPrependObjectToFigSet
txPrependObjectToFigSet.desc: Inserts an object in the beginning of the specified FigSet. The object may be a figure or a FigSet.

txRemoveFigSetData.name: txRemoveFigSetData
txRemoveFigSetData.desc: Removes the nth object from the specified FigSet.

txRemoveObjectFromFigSet.name: txRemoveObjectFromFigSet
txRemoveObjectFromFigSet.desc: Removes the specified object from the given FigSet, if the object is a member of this FigSet. This object can be a figure or a FigSet.

dbMakeFigSetGroup.name: dbMakeFigSetGroup
dbMakeFigSetGroup.desc: Creates a FigSetGroup in the specified cellview and populates it with the contents of the specified FigSet.

dbFindFigSetGroup.name: dbFindFigSetGroup
dbFindFigSetGroup.desc: Searches the specified cellview for a FigSetGroup that has the same name as the specified FigSet.

dbFindFigSetGroupByName.name: dbFindFigSetGroupByName
dbFindFigSetGroupByName.desc: Searches for the specified FigSetGroup name in the given cellview.

dbGetFigSetGroupName.name: dbGetFigSetGroupName
dbGetFigSetGroupName.desc: Returns the name of the specified FigSetGroup object.

dbGetCellViewFigSetGroups.name: dbGetCellViewFigSetGroups
dbGetCellViewFigSetGroups.desc: Returns a list of FigSetGroups in the specified cellview.

dbIsFigSetGroup.name: dbIsFigSetGroup
dbIsFigSetGroup.desc: Determines whether the specified object is a FigSetGroup.

dbDeleteFigSetGroup.name: dbDeleteFigSetGroup
dbDeleteFigSetGroup.desc: Deletes the specified FigSetGroup, including the hierarchy of FigSetGroups that may exist in this FigSetGroup.

dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid.name: dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid
dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid.desc: Returns a Boolean depending on whether the layer shift information on the instances in the specified cellview is synchronized with the layers and color information in the bound tech. This function is currently intended only for the advanced nodes release.

dbCellViewClearLayerShifts.name: dbCellViewClearLayerShifts
dbCellViewClearLayerShifts.desc: Clears the layer shift information from all instances in the specified cellview. Any cached layer shift specification for the tech bound to the cellview is left intact.

dbCellViewHasLayerShifts.name: dbCellViewHasLayerShifts
dbCellViewHasLayerShifts.desc: Returns a Boolean indicating whether there is layer shift information on any instance in the specified cellview.

dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts.name: dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts
dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts.desc: Creates or rebuilds the layer shift specification cache with the layers that are in the tech bound to the specified cellview. As a result, the per-layer shift information on the instances in the cellview is removed.

dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting.name: dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting
dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting.desc: Initializes the layer shift data for the given cell.

dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData.name: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData
dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData.syntax:
dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData(
d_cellView
[ ?dryRun { t | nil } ]
[ ?ignoreUnboundRefs { t | nil } ]
)
=> x_numClearedObjects / nil
dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData.desc: Opens hierarchy below the given cellview and removes all occShape coloring data that does not have any effect on the display of coloring data in the opened hierarchy. By default, if some instances or vias in the hierarchy cannot be bound, the function prints a warning message and returns nil, but cleanup can be forced with the ignoreUnboundRefs argument.

dbInstGetLayerShifts2.name: dbInstGetLayerShifts2
dbInstGetLayerShifts2.desc: Returns a list of shifts that are applied to the layers in the master of the specified instance.

dbInstHasLayerShifts.name: dbInstHasLayerShifts
dbInstHasLayerShifts.desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether per-layer color shifts are specified on the instance.

dbInstSetLayerShifts2.name: dbInstSetLayerShifts2
dbInstSetLayerShifts2.desc: Sets the given l_layerShifts on the specified instance.

dbInstClearLayerShifts.name: dbInstClearLayerShifts
dbInstClearLayerShifts.desc: Removes all per-layer color shifting information from the specified instance.

dbIsShapeColoringAllowed.name: dbIsShapeColoringAllowed
dbIsShapeColoringAllowed.desc: Indicates whether the specified shape is of a type that can be colored or not. Only the following shapes can be colored: arcs, lines, donuts, ellipses, pathSegs, paths, rects, and polygons.

dbIsShapeColored.name: dbIsShapeColored
dbIsShapeColored.desc: Indicates whether the specified shape is colored in a color other than grayColor.

dbGetShapeColor.name: dbGetShapeColor
dbGetShapeColor.desc: Returns the assigned color of the specified shape. By default, all newly created shapes are of the grayColor color type, which represents the currently assigned color of the shape.

dbSetShapeColor.name: dbSetShapeColor
dbSetShapeColor.desc: Assigns the specified color to the given shape if the color state is unlocked.

dbIsShapeColorLocked.name: dbIsShapeColorLocked
dbIsShapeColorLocked.desc: Indicates whether the coloring for the specified shape is locked.

dbSetShapeColorLocked.name: dbSetShapeColorLocked
dbSetShapeColorLocked.desc: Changes the color state of the shape.

dbIsBlockageColored.name: dbIsBlockageColored
dbIsBlockageColored.desc: Indicates whether the specified blockage is colored in a color other than grayColor.

dbIsBlockageColoringAllowed.name: dbIsBlockageColoringAllowed
dbIsBlockageColoringAllowed.desc: Indicates whether the specified blockage is of a blockage type that can be colored. Only layer blockages can be colored.

dbGetBlockageColor.name: dbGetBlockageColor
dbGetBlockageColor.desc: Returns the color assigned to the given blockage. The default color type is grayColor.

dbSetBlockageColor.name: dbSetBlockageColor
dbSetBlockageColor.desc: Assigns color to the specified blockage.

dbIsViaColorStateLocked.name: dbIsViaColorStateLocked
dbIsViaColorStateLocked.desc: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the coloring on the via is locked. The default value is nil.

dbSetViaColorStateLocked.name: dbSetViaColorStateLocked
dbSetViaColorStateLocked.desc: Sets the color state for the specified via.

dbIsViaColorStateLayerLocked.name: dbIsViaColorStateLayerLocked
dbIsViaColorStateLayerLocked.desc: Indicates whether the coloring for the specified individual layer in a via is locked.

dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked.name: dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked
dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked.syntax:
dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked(
d_dbViaId
t_dbViaLayerType
g_setLocked
)
=> t / nil
dbSetViaColorStateLayerLocked.desc: Locks and unlocks the color state for individual layers in a via.

dbGetViaLayerNumColorMasks.name: dbGetViaLayerNumColorMasks
dbGetViaLayerNumColorMasks.desc: Returns the number of supported color masks for specified layer of the given via.

dbGetViaLayer1Control.name: dbGetViaLayer1Control
dbGetViaLayer1Control.desc: Returns the color control assigned to layer1 of the via. Default value for color control is noShift.

dbGetViaLayer2Control.name: dbGetViaLayer2Control
dbGetViaLayer2Control.desc: Returns the color control assigned to layer 2 of the via. Default value for color control is noShift.

dbGetViaCutLayerControl.name: dbGetViaCutLayerControl
dbGetViaCutLayerControl.desc: Returns the color control assigned to the cut layer of the via. Default color control is noShift.

dbGetViaLayerControl.name: dbGetViaLayerControl
dbGetViaLayerControl.desc: Returns the color control assigned to the specified layer in the given via.

dbSetViaLayer1Control.name: dbSetViaLayer1Control
dbSetViaLayer1Control.desc: Sets the color control for layer1 shapes of the via master.

dbSetViaLayer2Control.name: dbSetViaLayer2Control
dbSetViaLayer2Control.desc: Sets the color control for layer2 shapes of the via master.

dbSetViaCutLayerControl.name: dbSetViaCutLayerControl
dbSetViaCutLayerControl.desc: Sets the color control for the cut layer shapes of the via master.

dbSetViaLayerControl.name: dbSetViaLayerControl
dbSetViaLayerControl.syntax:
dbSetViaLayerControl(
d_dbViaId
t_dbViaLayerType
t_colorControl
)
=> t / nil
dbSetViaLayerControl.desc: Sets the color control for the specified layer in the given via.

dbSetViaColorInfo.name: dbSetViaColorInfo
dbSetViaColorInfo.syntax:
dbSetViaColorInfo(
d_dbViaId
l_layer1ControlInfo 
l_layer2ControlInfo 
l_cutLayerControlInfo 
)
=> t / nil
dbSetViaColorInfo.desc: Updates the color control and color state for the three via layers (via layer1, via layer2, and cut layer) of the given via.

dbIsTrackPatternColored.name: dbIsTrackPatternColored
dbIsTrackPatternColored.desc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the first track of the specified track pattern is colored in a color other than gray.

dbIsTrackPatternColorAlternating.name: dbIsTrackPatternColorAlternating
dbIsTrackPatternColorAlternating.desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the coloring for the specified track pattern is alternating.

dbIsTrackPatternColoringAllowed.name: dbIsTrackPatternColoringAllowed
dbIsTrackPatternColoringAllowed.desc: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified track pattern can be colored. Only track patterns with specified track layer can be colored.

dbGetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor.name: dbGetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor
dbGetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor.desc: Returns the color assigned to the first track of the specified track pattern. Default color type is grayColor.

dbSetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor.name: dbSetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor
dbSetTrackPatternFirstTrackColor.desc: Assigns a color to the first track of the specified track pattern.

dbSetTrackPatternColorAlternating.name: dbSetTrackPatternColorAlternating
dbSetTrackPatternColorAlternating.desc: Sets the coloring type of the track pattern.

dbCreateSameMaskGroup.name: dbCreateSameMaskGroup
dbCreateSameMaskGroup.desc: Creates a same-mask, color shape group (d_group) in the specified cellview with the given name. The name must be unique amongst all same-mask groups in the cellview. You can only add shapes to the resulting group.

dbCreateDiffMaskGroup.name: dbCreateDiffMaskGroup
dbCreateDiffMaskGroup.syntax:
dbCreateDiffMaskGroup(
d_cellView
t_groupName
d_sameMaskGroup1
d_sameMaskGroup2
)
=> d_group / nil
dbCreateDiffMaskGroup.desc: Creates a diff-mask, color shape group (d_group) in the specified cellview with a pair of same-mask color shape groups and with the given name. The name must be unique amongst all diff-mask groups in the cellview.

dbGetSameMaskDiffMaskGroups.name: dbGetSameMaskDiffMaskGroups
dbGetSameMaskDiffMaskGroups.desc: Accepts an object with the same mask color group as a parameter and returns a list of all groups of type 'diffMaskColor'.

dbGetShapeSameMaskGroups.name: dbGetShapeSameMaskGroups
dbGetShapeSameMaskGroups.desc: Accepts the object of the shape for which you want to retrieve a list of all groups of type 'sameMaskColor'.

dbColorShapeQuery.name: dbColorShapeQuery
dbColorShapeQuery.syntax:
dbColorShapeQuery( 
d_cellViewId
l_layerPurposePair
l_bBox
[ x_startLevel ]
[ x_stopLevel ]
[ n_filterSize ]
[ l_transform ]
)
=> l_shapeColorPairs / nil
dbColorShapeQuery.desc: Returns a list of all shapes and their effective color, where the bounding boxes of the shapes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

dbGetIntegrationColorModel.name: dbGetIntegrationColorModel
dbGetIntegrationColorModel.desc: Returns a string value of the integration color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any or locked.

dbGetColorModel.name: dbGetColorModel
dbGetColorModel.desc: Returns a string value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

dbSetIntegrationColorModel.name: dbSetIntegrationColorModel
dbSetIntegrationColorModel.desc: Sets the value of the integration color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any or locked.

dbSetColorModel.name: dbSetColorModel
dbSetColorModel.desc: Sets the value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. It specifies how you want the contents of the block to be color-shifted. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

dbRemoveLayerColorData.name: dbRemoveLayerColorData
dbRemoveLayerColorData.syntax:
dbRemoveLayerColorData(
d_cellViewId
t_layerName
g_locked
[ g_via g_hcl g_instColorShift g_blockage g_trackPattern ]
)
=> t / nil
dbRemoveLayerColorData.desc: Removes the color data from the specified layer in the given cellview. By default, all color data is removed. You can optionally preserve the via color data, hierarchical color locks, layer shift information, blockage color data, and track pattern color data.

dbColorShapeQuery2.name: dbColorShapeQuery2
dbColorShapeQuery2.syntax:
dbColorShapeQuery2( 
d_cellViewId
l_layerPurposePair
l_bBox
[ x_startLevel ]
[ x_stopLevel ]
[ n_filterSize ]
[ l_transform ]
)
=> l_occShapesWithColorAndState / nil
dbColorShapeQuery2.desc: Returns a list of shapes and occurrence shapes within a given region, and the coloring information for each shape. The coloring information includes the color, whether the color is locked, and whether the coloring is due to the color attribute or hierarchical color locking on the shape.

dbGetColoredOccShapes.name: dbGetColoredOccShapes
dbGetColoredOccShapes.desc: Generates a list of all the occurrence shapes, associated with the specified instance or via, that were colored due to hierarchical color locking. If the optional argument b_lockedOnly is t, only the locked colored occurrence shapes are included.

dbGetShapeEffectiveColor.name: dbGetShapeEffectiveColor
dbGetShapeEffectiveColor.desc: Implements a query for individual colored shapes. This function takes an occurrence shape (a list consisting of the absolute hierarchical path and the master shape) as an argument. It returns the color of the shape and two Boolean values that indicate whether the color state is locked and whether it was colored by hierarchical color locking.

dbSetOccShapeColor.name: dbSetOccShapeColor
dbSetOccShapeColor.desc: Assigns the specified color to the given occurrence shape. You can set the color for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

dbSetOccShapeColorLocked.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLocked
dbSetOccShapeColorLocked.desc: Changes the color state of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state for occurrence shapes with types Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

dbGetHierColorOverride.name: dbGetHierColorOverride
dbGetHierColorOverride.desc: Returns the occurrence shape with the topmost hierarchical color lock that defines the effective color of the given occurrence shape. nil is returned if the effective color of the given occurrence shape is not defined by a hierarchical color lock.

dbGetShapeColorLockType.name: dbGetShapeColorLockType
dbGetShapeColorLockType.desc: Returns the color lock type assigned to the specified shape. If the shape is not locked, nil is returned.

dbSetShapeColorLockType.name: dbSetShapeColorLockType
dbSetShapeColorLockType.desc: Sets the color lock type for the specified shape.

dbGetViaLayerColorLockType.name: dbGetViaLayerColorLockType
dbGetViaLayerColorLockType.desc: Returns the color lock type assigned to the specified via layer.

dbSetViaLayerColorLockType.name: dbSetViaLayerColorLockType
dbSetViaLayerColorLockType.syntax:
dbSetViaLayerColorLockType(
d_viaId
t_viaLayer
g_lockType
)
=> t / nil
dbSetViaLayerColorLockType.desc: Sets the color lock type for the specified via layer.

dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges.name: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges
dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges.syntax:
dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges( 
d_cellViewId 
[ g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs ] 
) 
=> t / nil
dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges.desc: Checks whether any edits were done to the specified type of objects in the older versions of Virtuoso after color lock type information was set for some of them.

dbGetShapeEffectiveColorLockType.name: dbGetShapeEffectiveColorLockType
dbGetShapeEffectiveColorLockType.desc: Returns the effective color lock type of the specified occurrence shape. It is either the color lock type of the topmost HCL, returned by dbGetHierColorOverride or the color lock type of the shape itself.

dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes.name: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes
dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes.syntax:
dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes( 
d_cellViewId
t_value 
[g_shapes g_vias g_HCLs]
) 
=> t / nil
dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes.desc: Changes color lock type for all color-locked objects of the specified object types to the given value.

dbSetOccShapeColorLockType.name: dbSetOccShapeColorLockType
dbSetOccShapeColorLockType.desc: Changes the color lock type of the specified occurrence shape. You can set the color state only for occurrence shapes with the following types: Path, PathSeg, Polygon, and Rect.

dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern
dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern.syntax:
dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern( 
d_cellView
t_name
l_patternSpecs
[ n_offset ]
[ g_repeatOffset ]
[ g_shiftColor ]
[ t_allowedRepeatMode ]
[ t_defaultRepeatMode ]
)
=> d_widthSpacingPattern / nil
dbCreateWidthSpacingPattern.desc: Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified cellview.

dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.syntax:
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor(
d_cellView
t_name
l_patternSpecs
t_startingColor
[ n_offset ]
[ g_repeatOffset ]
[ t_allowedRepeatMode ]
[ t_defaultRepeatMode ]
)
=> d_widthSpacingPattern / nil
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.desc: Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified cellview. This function requires you to specify the color for only the first track, referred to as the starting color. All other tracks are colored automatically by shifting colors.

dbFindWidthSpacingPattern.name: dbFindWidthSpacingPattern
dbFindWidthSpacingPattern.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern with the given name in the specified cellview and technology library.

dbGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatMod.name: dbGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatMode
dbGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatMod.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the allowed repeat mode for the specified width spacing pattern.

dbGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatMod.name: dbGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatMode
dbGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatMod.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the default repeat mode of the specified width spacing pattern.

dbGetWidthSpacingPatterns.name: dbGetWidthSpacingPatterns
dbGetWidthSpacingPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of all width spacing pattern IDs in the specified cellview.

dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.name: dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode
dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.syntax:
dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode(
d_wspId
t_allowedRepeatMode
t_defaultRepeatMode
)
=> t / nil
dbSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets a valid combination of allowed and default repeat modes for the specified width spacing pattern.

dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.syntax:
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup(
d_cellView
t_name
l_patternNames
)
=> d_widthSpacingPatternGroup / nil
dbCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a group of width spacing patterns in the specified cellview.

dbGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups.name: dbGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups
dbGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of all width spacing pattern group IDs from the specified cellview.

dbFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup.name: dbFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup
dbFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern group with the specified name in the given cellview and technology library.

dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.name: dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.syntax:
dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef( 
d_cellViewId 
t_name
(tx_layer [tx_purpose])
t_direction
n_period
t_defaultActivePattern
[ l_snappingLayers ]
[ n_offset ]
[ l_patternNames ]
[ l_patternGroupNames ]
[ g_gridType ]
)
=> widthSpacingSnapPatternDefId / nil
dbCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object in the specified cellview.

dbFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName.name: dbFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName
dbFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object in the specified cellview.

dbDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.name: dbDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
dbDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Deletes the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object.

dbGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP.name: dbGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP
dbGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns all the widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs on a layer-purpose pair.

dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.name: dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns
dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.syntax:
dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns(
d_cellView
t_name
l_relatedSnapPatterns
[l_rowRegionSpecNames]
[l_extraLPP]   
[f_regionSnapPitchHorizontal]    
[f_regionSnapPitchVertical]
)
=> d_relatedSnapPatterns / nil
dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a group of related snap patterns in the specified cellview.

dbGetRelatedSnapPatterns.name: dbGetRelatedSnapPatterns
dbGetRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of related snap pattern IDs from the specified cellview.

dbFindRelatedSnapPatterns.name: dbFindRelatedSnapPatterns
dbFindRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Searches for the group of related snap patterns with the specified name in the given cellview and technology library.

dbGetPatternRegionActivePattern.name: dbGetPatternRegionActivePattern
dbGetPatternRegionActivePattern.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the name of the currently set active pattern for the specified shape.

dbSetPatternRegionActivePattern.name: dbSetPatternRegionActivePattern
dbSetPatternRegionActivePattern.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given active pattern for the specified shape.

dbHasPatternRegionActivePattern.name: dbHasPatternRegionActivePattern
dbHasPatternRegionActivePattern.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether the specified shape has an associated active pattern.

dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns.name: dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns
dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of allowed pattern names for the specified shape.

dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns
dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given allowed patterns for the specified shape.

dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups.name: dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups
dbGetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of allowed pattern groups for the specified shape.

dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups.name: dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups
dbSetPatternRegionAllowedPatternGroups.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the given allowed pattern groups for the specified shape.

dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatterns.name: dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatterns
dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatterns.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns a list of committed pattern names for the specified shape.

dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatternShiftC.name: dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatternShiftColor
dbGetPatternRegionCommittedPatternShiftC.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether a specific committed pattern was committed with or without a color shift.

dbGetPatternRegionCreateType.name: dbGetPatternRegionCreateType
dbGetPatternRegionCreateType.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the create type of the specified shape. Possible values of create type are systemCreated and userCreated.

dbGetPatternRegionShiftColor.name: dbGetPatternRegionShiftColor
dbGetPatternRegionShiftColor.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether shift color is enabled for the specified shape.

dbSetPatternRegionShiftColor.name: dbSetPatternRegionShiftColor
dbSetPatternRegionShiftColor.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether shift color is enabled for the specified shape.

dbHasPatternRegionInfo.name: dbHasPatternRegionInfo
dbHasPatternRegionInfo.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Determines whether the specified shape contains pattern region information.

dbGetPatternRegionName.name: dbGetPatternRegionName
dbGetPatternRegionName.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the name of the pattern region set for the specified shape.

dbSetPatternRegionName.name: dbSetPatternRegionName
dbSetPatternRegionName.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified pattern region for the specified shape.

dbGetPatternRegionWidthSpacingSnapPatter.name: dbGetPatternRegionWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefName
dbGetPatternRegionWidthSpacingSnapPatter.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Returns the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef name from the specified pattern region.

)
=> t / nil
pkxPadFile.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Pads the specified SiP file with so-called magic bytes up front. Magic bytes are a set of bytes that can be added to a SiP file to encrypt it. The import assisted flow takes a SiP file as an input to generate a Virtuoso RF Solution 5x hierarchy. In the process, the original SiP file can be modified incrementally in the assisted export flow. However, to ensure that the original SiP file can be retrieved, it is padded before any modification is done.

pkxUnPadFile(

)
=> t / nil
pkxUnPadFile.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Removes the padding from the specified SiP file using magic bytes.

ccIsEnabled.name: ccIsEnabled

t_y
l_interval
) 
=> o_curve / nil
ccCreateCurve.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object using the specified parametric functions and interval.

ccCreateFacet.name: ccCreateFacet
ccCreateFacet.syntax:
ccCreateFacet(
l_origin
[ ?angle n_angle ]
[ ?radius n_radius ]
[ ?offsets l_offsets ]
[ ?name t_name ]
)
=> o_facet / nil
ccCreateFacet.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccFacet object. A facet is a special type of straight segment that is specified by the origin point, offsets, curvature, and rotation angle. It can be used to implement a smooth stitching between two ccShape objects.

ccCreateLineSegment.name: ccCreateLineSegment
ccCreateLineSegment.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccCurve object that represents a straight line segment connecting two specified points.

ccCreatePolyCurve.name: ccCreatePolyCurve
ccCreatePolyCurve.syntax:
ccCreatePolyCurve(
l_segments
[ ?close { t | nil } ]
[ ?smoothness S_smoothness ]
) 
=> o_polyCurve / nil
ccCreatePolyCurve.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPolyCurve object from a list of specified polyCurve segments.

ccCreateEllipse.name: ccCreateEllipse
ccCreateEllipse.syntax:
ccCreateEllipse(
d_cellViewId
l_lpp
l_llPoint
l_urPoint
?offset l_offset 
?rotation n_rotation
?genFigs g_genFigs
)
=> o_surface / nil
ccCreateEllipse.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates an ellipse with the specified coordinates as a ccSurface object in the cellview with specified layer-purpose pair. The ellipse is then transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

ccCreateLine.name: ccCreateLine
ccCreateLine.syntax:
ccCreateLine(
d_cellViewId
l_lpp
g_polyCurveSegments
)
=> o_line / nil
ccCreateLine.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccLine object at the specified layer-purpose pair of the given cellview from either a ccPolyCurve object or a list of polyCurve segments forming a polyCurve. When list of polyCurve segments is specified the resulting polyCurve should be of class G2, otherwise, the function terminates with an error.

ccCreatePath.name: ccCreatePath
ccCreatePath.syntax:
ccCreatePath(
d_cellviewId
l_lpp
l_segments
[?defaultWidth g_defWidth] 
[?smoothness   S_smoothness]
) 
=> o_path / nil
ccCreatePath.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a ccPath object on the specified layer-purpose pair from one or a list of path segments.

ccCreatePie.name: ccCreatePie
ccCreatePie.syntax:
ccCreatePie(
d_cellviewId
l_lpp 
[ ?angle n_angle ] 
[ ?startRadius n_startRadius ]
[ ?length n_length ]
[ ?endWidth n_endWidth ]
[ ?endLength n_endLength ]
[ ?offset l_offset ]
[ ?rotation n_rotation ]
[ ?genFigs { t | nil } ]
) 
=> o_surface / nil
ccCreatePie.desc:
(Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a pie slice figure bounded by outer circle and optionally by an inner circle, two radiuses at given angles, and optionally by an outer capping of given length. The function generates different figures based on the input. 

When the startRadius is nil, the pie shape that is generated is a true pie shape, with the length being the radius. 

When the startRadius is larger than 0.0, a donut shape is generated, with the inner part radius determined by the value, while the length is used to represent the thickness of the donut. 

When endWidth is specified, a termination is generated, caping the coupler by a shape that is conceptually the union of a rectangle and the last pie shape, with the inner-curved radius as specified. In this case, endWidth must be smaller than the arc defined by sum of radius and length and larger than the arc from radius. 

If rotation or offset is specified, the resulting the object undergoes corresponding transformation.

ccCreatePolygon.name: ccCreatePolygon
ccCreatePolygon.syntax:
ccCreatePolygon(
d_cellview
l_lpp
l_points
?offset l_offset  
?rotation n_rotation
?genFigs g_genFigs
) 
=> o_surface | nil
ccCreatePolygon.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a polygon with the specified vertices as the ccSurface in the specified cellview and on the specified layer-purpose pair. The polygon is transformed according to the specified offset and rotation. Optionally, OpenAccess figures (polygons) are created.

This function can be used to turn positive-closed polyCurves into negative polyCurves, and negative-closed polyCurves into positive polyCurves.

ccTransformPolyCurve.name: ccTransformPolyCurve

ccBendConnector.name: ccBendConnector
ccBendConnector.syntax:
ccBendConnector(
l_port
n_radius
n_bangle 
n_rmin
n_gamma
) 
=> l_connector / nil
ccBendConnector.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a bend connector making a circular turn from the specified starting port with the radius, bend angle, and gamma fraction given in ccWaypointConnector. The connector consists of a central circular arc and two apex clothoids matching its curvature at one end and with zero curvature at the other end. Gamma is the ratio of the circular bend angle to the total bend angle.

ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList.name: ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList
ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList.syntax:
ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList(
n_startWidth
n_endWidth
S_taperStyle
o_polyCurve
[ ?startClamp n_startClampLength ]
[ ?endClamp n_endClampLength ]
)
=> l_segmentsWidths
ccCreateConnectorWidthExpressionList.desc:
(Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a list of curved segments with the corresponding width expressions defining a tapered connector path of the specified tapering style with the specified start and end width around the centerline specified by the input polyCurve. 

The segments of the input polyCurve are assumed to be parametrized by the arc length in the same way as the segments created by the connector generation functions ccBendConnector, ccCurveConnector, and ccWaypointConnector. 

The tapering width function can optionally be clamped to have zero derivative at either or both the ends of the connector with the length of the clamping regions specified by the specified clamp lengths.

ccCurveConnector.name: ccCurveConnector
ccCurveConnector.syntax:
ccCurveConnector(
l_port1
l_port2
n_rmin
[ ?method x_method ]
[ ?parameters l_parameters ]
) 
=> l_connector | nil
ccCurveConnector.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a curve connector with two specified ports and a minimum curvature radius. Depending on the input, the connector consists of different combinations of line, circle, and clothoid curve segments.

ccSpiralConnector.name: ccSpiralConnector
ccSpiralConnector.syntax:
ccSpiralConnector(
n_lengthInnerSpiral0
n_lengthOuterSpiral1
x_numberOfTurns
n_minRadius
n_gamma 
[ ?portLocation t_location ]
)
=> l_connector / nil
ccSpiralConnector.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a spiral connector that consists of an inner S-shaped figure of two joined circular bend connectors. Each endpoint of S is prolonged by a straight extension and then by N-turnings of a spiral circling around S.

ccTromboneConnector.name: ccTromboneConnector
ccTromboneConnector.syntax:
ccTromboneConnector(
l_legs 
n_rmin
n_gamma 
) 
=> l_connector / nil
ccTromboneConnector.desc: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a trombone-shaped connector that consists of five legs of given lengths, smoothly connected by waypoint connectors with the given gamma ratio and the minimum curvature radius.

ccWaypointConnector.name: ccWaypointConnector
ccWaypointConnector.syntax:
ccWaypointConnector(
l_port1   
l_port2   
l_points  
n_rmin
n_gamma   
) 
=> l_connector / nil
ccWaypointConnector.desc:
(Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a waypoint connector between the specified points with the given minimum curvature radius and the given portion (gamma) of the circular bending angle in the overall bending angle.

If both ports are nil, then at least three waypoints must be specified as input. The connector starts at the first waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the first two waypoints and ends at the last waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the last two waypoints.

If both ports are not nil, they specify the initial and the final points, tangents, and radiuses of the connector. 

If no waypoints are specified, the start and the end ports are connected by a curve connector. 

If a single waypoint is specified, it is connected to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoint. 

If two waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other with a straight line and to the start and the end ports with a pair of curve connectors with zero curvatures at the waypoints. 

If three or more waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other by a waypoint connector like in the case where both ports are nil and to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoints.

It is an error to only specify one port as nil and the other port as not nil.

The waypoint connector consists of a sequence of lines, circles, and clothoids. If the calculation of the waypoint connector can only be partially completed, then the result will only contain segments between the starting point and the point where the calculation failed.

[ ?saveResult s_saveResult ]
[ ?trace g_trace ] 
) 
=> t
ccORE.desc:
Evaluates Optical Rule Engine (ORE) expressions specified in a file or a SKILL list. Expressions are evaluated on the source cellview and the resulting markers and shapes are stored in the source cellview or optionally in the destination cellview. The evaluation can  be limited only to shapes on the specified layer-purpose pairs and down to the specified level of hierarchy. 

The default values defined in the expressions can be overridden by the specified parameter values. The ORE context can be saved at the end of the run under a specified name and loaded at the beginning of the next run by referring to the same name. The evaluation of ORE expressions can optionally be traced and the list of ORE objects resulting from them saved in a SKILL variable.

The instances of the waveguide building blocks are abutted together into a chain and the chain has the same input and output connectivity as the original composite waveguide.

phoWayPointConnector.desc: (ICADVM20.1 Photonics Only) Returns a waypoint connector that connects the start port to the end port by a sequence of straight-line segments and bend connectors. The straight-line segments are defined by a polynomial line through a series of waypoints. This series of waypoints is defined by the key argument ?shapeDataList.

pgssDRC.name: pgssDRC
pgssDRC.syntax:
pgssDRC(
d_cellviewID
t_rulesFile
t_layerMap
t_objectMap
l_options
g_function
) 
=> t / nil
pgssDRC.desc: Launches Pegasus DRC and processes the generated shapes in accordance with the specified function. The pgssDRC SKILL function needs Pegasus license.

pvsApplyDRC.name: pvsApplyDRC
pvsApplyDRC.syntax:
pvsApplyDRC
d_cellview
t_rulesFile
t_layerMap
t_objectMap
l_options
g_function
) 
=> t / nil
pvsApplyDRC.desc: Launches Virtuoso IPVS and process generated shapes.

ddAmUsingDM.name: ddAmUsingDM
ddAmUsingDM.desc: Uses a Design Management system if the library containing b_objId.

ddAutoCheckin.name: ddAutoCheckin
ddAutoCheckin.syntax:
ddAutoCheckin( 
l_ddIds 
[ g_isBatch( { t | nil } ) ] 
)
=> l_list
ddAutoCheckin.desc: Automatically checks in an object or list of objects. Objects in a temporary directory cannot be managed. The function skips objects that exist only in the temporary directory of the library and displays a warning for them.

ddAutoCheckout.name: ddAutoCheckout
ddAutoCheckout.syntax:
ddAutoCheckout( 
l_ddIds 
[ g_isBatch( { t | nil } ) ] 
)
=> l_list
ddAutoCheckout.desc: Checks out an object or list of objects automatically. Objects in a temporary directory cannot be managed; this function skips objects that exist only in the library's temporary directory and displays a warning for them.

ddAutoCtlGetVars.name: ddAutoCtlGetVars
ddAutoCtlGetVars.desc:
Returns a list of four elements in the following order:

x_prompCkout
x_promptCkin
x_AutoCkout
x_AutoCkin

Each element is a value from 0 through 3 as in ddAutoCtlSetVars. Each element can have one of four values: 0 - none, 1 - views, 2 - files, 3 - both views and files.

ddAutoCtlSetVars.name: ddAutoCtlSetVars
ddAutoCtlSetVars.syntax:
ddAutoCtlSetVars( 
x_promptCkout 
x_promptCkin 
x_AutoCkout 
x_AutoCkin 
)
=> t
ddAutoCtlSetVars.desc: Sets prompting and automatic check-in and check-out controls for files and views. Takes a list of four integers, each of which can be one of four values: 0 - none, 1 - views, 2 - files, 3 - both views and files. The integers are applied to indicate to the system to prompt for check out, prompt for check in, automatically check out, and automatically check in respectively.

ddCatRefresh.name: ddCatRefresh
ddCatRefresh.desc: Given the DD ID of a category file, this function will purge the in-memory copy of the file and read it in again from disk. This will update the in-memory copy. Refresh is allowed only if the category was opened in read mode.

ddCheckin.name: ddCheckin
ddCheckin.syntax:
ddCheckin( 
g_files 
t_description 
[ t_switches ] 
)
=> t / nil
ddCheckin.desc: Checks in the new version of the checked-out and modified data files. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmci command. ddCheckin makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

ddCheckout.name: ddCheckout
ddCheckout.desc: Checks out a version of the files. No version of a cellview can be checked out by any user until any version that is currently checked out is checked in. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmco command. ddCheckout makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

ddClearLibUnmanaged.name: ddClearLibUnmanaged
ddClearLibUnmanaged.desc: Removes any DMTYPE entry from the cdsinfo.tag file in the library directory. This will allow the default value for DMTYPE to be used for this library.

ddCreateLib.name: ddCreateLib
ddCreateLib.desc: Searches for the named library in the library list.

ddDeleteLocal.name: ddDeleteLocal
ddDeleteLocal.desc: Removes b_objectId from the local work area only. If the objects are under design management, they are not removed from the repository.

ddDumpLibList.name: ddDumpLibList
ddDumpLibList.desc: Prints information about the library list. It first prints the list of library files (cds.lib and lib.defs files) and then prints information about each library in the library list. This includes the path to the library and the path to TMP directories, if any.

ddGetCoManagedSet.name: ddGetCoManagedSet
ddGetCoManagedSet.desc: Returns the list of comanaged files for the specified view.

ddGetCombineValue.name: ddGetCombineValue
ddGetCombineValue.desc: Returns a list of names of libraries in a combined library, if the library specified has the COMBINE attribute assigned.

ddGetDisplayValue.name: ddGetDisplayValue
ddGetDisplayValue.desc: Returns the value of the DISPLAY attribute assigned to a library.

ddGetForcedLib.name: ddGetForcedLib
ddGetForcedLib.desc: Returns the path to the cds.lib file that was set by using either the -cdslib argument to the executable or by using ddSetForcedLib.

ddGetForcedLibEx.name: ddGetForcedLibEx
ddGetForcedLibEx.desc: Gets the cds.lib file that was set with the ddSetForcedLib or ddSetForcedLibEx functions or with the -cdslib command line option.

ddGetLibList.name: ddGetLibList
ddGetLibList.desc: Generates a list of the libraries in the libList.

ddsGetLibManLogFileName.name: ddsGetLibManLogFileName
ddsGetLibManLogFileName.desc: Returns the path to the log file created by Library Manager.

ddGetObj.name: ddGetObj
ddGetObj.syntax:
ddGetObj( 
{ t_libName / nil } 
[ t_cellName / nil ] 
[ t_viewName / nil ] 
[ t_fileName / nil ] 
[ b_contextId / nil ] 
[ t_mode ] 
) 
=> b_ddId / nil
ddGetObj.desc: Finds libraries, cells, views, and files, and creates cells, views, and files (you use ddCreateLib to create libraries).

ddGetObjAccess.name: ddGetObjAccess
ddGetObjAccess.desc: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId.

ddGetObjAccessEx.name: ddGetObjAccessEx
ddGetObjAccessEx.syntax:
ddGetObjAccessEx(
b_objId 
t_which 
x_pathType
) 
=> t_access / nil
ddGetObjAccessEx.desc: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjAccess except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjChildren.name: ddGetObjChildren
ddGetObjChildren.desc: Returns the children of b_objId. This includes all the objects in both the temporary and master directories.

ddGetObjChildrenEx.name: ddGetObjChildrenEx
ddGetObjChildrenEx.desc: Returns the children of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjChildren except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjDMSys.name: ddGetObjDMSys
ddGetObjDMSys.desc: Returns the name of the Design Management system of b_objId.

ddGetObjFiles.name: ddGetObjFiles
ddGetObjFiles.desc: Lists all the files found in the object. This includes files found in both the master and temporary directories.

ddGetObjFilesEx.name: ddGetObjFilesEx
ddGetObjFilesEx.desc: Lists all the files found in the object. This function is similar to ddGetObjFiles except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjGroup.name: ddGetObjGroup
ddGetObjGroup.desc: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer.

ddGetObjGroupEx.name: ddGetObjGroupEx
ddGetObjGroupEx.desc: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer. This function is similar to ddGetObjGroup except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjLastModify.name: ddGetObjLastModify
ddGetObjLastModify.desc: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId.

ddGetObjLastModifyEx.name: ddGetObjLastModifyEx
ddGetObjLastModifyEx.desc: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjLastModify except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjLib.name: ddGetObjLib
ddGetObjLib.desc: Finds the ID of the library object that contains it b_objId. If the object is a library, it returns the same ID.

ddGetObjOwner.name: ddGetObjOwner
ddGetObjOwner.desc: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId.

ddGetObjOwnerEx.name: ddGetObjOwnerEx
ddGetObjOwnerEx.desc: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjOwner except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjParent.name: ddGetObjParent
ddGetObjParent.desc: Returns the ID of the logical (often physical as well) owner-object od b_objId. For a file, it is the library, cell, or view. For a view, it is the cell. For the cell, it is the library. For the library, it is the library itself.

ddGetObjReadPath.name: ddGetObjReadPath
ddGetObjReadPath.desc: Returns the read path to b_objId.

ddGetObjReadPathEx.name: ddGetObjReadPathEx
ddGetObjReadPathEx.desc: Returns the read path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjReadPath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjSize.name: ddGetObjSize
ddGetObjSize.desc: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes.

ddGetObjSizeEx.name: ddGetObjSizeEx
ddGetObjSizeEx.desc: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes. This function is similar to ddGetObjSize except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetObjWritePath.name: ddGetObjWritePath
ddGetObjWritePath.desc: Returns the write path to b_objId.

ddGetObjWritePathEx.name: ddGetObjWritePathEx
ddGetObjWritePathEx.desc: Returns the write path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjWritePath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

ddGetPathDMSys.name: ddGetPathDMSys
ddGetPathDMSys.desc: Takes a string that is the path to a file or directory and either returns the string name of the design management system that manages that path or returns none if no design management system is in use for that path.

ddGetStartup.name: ddGetStartup
ddGetStartup.desc: Looks for t_fileName in each standard place, and if it is not there, in stdPlace/share/cdssetup.

ddGetTmpdirWarn.name: ddGetTmpdirWarn
ddGetTmpdirWarn.desc:
Returns the current setting used to suppress or print a warning message for an ASSIGN statement with attribute TMP that appears in cds.lib files. The TMP attribute defines a temporary storage directory for a read-only or reference library. If you set the DD_TMPDIR_ON environment variable to NO, the temporary directory functionality is turned off and DDPI skips ASSIGN and UNASSIGN statements when parsing cds.lib files and, by default, prints the following warning: 
WARNING `<PATH_TO_CDSLIB_FILE>/cds.lib', Line 3: skipping: 'ASSIGN' lib1 TMP /tmp

ddGetTriggerList.name: ddGetTriggerList
ddGetTriggerList.desc: Returns a list of functions registered to be executed when t_triggerName is activated.

ddGetUpdatedLib.name: ddGetUpdatedLib
