hiEnableMenuItem.desc: Makes unselectable menu items in pull-down, pop-up, or fixed menus selectable.

hiFixedMenuDown.name: hiFixedMenuDown
hiFixedMenuDown.desc: Removes the specified fixed menu from the screen.

hiGetMenuItems.name: hiGetMenuItems
hiGetMenuItems.desc: Returns a list of the menu items in the specified menu.

hiGetWindowMenu.name: hiGetWindowMenu
hiGetWindowMenu.desc: Returns the symbol of the menu associated with the specified window. This menu was associated with a window by using hiSetWindowMenu.

hiInsertMenuItem.name: hiInsertMenuItem
hiInsertMenuItem.syntax:
hiInsertMenuItem(
r_hiMenu 
r_menuItem
g_position 
) 
=> t / nil
hiInsertMenuItem.desc: Inserts a menu item or action into a specified position of all instances of r_hiMenu.

hiIs2DMenu.name: hiIs2DMenu
hiIs2DMenu.desc: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid 2D menu.

hiIsIcon.name: hiIsIcon
hiIsIcon.desc: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid icon.

hiIsMenu.name: hiIsMenu
hiIsMenu.desc: Determines whether the specified argument is a valid menu.

hiIsMenuItemEnabled.name: hiIsMenuItemEnabled
hiIsMenuItemEnabled.syntax:
hiIsMenuItemEnabled(
r_hiMenu
s_itemHandle
[ w_windowId ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiIsMenuItemEnabled.desc: Determines whether a menu item is enabled.

hiSetMenuItemCallback.name: hiSetMenuItemCallback
hiSetMenuItemCallback.syntax:
hiSetMenuItemCallback(
r_hiMenu 
s_itemHandle 
t_callback 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetMenuItemCallback.desc: Changes the callback associated with all instances of a specified menu item.

hiSetMenuItemStatusTip.name: hiSetMenuItemStatusTip
hiSetMenuItemStatusTip.syntax:
hiSetMenuItemStatusTip(
r_hiMenu
s_itemHandle
t_statusTip
)
=> t / nil
hiSetMenuItemStatusTip.desc: Sets the status tip for the specified menu item. The status tip is displayed on the status bar at the bottom of the window when the mouse hovers over the menu item.

hiSetMenuItemText.name: hiSetMenuItemText
hiSetMenuItemText.syntax:
hiSetMenuItemText(
r_hiMenu 
s_itemHandle 
t_itemText 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetMenuItemText.desc: Changes the text associated with all instances of a specified menu item.

hiSetWindowMenu.name: hiSetWindowMenu
hiSetWindowMenu.desc: Associates the given menu with the specified window.

ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox.name: ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox
ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox.syntax:
ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox(
?name s_name 
[ ?prompt t_prompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?toolTip t_toolTip ] 
[ ?validationType g_validationType ] 
[ ?highlightType g_highlightType ] 
) 
=> o_comboBox
ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox.desc: Creates a customized Cell combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting cells.

ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox.name: ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox
ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox.syntax:
ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox(
?name s_name 
[ ?prompt t_prompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?toolTip t_toolTip ] 
[ ?validationType g_validationType ] 
[ ?highlightType g_highlightType ] 
) 
=> o_comboBox
ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox.desc: Creates a customized Library combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting libraries.

ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox.name: ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox
ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox.syntax:
ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox(
?name s_name 
[ ?prompt t_prompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?toolTip t_toolTip ] 
[ ?viewTypes l_viewTypes ]
[ ?validationType g_validationType ] 
[ ?highlightType g_highlightType ] 
) 
=> o_comboBox
ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox.desc: Creates a customized View combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting views.

hiAddToolbarItem.name: hiAddToolbarItem
hiAddToolbarItem.desc: Adds one toolbar item to a toolbar. The item is added to the end of the toolbar.

hiAddToolbarItems.name: hiAddToolbarItems
hiAddToolbarItems.desc: Adds a list of toolbar items to a toolbar. The items are added at the end of the toolbar.

hiCreateAction.name: hiCreateAction
hiCreateAction.syntax:
hiCreateAction(
?name s_name
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?icon g_icon ]
[ ?iconText t_iconText ]
[ ?toolTip t_tooltip ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?checkable g_checkable ]
[ ?checked g_checked ]
[ ?defAction g_defaultAction ]
[ ?actionList l_actionList ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?useNameForIconText g_useNameForIconText ]
)
=> o_action
hiCreateAction.desc: Creates an action for a toolbar or menu. An action is a toolbar or menu item that, when clicked, triggers a callback. Actions are typically used for common commands that are added to multiple places in the user interface, such as toolbars and menus. An action present in both a toolbar and a menu remains synchronized. For example, if it is selected from the toolbar, the corresponding menu item is also checked.

hiCreateToolbar.name: hiCreateToolbar
hiCreateToolbar.syntax:
hiCreateToolbar(
?name s_name
[ ?title t_title ]
[ ?toolButtonStyle s_buttonStyle ]
[ ?toolTip t_toolTip ]
[ ?items l_toolbarItems ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?contextMenuItems l_contextMenuItems ]
)
=> o_hiToolbar
hiCreateToolbar.desc: Creates a toolbar that you can add to windows and session windows. A toolbar is a container object that can contain combo boxes, type-in items, actions, and separators.

hiCreateToolbarComboBox.name: hiCreateToolbarComboBox
hiCreateToolbarComboBox.syntax:
hiCreateToolbarComboBox(
?name s_name
?items l_items
[ ?prompt t_prompt ]
[ ?value t_value ]
[ ?toolTip t_tooltip ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?iconFile t_iconFile ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ]
)
=> o_comboBox
hiCreateToolbarComboBox.desc: Creates a drop-down list box item (popularly called a combo box) to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar. The drop-down list box has a type-in field as well as a drop-down list. You can either type in a value or select an item from the list.

hiCreateToolbarTypein.name: hiCreateToolbarTypein
hiCreateToolbarTypein.syntax:
hiCreateToolbarTypein(
?name s_name
[ ?prompt t_prompt ]
[ ?value t_value ]
[ ?tooltip t_tooltip ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?statusTip t_statusTip ]
[ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ]
)
=> o_typein
hiCreateToolbarTypein.desc: Creates a type-in field to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar.

hiCreateToolbarSeparator.name: hiCreateToolbarSeparator
hiCreateToolbarSeparator.desc: Creates a separator that is used to separate the items in a toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar.

hiDeleteToolbar.name: hiDeleteToolbar
hiDeleteToolbar.desc: Deletes a toolbar from a window.

hiDeleteToolbarBreak.name: hiDeleteToolbarBreak
hiDeleteToolbarBreak.desc: Deletes the toolbar break before the specified toolbar from the toolbar area of a window.

hiDeleteToolbarItem.name: hiDeleteToolbarItem
hiDeleteToolbarItem.desc: Deletes a toolbar item from a toolbar.

hiDeleteToolbarItems.name: hiDeleteToolbarItems
hiDeleteToolbarItems.desc: Removes the specified toolbar items from a toolbar.

hiFocusToToolbarItem.name: hiFocusToToolbarItem
hiFocusToToolbarItem.syntax:
hiFocusToToolbarItem(
?toolbar S_toolbar 
?item S_toolbarItem 
[?warpPointer g_warp] 
[?window w_window]
)
=> t / nil
hiFocusToToolbarItem.desc: Sets the keyboard focus on a visible, enabled, and editable toolbar type-in or combo item.

hiGetSharedIcon.name: hiGetSharedIcon
hiGetSharedIcon.desc: Gets the icon associated with an action. The icon is in the format in which it was originally specified: an image file name or an hiIcon list.

hiGetToolbarObjName.name: hiGetToolbarObjName
hiGetToolbarObjName.desc: Gets the name that is used to store the toolbar window configuration information. This name is set with the hiSetToolbarObjName function.

hiGetWindowToolbars.name: hiGetWindowToolbars
hiGetWindowToolbars.desc: Gets the list of toolbars that a window contains. The toolbars are listed in the order in which they were placed in the window with hiPlaceToolbar.

hiHasToolbarBreak.name: hiHasToolbarBreak
hiHasToolbarBreak.desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether there was a toolbar break before the specified toolbar.

hiHideToolbar.name: hiHideToolbar
hiHideToolbar.desc: Hides a toolbar. If g_detach is set to t, this function removes the toolbar from the window.

hiInsertToolbar.name: hiInsertToolbar
hiInsertToolbar.syntax:
hiInsertToolbar(
w_windowID
o_hiToolbar
s_toolbar
)
=> t / nil
hiInsertToolbar.desc: Inserts a toolbar into the toolbar area of a window before s_toolbar.

hiInsertToolbarBreak.name: hiInsertToolbarBreak
hiInsertToolbarBreak.desc: Inserts a toolbar break into the toolbar area of a window before the specified toolbar.

hiInsertToolbarItem.name: hiInsertToolbarItem
hiInsertToolbarItem.syntax:
hiInsertToolbarItem(
o_hiToolbar
o_hiToolbarItem
s_toolbarItemBefore
)
=> t / nil
hiInsertToolbarItem.desc: Inserts a toolbar item before a specific item in a toolbar.

hiInsertToolbarItems.name: hiInsertToolbarItems
hiInsertToolbarItems.syntax:
hiInsertToolbarItems(
o_hiToolbar
l_hiToolbarItems
s_toolbarItemBefore
)
=> t / nil
hiInsertToolbarItems.desc: Inserts toolbar items before the specified item in a toolbar.

hiListFocusableToolbarItems.name: hiListFocusableToolbarItems
hiListFocusableToolbarItems.desc: Lists all type-in and combo toolbar items that are currently defined in the specified window and can be used as arguments for the function hiFocusToToolbarItem.

hiPlaceToolbar.name: hiPlaceToolbar
hiPlaceToolbar.syntax:
hiPlaceToolbar(
w_windowID
o_hiToolbar
[ s_toolbarArea ]
)
=> t / nil
hiPlaceToolbar.desc: Adds a toolbar to the specified toolbar area of a window. If the toolbar already exists on the window, this function moves it to the specified area. The toolbar is placed at the end of the current toolbars in that area.

hiPlaceToolbarBreak.name: hiPlaceToolbarBreak
hiPlaceToolbarBreak.desc: Adds a toolbar break to the specified toolbar area of a window.

hiReattachToolbar.name: hiReattachToolbar
hiReattachToolbar.desc: Reattaches a given toolbar to its parent main window without showing it.

hiSetToolbarObjName.name: hiSetToolbarObjName
hiSetToolbarObjName.desc: Sets a name for the toolbar that is used for storing window configuration information about the toolbar. Every toolbar must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with toolbars provided by Cadence.

hiSetActionChecked.name: hiSetActionChecked
hiSetActionChecked.syntax:
hiSetActionChecked(
o_action
g_checkState
[ g_triggerCB ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetActionChecked.desc: Sets checked state for an action and triggers the action callback, unless you specify otherwise by setting g_triggerCB to nil.

hiDisplayAppDBox.name: hiDisplayAppDBox
hiDisplayAppDBox.syntax:
hiDisplayAppDBox(
?name s_dboxHandle 
[ ?dboxBanner t_dboxBanner ]
[ ?dboxText t_dboxText ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?dialogType x_dialogType ]
[ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ] 
[ ?buttonLayout s_buttonLayout ]
[ ?buttons g_buttons ]
[ ?dontPopdowns g_dontPopdowns ]
[ ?defaultButton x_defaultButton ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?help g_help ]
) 
=> t / nil / cancel
hiDisplayAppDBox.desc: Creates and displays a dialog box. You can add a pre-defined set of buttons to the dialog box or you can specfiy your own buttons. The dialog box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

hiDisplayUserDBox.name: hiDisplayUserDBox
hiDisplayUserDBox.syntax:
hiDisplayUserDBox(
?name s_dboxHandle
[ ?dboxBanner t_dboxBanner ]
[ ?dboxText t_dboxText ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?dialogType x_dialogType ]
[ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ]
[ ?defaultButton x_defaultButton ]
?buttons g_buttons
[ ?callbacks g_callbacks ]
[ ?dontPopdowns g_dontPopdowns ]
[ ?help g_help ]
)
=> buttonIndex / callbackReturnVal / t / nil
hiDisplayUserDBox.desc: Creates and displays a dialog box. This function lets you customize buttons in the dialog box. You can also choose whether the dialog box is removed from the screen or not when a button is pressed. Using this function is equivalent to using hiDisplayAppDBox with s_buttonLayout set to 'UserDefined.

hiDBoxCancel.name: hiDBoxCancel
hiDBoxCancel.desc: Function logged when either the Cancel or the No button is pressed on a dialog box. This function can also be called directly from SKILL to simulate pressing No or Cancel.

hiDBoxOK.name: hiDBoxOK
hiDBoxOK.desc: Function logged when the OK, Yes or Done button is pressed in a dialog box. This function can also be called directly from SKILL to simulate pressing OK, Yes or Done.

hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation.name: hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation
hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation.syntax:
hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation(
l_location
[ g_autoUpdate { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation.desc: Sets the default location for all dialog boxes created with hiDisplayAppDBox, hiDisplayUserDBox, hiDisplayProgressBox, and hiDisplayFileDialog. This setting is used if the l_location argument of those functions has not been set or has been set incorrectly.

hiGetDBoxDefaultLocation.name: hiGetDBoxDefaultLocation
hiGetDBoxDefaultLocation.desc: Gets the default location of all dialog boxes, which has been set with the hiSetDBoxDefaultLocation function.

hiDisplayFileDialog.name: hiDisplayFileDialog
hiDisplayFileDialog.syntax:
hiDisplayFileDialog(
[ ?dialogName s_dialogName ]
[ ?workingDir t_workingDir ]
[ ?filter t_filter ]
[ ?mode s_mode ]
[ ?modal g_modal ]
[ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?userData s_userData ]
[ ?caption t_caption ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?acceptMode s_acceptMode ]
[ ?labelText t_labelText ]
[ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ]
)
=> l_userSelection / nil
hiDisplayFileDialog.desc: Creates and displays a file selection dialog box, which lets users select a file or directory. The dialog box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

hiFileDialogSelection.name: hiFileDialogSelection
hiFileDialogSelection.desc: Returns the selection made by the user in the file dialog box. This function is typically called from a user callback.

hiFileDialogSetSelection.name: hiFileDialogSetSelection
hiFileDialogSetSelection.desc: This function is logged when a selection is made from a file dialog.

hiFileDialogDone.name: hiFileDialogDone
hiFileDialogDone.desc: This function is logged when a file dialog box is dismissed. Applications do not need to call this function; it is provided for replay purposes.

hiGetExistingFile.name: hiGetExistingFile
hiGetExistingFile.syntax:
hiGetExistingFile(
[ ?workingDir t_workingDir ]
[ ?filter t_filter ]
[ ?dialogName s_dialogName ]
[ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?userData s_userData ]
[ ?caption t_caption ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?modal g_modal ]
)
=> l_userSelection / nil
hiGetExistingFile.desc: Calls hiDisplayFileDialog with the mode set to 'existingFile. Use this function to ask the user to select a file to open.

hiGetExistingFiles.name: hiGetExistingFiles
hiGetExistingFiles.syntax:
hiGetExistingFiles(
[ ?workingDir t_workingDir ]
[ ?filter t_filter ]
[ ?dialogName s_dialogName ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?userData s_userData ]
[ ?caption t_caption ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?modal g_modal ]
)
=> l_userSelection / nil
hiGetExistingFiles.desc: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'existingFiles. Use this function to ask the user to select the files to open.

hiGetAnyFile.name: hiGetAnyFile
hiGetAnyFile.syntax:
hiGetAnyFile(
[ ?workingDir t_workingDir ]
[ ?filter t_filter ]
[ ?dialogName s_dialogName ]
[ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?userData s_userData ]
[ ?caption t_caption ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?modal g_modal ]
[ ?acceptMode s_acceptMode ]
[ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ]
)
=> l_userSelection / nil
hiGetAnyFile.desc: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'anyFile. Use this function to prompt the user to specify the name of a file to open or save.

hiGetExistingDirectory.name: hiGetExistingDirectory
hiGetExistingDirectory.syntax:
hiGetExistingDirectory(
[ ?workingDir t_workingDir ]
[ ?dirOnly g_dirOnly ]
[ ?dialogName s_dialogName ]
[ ?defaultValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?callback t_callback ]
[ ?userData s_userData ]
[ ?caption t_caption ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?modal g_modal ]
)
=> l_userSelection / nil
hiGetExistingDirectory.desc: Calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'dirOnly. If the ?dirOnly argument is nil, calls hiDisplayFileDialogBox with the mode set to 'directory. Use this function to ask the user to select a directory.

hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep.name: hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep
hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep.desc: Increments the  progress bar by one step for the specified window.

hiCancelProgressBox.name: hiCancelProgressBox
hiCancelProgressBox.desc: Programmatically cancels a progress dialog box. Calls the callback procedure for the dialog box, if any.

hiDisplayProgressBox.name: hiDisplayProgressBox
hiDisplayProgressBox.syntax:
hiDisplayProgressBox(
?name s_name
[ ?banner t_banner ]
[ ?text t_text ]
[ ?location l_location ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?totalSteps x_totalSteps ]
[ ?delay x_delay ]
[ ?autoClose g_autoClose ]
)
=> t / nil
hiDisplayProgressBox.desc: Creates a progress dialog box that displays the progress of a command. The progress dialog box is always modeless (non-blocking).

hiGetProgress.name: hiGetProgress
hiGetProgress.desc: Gets the current progress (that is, the current step) from a progress dialog box.

hiGetProgressBarCurrentStep.name: hiGetProgressBarCurrentStep
hiGetProgressBarCurrentStep.desc: Returns the current step of the progress bar from the window specified.

hiGetProgressBarTotalSteps.name: hiGetProgressBarTotalSteps
hiGetProgressBarTotalSteps.desc: Returns the maximum number of total steps for the  progress bar from the window specified.

hiGetProgressTotalSteps.name: hiGetProgressTotalSteps
hiGetProgressTotalSteps.desc: Gets the total number of steps of the progress bar in a progress dialog box.

hiHideProgressBar.name: hiHideProgressBar
hiHideProgressBar.desc: Removes the progress bar (and its label) from the window you specify.

hiIsProgressBoxCancelled.name: hiIsProgressBoxCancelled
hiIsProgressBoxCancelled.desc: Checks whether a progress box is canceled. A progress box is considered canceled if it is canceled with the Cancel button, canceled with the hiCancelProgressBox function, closed from the window manager, or automatically closed when the progress bar reaches 100% (if it was created with the ?autoClose argument set to t).

hiSetProgress.name: hiSetProgress
hiSetProgress.desc: Sets the progress bar in a progress dialog box to the step you specify. Note, however, that the text above the progress bar remains the same; use hiSetProgressText to update the text or hiSetProgressAndText to update both the step and the text.

hiSetProgressText.name: hiSetProgressText
hiSetProgressText.desc: Sets the text that is displayed above the progress bar in a progress dialog box.

hiSetProgressTotalSteps.name: hiSetProgressTotalSteps
hiSetProgressTotalSteps.syntax:
hiSetProgressTotalSteps(
g_dboxID
x_totalSteps
x_step
)
=> t / nil
hiSetProgressTotalSteps.desc: Sets the total number of steps on the progress bar in a progress dialog box. This function also sets the current step.

hiSetProgressAndText.name: hiSetProgressAndText
hiSetProgressAndText.syntax:
hiSetProgressAndText(
g_dboxID
x_step
t_text
)
=> t / nil
hiSetProgressAndText.desc: In a progress dialog box, sets the current step of the progress bar as well as the text that is displayed above the progress bar.

hiSetProgressButtonText.name: hiSetProgressButtonText
hiSetProgressButtonText.desc: Changes the text of the button on a progress dialog box. Progress dialog boxes, created with hiDisplayProgressBox, have one button, whose default text is Cancel.

hiSetProgressBannerText.name: hiSetProgressBannerText
hiSetProgressBannerText.desc: Sets the text that is displayed on the window banner of a progress dialog box.

hiResetProgressBox.name: hiResetProgressBox
hiResetProgressBox.syntax:
hiResetProgressBox(
g_pboxID
x_totalSteps
t_text
g_autoClose
)
=> t / nil
hiResetProgressBox.desc: Resets a progess dialog box to the new values you specify. The progress bar is also reset to 0%.

hiShowProgressBar.name: hiShowProgressBar
hiShowProgressBar.syntax:
hiShowProgressBar(
w_windowID
[ x_totalSteps ]
[ x_delay ]
[ t_label ]

)
=> t / nil
hiShowProgressBar.desc: Displays a progress bar in the status bar of a window, typically in the bottom-right corner. The progress bar displays the progress of a command.

hiSetProgressBar.name: hiSetProgressBar
hiSetProgressBar.desc: Sets the progress (the current step) of the progress bar in the window you specify.

hiSetProgressLabel.name: hiSetProgressLabel
hiSetProgressLabel.desc: Sets the label of the progress bar in the specified window. An empty string removes the label.

hiDisplayColorDialog.name: hiDisplayColorDialog
hiDisplayColorDialog.desc: Displays the Select color dialog, which lets you select a color. This function returns the RGB (Red, Green, and Blue) value of the color you select as well as the alpha channel value, if the ?alpha argument was t. The Select color dialog is a modal dialog.

hiDisplayBlockingDBox.name: hiDisplayBlockingDBox
hiDisplayBlockingDBox.desc: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

hiDisplayModalDBox.name: hiDisplayModalDBox
hiDisplayModalDBox.syntax:
hiDisplayModalDBox(
s_dBoxHandle 
t_dBoxBannerText 
t_dBoxMsg 
g_dBoxHelp 
t_confirmAction
[ l_location ]
[ x_dboxType ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiDisplayModalDBox.desc: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

hiDisplayModelessDBox.name: hiDisplayModelessDBox
hiDisplayModelessDBox.syntax:
hiDisplayModelessDBox(
s_dBoxHandle 
t_dBoxBannerText 
t_dBoxMsg 
g_dBoxHelp 
t_confirmAction
[ l_location ]
[ x_dboxType ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiDisplayModelessDBox.desc: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function. Additionally, set ?dialogStyle to 'modeless.

hiDisplayNonBlockingDBox.name: hiDisplayNonBlockingDBox
hiDisplayNonBlockingDBox.desc: Use hiDisplayAppDBox, which is the recommended dialog box interface function.

hiDisplayListBox.name: hiDisplayListBox
hiDisplayListBox.syntax:
hiDisplayListBox(
s_listBoxHandle 
t_listBoxTitle 
l_listItems 
t_help
) 
=> t / nil
hiDisplayListBox.desc: Creates and displays a list box. The list box displays a list of strings. The user can select one of these strings by clicking over the item with the left mouse button. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen

hiGetListBoxFieldFit.name: hiGetListBoxFieldFit
hiGetListBoxFieldFit.desc: Returns the width and height necessary for displaying a list box with the specified number of rows and columns and the specified font.

hiListBoxCancel.name: hiListBoxCancel
hiListBoxCancel.desc: Performs the same action as the Cancel button on the listbox.

hiListBoxDone.name: hiListBoxDone
hiListBoxDone.desc: Performs the same action as the OK button on the listbox.

hiShowListBox.name: hiShowListBox
hiShowListBox.syntax:
hiShowListBox(
?name s_listBoxHandle 
?choices lt_listItems 
?callback s_callback 
[?title t_listBoxTitle] 
[?multipleSelect g_multiSelect]
[?value lt_selectedItem]
[?appData g_appData]
[?applyButton g_applyButton]
) 
=> t / nil
hiShowListBox.desc: Creates and displays a list box. The list box displays a list of strings. The list box can be created so that one item is selectable or multiple items are selectable. While the list box is displayed on the screen, the user may change the items in the list box, or change the item(s) selected. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

colorIndex.name: colorIndex
colorIndex.desc: Returns the pixel value for the colormap index of the specified RGB value. This function is an alias for hiMatchColor.

hiAddIconOverrides.name: hiAddIconOverrides
hiAddIconOverrides.desc: Adds names to the list of icons that are loaded using CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

hiCreateColorArray.name: hiCreateColorArray
hiCreateColorArray.desc: Example: colorArray[0] is represented by a or A; colorArray[12] is represented by m or M; colorArray[26] is represented by a period (.).

hiGetIconOverrides.name: hiGetIconOverrides
hiGetIconOverrides.desc: Returns the list of icon names that are loaded by the CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

hiLoadIconFile.name: hiLoadIconFile
hiLoadIconFile.syntax:
hiLoadIconFile(
t_fileName
x_width
x_height
)
=> l_hiIcon / nil
hiLoadIconFile.desc: Loads an icon file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the icon in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

hiLoadImageFile.name: hiLoadImageFile
hiLoadImageFile.syntax:
hiLoadImageFile(
t_fileName
x_width
x_height
)
=> l_hiImage / nil
hiLoadImageFile.desc: Loads an image file of any format, such as PNG, and returns the image in a format that can be used with hi functions that accept icons. If t_fileName is a relative path, the Cadence Search File mechanism (CSF) is used to search for the file.

hiLoadIconData.name: hiLoadIconData
hiLoadIconData.desc: Loads a pixmap and returns it in a format that can be used with any hi function that accepts icons, such as hiCreateMenuItem or hiCreateButton. This function can load files that are in any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently these are:  BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. PNG is the recommended format.

hiMatchColor.name: hiMatchColor
hiMatchColor.desc: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified RGB color. It creates a new color index if the color specified does not have any corresponding index.

hiMatchColorByName.name: hiMatchColorByName
hiMatchColorByName.desc: Returns a layer color index corresponding to the specified color name.

hiRemoveIconOverrides.name: hiRemoveIconOverrides
hiRemoveIconOverrides.desc: Removes names from the list of icons that are loaded using the CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

hiSaveIconData.name: hiSaveIconData
hiSaveIconData.syntax:
hiSaveIconData(
l_hiIcon
t_fileName
[ t_formatName ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSaveIconData.desc: Saves a loaded pixmap to a file in the specified format. This function accepts an hi pixmap description and converts it to any of the image formats supported by Qt; currently, these are: BMP, JPG, PNG, PPM, XBM, and XPM. However, PNG is the recommended format.

hiStringToIcon.name: hiStringToIcon
hiStringToIcon.syntax:
hiStringToIcon(  
a_colorArray 
t_iconString 
x_width 
x_height 
) 
=> l_hiIcon / nil
hiStringToIcon.desc: Returns an icon description that can be used in hi functions that accept icons, such as  hiCreatePulldownMenu, hiCreateMenuItem, hiCreateSliderMenuItem, hiCreateButton, hiCreateCyclicField, hiCreateLabel, and hiAddCyclicChoice.

hiSetDisabledIcon.name: hiSetDisabledIcon
hiSetDisabledIcon.desc: Specifies a disabled icon for an icon, which is displayed whenever the icon is disabled. This function only applies to icons used in menus, not to icons used in form fields or buttons.

nameToColor.name: nameToColor
nameToColor.desc: Specifies the color name as string or symbol.

hiAddItemToLayout.name: hiAddItemToLayout
hiAddItemToLayout.syntax:
hiAddItemToLayout( 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
g_item 
[ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ] 
[ ?toLayout s_layoutName ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiAddItemToLayout.desc: Adds the required controls to the layout.

hiAddField.name: hiAddField
hiAddField.syntax:
hiAddField( 
g_formRegionOrLayout
g_field 
[ x_attachment | s_layout [ l_field_controls ] ] 
)
=> t / nil
hiAddField.desc: Adds a field to a form. The form must already exist, and the field must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

hiAddFields.name: hiAddFields
hiAddFields.syntax:
hiAddFields( 
g_formRegionOrLayout
l_items
[ g_attachmentsOrLayout ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiAddFields.desc: Adds fields to a form. The form must already exist, and the fields must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

hiCreateFormLayout.syntax:
hiCreateFormLayout( 
s_name 
[ ?items l_items ] 
[ ?frame g_frame ] 
[ ?margins l_margins ] 
[ ?spacing g_spacing ] 
[ ?label_align g_labelAlign ]
[ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ] 
[ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?scrollable g_scrollable]
) 
=> r_hiLayout
hiCreateFormLayout.desc: Creates a form layout by specifying the labels, margins, spacing, and alignment.

hiCreateGridLayout.name: hiCreateGridLayout
hiCreateGridLayout.syntax:
hiCreateGridLayout( 
s_name 
[ ?items l_items ] 
[ ?frame g_frame ] 
[ ?margins l_margins ]

[ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?scrollable g_scrollable]
) 
=> r_hiLayout
hiCreateGridLayout.desc: Creates a grid layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout.name: hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout
hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout.syntax:
hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout( 
s_name 
[ ?items l_items ] 
[ ?frame g_frame ] 
[ ?margins l_margins ] 
[ ?spacing g_spacing ] 
[ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ] 
[ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?scrollable g_scrollable ]
) 
=> r_hiLayout
hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout.desc: Creates a horizontal box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

hiCreateStackedLayout.name: hiCreateStackedLayout
hiCreateStackedLayout.syntax:
hiCreateStackedLayout( 
s_name 
[ ?items l_items ] 
[ ?frame g_frame ] 
[ ?margins l_margins ] 
[ ?currentIndex g_currentIndex ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?scrollable g_scrollable ]
) 
=> r_hiLayout
hiCreateStackedLayout.desc: Creates a stacked layout. A stacked layout only shows one of the fields at a time, which can be set using the currentIndex argument of the layout.

hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout.name: hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout
hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout.syntax:
hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout( 
s_name 
[ ?items l_items ] 
[ ?frame g_frame ] 
[ ?margins l_margins ] 
[ ?spacing g_spacing ] 
[ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ] 
[ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?scrollable g_scrollable ]
) 
=> r_hiLayout
hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout.desc: Creates a vertical box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

hiCreateLayoutForm.name: hiCreateLayoutForm
hiCreateLayoutForm.syntax:
hiCreateLayoutForm( 
s_name 
t_title 
r_layout 
[ ?callback g_callback ]

[ ?sizePolicy s_sizePolicy ]

) 
=> r_form / nil
hiCreateLayoutForm.desc: Returns the SKILL representation of a layout form with the specified field entries and sets it to the specified name.

hiDeleteField.name: hiDeleteField
hiDeleteField.desc: Deletes a field from a form.

hiDeleteFields.name: hiDeleteFields
hiDeleteFields.desc: Deletes multiple fields from a form.

hiDeleteItemFromLayout.name: hiDeleteItemFromLayout
hiDeleteItemFromLayout.syntax:
hiDeleteItemFromLayout( 
x_index
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ]
) 
=> x_index / nil
hiDeleteItemFromLayout.desc: Deletes an item from hiLayout using the specified index.

ddHiCreateCellComboField.name: ddHiCreateCellComboField

=> r_comboField
ddHiCreateCellComboField.desc: Creates a customized Cell combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting cells.

ddHiCreateLibraryComboField.name: ddHiCreateLibraryComboField
ddHiCreateLibraryComboField.syntax:
ddHiCreateLibraryComboField(

ddHiCreateLibraryComboField.desc: Creates a customized Library combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting libraries.

ddHiCreateViewComboField.name: ddHiCreateViewComboField
ddHiCreateViewComboField.syntax:
ddHiCreateViewComboField(

[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]

ddHiCreateViewComboField.desc: Creates a customized View combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting views.

ddoAccepts.name: ddoAccepts
ddoAccepts.desc: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that is called with a specified dd object argument to get listed in the associated combo box.

ddoPreferred.name: ddoPreferred
ddoPreferred.desc: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that returns the preferred dd view object only for the View combo box. This return value is called after a linked cell ID is changed, and the value of the View combo box is not valid. The function is called with a list of dd object IDs and is expected to return a valid dd-view-id or nil.

ddHiLinkFields.name: ddHiLinkFields
ddHiLinkFields.syntax:
ddHiLinkFields(
o_libraryComboBox
o_cellCombobox
o_viewComboBox
)
=> t / nil
ddHiLinkFields.desc: Connects the given combo boxes, where the value changes in one combo box triggers re-populating of the next combo box.

hiAddCyclicChoice.name: hiAddCyclicChoice
hiAddCyclicChoice.syntax:
hiAddCyclicChoice( 
r_form 
s_cyclicField 
g_newChoice 
) 
=> t / nil
hiAddCyclicChoice.desc: Adds the new entry to the end of the list of choices in the cyclic field in the form.

hiChangeFormCallback.name: hiChangeFormCallback
hiChangeFormCallback.desc: Changes the doneAction and/or the cancelAction of the specified form to the SKILL callback procedure defined by newCallback. newCallback can be a symbol, a string, a function object,or a list of two symbols/strings/function objects. The first callback is taken as the doneAction. The second callback is taken as the cancelAction. After this routine is called, if the OK or Apply button of the form is pressed, the doneAction is executed, and if the Cancel button is pressed, the cancelAction is executed.

hiChangeFormTitle.name: hiChangeFormTitle
hiChangeFormTitle.desc: Changes the window manager title of the specified form to t_newTitle.

hiCollapseTreeItem.name: hiCollapseTreeItem
hiCollapseTreeItem.desc: Collapses the tree item you specify. This function also executes the collapse callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiCreateAppForm.name: hiCreateAppForm
hiCreateAppForm.syntax:
hiCreateAppForm( 
?name s_name 
?fields l_fieldEntries 
[ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ]
[ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ]
[ ?formTitle t_formTitle ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?unmapAfterCB g_unmapAfterCB ] 
[ ?mapCB g_mapCallback ]
[ ?formType s_formType ] 
[ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ]
[ ?buttonLayout g_buttonLayout ] 
[ ?buttonDisabled s_buttonDisabled ]
[ ?help g_help ] 
[ ?initialSize g_initialSize ]
[ ?minSize g_minSize ]
[ ?maxSize g_maxSize ]
[ ?dontBlock g_dontBlock ]
[ ?fieldFocus s_fieldFocus ]
[ ?plist g_plist ]
[ ?baseName s_baseName ]
) 
=> r_form
hiCreateAppForm.desc: Returns the SKILL representation of a form with the specified field entries, setting it to the specified name. All standard forms, from simple forms to property lists, are generated using hiCreateAppForm, with varying field entries. Use this function instead of hiCreateForm.

hiCreateBBoxField.name: hiCreateBBoxField
hiCreateBBoxField.syntax:
hiCreateBBoxField( 
?name s_fieldName 
[ prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?value l_currentValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?defValue l_defaultValue ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ] 
[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateBBoxField.desc: Creates a bounding box field for a form.

hiCreateBooleanButton.name: hiCreateBooleanButton
hiCreateBooleanButton.syntax:
hiCreateBooleanButton(
?name s_fieldName 
?buttonText t_buttonText
[ ?buttonLocation s_buttonLocation ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?value g_booleanValue ]
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?partialSelect g_partialSelect ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateBooleanButton.desc: Creates a single Boolean button for a form. The button text appears as a prompt next to the button; the button is on the left of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'left and on the right of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'right. A Boolean field consists of a single toggle button which may have an associated callback procedure executed when the Boolean state changes.

hiCreateButton.name: hiCreateButton
hiCreateButton.syntax:
hiCreateButton(
?name s_fieldName 
?callback g_callback 
[ ?buttonText t_buttonText ] 
[ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ] 
[ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?toolTip l_tooltip ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateButton.desc: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. The button must have an associated callback procedure to be executed when the button is selected. A button-only field differs from a button box field in that there is no prompt associated with this button.

hiCreateButtonBoxField.name: hiCreateButtonBoxField
hiCreateButtonBoxField.syntax:
hiCreateButtonBoxField(
?name s_fieldName 
?choices l_buttonText 
?callback l_callbackList 
?prompt t_fieldPrompt
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateButtonBoxField.desc: Creates a button box field for a form. A button box field contains individual buttons to be displayed in one row. Each button in the button box have an associated callback procedure that is run when that button is selected. A prompt is displayed on this row as well.

hiCreateComboField.name: hiCreateComboField
hiCreateComboField.syntax:
hiCreateComboField(
?name s_fieldName 
?items g_choices
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?defValue t_defaultValue ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?format t_fieldFormat ] 
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateComboField.desc: Creates a drop-down combination field, which is a type-in field with an attached drop-down list. Users can either select an item from the list or type in a value.

hiCreateCyclicField.name: hiCreateCyclicField
hiCreateCyclicField.syntax:
hiCreateCyclicField( 
?name s_fieldName 
?choices l_enumerations 
?prompt t_fieldPrompt 
[ ?value g_currentValue ] 
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ] 
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?keepHistory g_keepHistory ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateCyclicField.desc: Creates a cyclic field for a form. A cyclic field contains a list of string or icon enumerations, which are displayed in a drop-down list. Only one item can be selected at a time.

hiCreateFileSelectorField.name: hiCreateFileSelectorField
hiCreateFileSelectorField.syntax:
hiCreateFileSelectorField(
?name s_fieldName 
?mode s_mode
[ ?prompt t_prompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?defValue t_defaultValue ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
[ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFileSelectorField.desc: Creates a type-in field similar to a string field, except that it also has a Browse button at the right of the type-in box. The Browse button, when pressed, brings up a file dialog box that lets users select a file or directory. You can use the ?mode argument to specify what the user is allowed to select. The file dialog is modal, that is, it blocks access to the application while it is open. When the user makes a selection and closes the file dialog, the selection is entered into the type-in box.

hiCreateDisclosureButton.name: hiCreateDisclosureButton
hiCreateDisclosureButton.syntax:
hiCreateDisclosureButton(  
?name s_name
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?value g_value ]
[ ?defValue g_defValue ]
[ ?help S_help ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?onFields l_onFields ]
[ ?offFields l_offFields ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateDisclosureButton.desc: A disclosure button is a button without a label used for displaying the additional information or functionality associated with another widget.

hiCreateDisclosureTriangle.name: hiCreateDisclosureTriangle
hiCreateDisclosureTriangle.syntax:
hiCreateDisclosureTriangle(  
?name s_name
[ ?labelText t_labelText ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?value g_value ]
[ ?defValue g_defValue ]
[ ?help S_help ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?onFields l_onFields ]
[ ?offFields l_offFields ]
[ ?persistent g_state ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateDisclosureTriangle.desc: A disclosure triangle is a low profile widget for displaying the additional information or functionality embedded in a form.

hiCreateFloatField.name: hiCreateFloatField
hiCreateFloatField.syntax:
hiCreateFloatField( 
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?value f_currentValue ]
[ ?acceptNil g_acceptNil ]
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?defValue f_defaultValue ] 
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ] 
[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?range l_fieldRange ] 
[ ?format t_fieldFormat ] 
[ ?editable g_editable ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFloatField.desc: Creates a float field for a form. A float field is a field which accepts floating-point input only. A format string can be specified which is automatically imposed on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

hiCreateFrameField.name: hiCreateFrameField
hiCreateFrameField.syntax:
hiCreateFrameField(
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?labelText t_labelText ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFrameField.desc: Creates a frame field for a two-dimensional form. A frame field is a border that surrounds a group of related fields so they are easier to see.

hiCreateScrollRegion.name: hiCreateScrollRegion
hiCreateScrollRegion.syntax:
hiCreateScrollRegion(
?name s_name
[ ?fields l_fieldEntries ]
[ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ]
[ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ]
[ ?labelText t_labelText ] 
[ ?borderWidth x_borderWidth ] 
[ ?scrollBars g_scrollBars ]
[ ?rightMargin x_rightMargin ]
[ ?bottomMargin x_bottomMargin ]
[ ?help g_help ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateScrollRegion.desc: Creates a scroll region field, which can be scrolled and can contain any type of field. A scroll region field is like a sub-form within a form.

hiIsScrollRegion.name: hiIsScrollRegion
hiIsScrollRegion.desc: Determines if the item is a scroll region field.

hiCreateForm.name: hiCreateForm
hiCreateForm.syntax:
hiCreateForm( 
s_formHandle 
t_formName 
g_formAction 
l_fieldEntries 
g_formHelp
[ g_unmapAfterCB ] 
) 
=> r_form
hiCreateForm.desc: Use hiCreateAppForm instead of this function.

hiCreateFormButton.name: hiCreateFormButton
hiCreateFormButton.syntax:
hiCreateFormButton(
?name s_fieldName 
?buttonText t_buttonText 
?callback g_callback 
[ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ] 
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFormButton.desc: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. This function is the same as hiCreateButton.

hiCreateFormLabel.name: hiCreateFormLabel
hiCreateFormLabel.syntax:
hiCreateFormLabel(
?name s_name
[ ?labelText t_labelText ]
[ ?labelIcon g_labelIcon ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?justification s_justification ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFormLabel.desc: This function is an alias for hiCreateLabel. Use hiCreateLabel instead of this function.

hiCreateHypertextField.name: hiCreateHypertextField
hiCreateHypertextField.syntax:
hiCreateHypertextField(
?name s_name
[ ?title t_title ]
[ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ]
[ ?value t_value ]
[ ?pos t_position ]
[ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?shadowed g_shadowed ]
[ ?hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasVerticalScrollbar ]
[ ?hasHorizontalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateHypertextField.desc: Creates a hypertext field, which displays rich text with hypertext navigation. You can also specify hyperlinks to execute SKILL commands.

hiCreateIntField.name: hiCreateIntField
hiCreateIntField.syntax:
hiCreateIntField( 
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?value x_currentValue ]

[ ?nextField g_nextField ]

hiCreateIntField.desc: Creates an integer field entry for a form. An int field is a field that accepts integer input only. A format string can be specified which is imposed automatically on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

hiCreateLabel.name: hiCreateLabel
hiCreateLabel.syntax:
hiCreateLabel(

[?font t_font] 
[?enabled g_enabled]
[?invisible g_invisible]
[?help g_fieldHelp]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateLabel.desc: Creates a standalone label entry for a form or two-dimensional menu. This label-only field contains a descriptive label and can provide additional features to a form or two-dimensional menu.

hiCreateLayerCyclicField.name: hiCreateLayerCyclicField
hiCreateLayerCyclicField.syntax:

d_techFileId 
t_fieldPrompt 
t_callback 
l_layers 
[ l_LPpair ]
[ s_fieldName ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateLayerCyclicField.desc: Creates a cyclic field entry containing icon representations of specified layers for a form.

hiCreateListField.name: hiCreateListField
hiCreateListField.syntax:
hiCreateListField( 
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?value l_currentValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]

[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]

[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateListField.desc: Creates a list field entry for a form. A list field accepts a valid SKILL expression as input. linereadstring determines if the expression is valid. The list expression ID is not evaluated; it is only checked to see if it is valid.

hiCreateListBoxField.name: hiCreateListBoxField
hiCreateListBoxField.syntax:
hiCreateListBoxField(
?name s_fieldName
?choices l_listItems

[ ?value l_selectedItem ] 
[ ?defValue l_defSelectedItem ]

[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?selectionEnabled g_selectionEnabled ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateListBoxField.desc: Creates a list box field for a form.

hiCreateMLTextField.syntax:
hiCreateMLTextField(

[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?changeCB g_changeCB ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ] 
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateMLTextField.desc: Creates a multiline text field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field gets converted to a single string accessible through SKILL.

hiCreateOptionsForm.name: hiCreateOptionsForm
hiCreateOptionsForm.syntax:
hiCreateOptionsForm(
s_formHandle 
t_formName 
l_fieldEntries 
g_help 
)
=> r_form
hiCreateOptionsForm.desc: Generates a form with the specified field entries, setting it to formHandle.

hiCreateOutputStringField.name: hiCreateOutputStringField
hiCreateOutputStringField.syntax:
hiCreateOutputStringField(
?name s_fieldName
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?defValue t_defaultValue ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateOutputStringField.desc: Creates a field that displays text. You cannot type into this field.

hiCreatePointField.name: hiCreatePointField

hiCreatePointField(

[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreatePointField.desc: Creates a point field entry for a form.

hiCreatePointListField.name: hiCreatePointListField
hiCreatePointListField.syntax:
hiCreatePointListField( 
?name s_fieldName

[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreatePointListField.desc: Creates a point list field entry for a form.

hiCreateRadioField.name: hiCreateRadioField
hiCreateRadioField.syntax:
hiCreateRadioField( 
?name s_fieldName 
?choices l_radioList

[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]

) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateRadioField.desc: Creates a radio field for a form.

hiCreateReportField.name: hiCreateReportField
hiCreateReportField.syntax:
hiCreateReportField(
?name s_fieldName
[ ?title t_title ]
[ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ]
[ ?headers g_headers ]
[ ?choices l_choices ]
[ ?value g_value ]
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]
[ ?returnPackedValue g_returnPackedValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]

[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]

[ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateReportField.desc: Creates a report field, which you can use to display information in a complex format. For example, you can display a table with sortable columns. The items in a report field can be selected but they cannot be edited.

hiCreateScaleField.name: hiCreateScaleField
hiCreateScaleField.syntax:
hiCreateScaleField(
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?prompt t_prompt ] 
[ ?value x_currentValue ]
[ ?callback g_callback ] 
[ ?isContinuous g_isContinuous ]
[ ?range l_range ]

[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?precision x_precision ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateScaleField.desc: Creates a scale field for a form.

hiCreateSeparatorField.name: hiCreateSeparatorField
hiCreateSeparatorField.desc: Creates a separator field for a form.

hiCreateSimpleHypertextField.name: hiCreateSimpleHypertextField
hiCreateSimpleHypertextField.syntax:
hiCreateSimpleHypertextField(
s_name
t_text
t_link
[ g_newWindow ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateSimpleHypertextField.desc: Creates a simple one-line hypertext field, which displays a hyperlink to a Web page. See hiCreateHypertextField() for information on how to create a more complex hypertext field.

hiCreateSpinBox.name: hiCreateSpinBox
hiCreateSpinBox.syntax:
hiCreateSpinBox(
?name s_fieldName
[ ?prompt t_prompt ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?value g_value ]
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]
[ ?font t_fontName ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?range l_rangeOfItems ]
[ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ]
[ ?shadowed g_shadowed ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?obeyWidth g_obeyWidth ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?wrapAround g_wraparound ]
[ ?justification s_justification ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateSpinBox.desc: Creates a spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain integers. For floating point numbers, use hiCreateFloatSpinBox.

hiCreateFloatSpinBox.name: hiCreateFloatSpinBox
hiCreateFloatSpinBox.syntax:
hiCreateFloatSpinBox(
