[ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateFloatSpinBox.desc: Creates a float spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain floating point numbers. For integers, use hiCreateSpinBox.

hiCreateStringField.name: hiCreateStringField
hiCreateStringField.syntax:
hiCreateStringField( 
?name s_fieldName 
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?value t_currentValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?defValue t_defaultValue ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ]
[ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ]
[ ?format t_fieldFormat ] 
[ ?editable g_editable ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateStringField.desc: Creates a string field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field is surrounded by double quotation marks before being passed to SKILL to interpret.

hiCreateTabField.name: hiCreateTabField
hiCreateTabField.syntax:
hiCreateTabField(
?name s_name
?fields l_fieldEntries
[ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ]
[ ?tabs g_tabs ]
[ ?pageBase g_pageBase ]
[ ?value g_currentValue ]
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]
[ ?tabPlacement g_tabPlacement ]
[ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?pageScroller g_pageScroller ]
[ ?notebookStyle g_notebookStyle ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?tabToolTips l_tooltip ]
[ ?tabLabels l_tabLabel ]
[ ?scrollPage l_scrollPage ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateTabField.desc: Creates a tab field, which can have multiple pages. You can change the pages interactively by selecting the tab attached to each page, or programmatically by using the form->field->value property.

hiCreateTree.name: hiCreateTree
hiCreateTree.desc: Creates a new tree or sub-tree, to which you then add items you create with the hiCreateTreeItem function. You add the tree to a tree table field created with the hiCreateTreeTable function.

hiCreateTreeItem.name: hiCreateTreeItem
hiCreateTreeItem.syntax:
hiCreateTreeItem(
s_itemName
[ g_description ]
[ g_itemIcon ]
[ g_selectionIcon ]
[ g_expandedIcon ]
[ g_expandedSelectionIcon ]
)
=> r_treeItem / nil
hiCreateTreeItem.desc: Creates a new item for a tree. Use hiTreeAppendItem or hiTreePrependItem to attach the item to a tree.

hiCreateTreeTable.name: hiCreateTreeTable
hiCreateTreeTable.syntax:
hiCreateTreeTable(
?name s_name
[ ?title t_title ]
[ ?choice g_choice ]
[ ?value g_value ]
[ ?defValue g_defaultValue ]
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ]
[ ?headers g_headers ]
[ ?sort l_sort ]
[ ?callback g_callback ]
[ ?enableDeselectCB g_enableDeselectCB ]
[ ?expandCallback g_expandCallback ]
[ ?collapseCallback g_collapseCallback ]
[ ?sortCallback g_sortCallback ]
[ ?nextField g_nextField ]
[ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ]
[ ?selectMode s_selectMode ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ]
[ ?expandCollapseOnDoubleClick g_expandCollapseOnDoubleClick ]
)
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateTreeTable.desc: Creates a tree table field. If you have already created a tree, you can specify it when you create the field; otherwise you can add a tree later to the field. To create a tree, use hiCreateTree and other tree table field functions.

hiCreateToggleField.name: hiCreateToggleField
hiCreateToggleField.syntax:
hiCreateToggleField( 
?name s_fieldName 
?choices l_toggleList 
[ ?help g_fieldHelp ] 
[ ?numSelect x_numSelectable ] 
[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ] 
[ ?value l_currentValues ] 
[ ?defValue l_defaultValues ]
[ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ] 
[ ?font t_font ] 
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?invisible g_invisible ]
[ ?callback l_toggleListCallbacks ] 
) 
=> r_fieldHandle
hiCreateToggleField.desc: Creates a toggle field entry for a form.

hiDeleteForm.name: hiDeleteForm
hiDeleteForm.desc: Deletes the form specified and any fields the form contains.

hiDisplayForm.name: hiDisplayForm
hiDisplayForm.desc: Displays a form. Do not use hiDisplayForm for displaying options forms. You can also use this function to bring a form to the top of the screen if the form is covered by other windows.

hiEditPropList.name: hiEditPropList
hiEditPropList.syntax:
hiEditPropList(
g_object 
[ t_title ]
[ g_modifiable ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiEditPropList.desc: Opens the property list editor for the given g_object.

hiEscapeStringChars.name: hiEscapeStringChars
hiEscapeStringChars.desc: Escapes certain characters (backslash and double quote characters) in a string by preceding them with a backslash so that they do not cause errors when the string is evaluated in SKILL. You can use this function to prepare strings that needs to be evaluated in callbacks.

hiEscapeHTMLTags.name: hiEscapeHTMLTags
hiEscapeHTMLTags.desc: Returns a string in which HTML tags such as greater-than and less-than are replaced with or converted to character directives such as ampersand-g-t-semicolon and ampersand-l-t-semicolon.This is done to preserve the display of the HTML tags in places such as field prompts.

hiExpandTreeItem.name: hiExpandTreeItem
hiExpandTreeItem.desc: Expands the tree item you specify. This function also executes the expand callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiFormApply.name: hiFormApply
hiFormApply.desc: Equivalent to clicking the Apply button on a form.

hiFormCancel.name: hiFormCancel
hiFormCancel.desc: Equivalent to clicking the Cancel button on a form.

hiFormClose.name: hiFormClose
hiFormClose.desc: Equivalent to clicking the Close button on a form. This function is an alias for hiFormDone. The Close button is identical to the OK button, except that it triggers hiFormClose instead of hiFormDone.

hiFormDefaults.name: hiFormDefaults
hiFormDefaults.desc: Equivalent to clicking the Defaults button on a form. The value of each field on the form is compared to its default value and, if it is different, it is set to the default value and the value-change callback is invoked.

hiFormDone.name: hiFormDone
hiFormDone.desc: Equivalent to clicking the OK button on a form. This function is identical to the hiFormFinish function.

hiFormFinish.name: hiFormFinish
hiFormFinish.desc: Equivalent to clicking the OK button on a form. This function is identical to the  hiFormDone function.

hiFormList.name: hiFormList
hiFormList.desc: Returns a list of all form symbols currently defined in SKILL space.

hiFormUnmap.name: hiFormUnmap
hiFormUnmap.desc: Unmaps the form from the screen before a callback is completed.

hiGetButtonAreaHeight.name: hiGetButtonAreaHeight
hiGetButtonAreaHeight.desc: Returns the button area height of an instantiated form.

hiGetChoiceStrings.name: hiGetChoiceStrings
hiGetChoiceStrings.desc: Returns strings of all choices in a list box, radio button, or cyclic field.

hiGetCurrentField.name: hiGetCurrentField
hiGetCurrentField.desc: Returns the symbol name of the field that currently has input focus.

hiGetCurrentForm.name: hiGetCurrentForm
hiGetCurrentForm.desc: Returns the current form, that is, the form that the cursor was last located.

hiGetCyclicValueString.name: hiGetCyclicValueString
hiGetCyclicValueString.desc: Returns the current value of a cyclic field as a string. This function returns nil if the specified value is an icon list without the fourth member (optional).

hiGetFieldAttachments.name: hiGetFieldAttachments
hiGetFieldAttachments.desc: Returns the integer representing the combination of attachment bit values when the field is in an attachment form.

hiGetFieldInfo.name: hiGetFieldInfo
hiGetFieldInfo.desc: Returns the dimensions of any form field or 2D menu item that is in an instantiated form. Do not use the return value of hiGetFieldInfo to restore a field to its original location. Instead, use the values you specified originally.

hiGetFieldMinSize.name: hiGetFieldMinSize
hiGetFieldMinSize.desc: Returns the minimum size for the field widget and prompt.

hiGetRadioValueString.name: hiGetRadioValueString
hiGetRadioValueString.desc: Returns the current value of a radio field as a string.

hiLayoutUTp.name: hiLayoutUTp
hiLayoutUTp.desc: Verifies that an argument is an instantiated hiLayout object.

hiGetFieldOverlaps.name: hiGetFieldOverlaps
hiGetFieldOverlaps.desc: Generates warnings if the form specified contains any fields whose bounding boxes overlap with other fields, or any fields in which the bounding box for the prompt portion of the field overlaps with the main portion of the field. The function generates an initial warning that overlaps were found, then additional warnings for each overlap. Returns nil if the form is uninstantiated.

hiGetFieldScope.name: hiGetFieldScope
hiGetFieldScope.desc: Returns the scope containing the given field. The return value can be a scroll region, a tab page, a tab field, form, or nil.

hiGetFormLocation.name: hiGetFormLocation
hiGetFormLocation.desc: Returns the x and y coordinates of the upper-left corner of the form you specify. If the form is not currently displayed, but has been displayed at least once, this function returns the last location at which it was displayed. If the form has never been displayed, this function returns nil.

hiGetFormSize.name: hiGetFormSize
hiGetFormSize.desc: Returns the width and height of the given form.

hiGetInsertionPosition.name: hiGetInsertionPosition
hiGetInsertionPosition.desc: Gets the current position of the insertion cursor in a type-in field. You can use the hiSetInsertionPosition function to change the position of the cursor.

hiGetItemOfLayout.name: hiGetItemOfLayout
hiGetItemOfLayout.syntax:
hiGetItemOfLayout( 
x_index
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ]
) 
=> x_index / nil
hiGetItemOfLayout.desc: Returns the description of all the items in the specified hiLayout as per the index order.

hiGetLayerCyclicValue.name: hiGetLayerCyclicValue
hiGetLayerCyclicValue.desc: Returns the layer object associated with the current value of the layer cyclic field.

hiGetLayoutChildLayouts.name: hiGetLayoutChildLayouts
hiGetLayoutChildLayouts.desc: Returns the list of symbolic names of child-hiLayout items in the hiLayout.

hiGetLayoutFields.name: hiGetLayoutFields
hiGetLayoutFields.desc: Returns the list of symbolic names of field items in hiLayout.

hiGetLayoutItems.name: hiGetLayoutItems
hiGetLayoutItems.desc: Returns the description of all the items in the specified hiLayout in the index sequence.

hiGetListBoxValue.name: hiGetListBoxValue
hiGetListBoxValue.desc: Provides the value of a list box field as a list of strings. This function is useful when the valueByPosition property of a list box field is set to non-nil, which means its value is managed and reported as a list of integers (indicating position) instead of a list of strings.

hiGetLayoutFrame.name: hiGetLayoutFrame
hiGetLayoutFrame.syntax:
hiGetLayoutFrame(
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ]
)
=> t_title / t / nil
hiGetLayoutFrame.desc: Returns the frame title of a hiLayout form, a scroll region, or a tab page in the hiLayout form.

hiGetLayoutItemIndex.name: hiGetLayoutItemIndex
hiGetLayoutItemIndex.desc: Returns a list containing the symbol name of the layout, which contains s_layoutOrField, and the index of that item within the layout.

hiGetLayoutType.name: hiGetLayoutType
hiGetLayoutType.desc: Returns the type of hiLayout. The layout types that can be returned are 'hbox, 'vbox, 'grid, 'form, or 'stacked.

hiGetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex.name: hiGetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex
hiGetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex.desc: Returns the index of the current top item.

hiSetFieldMinSize.name: hiSetFieldMinSize
hiSetFieldMinSize.syntax:
hiSetFieldMinSize( 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
s_fieldName 
[ ?widgetWidth x_widgetWidth ] 
[ ?widgetHeight x_widgetHeight ] 
[ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetFieldMinSize.desc: Sets the minimum width and height for the widget portion of a field.

hiSetKeyboardFocusField.name: hiSetKeyboardFocusField
hiSetKeyboardFocusField.syntax:
hiSetKeyboardFocusField( 
g_formOrRegion 
s_field 
[ g_limitSearch [ g_onlyCurrentTabPage ]]
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetKeyboardFocusField.desc: Sets the keyboard focus to field, s_field, if it is found in the form or region, g_formOrRegion and is allowed to have keyboard focus. It also enables you to do a hierarchical search if g_limitSearch is not specified or is set to nil. The search is limited to only the top-level of the form or scroll region field if, g_limitSearch is specified as a non-nil value.

hiSetLayoutFrameTitle.name: hiSetLayoutFrameTitle
hiSetLayoutFrameTitle.syntax:
hiSetLayoutFrameTitle(
g_title 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ]
)
=> t_title / t / nil
hiSetLayoutFrameTitle.desc: Sets the frame title of a hiLayout form, a scroll region, or a tab page in the hiLayout form.

hiSetLayoutMargins.name: hiSetLayoutMargins
hiSetLayoutMargins.syntax:
hiSetLayoutMargins( 
l_margins 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetLayoutMargins.desc: Set the top, bottom, left, and right margins of the layout.

hiGetGridLayoutItemLocation.name: hiGetGridLayoutItemLocation
hiGetGridLayoutItemLocation.desc: Searches for a list containing the symbol name of the layout that contains s_layoutOrField, and the row, column, row span, and column span of that item within the layout.

hiGetKeyboardFocusField.name: hiGetKeyboardFocusField
hiGetKeyboardFocusField.desc: Returns the field that currently has keyboard focus or is nil.

hiGetLayoutMargins.name: hiGetLayoutMargins
hiGetLayoutMargins.desc: Returns the top, bottom, left, and right margins of the layout.

hiGetNumVisibleItems.name: hiGetNumVisibleItems
hiGetNumVisibleItems.desc: Returns the number of visible items for a list box field.

hiGetScrollBarInfo.name: hiGetScrollBarInfo
hiGetScrollBarInfo.desc: Provides information about the horizontal and vertical scroll bars on a form or scroll region field. You can use this information to set the position of scroll bars with the hiSetScrollBarValue function.

hiGetTextFieldFit.name: hiGetTextFieldFit
hiGetTextFieldFit.syntax:
hiGetTextFieldFit( 
x_rows
x_columns
g_ignored
g_hasVerticalScrollbar
g_hasHorizontalScrollbar
) 
=> l_dimensions
hiGetTextFieldFit.desc: Returns the size necessary for a multiline text field to display x_rows and x_columns of characters.

hiGetTopListItem.name: hiGetTopListItem
hiGetTopListItem.desc: Returns the top item position of a listbox field.

hiGetTree.name: hiGetTree
hiGetTree.desc: Gets the tree that is inserted under the item you specify.

hiGetTreeItems.name: hiGetTreeItems
hiGetTreeItems.desc: Gets a list of all the items in a tree.

hiGetTreeItemDescription.name: hiGetTreeItemDescription
hiGetTreeItemDescription.desc: Returns the description of an item. The description is set initially with the g_description argument of hiCreateTreeItem. You can reset the description with hiSetTreeItemDescription.

hiGetTreeItemIcons.name: hiGetTreeItemIcons
hiGetTreeItemIcons.desc: Gets the following icons associated with a tree item: default icon, expanded icon (displayed when the item is expanded), selection icon (displayed when the item is selected), and expanded selection icon (displayed when the item is both expanded and selected).

hiGetTreeItemParent.name: hiGetTreeItemParent
hiGetTreeItemParent.desc: Gets the parent tree of an item, that is, the tree to which the item belongs. If the item is used in multiple places, this function returns all the parent trees.

hiGetTreeParent.name: hiGetTreeParent
hiGetTreeParent.desc: Gets the parent of a tree, that is, the item under which the tree is inserted. If the tree is inserted in multiple places, this function returns all the items under which it is inserted.

hiHighlightField.name: hiHighlightField
hiHighlightField.syntax:
hiHighlightField( 
g_form 
s_field 
g_highlightType 
) 
=> t / nil
hiHighlightField.desc: Highlights a type-in field depending on the value of g_highlightType.

hiHypertextReadin.name: hiHypertextReadin
hiHypertextReadin.desc: Reads in a text file, which can include hyperlinks, into a hypertext field. This function resets the value of the hypertext field.

hiHypertextReplace.name: hiHypertextReplace
hiHypertextReplace.desc: Replaces the text in a hypertext field with the new text that you provide. The text can contain hyperlinks. This function replaces the value of the hypertext field with the new text.

hiHypertextScroll.name: hiHypertextScroll
hiHypertextScroll.desc: Scrolls a hypertext field to display the text containing the link you specify. This function updates the ?pos argument of hiCreateHypertextField().

hiIgnoreProp.name: hiIgnoreProp
hiIgnoreProp.desc: Does not display the specified property of a given object type in the Property List Editor form.

hiInFormApply.name: hiInFormApply
hiInFormApply.desc: Checks whether the Apply button on a mapped form is selected.

hiInsertItemToLayout.name: hiInsertItemToLayout
hiInsertItemToLayout.syntax:
hiInsertItemToLayout( 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
g_item 
[ ?layoutControls l_layoutControls ] 
[ ?index x_index ] 
[ ?toLayout s_layoutName ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiInsertItemToLayout.desc: Inserts the required controls to the layout.

hiInstantiateForm.name: hiInstantiateForm
hiInstantiateForm.desc: Instantiates the C structure of a form from SKILL.

hiIsForm.name: hiIsForm
hiIsForm.desc: Checks whether a form or menu is a valid one.

hiIsFormDisplayed.name: hiIsFormDisplayed
hiIsFormDisplayed.desc: Checks whether a form is displayed.

hiIsInstantiated.name: hiIsInstantiated
hiIsInstantiated.desc: Displays a form at least once or a menu has been placed in a window. Returns nil if the form has been deleted or if g_formRegionOrMenu is not valid.

hiIsInFieldCancel.name: hiIsInFieldCancel
hiIsInFieldCancel.desc: Query this function during a field callback to determine if the form is currently being canceled, the callback may be initiated by the cancel operation. If the form is being canceled, the form handle is returned; otherwise nil is returned.

hiItemInsertTree.name: hiItemInsertTree
hiItemInsertTree.desc: Creates a sub-tree under an item. You need to specify the item and the sub-tree as the arguments for this function.

hiLayerMatchCyclicStr.name: hiLayerMatchCyclicStr
hiLayerMatchCyclicStr.desc: Returns the layer cyclic value associated with the specified t_layer.

hiLaunchBrowser.name: hiLaunchBrowser
hiLaunchBrowser.desc: Starts a Web browser, if needed, and opens the URL you specify.

hiLayerStringToLPP.name: hiLayerStringToLPP
hiLayerStringToLPP.desc: Returns the layer object in the specified d_techFileID associated with the specified t_layer.

hiMoveField.name: hiMoveField
hiMoveField.syntax:
hiMoveField( 
r_2DFormOr2DMenu 
s_field 
l_location 
) 
=> t / nil
hiMoveField.desc: Moves the specified field to a new location. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

hiMoveToFormField.name: hiMoveToFormField
hiMoveToFormField.syntax:
hiMoveToFormField( 
g_formOrRegion
s_field
) 
=> moved / focused / nil
hiMoveToFormField.desc: If the specified field is a text field and can accept input focus, it is set as the current field and the input focus is set to it.

hiMoveInsBarToEnd.name: hiMoveInsBarToEnd
hiMoveInsBarToEnd.desc: Places the cursor (insertion point) at the end of a text field, scrolling the field so the cursor is visible.

hiOffsetField.name: hiOffsetField
hiOffsetField.syntax:
hiOffsetField( 
r_2DFormOr2DMenu 
s_field 
l_offsets 
) 
=> t / nil
hiOffsetField.desc: Offsets one field from its current position. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

hiOffsetFields.name: hiOffsetFields
hiOffsetFields.syntax:
hiOffsetFields( 
r_2DFormOr2DMenu 
l_fields
l_offsets 
) 
=> t / nil
hiOffsetFields.desc: Offsets several fields from their current positions. All fields are offset by the same distance, they move as a block. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

hiResizeField.name: hiResizeField
hiResizeField.syntax:
hiResizeField( 
r_2DForm 
s_field 
l_resizeDescription 
) 
=> t / nil
hiResizeField.desc: Changes the width, height, or promptBox width of a specified field. This function cannot be used for fields that have field attachments. Use hiReattachField for fields with field attachments.

hiReattachField.name: hiReattachField
hiReattachField.desc: Reattaches a field in a two-dimensional form or scroll region that has field attachments. This function places the field according to the new position and attachment information. This function can be used only with forms or scroll regions that already have field attachments. For forms or scroll regions that do not have field attachments, use the hiMoveField, hiResizeField, hiOffsetField, and hiOffsetFields functions.

hiReportSelectItem.name: hiReportSelectItem
hiReportSelectItem.syntax:
hiReportSelectItem(
g_reportField
g_itemIndex
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiReportSelectItem.desc: Selects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportSelectItems.name: hiReportSelectItems
hiReportSelectItems.syntax:
hiReportSelectItems(
g_reportField
l_itemIndexList
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiReportSelectItems.desc: Selects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportSelectAllItems.name: hiReportSelectAllItems
hiReportSelectAllItems.desc: Selects all items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportDeselectItem.name: hiReportDeselectItem
hiReportDeselectItem.syntax:
hiReportDeselectItem(
g_reportField
g_itemIndex
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiReportDeselectItem.desc: Deselects an item in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportDeselectItems.name: hiReportDeselectItems
hiReportDeselectItems.syntax:
hiReportDeselectItems(
g_reportField
l_itemIndexList
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiReportDeselectItems.desc: Deselects items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportDeselectAllItems.name: hiReportDeselectAllItems
hiReportDeselectAllItems.desc: Deselects all selected items in a report field. This function also executes the callback of the report field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiReportGetSelectedItems.name: hiReportGetSelectedItems
hiReportGetSelectedItems.desc: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a report field.

hiSetButtonIcon.name: hiSetButtonIcon
hiSetButtonIcon.desc: Changes a button icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

hiSetButtonLabel.name: hiSetButtonLabel
hiSetButtonLabel.desc: Changes a button label text or icon after the button is created. This function updates all instances of the button.

hiSetCallbackStatus.name: hiSetCallbackStatus
hiSetCallbackStatus.desc: Overrides the removal (unmapping) of a form when the form's OK button is pressed.

hiSetCurrentField.name: hiSetCurrentField
hiSetCurrentField.syntax:
hiSetCurrentField(
g_form 
s_fieldName
[ g_limitSearch ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetCurrentField.desc: Makes the specified type-in field the current field (sets input focus to the field). If the field is not visible, hiSetCurrentField scrolls the form or scroll region field so the field becomes visible.

hiSetCurrentForm.name: hiSetCurrentForm
hiSetCurrentForm.syntax:
hiSetCurrentForm(
g_form
[ g_setIfNotDisplayed [ g_setIfNotInstantiated ] ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetCurrentForm.desc: Makes the form you specify the current form. If the form is displayed, moves the focus to the form.

hiSetFieldEditable.name: hiSetFieldEditable
hiSetFieldEditable.desc: Sets the specified field editable or noneditable, in all forms where it appears.

hiSetFieldEnabled.name: hiSetFieldEnabled
hiSetFieldEnabled.desc: Enables or disables a form field. A disabled field is greyed-out. This function updates all instances of the field. You can use hiSetFieldEnabled with all types of fields except separator fields.

hiSetFormButtonEnabled.name: hiSetFormButtonEnabled
hiSetFormButtonEnabled.syntax:
hiSetFormButtonEnabled(
r_form
s_buttonSym
g_enabled
)
=> t / nil
hiSetFormButtonEnabled.desc: Enables or disables a button on a form. To enable or disable fields on a form, use the hiSetFieldEnabled function.

hiSetFormBlock.name: hiSetFormBlock
hiSetFormBlock.syntax:
hiSetFormBlock(
r_form
[ g_blockUpdates ]
[ g_unmanage ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetFormBlock.desc: Prevents time-consuming multiple updates to a form during multiple changes (such as adding, deleting, moving, or resizing elements). You can also blank out the form during extensive changes. Updates are blocked until you call hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil) or hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form).

hiSetFormHighlights.name: hiSetFormHighlights
hiSetFormHighlights.desc: Highlights all type-in fields for form, depending on the value of highlightType.

hiSetFormMinMaxSize.name: hiSetFormMinMaxSize
hiSetFormMinMaxSize.syntax:
hiSetFormMinMaxSize(
r_form
g_minSize
g_maxSize
)
=> t / nil
hiSetFormMinMaxSize.desc: Sets the minimum or maximum size of the form. The size excludes the window manager title and border.

hiSetFormName.name: hiSetFormName
hiSetFormName.desc: Changes the form title, which is displayed in the window frame banner. The function can be called by its alias hiChangeFormTitle.

hiSetFormPosition.name: hiSetFormPosition
hiSetFormPosition.desc: Sets the default initial location for forms displayed without an explicit location argument.

hiSetFormSize.name: hiSetFormSize
hiSetFormSize.syntax:
hiSetFormSize(
r_form
l_size
[ g_reattachFields ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSetFormSize.desc: Resizes a form programmatically. If the optional argument g_reattachFields is non-nil, field attachments is recalculated based on the new form size and original field sizes.

hiSetFormToDefaults.name: hiSetFormToDefaults
hiSetFormToDefaults.desc: Sets each field in the form to its default value, except the disclosure field value.

hiSetInsertionPosition.name: hiSetInsertionPosition
hiSetInsertionPosition.syntax:
hiSetInsertionPosition(
g_form
s_field
x_newPosition
)
=> t / nil
hiSetInsertionPosition.desc: Resets the position of the insertion cursor in a type-in field. You can use the hiGetInsertionPosition function to get the current position of the cursor.

hiSetLayerCyclicValue.name: hiSetLayerCyclicValue
hiSetLayerCyclicValue.syntax:
hiSetLayerCyclicValue( 
d_techFileId
l_lpp
r_form 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetLayerCyclicValue.desc: Sets the current value of the layer cyclic field.

hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex.name: hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex
hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex.syntax:
hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex( 
x_index 
g_formRegionOrLayout 
[ s_layoutName ] 
) 
=> x_index / nil
hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex.desc: Sets the index of the current top item of a valid stacked hiLayout.

hiSetScrollBarValue.name: hiSetScrollBarValue
hiSetScrollBarValue.desc: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll bars in a form or scroll region field to the position you specify, therefore allowing you to display a specific part of the form or scroll region field programmatically. Use hiGetScrollBarInfo to get information about the form or scroll region field before you use this function.

hiSetTopListItem.name: hiSetTopListItem
hiSetTopListItem.desc: Sets the first visible item in a list box field to the specified position (x_itemPosition). A position value of 1 indicates the first item, a position value of 2 indicates the second item, and so on. A value of 0 (zero) specifies the last item in the list.

hiSetTreeItemDescription.name: hiSetTreeItemDescription
hiSetTreeItemDescription.desc: Changes the item description. The description is initially set with the g_description argument of  hiCreateTreeItem. To get the current description, use hiGetTreeItemDescription.

hiSetTreeItemIcons.name: hiSetTreeItemIcons
hiSetTreeItemIcons.desc: Sets the following icons for a tree item: default icon, expanded icon (displayed when the item is expanded), selection icon (displayed when the item is selected), and expanded selection icon (displayed when the item is both expanded and selected).

hiSetListItemVisible.name: hiSetListItemVisible
hiSetListItemVisible.desc: Brings the specified list box item into view in the list box. Takes a list box field of a form as the first argument and the numeric position of the item you want to bring into view as the second argument. If the numeric position specified is 0 or less than 0, the last item in the list is scrolled into view.

hiSetListItemCenter.name: hiSetListItemCenter
hiSetListItemCenter.desc: Brings the specified list box item into view in the center of the list box, if possible. Takes a list box field of a form as the first argument and the numeric position of the item you want to bring into view as the second argument.

hiShowFieldBorders.name: hiShowFieldBorders
hiShowFieldBorders.desc: Displays or hides borders around form fields. Used as a debugging aid to avoid overlapping fields when laying out forms.

hiStoreFormLocation.name: hiStoreFormLocation
hiStoreFormLocation.desc: Stores a form location coordinates so that the form can be restored later to the same position.

hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons.name: hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons
hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons.desc: Swaps the item icon and expanded icon with the selection icon and expanded selection icon respectively for the specified tree item. For information about setting these icons, see hiSetTreeItemIcons.

hiTreeAppendItem.name: hiTreeAppendItem
hiTreeAppendItem.desc: Adds an item at the end of a tree. To add an item to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItem.

hiTreeAppendItems.name: hiTreeAppendItems
hiTreeAppendItems.desc: Adds items at the end of a tree. To add items to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItems.

hiTreePrependItem.name: hiTreePrependItem
hiTreePrependItem.desc: Adds an item to the beginning of a tree. To add an item at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItem.

hiTreePrependItems.name: hiTreePrependItems
hiTreePrependItems.desc: Adds items to the beginning of a tree. To add items at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItems.

hiTreeRemoveItem.name: hiTreeRemoveItem
hiTreeRemoveItem.desc: Removes an item from a tree. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems. To remove all the items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

hiTreeRemoveItems.name: hiTreeRemoveItems
hiTreeRemoveItems.desc: Removes the specified items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem; to remove all items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

hiTreeRemoveAllItems.name: hiTreeRemoveAllItems
hiTreeRemoveAllItems.desc: Removes all the items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems.

hiTreeTableDeselectItem.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItem
hiTreeTableDeselectItem.syntax:
hiTreeTableDeselectItem(
g_treeField
g_item
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiTreeTableDeselectItem.desc: Deselects an item in a tree table field. To deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems. To deselect all selected items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.name: hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems
hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.desc: Deselects all selected items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems.

hiTreeTableDeselectItems.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItems
hiTreeTableDeselectItems.syntax:
hiTreeTableDeselectItems(
g_treeField
l_items
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiTreeTableDeselectItems.desc: Deselects items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect all items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems
hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems.desc: Gets a list of all the items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount
hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount.desc: Returns the number of items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableGetItems.name: hiTreeTableGetItems
hiTreeTableGetItems.desc: Gets a list of all the items in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableGetItemCount.name: hiTreeTableGetItemCount
hiTreeTableGetItemCount.desc: Returns the number of items in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems
hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems.desc: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount
hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount.desc: Returns the number of items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

hiTreeTableSelectItem.name: hiTreeTableSelectItem
hiTreeTableSelectItem.syntax:
hiTreeTableSelectItem(
g_treeField
g_item
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiTreeTableSelectItem.desc: Selects an item in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiTreeTableSelectAllItems.name: hiTreeTableSelectAllItems
hiTreeTableSelectAllItems.desc: Selects all items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiTreeTableSelectItems.name: hiTreeTableSelectItems
hiTreeTableSelectItems.syntax:
hiTreeTableSelectItems(
g_treeField
l_items
[ g_notify ]
)
=> t / nil
hiTreeTableSelectItems.desc: Selects items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

hiItemRemoveTree.name: hiItemRemoveTree
hiItemRemoveTree.desc: Removes the sub-tree from an item in the tree. The item remains in the tree as a leaf; only the sub-tree under it is removed. The expansion icon next to the item is removed.

hiUpdateFormBlock.name: hiUpdateFormBlock
hiUpdateFormBlock.desc: Used to reset a form if you have blocked multiple updates with the hiSetFormBlock function. The functions pf hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form) is equivalent to hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil).

dwindow.name: dwindow
dwindow.desc: Gets the window ID of a dockable window.

dwindowp.name: dwindowp
dwindowp.desc: Checks whether the specified object is a valid dock window.

getCurrentWindow.name: getCurrentWindow
getCurrentWindow.desc: The getCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiGetCurrentWindow function.

getMaxScreenCoords.name: getMaxScreenCoords
getMaxScreenCoords.desc: The getMaxScreenCoords function is an alias for the hiGetMaxScreenCoords function.

hiAddFixedMenu.name: hiAddFixedMenu
hiAddFixedMenu.syntax:
hiAddFixedMenu( 
[ ?window w_window ] 
?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu 
[ ?menuSide s_menuSide ] 
[ ?append g_append ]
[ ?newLine g_newLine ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiAddFixedMenu.desc: Fixed menus are no longer supported in windows. Use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars instead for windows. Existing fixed menus that have been added to windows are no longer displayed, although no warnings are being generated. Replace these menus with toolbars.

hiCloseWindow.name: hiCloseWindow
hiCloseWindow.desc: Closes and destroys a window, dock window, or session window.

hiCreateDockWindow.name: hiCreateDockWindow
hiCreateDockWindow.syntax:
hiCreateDockWindow(
?appType t_appType
?widgetType t_widgetType
[ ?handle s_handle ]
[ ?dockSizeHint l_dockSizeHint ]
[ ?minimumSizeHint l_minimumSizeHint ]
[ ?floatSizeHint l_floatSizeHint ]
[ ?form g_form ]
[ ?help t_help ]
[ ?scrollBar g_scrollBar ]
[ ?title t_title ]
[ ?visibilityProc s_visibilityProc ]
)
=> w_dwindowID / nil
hiCreateDockWindow.desc: Creates a dockable window, which can be docked in a session window with the hiDockWindow function. Dockable windows can be of the following types: form, hypertext, html, or text. Dockable windows cannot be of type graphics.

hiCreateWindow.name: hiCreateWindow
hiCreateWindow.syntax:
hiCreateWindow(
g_boxSpec 
t_widgetType 
t_appType 
[ t_help ]
[ g_scrollbars ]
[ g_form ] 
[ l_iconPosition ]
) 
=> w_windowId / nil
hiCreateWindow.desc: Creates, but does not display, a window of one of the following types: session, graphics, text, hypertext, html, encap, or form. This window becomes the current window.

hiDeiconifyWindow.name: hiDeiconifyWindow
hiDeiconifyWindow.desc: Converts an icon to a window. If the window is contained in a session window, the session window is deiconified.

hiDisplayWindow.name: hiDisplayWindow
hiDisplayWindow.syntax:
hiDisplayWindow(
w_windowId | w_sessionWindowID
[ w_sessionWindowId ]
[ g_tabTitle ]
[ g_tabIcon ]
[ g_tabTip ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiDisplayWindow.desc: Displays any window created by hiCreateWindow, including session windows; does not display dockable windows or empty session windows. This function always displays graphics windows in a session window-if you do not specify a session window, this function creates a new one and displays the graphics window in it.

hiDockWindow.name: hiDockWindow
hiDockWindow.syntax:
hiDockWindow(
?window w_dwindowID
[ ?session g_sessionWindowID ]
[ ?side s_side ]
[ ?index x_index ]
[ ?unmapped g_unmapped ]
[ ?tabOnto w_dwindowID ]
)
=> t / nil
hiDockWindow.desc: Docks a dockable window in a session window. You must specify the g_sessionWindowID argument the first time that you display a dock window with this function.

hiGetAbsWindowScreenBBox.name: hiGetAbsWindowScreenBBox
hiGetAbsWindowScreenBBox.desc: Returns the absolute screen coordinates of a window, assuming 0:0 is the lower-left corner of the screen.

hiGetActiveTabWindow.name: hiGetActiveTabWindow
hiGetActiveTabWindow.desc: Returns the window ID of the window that is the active tab in the session window.

hiGetAppType.name: hiGetAppType
hiGetAppType.desc: Returns the application type of a window. The application type is set when the window is created.

hiGetCurrentEnterFunPoints.name: hiGetCurrentEnterFunPoints
hiGetCurrentEnterFunPoints.desc: Returns the list of points entered in the active enterfunction of the current window.

hiGetCurrentWindow.name: hiGetCurrentWindow
hiGetCurrentWindow.desc: Returns the ID of the current window. If the current window is in a session window, the ID of the window, not the session window, is returned. Session windows and dockable windows can never be the current window.

hiGetCursor.name: hiGetCursor
hiGetCursor.desc: Identifies the type of cursor that is currently set for the specified window.

hiGetCursorByName.name: hiGetCursorByName
hiGetCursorByName.desc: Returns the ID associated with the specified cursor name.

hiGetDbuPoint.name: hiGetDbuPoint
hiGetDbuPoint.desc: Returns the current location of the pointer, or nil if the pointer is not within the drawable area of the window or the window is hidden behind other tabs in a session window.

hiGetDrawThruDelta.name: hiGetDrawThruDelta
hiGetDrawThruDelta.syntax:
hiGetDrawThruDelta( 
[ g_detail ]
) 
=> x_defaultDelta / ( x_defaultDelta ( x_highButton1Delta x_highButton2Delta x_highButton3Delta ) )
hiGetDrawThruDelta.desc: When no argument is presented, or if the g_detail argument is nil, returns the default draw-thru delta.

hiGetEFDrawThruDelta.name: hiGetEFDrawThruDelta
hiGetEFDrawThruDelta.desc: Returns the list of EnterFunction draw-thru deltas for the three mouse buttons.

hiGetEFunCursor.name: hiGetEFunCursor
hiGetEFunCursor.desc: Gets the cursor for an active enterfunction.

hiGetHelp.name: hiGetHelp
hiGetHelp.desc: Retrieves the help string that is defined for the window.

hiGetIconName.name: hiGetIconName
hiGetIconName.desc: Gets the name that is displayed on a window icon when the window is minimized. This name is set with the hiSetIconName function.

hiGetScreenPoint.name: hiGetScreenPoint
hiGetScreenPoint.desc: Returns the current location of the pointer relative to the upper-left corner of the drawable area of a window. This function does not apply to session windows or dockable windows.

hiGetSessionWindow.name: hiGetSessionWindow
hiGetSessionWindow.desc: Returns the ID of the session window that contains the specified window or dock window.

hiGetWindowState.name: hiGetWindowState
hiGetWindowState.desc: Returns the display state of a window: mapped, unmapped, or iconified.

hiGetWindowDisplayState.name: hiGetWindowDisplayState
hiGetWindowDisplayState.desc: Returns detailed information about the display state of a window.

hiGetWindowIconifyState.name: hiGetWindowIconifyState
hiGetWindowIconifyState.desc: Returns the icon position of an iconified window. If the window is contained in a session window, this function returns the icon position of the session window.

hiGetWindowList.name: hiGetWindowList
hiGetWindowList.desc: Returns a list of window IDs of all windows that have been created but not closed, including those that are not currently displayed. You can specify the type of window with the s_windowType argument. By default, all windows except session windows and dock windows are returned.

hiGetWindowName.name: hiGetWindowName
hiGetWindowName.desc: Returns the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. This name is set with the hiSetWindowName function.

hiOpenWindow.name: hiOpenWindow
hiOpenWindow.syntax:
hiOpenWindow(
[ ?bBox l_boxSpec ] 
[ ?type t_widgetType ] 
[ ?appType t_applicationType ] 
[ ?menus l_menus ] 
[ ?labels l_labels ] 
[ ?help t_helpString ] 
[ ?scroll g_scrollbars ]
[ ?form g_form ]
[ ?closeProc s_closeProc ]
[ ?iconPosition l_iconPosition ]
[ ?session g_sessionWindow ]
[ ?tabTitle g_tabTitle ]
[ ?tabIcon g_tabIcon ]
[ ?tabTip g_tabTip ]
) 
=> w_windowId / nil
hiOpenWindow.desc: Creates and displays a window. This function displays the new window in a session window if the session window argument is specified or if the new window is a graphics window.

hiUndockWindow.name: hiUndockWindow
hiUndockWindow.desc: Undocks a dockable window from a session window. The window is floated. You can dock the window again with hiDockWindow.

hiIsWindowSpecifier.name: hiIsWindowSpecifier
hiIsWindowSpecifier.desc: Validates a window specifier, which is passed as the boxSpec argument to the hiCreateWindow and hiOpenWindow functions.

hiSetDrawThruDelta.name: hiSetDrawThruDelta
hiSetDrawThruDelta.desc: Sets the default draw-thru delta and, optionally, the high draw-thru delta for mouse buttons 1, 2 or 3.

hiSetSessionFocus.name: hiSetSessionFocus
hiSetSessionFocus.desc: Sets the keyboard focus to a session window's active tab window or docked window when the session window becomes active. The active tab window or docked window that you specify must be part of a session window and must contain a sub-widget that is enabled, visible, and that can get focus through the Tab key. The focus is set to a sub-widget.

hiSetTabWindowTitle.name: hiSetTabWindowTitle
hiSetTabWindowTitle.desc: Sets the title of the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

hiSetTabWindowIcon.name: hiSetTabWindowIcon
hiSetTabWindowIcon.desc: Sets the icon in the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

hiSetTabWindowTip.name: hiSetTabWindowTip
hiSetTabWindowTip.desc: Sets the tooltip for the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

hiSetWindowAtts.name: hiSetWindowAtts
hiSetWindowAtts.syntax:
hiSetWindowAtts(
[ ?window w_windowId ] 
[ ?appType t_applicationType ] 
[ ?help t_help ] 
[ ?scroll g_scrollbars ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetWindowAtts.desc: Changes the application type, help string, or scroll bar attributes of a window. You must register the new application type before setting it with this function.

hiSetWinStyle.name: hiSetWinStyle
hiSetWinStyle.desc: Sets the window creation style to 'default, 'interactive or 'bBox.

hiRegCloseProc.name: hiRegCloseProc
hiRegCloseProc.desc: Registers the procedure to be called when a window is closed. You can register closing procedures for windows, session windows, and dockable windows. A session window's closing procedure is called before the closing procedure of any of the windows it contains.

hiUnregCloseProc.name: hiUnregCloseProc
hiUnregCloseProc.desc: Unregisters the closing procedure for a window.

hiSwitchWindowType.name: hiSwitchWindowType
hiSwitchWindowType.syntax:
hiSwitchWindowType(
w_windowId 
t_widgetType
t_appType
t_help
[ g_scroll ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSwitchWindowType.desc: Switches the widget type of a window between graphics, text, or hypertext. The window must be in a session window.

hiIconifyWindow.name: hiIconifyWindow
hiIconifyWindow.desc: Converts a window to its icon. If the window is contained in a session window, the session window is iconified.

hiLowerWindow.name: hiLowerWindow
hiLowerWindow.desc: Lowers a window to the bottom of the list of visible windows.

hiRaiseWindow.name: hiRaiseWindow
hiRaiseWindow.desc: Raises a window to the top of the list of visible windows.

hiRaiseTab.name: hiRaiseTab
hiRaiseTab.desc: Raises a tab contained in a multi-tabbed session window to the top of the list and makes it the active tab. If there is only a single tab, the function does nothing.

hiLowerTab.name: hiLowerTab
hiLowerTab.desc: Lowers a tabbed window contained in a session window to the bottom of the list of tabbed windows.

hiPickWindow.name: hiPickWindow
hiPickWindow.desc: Lets you select a window without changing the current window. When this function is called, the pointer is grabbed and not released until either the mouse button or the Escape key is pressed. Any other keyboard event is ignored and the mouse click is not passed on to anything else.

hiMapWindow.name: hiMapWindow
hiMapWindow.desc: Displays a window, dockable window, or session window on screen.

hiUnmapWindow.name: hiUnmapWindow
hiUnmapWindow.desc: Removes a window, dockable window, or session window from the screen without closing or destroying it.

hiMoveWindow.name: hiMoveWindow
hiMoveWindow.desc: Moves the lower left corner of a window to a new screen location. If w_windowId is a window contained in a session window, the session window is moved.

hiResizeWindow.name: hiResizeWindow
hiResizeWindow.desc: Resizes a window to the size of a bounding box. If w_windowID is a window within a session window, the session window is resized.

hiSetWindowName.name: hiSetWindowName
hiSetWindowName.desc: Sets the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. A session window displays the window name of the window that is currently active within it.

hiSetIconName.name: hiSetIconName
hiSetIconName.desc: Sets the name that is displayed on a window's icon when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon name of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon name set, then the session window's icon name is displayed.

hiSetWindowIcon.name: hiSetWindowIcon
hiSetWindowIcon.desc: Sets the icon of a window, which is displayed when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon set, then the session window's icon is displayed.

hiGetWidgetType.name: hiGetWidgetType
hiGetWidgetType.desc: Returns the widget type of a window. Valid widget types are session, graphics, text, hypertext, html, encap, form, and none.

hiIsWidgetType.name: hiIsWidgetType
hiIsWidgetType.desc: Determines if a widget type is valid or not.

hiSetCurrentWindow.name: hiSetCurrentWindow
hiSetCurrentWindow.desc: Sets the window you specify as the current window.

hiRegCurWindowTrigger.name: hiRegCurWindowTrigger
hiRegCurWindowTrigger.desc: Registers the SKILL function to be called whenever the current window changes. The SKILL function is called with one argument: an integer representing the window number of the new current window. If no window is current (for example, if all windows except the CIW are closed or if any open windows have the property neverCurrentWindow set to t), then the argument is 0.

hiUnregCurWindowTrigger.name: hiUnregCurWindowTrigger
hiUnregCurWindowTrigger.desc: Unregisters a SKILL function that was registered to be called whenever the current window changes.

hiGetMaxScreenCoords.name: hiGetMaxScreenCoords
hiGetMaxScreenCoords.desc: Retrieves the screen coordinates of the upper-right corner of the display screen. The lower-left corner of the screen is assumed to be 0:0. This is the maximum size that you can specify for a window.

hiGetWMOffsets.name: hiGetWMOffsets
hiGetWMOffsets.desc: Returns a list of offsets (dimensions) of the window manager border placed around each window.

hiRemoveFixedMenu.name: hiRemoveFixedMenu
hiRemoveFixedMenu.desc: Removes a fixed menu from a window. If you do not specify a menu, all fixed menus are removed. To delete a fixed menu, first use hiRemoveFixedMenu to remove the fixed menu from the window and then use hiDeleteMenu to destroy the fixed menu.

hiMoveFixedMenu.name: hiMoveFixedMenu
hiMoveFixedMenu.syntax:
hiMoveFixedMenu( 
[ ?window w_window ] 
[ ?menuSide s_menuSide ] 
[ ?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu ]
) 
=> t / nil
hiMoveFixedMenu.desc: Moves the fixed menu to the opposite side of the window.

hiGetWindowFixedMenu.name: hiGetWindowFixedMenu
hiGetWindowFixedMenu.desc: Identifies the fixed menu on a window.

hiSetCursor.name: hiSetCursor
hiSetCursor.desc: Sets the cursor you specify for the window.

hiGetCursorName.name: hiGetCursorName
hiGetCursorName.desc: Returns the name of the cursor associated with the specified cursor ID.

hiSetShadowMode.name: hiSetShadowMode
hiSetShadowMode.desc: Controls the display of unselected objects in a graphics window. When you enable shadow mode with this function, all unselected objects are dimmed and all selected objects are displayed at full brightness in their original layer color instead of the selection color. The shadow mode setting applies to all graphics in all windows of the application, not just to the current window.

hiRemovePromptLine.name: hiRemovePromptLine
hiRemovePromptLine.desc: Removes the prompt line from the graphics window you specify or, if you do not specify a window, from the current window.

hiSetEFunCursor.name: hiSetEFunCursor
hiSetEFunCursor.desc: Sets the cursor for an active enterfunction.

hiSetEFDrawThruDelta.name: hiSetEFDrawThruDelta
hiSetEFDrawThruDelta.desc: Sets the Enter Function draw-thru delta.

setCurrentWindow.name: setCurrentWindow
setCurrentWindow.desc: The setCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiSetCurrentWindow function.

window.name: window
window.desc: Given a window number, gets the window ID.

swindow.name: swindow
swindow.desc: Gets the window ID of a session window.

swindowp.name: swindowp
swindowp.desc: Checks whether the specified object is a valid session window.

windowp.name: windowp
windowp.desc: Checks whether the specified object is a valid window.

wtypep.name: wtypep
wtypep.desc: A predicate function that returns t if g_object is of type window, and nil otherwise.

hiZoomRelativeScale.name: hiZoomRelativeScale
hiZoomRelativeScale.desc: Zooms in or out with a scale relative to the current window.

hiZoomAbsoluteScale.name: hiZoomAbsoluteScale
hiZoomAbsoluteScale.syntax:
hiZoomAbsoluteScale(
[ w_window ] 
[ n_scale ] 
[ g_ignoreEFunBBox ]
)
=> t / nil
hiZoomAbsoluteScale.desc: Zooms in or out with an absolute scale.

hiZoomWindowAtPoint.name: hiZoomWindowAtPoint
hiZoomWindowAtPoint.syntax:
hiZoomWindowAtPoint(
w_window
f_scale
l_point
)
=> t / nil
hiZoomWindowAtPoint.desc: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point you specify at its current location in the window.

hiZoomWindowAtMouse.name: hiZoomWindowAtMouse
hiZoomWindowAtMouse.desc: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

hiZoomInAtMouse.name: hiZoomInAtMouse
hiZoomInAtMouse.desc: Zooms into a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

hiZoomOutAtMouse.name: hiZoomOutAtMouse
hiZoomOutAtMouse.desc: Zooms out of a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

hiZoomExpandAtPoint.name: hiZoomExpandAtPoint
hiZoomExpandAtPoint.syntax:
hiZoomExpandAtPoint( 
w_window
f_zoomFactor
l_point
)
=> t / nil
hiZoomExpandAtPoint.desc: Zooms out the image by keeping the mirror image point of l_point at the same location

hiZoomExpandAtMouse.name: hiZoomExpandAtMouse
hiZoomExpandAtMouse.desc: Zooms out by two in the specified window (or current window) expanding the zoom area in the direction of the mouse relative to the center of the window

hiGetViewBBox.name: hiGetViewBBox
hiGetViewBBox.desc: Returns the bounding box displayed in a window.

hiPan.name: hiPan
hiPan.desc: Scrolls a window so that the display is centered on a point.

hiVectorPan.name: hiVectorPan
hiVectorPan.syntax:
hiVectorPan(
[ w_window ] 
[ l_refPt ] 
[ l_destPt ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiVectorPan.desc: Scrolls the view of the design in any direction by specifying two points in user units.

hiDeltaPan.name: hiDeltaPan
hiDeltaPan.syntax:
hiDeltaPan(
[ w_window ] 
[ n_deltax ] 
[ n_deltay ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiDeltaPan.desc: Pans the view of a design in any direction by specifying the displacements in user units.

hiAbsolutePan.name: hiAbsolutePan
hiAbsolutePan.syntax:
hiAbsolutePan(
[ w_window ] 
[ n_%x ] 
[ n_%y ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiAbsolutePan.desc: Scrolls a window in any direction by specifying the amount to pan as a percentage of the window size.

hiDynamicPanAbsolute.name: hiDynamicPanAbsolute
hiDynamicPanAbsolute.desc: Pans a design to display the specified point at the center of the window. This function is similar to hiPan, except that it pans dynamically, that is, it displays the panning movement.

hiDynamicPanRelative.name: hiDynamicPanRelative
hiDynamicPanRelative.syntax:
hiDynamicPanRelative(
[ w_window ]
[ n_percentX ]
[ n_percentY ]
[ g_noAnimation { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
hiDynamicPanRelative.desc: Pans a design in the direction and distance specified in n_percentX and n_percentY. The distance is a percentage of the window size.

hiDynamicPanInteractive.name: hiDynamicPanInteractive
hiDynamicPanInteractive.syntax:
hiDynamicPanInteractive(
[ w_window ]
[ n_scope ]
[ g_noAnimation { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
hiDynamicPanInteractive.desc: Pans a design continuously when you place the cursor near the edge of a graphics window. You can control the speed at which the design is panned by varying the distance between the cursor and the edge of the window-the closer the cursor is to the edge of the window, the faster the speed.

hiDynamicPanGrabbing.name: hiDynamicPanGrabbing
hiDynamicPanGrabbing.desc: Pans (grabs and moves) a design in the specified (or current) window from one point to another. You can even pan the design when editing it. The panning operation ends when you release holding the mouse button or DrawThru bindkey.

hiRedraw.name: hiRedraw
hiRedraw.desc: Redraws the contents of a window.

hiRegZoomPanProc.name: hiRegZoomPanProc
hiRegZoomPanProc.desc: Registers a SKILL procedure for a graphics window that gets called whenever a user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in that window. If you do not specify a window while registering the procedure, the procedure gets called whenever the user uses these commands in any graphics window. The SKILL procedure is passed the window ID.

hiUnregZoomPanProc.name: hiUnregZoomPanProc
hiUnregZoomPanProc.desc: Unregisters a SKILL procedure that was registered with the hiRegZoomPanProc function and that is called whenever the user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in a graphics window.

hiSaveView.name: hiSaveView
hiSaveView.desc: Saves the current viewing parameters of a graphics window.

hiListView.name: hiListView
hiListView.desc: Lists the saved viewing parameters for a given view, or for all views if viewName is not specified. This function applies to graphics windows only

hiRestoreView.name: hiRestoreView
hiRestoreView.desc: Restores a graphics window to the view specified by viewName.

hiPrevWinView.name: hiPrevWinView
hiPrevWinView.desc: Restores a graphics window to the view displayed before the last zoom or pan command.

hiNextWinView.name: hiNextWinView
hiNextWinView.desc: Undoes hiPrevWinView on a graphics window.

hiGetUndoLimit.name: hiGetUndoLimit
hiGetUndoLimit.desc: Returns the maximum number of hiUndo commands that can be performed in sequence. This number is set with the hiSetUndoLimit function or with the Undo Limit field in the CIW User Preferences form.

hiSetUndoLimit.name: hiSetUndoLimit
hiSetUndoLimit.desc: Sets the maximum number of hiUndo commands that can be performed in sequence. Specify either 0 or 128; 0 disables the undo command and 128 sets the undo limit to 128. If you specify any number other than 0, the undo limit is 128.

hiUndo.name: hiUndo
hiUndo.desc: Undoes the last user command that modified the database and that has not been undone by a previous hiUndo.

hiRedo.name: hiRedo
hiRedo.desc: Undoes the last hiUndo, assuming no other database modifications have occurred.

hiEnableBlink.name: hiEnableBlink
hiEnableBlink.desc: Enables or disables blinking, depending on the value of the g_blink argument. When blinking is disabled, objects that would normally blink in graphics windows stops blinking. In some cases, disabling blinking can improve graphics performance. You can also disable blinking by starting the application with the -noblink option.

hiIsBlinkEnabled.name: hiIsBlinkEnabled
hiIsBlinkEnabled.desc: Checks whether blinking is enabled or not. You can use hiEnableBlink to enable or disable blinking in your current session.

hiCreateWorldView.name: hiCreateWorldView
hiCreateWorldView.desc: Creates a World View assistant for your graphics window, which you can then display with hiDockWindow. World View assistant is a small window that shows you a picture of your entire design and marks the part of the design that is currently displayed in the graphics window. You can also use it to navigate the design or zoom in or out of it.

hiWorldViewFit.name: hiWorldViewFit
hiWorldViewFit.desc: Fits the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

hiWorldViewRedraw.name: hiWorldViewRedraw
hiWorldViewRedraw.desc: Redraws the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

hiWorldViewZoomIn.name: hiWorldViewZoomIn
hiWorldViewZoomIn.desc: Zooms into the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

hiWorldViewZoomOut.name: hiWorldViewZoomOut
hiWorldViewZoomOut.desc: Zooms out of the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

hiGenerateThumbnails.name: hiGenerateThumbnails
hiGenerateThumbnails.syntax:
hiGenerateThumbnails(
?lib g_lib
[ ?cell g_cell ]
[ ?view g_view ]
[ ?sizes g_sizes ]
[ ?output g_output ]
[ ?verbose g_verbose ]
[ ?exportArgs g_exportArgs ]
[ ?filePath t_filePath ]
)
=> thumbnails / nil
hiGenerateThumbnails.desc: Generates thumbnails for given library cellviews. Function behavior depends on arguments provided. All arguments can be lists in order to batch-generate thumbnails for a series of libraries, cells, views and sizes. At present, only the default 128x128 thumbnail is used by Cadence tools.

hiGetDefaultThumbnail.name: hiGetDefaultThumbnail
hiGetDefaultThumbnail.desc: Displays a default cellview type thumbnail when a thumbnail is not available for that application. This prevents the thumbnail area of a dialog or window from being left blank.

hiGetDefaultThumbnailResolution.name: hiGetDefaultThumbnailResolution
hiGetDefaultThumbnailResolution.desc: Returns a list that comprises of a pair of integers that indicate the default thumbnail resolution that applications are currently using.

hiGetDefaultWidgetSpacing.name: hiGetDefaultWidgetSpacing
hiGetDefaultWidgetSpacing.desc: Returns the recommended number of pixels between UI elements. The spacing between related elements, such as a group of Boolean buttons, is smaller than elements, which are not related.

hiGetThumbnailFilename.name: hiGetThumbnailFilename
hiGetThumbnailFilename.desc: Returns the name of a thumbnail file for a given resolution. If no specific size is requested, the filename for the default thumbnail resolution is used (as set by hiGetThumbnailDefaultResolution).

hiGetWinConfig.name: hiGetWinConfig
hiGetWinConfig.desc: Creates a new workspace based on the session window layout and returns its ID.

hiSaveWinConfig.name: hiSaveWinConfig
hiSaveWinConfig.syntax:
hiSaveWinConfig(
n_configID
t_pathToFile
[ g_overwrite ]
)
=> t / nil
hiSaveWinConfig.desc: Saves a workspace to a file. The g_overwrite argument lets you specify whether or not to overwrite an existing file.

hiReadWinConfig.name: hiReadWinConfig
hiReadWinConfig.desc: Reads a workspace file previously saved by hiSaveWinConfig and returns the workspace ID.

hiApplyWinConfig.name: hiApplyWinConfig
hiApplyWinConfig.desc: Applies a workspace to a session window. If the session window has toolbars and dock assistants that were not present when the workspace was created, they get hidden.

hiWinConfigModified.name: hiWinConfigModified
hiWinConfigModified.desc: Checks whether a workspace has been modified since it was last applied to the session window.

hiGetWinConfigInfo.name: hiGetWinConfigInfo
hiGetWinConfigInfo.desc: Returns information about a workspace (window configuration): the list of dock assistants and toolbars that are are part of the workspace and whether they are visible, hidden, or floating.

hiSetWinObjName.name: hiSetWinObjName
hiSetWinObjName.desc: Sets the window name which is used for storing workspace information about a dock assistant. Every dock assistant must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with dock assistants provided by Cadence.

hiGetWinObjName.name: hiGetWinObjName
hiGetWinObjName.desc: Gets the window name that is used to store the dock assistant's workspace information. This name is set with the hiSetWinObjName function.

hiWindowSaveImage.name: hiWindowSaveImage
hiWindowSaveImage.syntax:
hiWindowSaveImage(
[ ?target g_target ]
[ ?path t_path ]
[ ?format t_format ]
[ ?toplevel g_toplevel ]
[ ?quality n_quality ]
[ ?delay n_delay ]
[ ?timeoutBeep g_timeoutBeep ]
[ ?grabFromScreen g_grabFromScreen ]
[ ?centralWidget g_centralWidget ]
)
=> t / nil
hiWindowSaveImage.desc: Takes a screen capture of a window, a region, or the entire screen. You can specify the object to capture either through the arguments or, in interactive mode, by selecting it with the mouse.

hiExportImage.name: hiExportImage
hiExportImage.syntax:
hiExportImage(
?fileName t_filename
[?window w_window]
[?exportRegion s_exportRegion]
[?bBox l_bBox]
[?width n_width]
[?height n_height]
[?scaleFactor n_scaleFactor]
[?haloType s_haloType]
[?scaleHalos g_scaleHalos]
[?fileType g_fileType]
[?keepAspect g_keepAspect]
[?transparentBG g_transparentBG]
[?colorType s_colorType]
[?fgColor t_fgColor]		
[?bgColor t_bgColor]
[?verbose g_verbose]
[?windowProps g_windowProps]
[?decorations g_decorations]
)
=> t / nil
hiExportImage.desc: Takes a screen capture of a design in a graphics window and exports it to a standard image format such as PNG. This function can only be used with graphics windows.

hiExportImageDialog.name: hiExportImageDialog
hiExportImageDialog.desc: Displays the Export Image dialog box, which lets you take a screen capture of the design contained in the specified window and save it to a standard image format. This function can only be called for graphics windows.

hiAbout.name: hiAbout
hiAbout.desc: Displays an application's product information window, which includes the release version and copyright information. If w_windowId is a session window, the product information is about the window that is displayed in the top tab.

hiSetSplashBackground.name: hiSetSplashBackground
hiSetSplashBackground.desc: Sets the background for an application's splash screen. If the graphic you specify has too many colors, the background is not set.

hiSetSplashDefaultBackground.name: hiSetSplashDefaultBackground
hiSetSplashDefaultBackground.desc: Sets the splash screen background to the default background.

hiSetSplashIcon.name: hiSetSplashIcon
hiSetSplashIcon.desc: Sets a new icon for an application splash screen. The icon is displayed between the product name and the license information and always be set to a 48x48 size.

hiSetSplashFamily.name: hiSetSplashFamily
hiSetSplashFamily.desc: Sets the product family name on an application's splash screen.

hiSetSplashProduct.name: hiSetSplashProduct
hiSetSplashProduct.desc: Sets the product name on an application's splash screen.

hiSetSplashLicense.name: hiSetSplashLicense
hiSetSplashLicense.desc: Sets the license information in an application's splash screen. You can currently set only Cadence license information.

hiGetMagnifierSize.name: hiGetMagnifierSize
hiGetMagnifierSize.desc: Returns a two element list for the currently opened magnifier for the specified graphics window.

hiIsMagnifierAnchored.name: hiIsMagnifierAnchored
hiIsMagnifierAnchored.desc: Checks if the magnifier has been anchored inside the specified graphics window. If the magnifier has been anchored it and does not move with the mouse cursor.

hiIsMagnifierOpened.name: hiIsMagnifierOpened
hiIsMagnifierOpened.desc: Indicates whether a magnifier is currently opened in the specified window.

hiScaleMagnifier.name: hiScaleMagnifier
hiScaleMagnifier.desc: Changes the zooming factor of the magnifier dynamically.

hiToggleAnchorMagnifier.name: hiToggleAnchorMagnifier
hiToggleAnchorMagnifier.desc: Toggles the anchored state of the magnifier to anchored/un-anchored depending upon the current anchored state of the magnifier.

hiToggleMagnifier.name: hiToggleMagnifier
hiToggleMagnifier.desc: Changes the visibility of the magnifier to on/off depending on the current visibility setting of the magnifier.

hiToggleMagnifierResolution.name: hiToggleMagnifierResolution
hiToggleMagnifierResolution.desc: Turns on magnifier resolution in the canvas if the canvas is not currently using magnifier resolution. Otherwise turns off magnifier resolution.

hiUpdateMagOptions.name: hiUpdateMagOptions
hiUpdateMagOptions.desc: Update and display the Magnifier Options form with the magnifier values that are being used in the current window.

hiUseMagnifierResolution.name: hiUseMagnifierResolution
hiUseMagnifierResolution.desc: Alters the movement of the cursor within the canvas.

hiUsingMagnifierResolution.name: hiUsingMagnifierResolution
hiUsingMagnifierResolution.desc: Returns whether mouse movement in the canvas is set to behave as if the mouse is located within the magnifier.

hiZoomInMagnifier.name: hiZoomInMagnifier
hiZoomInMagnifier.desc: Zooms into the picture in canvas, as opposed to the picture in the magnifier, with the current magnifier zooming factor.

hiZoomOutMagnifier.name: hiZoomOutMagnifier
hiZoomOutMagnifier.desc: Backs out one call to the hiZoomInMagnifier command from the stack, similar to an undo action.

hiChangeBannerLabel.name: hiChangeBannerLabel
hiChangeBannerLabel.syntax:
hiChangeBannerLabel(
w_windowId 
t_bannerLabel 
x_labelPosition 
) 
=> t / nil
hiChangeBannerLabel.desc: Overwrites an existing label or adds a new label in the banner bar of a window.

hiDeleteBannerLabel.name: hiDeleteBannerLabel
hiDeleteBannerLabel.desc: Deletes a label from the banner bar of a window.

hiDeleteBannerMenu.name: hiDeleteBannerMenu
hiDeleteBannerMenu.desc: Deletes a menu from the menu bar of a window.

hiDeleteBannerMenus.name: hiDeleteBannerMenus
hiDeleteBannerMenus.desc: Deletes all menus from the menu bar of a window.

hiGetBannerLabels.name: hiGetBannerLabels
hiGetBannerLabels.desc: Returns the list of labels that are in the banner bar of a window. (These labels were added with the  ?labels argument to the hiOpenWindow function when the window was created or with the hiChangeBannerLabel function.)

hiGetBannerMenus.name: hiGetBannerMenus
hiGetBannerMenus.desc: Returns a list of menus available in the menu bar of a window.

hiGetNumMenus.name: hiGetNumMenus
hiGetNumMenus.desc: Returns the number of menus in the menu bar of a window.

hiInsertBannerMenu.name: hiInsertBannerMenu
hiInsertBannerMenu.syntax:
hiInsertBannerMenu(
w_windowId 
g_menu 
x_menuPosition 
) 
=> t / nil
hiInsertBannerMenu.desc: Inserts a menu into the menu bar of a window. If the menu symbol that you specify already exists on the window, a warning message is issued and the menu is not placed on the window.

hiIsMenuSlotFilled.name: hiIsMenuSlotFilled
hiIsMenuSlotFilled.desc: Checks whether a menu already exists in the specified position in the menu bar of a window.

hiReplaceAllBannerMenus.name: hiReplaceAllBannerMenus
hiReplaceAllBannerMenus.desc: Replaces all menus in a window with new menus.

hiBindKeyModifiers.name: hiBindKeyModifiers
hiBindKeyModifiers.desc: Returns the list of modifiers that can be used with bindkeys in the current session. You can specify the type of keys for which you want the list of legal modifiers: printable, mouse, or function.

hiSetBindKey.name: hiSetBindKey
hiSetBindKey.syntax:
hiSetBindKey(
[ t_applicationType ] 
[ t_key ] 
[ t_skill_cmd ] 
) 
=> t / nil
hiSetBindKey.desc: Binds a SKILL command string to a keyboard key or a mouse sequence for an application.

hiSetBindKeys.name: hiSetBindKeys
hiSetBindKeys.desc: Sets multiple bindkeys for an application at one time. For memory and performance efficiency, use this function instead of hiSetBindKey if you are setting multiple bindkeys. For information about restrictions, see hiSetBindKey.

hiRegSetBindKeyProc.name: hiRegSetBindKeyProc
hiRegSetBindKeyProc.syntax:
hiRegSetBindKeyProc(
t_application
S_function
[ g_notInherited ]
)
=> t / nil
hiRegSetBindKeyProc.desc: Registers a SKILL function that will be called after a bindkey is set for the specified application with the hiSetBindKey function or the CIW Key or Mouse Binding form, or after a set of bindkeys is defined with the hiSetBindKeys function.

hiGetBindKey.name: hiGetBindKey
hiGetBindKey.desc: Returns the SKILL command string bound to a key or mouse button for an application.

hiGetBindKeys.name: hiGetBindKeys
hiGetBindKeys.desc: Returns the list of bindkeys that are set for an application.

hiShowBindKeys.name: hiShowBindKeys
hiShowBindKeys.desc: Displays the bindkeys for an application type or window in a Viewfile window.

hiShowBindKeysByAppType.name: hiShowBindKeysByAppType
hiShowBindKeysByAppType.syntax:
hiShowBindKeysByAppType(
w_window1
t_applicationType
[ g_showInheritBindings ]
)
=> t / nil
hiShowBindKeysByAppType.desc: Displays the bindkeys for an application in a Viewfile window.

hiShowBindKeysByWindow.name: hiShowBindKeysByWindow
hiShowBindKeysByWindow.desc: Displays the bindkeys for a window in a Viewfile window.

hiRegisterBindKeyPrefix.name: hiRegisterBindKeyPrefix
hiRegisterBindKeyPrefix.desc: Registers an application bindkey prefix. Use this function to register prefixes that you do not want to register with the Design Editor application. Cadence applications are already registered.

hiInheritBindKey.name: hiInheritBindKey
hiInheritBindKey.desc: Causes a registered application to inherit bindkeys from another application.

hiGetBindKeyInheritRoot.name: hiGetBindKeyInheritRoot
hiGetBindKeyInheritRoot.desc: Returns the application name from which t_applicationType inherits its bindkeys.

hiGetBindKeyInheritAlias.name: hiGetBindKeyInheritAlias
hiGetBindKeyInheritAlias.desc: Returns a list of application names that inherit the bindkeys from t_applicationType.

hiGetBindKeyPrefixList.name: hiGetBindKeyPrefixList
hiGetBindKeyPrefixList.desc: Returns a list of registered applications. This list is used to build the menu for the Cyclic button on the Bind Keys form.

hiConfigureBindKeys.name: hiConfigureBindKeys
hiConfigureBindKeys.syntax:
hiConfigureBindKeys(
?showOnlyApps l_apps
?showAllChildren g_showAllChildren
?selectApp t_appname
?selectKeyBinding t_keyBinding
?showEmptyApps g_showEmptyApps
?showInheritedBindings g_showInheritedBindings
) 
=> t / nil
hiConfigureBindKeys.desc: Resets and displays the Bindkey Configuration form according to the supplied arguments. If the form is currently open, and contains unsaved changes, it will prompt before resetting the data.

hiEnableAsstBindKeyPrefix.name: hiEnableAsstBindKeyPrefix
hiEnableAsstBindKeyPrefix.desc: Removes the specified bindkey prefix (also known as an appType), which is associated with a dock window (assistant), from the list of disabled bindkey prefixes.

hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix.name: hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix
hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix.desc: Adds the specified bindkey prefix also known as an appType, which is associated with a dock window (assistant), to the list of disabled bindkey prefixes. As a result, the bindkeys defined using that prefix are disabled.

hiGetDisabledAsstBindKeyPrefixes.name: hiGetDisabledAsstBindKeyPrefixes
hiGetDisabledAsstBindKeyPrefixes.desc: Returns the list of bindkey prefixes disabled using hiDisableAsstBindKeyPrefix.

hiPrintBindKeyUsage.name: hiPrintBindKeyUsage
hiPrintBindKeyUsage.desc: Returns bindkey usage data for the specified applications.

addPoint.name: addPoint
addPoint.desc: Adds the point to the enterfunction in the current window.

applyEnterFun.name: applyEnterFun
applyEnterFun.desc: Calls doneProc, passes it the points you entered, resets the enterfunction, and calls initProc.

cancelEnterFun.name: cancelEnterFun
cancelEnterFun.desc: Cancels the enterfunction in the current window.

changeEnterFun.name: changeEnterFun
changeEnterFun.syntax:
changeEnterFun(
s_enterFun 
[ ?prompts l_promptList ] 
[ ?points l_pointList ] 
[ ?wantPoints x_pointLimit ]
[ ?form s_form ] 
[ ?addPointProc t_addProcName ] 
[ ?delPointProc t_delProcName ] 
[ ?initProc t_initProcName ] 
[ ?doneProc t_doneProcName ]
[ ?formProc t_formProcName ]

hiGetCurrentCmd.name: hiGetCurrentCmd
hiGetCurrentCmd.desc: Returns the 	command name associated with the enterfunction currently running in a window, or nil if no enterfunction is running.

hiInEnterFun.name: hiInEnterFun
hiInEnterFun.desc: Returns the symbol of the enterfunction pending in the window.

hiMarkNestable.name: hiMarkNestable
hiMarkNestable.desc: Makes enterfunctions nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces the old enterfunction in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the old enterfunction is resumed. This function reverses the effect of hiMarkNonNestable.

hiMarkNonNestable.name: hiMarkNonNestable
hiMarkNonNestable.desc: Makes enterfunctions non-nestable. When an enterfunction is running and a new one is called, the new enterfunction replaces it in the stack. When the new enterfunction is finished or canceled, the enterfunction it replaced will not be returned to, but will have been canceled by the new enterfunction.

hiToggleEnterForm.name: hiToggleEnterForm
hiToggleEnterForm.desc: Displays or removes the options form of the enterfunction in the current window.

hiUpdate.name: hiUpdate
hiUpdate.desc: Updates window prompts and application-specific state variables. Especially important if an enterfunction has been canceled in a window that is not the current window.

preXY.name: preXY
preXY.desc: Causes an addPoint( l_point ) command to be added to the command queue in order to be logged and executed at the next toplevel to simulate the user selecting a point.

setEFunFlightLineTarget.name: setEFunFlightLineTarget
setEFunFlightLineTarget.desc: Sets a target point for the enterLine function so that a flight line is drawn from the cursor to this point.

undrawEnterFun.name: undrawEnterFun
undrawEnterFun.desc: Undraws any rubberbanding shapes. Called when an enterfunction is active. If you enter data in the window, rubberbanding resumes.

hiAppendInputCmd.name: hiAppendInputCmd
hiAppendInputCmd.desc: Appends a command to the input area of an encapsulation window.

hiFocusToEncap.name: hiFocusToEncap
hiFocusToEncap.desc: Temporarily focuses the keyboard input to an encapsulation window.

hiGetEncapSkillCmd.name: hiGetEncapSkillCmd
hiGetEncapSkillCmd.desc: Returns the SKILL function associated with a window.

hiSetEncapPrompt.name: hiSetEncapPrompt

hiSetEncapSkillCmd.name: hiSetEncapSkillCmd
hiSetEncapSkillCmd.desc: Registers the SKILL function that wraps or embraces the input command line entered during the current encapsulation session.

hiClearClipboard.name: hiClearClipboard
hiClearClipboard.desc: Clears the text stored in the system clipboard.

hiClearCurrentTextSelection.name: hiClearCurrentTextSelection
hiClearCurrentTextSelection.desc: Clears current selection, if any, in the specified text window. This is equivalent to clicking anywhere in the text window when text is selected.

hiDisableTailViewfile.name: hiDisableTailViewfile
hiDisableTailViewfile.desc: Turns off the ability to repeatedly read from the end of a file.

hiEnableTailViewfile.name: hiEnableTailViewfile
hiEnableTailViewfile.desc: Turns on the ability to repeatedly read from the end of a file and update the viewfile window. This continually updates the viewfile window with text that is appended to the end of the file being viewed. This only works when appending to a file. If the file is modified in another way, such as edited using an editor, the results are unpredictable. This function is equivalent to the UNIX command tail_f and works the same way.

hiGenTextIndex.desc: Returns the character position that is the next occurrence of the text string relative to a specified position in the file.

hiStartGenTextIndex.name: hiStartGenTextIndex

hiGetTextSelection.name: hiGetTextSelection

hiGetTextSelByLoc.name: hiGetTextSelByLoc

hiGetCurrentTextSelection.name: hiGetCurrentTextSelection
hiGetCurrentTextSelection.desc: Returns the text selected in the specified viewfile window. This is the text which has been selected by using a mouse button action, such as by double-clicking or drag-selecting. If no text appears selected, the function returns nil.

hiGetCurrentTextSelectionLoc.name: hiGetCurrentTextSelectionLoc
hiGetCurrentTextSelectionLoc.desc: Returns the text coordinates of the text selected in the specified viewfile window. This is the text which has been selected using a mouse action, such as by double-clicking or drag-selecting. If no text is selected in the specified window, the function returns nil.

hiUnselectTextClass.name: hiUnselectTextClass

If the search pattern t_text is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text of all classes. If the class x_class is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text. Afterwards, the cursor position is reset to the top of the file. If an empty string is passed for t_text, and x_class is specified, unselects all strings selected in that class

hiScrollWindowRight.name: hiScrollWindowRight

hiScrollWindowUp.name: hiScrollWindowUp
