hiScrollWindowDown.name: hiScrollWindowDown
hiScrollWindowDown.desc: Scrolls the window down one screenful of text at a time.

hiScrollWindowTop.name: hiScrollWindowTop
hiScrollWindowTop.desc: Scrolls the window to the top position of the viewable window.

hiScrollWindowBottom.name: hiScrollWindowBottom
hiScrollWindowBottom.desc: Scrolls the window to the bottom position of the viewable window.

hiScrollWindowToCurrentIndex.name: hiScrollWindowToCurrentIndex
hiScrollWindowToCurrentIndex.desc: Scrolls the window to the current cursor index position in the viewable window.

hiScrollWindowToIndex.name: hiScrollWindowToIndex
hiScrollWindowToIndex.desc: Scrolls the window to the index position in the specified window and forces the text at the given position to be displayed.

hiScrollWindowToName.name: hiScrollWindowToName
hiScrollWindowToName.desc: Scrolls a hypertext window to a link and displays the text associated with the link. A hypertext window is a text window that can display text with hyperlinks in it.

hiGetCurrentIndex.name: hiGetCurrentIndex
hiGetCurrentIndex.desc: Returns the current cursor index position relative to all the text in the window.

hiSetCurrentIndex.name: hiSetCurrentIndex

hiGetClipboard.name: hiGetClipboard
hiGetClipboard.desc: Returns the text stored in the system clipboard.

hiSetClipboard.name: hiSetClipboard

hiGetTextClass.name: hiGetTextClass
hiGetTextClass.desc: Returns the value of the current active text class. If hiSetTextClass() has not been set, the current active text class will be 0. Also, a few other functions may reset the active text class back to 0 or possibly another value. Otherwise the currently active text class will be the one set by the last call to hiSetTextClass().

If the hiHelpAction property is set, hiHelp executes the callback associated with the property, instead of calling the Doc Assistant API. hiHelp is the main service routine for the online help system.

hiLookupHRFtag.name: hiLookupHRFtag
hiLookupHRFtag.desc: Returns the command that has been defined as the help response for a help tag in a .HRF file. You can get more information about the usage of this function from the your_install_dir/tools/dfII/samples/local/hrfHelp.il file.

hiModalDBoxHelp.name: hiModalDBoxHelp
hiModalDBoxHelp.desc: Displays a message in a modal dialog box. A modal dialog box is a blocking dialog box-it waits for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

hiModelessDBoxHelp.name: hiModelessDBoxHelp
hiModelessDBoxHelp.desc: Displays a message in a modeless dialog box. A modeless dialog box is a non-blocking dialog box-it does not wait for an acknowledgement before allowing the application to continue.

hiObShowTag.name: hiObShowTag
hiObShowTag.syntax:
hiObShowTag(
t_tool
t_tag
t_version
)
=> t / nil
hiObShowTag.desc: Opens Doc Assistant to display the help document related to the specified tool and tag.

nrDialogAccept.name: nrDialogAccept
nrDialogAccept.desc: Function logged when a dialog box is accepted, when the Return key is pressed or buttons such as OK, Yes, or Done in the dialog box are clicked. This function is logged only for native Qt dialog boxes. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrGetIndexesFromSelection.name: nrGetIndexesFromSelection
nrGetIndexesFromSelection.desc: Expands the specified compact list representing a selection of items from other lists or tree widgets into the corresponding expanded list representation detailing each selected item.

nrGetSelectedIndexes.name: nrGetSelectedIndexes
nrGetSelectedIndexes.desc: Returns a list comprising the selected indexes of lists or tree widgets.

nrListColumnMove.name: nrListColumnMove
nrListColumnMove.syntax:
nrListColumnMove(
o_listView
x_position
x_newPosition
)
=> t / nil
nrListColumnMove.desc: Function logged when a column in a list/tree view (created with the Qt QListView class) is moved. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrListColumnSort.name: nrListColumnSort
nrListColumnSort.desc: Function logged when a column in a list/tree view, created with the Qt QListView class, is sorted. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrListItemAction.name: nrListItemAction
nrListItemAction.desc: Function logged when the action associated with an item in a list/tree view created with the Qt QListView class is invoked by double-clicking on the item. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrListItemExpand.name: nrListItemExpand
nrListItemExpand.syntax:
nrListItemExpand(
o_listView
t_listItem
g_expandedOrCollapsed
)
=> t / nil
nrListItemExpand.desc: Function logged when an item in a list/tree view created with the Qt QListView class is expanded or collapsed. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrListItemRename.name: nrListItemRename
nrListItemRename.syntax:
nrListItemRename(
o_listView
t_itemName
x_columnIndex
t_newItemName
)
=> t / nil
nrListItemRename.desc: Function logged when an item in a list/tree view (created with the Qt QListView class) is renamed. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrResizeWindow.name: nrResizeWindow
nrResizeWindow.desc: Function logged when a window is resized or moved. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrSetCurrentWindow.name: nrSetCurrentWindow
nrSetCurrentWindow.desc: Function logged when the current window is set. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrSetFileFilter.name: nrSetFileFilter
nrSetFileFilter.desc: Function logged when a file filter is selected in a file dialog box. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrSetWindowVisibility.name: nrSetWindowVisibility
nrSetWindowVisibility.desc: Function logged when a window is displayed, removed from the screen, or iconified. When a window is displayed, the second argument of this function is the string show, when a window is removed, the second argument is hide, and when a window is iconified, the second argument is min. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

nrUpdateMenu.name: nrUpdateMenu
nrUpdateMenu.desc: Function logged when the contents of a dynamic popup menu are modified. This function is logged for menus derived from the nrReplayPopupMenu class, which is a part of the native Qt replay library. The function is logged whenever the contentsChanged signal is emitted from the menu. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

perfDiagInstall.name: perfDiagInstall
perfDiagInstall.syntax:
perfDiagInstall
g_RdOnly
[ ?openCallstack g_openCallstack | ?loadOnly g_loadOnly ]
=> t / nil
perfDiagInstall.desc: Installs the Performance Diagnosis tools and places its submenu under the Tools menu in CIW. You can use this tool to diagnose various performance issues in Virtuoso custom IC design platform, typically starting with the PerfDiagnosis control form to record callstacks.

perfRefreshControl.name: perfRefreshControl
perfRefreshControl.desc: Refreshes the Health Monitor form to apply the changes made using the Performance Diagnostic environment variables.

perfStartCallStackProc.name: perfStartCallStackProc
perfStartCallStackProc.desc: Starts collecting the callstacks using the Health Monitor tool.

perfStopCallStackProc.name: perfStopCallStackProc
perfStopCallStackProc.desc: Stops the Health Monitor tool from collecting the callstacks.

dlAddPath.name: dlAddPath
dlAddPath.syntax:

l_pointsList

dlAddPath.desc: Adds a path to the display list.

dlAddPoint.syntax:
dlAddPoint(
w_dlist

l_point

)

dlAddPoint.desc: Adds a point to the display list.

dlAddPolygon.name: dlAddPolygon
dlAddPolygon.syntax:
dlAddPolygon(
w_dlist

l_pointsList
[ s_tagSymbol ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlAddPolygon.desc: Adds a polygon to the display list.

)

dlAddRasterText.desc: Adds a text string to the display list.

dlAddSegment.name: dlAddSegment
dlAddSegment.syntax:
dlAddSegment(
w_dlist

l_point1 
l_point2 
[ s_tagSymbol ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlAddSegment.desc: Adds a line segment to the display list.

dlAddSkillObject.name: dlAddSkillObject
dlAddSkillObject.syntax:
dlAddSkillObject(

x_penNumber 
l_point1 
l_point2 
t_procName 
t_procArgs
[ s_tagSymbol ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlAddSkillObject.desc: Adds a SkillObject to the display list. SkillObjects are SKILL procedures called whenever the object should be drawn.

dlAddStrokeText.name: dlAddStrokeText
dlAddStrokeText.syntax:
dlAddStrokeText(

dlAddStrokeText.desc: Adds a stroke text string to the display list.

dlMakeDisplayList.name: dlMakeDisplayList
dlMakeDisplayList.desc: Creates an empty display list you can add objects to.

dlSetClearOnDraw.name: dlSetClearOnDraw
dlSetClearOnDraw.syntax:
dlSetClearOnDraw(
w_dlist
x_widgetId
g_draw
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetClearOnDraw.desc: Specifies whether the area the display list is drawn in is cleared before the display list is drawn.

dlDrawArc.name: dlDrawArc

dlDrawArc(
l_point1 
l_point2 
f_startAngle 
f_sweepAngle
) 
=> t / nil
dlDrawArc.desc: Draws an arc to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawBox.name: dlDrawBox
dlDrawBox.desc: Draws a box to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawCircle.name: dlDrawCircle
dlDrawCircle.desc: Draws a circle to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawDonut.name: dlDrawDonut
dlDrawDonut.syntax:
dlDrawDonut(
l_point 
x_innerRadius

) 
=> t / nil
dlDrawDonut.desc: Draws a donut to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawPath(

l_pointsList
) 
=> t / nil
dlDrawPath.desc: Draws a path to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure. A path is specified by a center line and a width.

dlDrawPoint.name: dlDrawPoint
dlDrawPoint.desc: Draws a point to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawPolygon.name: dlDrawPolygon
dlDrawPolygon.desc: Draws a polygon to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawRasterText.name: dlDrawRasterText
dlDrawRasterText.syntax:
dlDrawRasterText(
l_point 
t_text 
t_fontName 
[ t_verticalJustify ] 
[ t_horizontalJustify ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlDrawRasterText.desc: Draws a text string to the screen from within a SkillObject. The text is drawn using an X Window System font..

dlDrawSegment.name: dlDrawSegment
dlDrawSegment.desc: Draws a line segment to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlDrawStrokeText.name: dlDrawStrokeText
dlDrawStrokeText.syntax:
dlDrawStrokeText(
l_point 
t_text 
t_justification 
t_fontName 
x_height 
t_orientation
) 
=> t / nil
dlDrawStrokeText.desc: Draws a stroke text string to the screen from within a SkillObject procedure. The height and therefore scale can be specified.

dlMakePenTable.name: dlMakePenTable
dlMakePenTable.desc: Creates a pen table a display list can use.

dlMakeStipple.name: dlMakeStipple
dlMakeStipple.desc: Creates a stipple pattern from the supplied string.

dlSetCurrentPen.name: dlSetCurrentPen
dlSetCurrentPen.desc: Sets the specified pen number to the current pen. Changes the pen number objects are drawn with from within a SkillObject procedure. This function should only be called from within a SkillObject procedure.

dlSetPenColor.name: dlSetPenColor
dlSetPenColor.syntax:
dlSetPenColor(
x_penNumber 
x_colorIndex 
[ w_penTable ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetPenColor.desc: Changes the specified pen to the specified color index from the pen table.

dlSetPenFillStyle.name: dlSetPenFillStyle
dlSetPenFillStyle.syntax:
dlSetPenFillStyle(
x_penNumber 
t_fillStyle 
[ w_penTable ] 
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetPenFillStyle.desc: Sets the fill style of a pen.

dlSetPenFilled.name: dlSetPenFilled
dlSetPenFilled.desc: Sets the fill style of a pen to SolidFill.

dlSetPenStipple.name: dlSetPenStipple
dlSetPenStipple.syntax:
dlSetPenStipple(
x_penNumber 
x_stippleId 
[ w_penTable ] 
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetPenStipple.desc: Sets the stipple pattern for a pen.

dlSetPenTable.name: dlSetPenTable
dlSetPenTable.desc: Sets the pen table a display list will use.

dlAttachDlistToWidget.name: dlAttachDlistToWidget
dlAttachDlistToWidget.desc: Attaches a display list to a widget.

dlAttachDlistToWindow.name: dlAttachDlistToWindow
dlAttachDlistToWindow.desc: Attaches a display list to the window defined by w_windowId. This function can be used to preview a display list.

dlClearDisplayList.name: dlClearDisplayList
dlClearDisplayList.desc: Removes all the objects from a display list.

dlConfigureButton.name: dlConfigureButton
dlConfigureButton.syntax:
dlConfigureButton(
x_button
x_xPosition
x_yPosition
x_width
x_height
) 
=> t / nil
dlConfigureButton.desc: Moves a button to another location. Both the x and y position are specified in X Window System coordinates, where 0:0 is the upper left corner of the screen.

dlDetachDlistFromWidget.name: dlDetachDlistFromWidget
dlDetachDlistFromWidget.desc: Detaches a display list from a widget.

dlDetachDlistFromWindow.name: dlDetachDlistFromWindow
dlDetachDlistFromWindow.desc: Detaches a display list (w_displayList) from the window defined by w_windowId.

dlDisplay.name: dlDisplay
dlDisplay.desc: Redraws the display list (w_displayList) in all the windows and buttons it is currently attached to.

dlDlistToIcon.name: dlDlistToIcon
dlDlistToIcon.syntax:
dlDlistToIcon(
w_displayList 
x_width 
x_height 
[ x_backColorIndex ] 
) 
=> l_iconId / nil
dlDlistToIcon.desc: Converts a displayList to an icon.

dlEnableItem.name: dlEnableItem
dlEnableItem.syntax:
dlEnableItem(
w_dlist 
x_penNumber 
s_symbolTag 
g_enableOrDisable 
) 
=> t / nil
dlEnableItem.desc: Allows you to turn on or off shapes within a display list that match the provided symbol. All shapes on pen x_penNumber are searched and checked to see if the symbolTag matches.

dlGetRasterTextWidth.name: dlGetRasterTextWidth
dlGetRasterTextWidth.desc: Retrieves width of the text in pixels for the specified raster font.

dlFitDlistOnDraw.name: dlFitDlistOnDraw
dlFitDlistOnDraw.syntax:
dlFitDlistOnDraw(
w_displayList
x_widgetId
g_doFit 
) 
=> t / nil
dlFitDlistOnDraw.desc: Specifies whether a display list should automatically fit within the specified widget.

dlMakeDlistButton.name: dlMakeDlistButton
dlMakeDlistButton.syntax:
dlMakeDlistButton(
x_parentWidgetId
x_xPosition
x_yPosition
x_width
x_height
w_displayList
t_pressCallback
[ x_backgroundColor ]
) 
=> t / nil
dlMakeDlistButton.desc: Creates a button to display a display list in. The display list button is a rectangular region with a widget or window in which a display list is drawn and which dispatches a callback whenever the left mouse button is pressed within it.

dlMakeWidget.name: dlMakeWidget
dlMakeWidget.syntax:
dlMakeWidget(
[ x_backgroundColor ] 
[ l_point1 ]
[ l_point2 ]
) 
=> x_widgetId / nil
dlMakeWidget.desc: Creates a general purpose window (or widget). Uses of this widget can be for fixed menus or graphic display panels. Both points are specified in X Window System coordinates, where 0:0 is the upper-left corner of the screen.

dlMapWidget.name: dlMapWidget
dlMapWidget.desc: Puts a widget back on the screen after a call to dlUnMapWidget. This function also applies to buttons.

dlMoveButton.name: dlMoveButton
dlMoveButton.syntax:
dlMoveButton(
x_button
x_xPosition
x_yPosition
) 
=> t | nil
dlMoveButton.desc: Moves a button to another location. Both the x and y position are specified in X Window System coordinates, where 0:0 is the upper-left corner of the screen.

dlQueryRasterFont.name: dlQueryRasterFont
dlQueryRasterFont.desc: Returns the font property list for the raster font.

dlResizeButton.name: dlResizeButton
dlResizeButton.syntax:
dlResizeButton(
x_button
x_width
x_height
) 
=> t / nil

dlSaveDlist.name: dlSaveDlist
dlSaveDlist.syntax:
dlSaveDlist(
w_displayList 
t_fileName 
t_dlistName
) 
=> t / nil

dlSetDlistPosition.name: dlSetDlistPosition
dlSetDlistPosition.syntax:
dlSetDlistPosition(
w_displayList
x_widgetId
x_xOffset
x_yOffset 
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetDlistPosition.desc: Specifies the scale factor to map from display list coordinates to screen coordinates. The offsets only have effect if auto-fitting was turned off (via dfIIFitDlistOnDraw).

dlSetDlistScale.name: dlSetDlistScale
dlSetDlistScale.syntax:
dlSetDlistScale(
w_displayList
x_widgetId
f_scale 
) 
=> t / nil
dlSetDlistScale.desc: Specifies the scale factor to map from display list coordinates to screen coordinates. This scale factor only has effect if auto-fitting was turned off (using dfIIFitDlistOnDraw).

dlSetWidgetName.name: dlSetWidgetName
dlSetWidgetName.desc: Sets the text displayed by the window manager banner.

dlUnMapWidget.name: dlUnMapWidget
dlUnMapWidget.desc: Removes the widget from the screen, but does not destroy it. This function also applies to buttons.

dagAddActionToObject.name: dagAddActionToObject
dagAddActionToObject.desc: Adds the action to the specified dag node or class. However, if the action is already in the list, it is not replaced. For an existing action, use dagDeleteActionFromObject to delete the action and then call dagAddActionToObject.

dagCreateClass.name: dagCreateClass
dagCreateClass.desc: Creates a dagClass and returns it. If a class by this name already exists, it is overwritten.

dagCreateNode.name: dagCreateNode
dagCreateNode.desc: Creates a dagNode and returns it.

dagDeleteActionFromObject.name: dagDeleteActionFromObject
dagDeleteActionFromObject.desc: Deletes the action named t_actionName from the specified class or node. If a node action was inherited from its class, the action must be deleted from the class, not the node.

dagDestroyNode.name: dagDestroyNode
dagDestroyNode.desc: Destroys a dagNode. All descendant nodes and arcs of this node are also destroyed, as well as the arcs linking this node to its parents.

dagDisplayTool.name: dagDisplayTool
dagDisplayTool.desc: Redisplays a dagTool. You can use this function if you want to re-display all of the objects in the graph rather than calling dagRefreshObject for each one.

dagGetCurrentObject.name: dagGetCurrentObject
dagGetCurrentObject.desc: Identifies the node for which the action was selected. It takes no arguments and returns the current node, or nil.

dagGetCurrentTool.name: dagGetCurrentTool
dagGetCurrentTool.desc: Returns the current dagTool, and nil if there is not a current dagTool. The current dagTool is different from the current window. The current tool might not be the current window.

dagLinkParentToChild.name: dagLinkParentToChild
dagLinkParentToChild.desc: Creates a dagArc that links the parent node to the child node. It returns the arc it creates. If an error occurs, it returns nil.

dagNumToTool.name: dagNumToTool
dagNumToTool.desc: Returns the dagtool that matches the window number specified by x_toolNumber.

dagOpenTool.name: dagOpenTool
dagOpenTool.syntax:
dagOpenTool(
x_backGroundColor
l_bBox
w_startingObject
t_name
t_help
) 
=> w_dagTool / nil
dagOpenTool.desc: Creates a dagTool object and opens a window in which to display the graph starting from the specified starting node.

dagPopTool.name: dagPopTool
dagPopTool.desc: Pops the tool stack specified by the w_dagTool argument.

dagPushTool.name: dagPushTool
dagPushTool.desc: Pushes a new starting object specified by the w_newStartingNode argument onto the stack of the tool specified by w_dagTool.

dagRefreshObject.name: dagRefreshObject
dagRefreshObject.desc: Redraws the node specified by w_dagNode in all the tools it is currently displayed.

dagSetActionStatus.name: dagSetActionStatus
dagSetActionStatus.syntax:
dagSetActionStatus(
t_actionName
w_dagObject
g_status 
)
=> t / nil
dagSetActionStatus.desc: Sets the status of the specified action in the action list of the class or node. An action that has been turned off is grayed-out in the pop-up menu and not available through its action accelerator, if any.

dagSetCurrentTool.name: dagSetCurrentTool
dagSetCurrentTool.desc: Sets the current dagTool to the one specified by the w_dagTool argument.

dagSetExpandedActionStatus.name: dagSetExpandedActionStatus
dagSetExpandedActionStatus.syntax:
dagSetExpandedActionStatus(
t_actionName
w_dagObject
g_status
)
=> t / nil
dagSetExpandedActionStatus.desc: Sets the status of the specified action in the expanded-action list of a node. Setting the status to nil makes the action name appear gray in the pop-up menu and makes the action accelerator unavailable. Once a dagNode has been placed into a tool, the actions from the dagClass are concatenated to make a full list of actions for this node. This is known as the expanded-action list.

dagSetFont.name: dagSetFont
dagSetFont.desc: Modifies the font used in text mode in any dag tool.

dagUnlinkParentFromChild.name: dagUnlinkParentFromChild
dagUnlinkParentFromChild.desc: Unlinks a parent node from a child node. It takes, as its only argument, the dagArc that connects the parent to the child. The arc is destroyed; however, neither the parent node nor the child node is destroyed. This can be useful if you want to change the parent of a node.

hiSleep.name: hiSleep
hiSleep.desc: The hiSleep() function is an alias for the ipcSleep function.

hiGetStrokeBBox.name: hiGetStrokeBBox
hiGetStrokeBBox.desc: Returns the bounding box of the stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

hiGetStrokeFirstPt.name: hiGetStrokeFirstPt
hiGetStrokeFirstPt.desc: Returns the point location of the first pixel of a stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

hiGetStrokeLastPt.name: hiGetStrokeLastPt
hiGetStrokeLastPt.desc: Returns the point location of the last pixel of a stroke when within a callback initiated by a stroke.

hiStroke.name: hiStroke
hiStroke.desc: Mouse callback that initiates a stroke command.

iqCreateDummyCell.name: iqCreateDummyCell
iqCreateDummyCell.desc: Creates a dummy cell and library when you type this SKILL command, in the Command Interpreter Window (CIW).

vsaCreateMarker.name: vsaCreateMarker
vsaCreateMarker.syntax:
vsaCreateMarker( 
x x_coordinate
y y_coordinate
message
)
=> t / nil
vsaCreateMarker.desc: Creates a point marker with the specified attributes. When this marker is created successfully, it appears in the Misc tab of Annotation Browser.

vsaOpenLayout.name: vsaOpenLayout
vsaOpenLayout.desc: Opens the design in Virtuoso in the read-only mode.

vsaLoadNets.name: vsaLoadNets
vsaLoadNets.desc: Specifies the nets to be loaded in the Voltus-Fi GUI.

vsaLoadSecondaryLayers.name: vsaLoadSecondaryLayers
vsaLoadSecondaryLayers.desc: Enables the loading of data for all layers in the Voltus-Fi GUI.

vsaSetLayersToMergeDuringResultsLoading.name: vsaSetLayersToMergeDuringResultsLoading
vsaSetLayersToMergeDuringResultsLoading.desc: Specifies the name of the metal layer and the corresponding cut-layer to be excluded from highlighting while plotting the EMIR analysis results. This function can be called multiple times to specify different pairs of metal and cut layers. Voltus-Fi honors all these calls. This function must be called before loading results in Voltus-Fi.

vsaSetInputType.name: vsaSetInputType
vsaSetInputType.syntax:
vsaSetInputType(
inputType
resultsFile 
resultsType 
startTime 
stopTime)
)
vsaSetInputType.desc: Specifies the data base input options, parameter storage format (PSF) or vavo_db, for running IR drop and EM analyses in the Voltus-Fi-L GUI. The resultsType, startTime and stopTime arguments are only valid for the psf-based flow.

vsaSetEMIRConfig.name: vsaSetEMIRConfig
vsaSetEMIRConfig.desc: Loads the EMIR configuration file to be used for EMIR analysis in Voltus-Fi-XL. This file is specified before calling the vsaLoadEM() function.

vsaSetEMResultsFile.name: vsaSetEMResultsFile
vsaSetEMResultsFile.desc: Specifies the simulation results file to be used for viewing the EMIR analysis results in Voltus-Fi-XL. This file contains the simulation database generated using the Spectre simulator.

vsaSetEMLayerMapFileName.name: vsaSetEMLayerMapFileName
vsaSetEMLayerMapFileName.desc: Specifies the name of the layer map file to be used for the EM technology file. This file provides the mapping between layer names in the simulation database and those in the technology file. This function is only used for EM plots.

vsaSetEMTechFileName.name: vsaSetEMTechFileName
vsaSetEMTechFileName.desc: Specifies the name of the EM technology file that contains the EM rule information to be used for plotting EM results in Voltus-Fi.

vsaSetEMTypes.name: vsaSetEMTypes
vsaSetEMTypes.desc: Specifies the types of EM analyses for which you want to plot EM results in Voltus-Fi. At least one analysis type must be selected.

vsaSetDfiiLayerMapFileName.name: vsaSetDfiiLayerMapFileName
vsaSetDfiiLayerMapFileName.desc: Specifies the DFII layer map filename that provides the mapping between the extractor-generated xDSPF file layer names and the DFII layer names.

vsaShowAllResistors.name: vsaShowAllResistors
vsaShowAllResistors.desc: When specified, displays all resistors on the Voltus-Fi GUI including those for which there are no layout shapes matching the specified resistor coordinates. These resistors are displayed using stick diagrams.

vsaSetQRCData.name: vsaSetQRCData
vsaSetQRCData.desc: Sets the Quantus inputs to enable solid shape highlighting for EMIR plots displayed on the Virtuoso layout.

vsaSelectFailedNets.name: vsaSelectFailedNets
vsaSelectFailedNets.desc: Specifies that EM analysis results for only those nets that failed the EM check should be plotted. It enables the Show Only Failed option in the GUI.

vsaSetEMOnlyICTFile.name: vsaSetEMOnlyICTFile
vsaSetEMOnlyICTFile.desc: Specifies the name of the ICT file to be used for specifying the EM rules for plotting EM analysis results.

vsaSetEMPlot.name: vsaSetEMPlot
vsaSetEMPlot.desc: Specifies the default plot for EM analysis results in Voltus-Fi.

vsaLoadEM.name: vsaLoadEM
vsaLoadEM.desc: Specifies that the EM analysis results should be loaded. Before specifying this function, ensure that the EM results file and the EM technology file are specified.

vsaSetIRResultsFile.name: vsaSetIRResultsFile
vsaSetIRResultsFile.desc: Specifies the results file to be used for viewing the EMIR analysis results in Voltus-Fi-XL.

vsaSetIRThreshold.name: vsaSetIRThreshold
vsaSetIRThreshold.desc: Sets the threshold value for viewing IR drop violations.

vsaSetIRPlot.name: vsaSetIRPlot
vsaSetIRPlot.desc: Specifies the default plot for IR drop analysis results in Voltus-Fi.

vsaSetLRPShortedLayers.name: vsaSetLRPShortedLayers
vsaSetLRPShortedLayers.desc: Specifies the names of layers to be shorted for the least-resistive path (LRP) analysis.

vsaLoadIR.name: vsaLoadIR
vsaLoadIR.desc: Specifies that the IR drop analysis results should be loaded. Before specifying this function, ensure that the IR drop results filename is specified.

vsaSetFinerDisplayOff.name: vsaSetFinerDisplayOff
vsaSetFinerDisplayOff.desc: Disables the finer gradient for the specified layers while displaying the IR/EM plots on the Virtuoso layout. This function is specified after specifying the DFII layermap file and before loading the IR drop or EM analysis results.

vsaSetParallelLoading.name: vsaSetParallelLoading
vsaSetParallelLoading.desc: Enables parallel loading of OpenAccess shapes in the Voltus-Fi application interface.

vicOpenVlogCallBack.name: vicOpenVlogCallBack
vicOpenVlogCallBack.desc: Opens the Verilog Integration form.This function is a CIW menu callback function and is called when the Verilog integration environment is invoked.

vlVicCrossSelectionForm.name: vlVicCrossSelectionForm
vlVicCrossSelectionForm.desc: Opens the Cross Selection Setup form. This form is used to cross-select objects of a design between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor during interactive simulation.

vlVicPSForm.name: vlVicPSForm
vlVicPSForm.desc: Opens the Post Simulation Analysis form. This form is used to cross-select objects of a design between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor during post-simulation analysis.

vlogifCrossSelectionCB.name: vlogifCrossSelectionCB
vlogifCrossSelectionCB.desc: Controls the cross-selection between SimVision and Virtuoso Schematic Editor when performing interactive simulation.

cat.name: cat
cat.desc: Prints the contents of filename on standard output. The function is defined in /etc/skill/si/simcap.ile. You can modify this function.

cdsGetNetlistMode.name: cdsGetNetlistMode
cdsGetNetlistMode.desc: Returns the value of the shell environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode that is set in the current shell to invoke Virtuoso.

cdsSetNetlistMode.name: cdsSetNetlistMode
cdsSetNetlistMode.desc: Sets netlisting mode, which is based on the current value of the SHELL environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode. The valid values for this shell environment variable are Digital, Analog, or Compatibility. The function cdsSetNetlistMode is used in the Virtuoso SKILL environment to update the settings without restarting Virtuoso.

ERC.name: ERC
ERC.desc: Defines the sequence of steps for performing an Electric Rule Checking (ERC). This function is invoked if you provide no overriding function. It checks the variables, the sequence of steps, such as netlisting (ercNetlist), and calls the ERC program for execution (ercSimout).

fnlAbortNetlist.name: fnlAbortNetlist
fnlAbortNetlist.desc: Aborts netlisting. When the formatter detects an error during netlisting, it calls this function to inform the netlister to abort netlisting.

fnlCurrentCell.name: fnlCurrentCell
fnlCurrentCell.desc: Returns the master of the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during the evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

fnlCurrentCellCdsName.name: fnlCurrentCellCdsName
fnlCurrentCellCdsName.desc: Returns the master cell name of the current instance being expanded. This function corresponds to the netlister-defined BlockName property and must be called only during evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

fnlCurrentInst.name: fnlCurrentInst
fnlCurrentInst.desc: Returns the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during expansion of the NLPcompleteElementString property. Do not use the master field of the resulting instanceId. If you use it, you get the symbol cellview rather than the stopping cellview corresponding to the symbol placed in the schematic. To get the instance master in a format instruction, use the fnlCurrentCell function.

fnlCurrentInstCdsName.name: fnlCurrentInstCdsName
fnlCurrentInstCdsName.desc: Returns the full instance pathname to the current instance being expanded. This function must be called only during expansion of the NLPcompleteElementString property.

fnlCurrentIteration.name: fnlCurrentIteration
fnlCurrentIteration.desc: Returns an index of the current iterated instance being expanded. Only an instance can be iterated and placed in the schematic.

fnlCurrentModelExtName.name: fnlCurrentModelExtName
fnlCurrentModelExtName.desc: Returns the netlister-assigned model name of the current instance being expanded. This function corresponds to the netlister-defined ModelNumber property and must be called only during evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString and NLPcreateModelString properties.

fnlCurrentSig.name: fnlCurrentSig
fnlCurrentSig.desc: Returns the current signal being expanded.

fnlCurrentSigPathName.name: fnlCurrentSigPathName
fnlCurrentSigPathName.desc: Returns the full pathname of the current signal being expanded. It corresponds to the netlister-defined NetPathName property. As the corresponding property, this function is valid only during evaluation of the NLPcreateNetString property.

fnlGetGlobalSigNames.name: fnlGetGlobalSigNames
fnlGetGlobalSigNames.desc: Returns a list of strings that are the names for all of the global signals contained in the design hierarchy. If the netlister-assigned name is required, you can pass these names to the fnlSigCdsNameExtName function to translate them during the header or footer evaluation. You can use the fnlGetGlobalSigName function at any time during the netlisting process.

fnlInstCdsNameExtName.name: fnlInstCdsNameExtName
fnlInstCdsNameExtName.desc: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the instance name specified as an argument, if the instance is found.

fnlPathList.name: fnlPathList
fnlPathList.desc: Returns a list representing the current instance path down the schematic hierarchy to the current instance or signal being expanded.

fnlPrint.name: fnlPrint
fnlPrint.desc: Prints the specified argument in the netlist file.

fnlSearchPropString.name: fnlSearchPropString
fnlSearchPropString.desc: Returns the property value for the property name specified as an argument.

fnlSigCdsNameExtName.name: fnlSigCdsNameExtName
fnlSigCdsNameExtName.desc: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the signal name specified as an argument, if the signal is found.

fnlTermCdsNameExtName.name: fnlTermCdsNameExtName
fnlTermCdsNameExtName.desc: Returns each netlister-assigned signal name for the signal attached to the terminal whose name is specified as an argument. The function is equivalent to the substitution expression [ |name ]. As with the matching expression, the terminal names allowed as arguments are restricted to the terminals attached to the current instance.

fnlTermExtName.name: fnlTermExtName
fnlTermExtName.desc: Returns the netlister-assigned name for the signal attached to the bit of the terminal specified as an argument. The function is similar to the substitution expression [ |name ]. As with the matching expression, the terminals allowed as arguments are restricted to the formal terminals of the master of the current instance. This function must be called only during the evaluation of the NLPcompleteElementString property.

hnlAbortNetlist.name: hnlAbortNetlist
hnlAbortNetlist.desc: Aborts netlisting. When the formatter detects an error during netlisting, it calls this function to inform the netlister to abort netlisting. This function aborts netlisting at the next convenient point, usually after the current cell is processed.

hnlAddExtraParameters.name: hnlAddExtraParameters
hnlAddExtraParameters.desc: Adds user-specified design variables to the OSS design variables list. For example, ADE-XL requires to add more design variables to OSS design variables list that are obtained after CDF callback evaluation.

hnlCatIncrementalNetlistFiles.name: hnlCatIncrementalNetlistFiles
hnlCatIncrementalNetlistFiles.desc: Concatenates the list of netlist files into a single file whose file handle is given as the first parameter to this function. The second parameter is the list of files to be concatenated.

hnlCellExtracted.name: hnlCellExtracted
hnlCellExtracted.desc: Checks if the cellview has not been modified since it was last extracted.

hnlCellInAllCells.name: hnlCellInAllCells
hnlCellInAllCells.desc: Checks if the cellview argument exists as a cellview in the list of all cells. If not, this function returns nil.

hnlCloseCellFiles.name: hnlCloseCellFiles
hnlCloseCellFiles.desc: Closes all opened files to netlist the cell from hnlCurrentCell. This function calls the hnlWriteBlockControlFile function to create the control file under the directory for hnlCurrentCell.

hnlCloseMasterList.name: hnlCloseMasterList
hnlCloseMasterList.desc: Closes a list of cellviews one by one. This is the reverse function of hnlGetMasterCells.

hnlCompletePrint.name: hnlCompletePrint
hnlCompletePrint.desc: Clears the buffers needed for the hnlPrintString function and closes the netlist file.

hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.name: hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger
hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.desc: Deregisters a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that has been registered using hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.

hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.name: hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger
hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.desc: Deregisters a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that has been registered using hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.

hnlDoInstBased.name: hnlDoInstBased
hnlDoInstBased.desc: Driver for instance-based netlists. It determines the order in which most of the output functions are called. For each cellview in the schematic hierarchy that is determined by the hnlListOfAllCells variable, it sets the hnlCurrentCell global variable to the cellview to be netlisted.

hnlDoNetBased.name: hnlDoNetBased
hnlDoNetBased.desc: The driver for net-based netlists. cellList is the list of cellviews, or macros used to generate the netlist. By default, this procedure is called by the hnlPrintNetlist function with hnlListOfAllCells as the list of cells to be netlisted.

hnlEMHGetDigitaGlobalNets.name: hnlEMHGetDigitaGlobalNets
hnlEMHGetDigitaGlobalNets.desc: Returns a list of global nets found in digital design during mixed signal netlisting. This is used by the auCdl netlister to print *.GLOBAL statements for these nets in the top level netlist. This function must be called from Cadence internal formatters or ADE third-party integration formatters only when mixed signal netlisting is in progress.

hnlEMHGetDigitalNetlistFileName.name: hnlEMHGetDigitalNetlistFileName
hnlEMHGetDigitalNetlistFileName.desc: Returns the netlist file path for digital netlist during mixed signal netlisting. This path is exported for use by formatters like auCdl to include digital netlist file name in the top-level netlist. This function must be called from Cadence internal formatters or ADE third-party integration formatters only when mixed signal netlisting is in progress.

hnlEMHSetVerbosityLevel.name: hnlEMHSetVerbosityLevel
hnlEMHSetVerbosityLevel.desc: Raises the level of informative output from the mixed signal netlister. To avoid cluttering of output, the level should be set to one.

hnlFindAllCells.name: hnlFindAllCells
hnlFindAllCells.desc: Returns a list of all the unique devices and levels of the hierarchy that need to be netlisted. This is a list of lists where the first element of each sublist is a cell.

hnlFindAllInstInCell.name: hnlFindAllInstInCell
hnlFindAllInstInCell.desc: Finds all instances that can be netlisted in a cellview.

hnlGenIncludeFile.name: hnlGenIncludeFile
hnlGenIncludeFile.desc: Creates the include file. You must define this function for a formatter that needs an include file. Use the hnlIncludeFileName variable to specify the name of the include file. Use the hnlIncludeFile variable to access the file pointer. IHNL calls the hnlGenIncludeFile function after it generates the netlist files.

hnlGetCellHdbProps.name: hnlGetCellHdbProps
hnlGetCellHdbProps.desc: Returns the list of HDB properties and their values for the given cellview, when called by the formatter during netlisting. The function uses the DBId of cellview to extract the libName and cellName. It further uses the libName and cellName combination to query the HDB properties from prop.cfg property file.

hnlGetGlobalModelMappedName.name: hnlGetGlobalModelMappedName
hnlGetGlobalModelMappedName.desc: Returns a new mapped name for a given cell, if the argument specified as cellName is not a valid name for the target tool. Otherwise, an empty string is returned.

hnlGetGlobalNetMappedName.name: hnlGetGlobalNetMappedName
hnlGetGlobalNetMappedName.desc: Returns a new mapped name for a given global net, if the argument specified as netName is not a valid name for the target tool. Otherwise, an empty string is returned.

hnlGetInstanceCount.name: hnlGetInstanceCount
hnlGetInstanceCount.desc: Returns the number of instances netlisted in a single session. The function does not count the instances for which the nlAction property is set to ignore. This functions helps estimate the time taken to netlist and simulate based on the number of instances in a design. For example, this function can be used to implement a progress bar. A formatter can use this function only when OSS calls formatter functions to print a netlist.

hnlGetMappedInstNames.name: hnlGetMappedInstNames
hnlGetMappedInstNames.desc: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapInstName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

hnlGetMappedModelNames.name: hnlGetMappedModelNames
hnlGetMappedModelNames.desc: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapModelName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

hnlGetMappedNames.name: hnlGetMappedNames
hnlGetMappedNames.desc: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

hnlGetMappedNetNames.name: hnlGetMappedNetNames
hnlGetMappedNetNames.desc: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapNetName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

hnlGetMasterCells.name: hnlGetMasterCells
hnlGetMasterCells.desc: Returns a list of cellviews of the view-switched masters for a list of instances, which are stored in the same order as the given list.

hnlGetPrintLinePrefix.name: hnlGetPrintLinePrefix
hnlGetPrintLinePrefix.desc: Returns the line prefix set using hnlSetPrintLinePrefix function, which is used to print individual subcircuits during auCdl netlisting to indicate the continuation of the text on the next line, when the line exceeds the maximum character limit.

hnlGetPropVal.name: hnlGetPropVal
hnlGetPropVal.syntax:
hnlGetPropVal(
t_propName
d_cellView
d_inst
)
=> propValue / nil
hnlGetPropVal.desc: Returns the value of the property whose string name is given as the first argument. First, the property is searched for on the instance given as the third argument, and if not found there, on the cellview given as the second argument. If the property is found, the value is returned. Otherwise, nil is returned.

hnlGetRoundProp.name: hnlGetRoundProp
hnlGetRoundProp.desc: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned.

hnlGetScaleCapacitance.name: hnlGetScaleCapacitance
hnlGetScaleCapacitance.desc: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simCapUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer.

hnlGetScaleMarginalDelay.name: hnlGetScaleMarginalDelay
hnlGetScaleMarginalDelay.desc: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, multiplies it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest tenth. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest tenth.

hnlGetScaleTimeUnit.name: hnlGetScaleTimeUnit
hnlGetScaleTimeUnit.desc: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, then the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer.

hnlGetSimulator.name: hnlGetSimulator
hnlGetSimulator.desc: Provides a distinction between AMS and other flows. When it is called from the AMS flow, the function displays AMS as output, otherwise it behaves the same as simSimulator.

hnlGetSourceFile.name: hnlGetSourceFile
hnlGetSourceFile.desc: Retreives the path of source file of the given instance or cellview as specified in the HDB (prop.cfg property file), when this function is called by the formatter during netlisting.

hnlGetSourceFileModels.name: hnlGetSourceFileModels
hnlGetSourceFileModels.desc: Retreives a list of names of the netlisted cells, when this function is called by the formatter during netlisting. For the cells that have the -subckt value set using the sourcefile_opts property, the cell names in the list are replaced by the subcircuit names, for example, -subckt <name>.

hnlGetTermByName.name: hnlGetTermByName
hnlGetTermByName.desc: Returns the terminal ID and index corresponding to the member termname found in the specified cellview, where the ID is the first element of the list and the index is the second. If the given terminal name implies a width greater than 1, a -1 is returned as the index. If a single bit name is given, then the index returned is the index to the terminal.

hnlGetTermNameOfSig.name: hnlGetTermNameOfSig
hnlGetTermNameOfSig.desc: Finds the names of all the terminals that the specified signal connects to. The names are the single-bit names of the bits of the terminals that connect to the signal.

hnlIfNoProcedure.name: hnlIfNoProcedure
hnlIfNoProcedure.desc: Defines procedures in HNL. By using this function, the netlister only defines a procedure if it is not already defined, thus allowing user-override of netlister functionality by loading user-supplied functions before loading the Cadence netlister.

hnlIgnoreTerm.name: hnlIgnoreTerm
hnlIgnoreTerm.desc: Checks if the terminal argument belongs to a patchcord or to an instance whose master is not a stopping cell and does not contain any instances. This function excludes terminals attached to instances such as vdd and gnd.

hnlInitMap.name: hnlInitMap
hnlInitMap.syntax:
hnlInitMap( 
x_maxNameLength  
x_maxInstNameLength
x_maxModelNameLength
x_maxNetNameLength
x_maxTermNameLength
t_namePrefix  
t_netNamePrefix  
t_instNamePrefix 
t_modelNamePrefix  
t_termNamePrefix
t_hierarchyDelimeter  
l_invalidFirstChars  
l_invalidCharsInName  
l_hnlMapNetFirstChar  
l_hnlMapNetInName  
l_hnlMapInstFirstChar  
l_hnlMapInstInName  
l_hnlMapModelFirstChar  
l_hnlMapModelInName 
l_hnlMapTermFirstChar
l_hnlMapTermInName 
t_mapName  
t_designName  
t_viewList 
t_stopList
l_hnlInvalidNames
l_hnlInvalidNetNames
l_hnlInvalidInstNames
l_hnlInvalidModelNames
l_hnlInvalidTermNames
)
=> t / nil
hnlInitMap.desc: Initializes the variables needed for name translation.

hnlInitPrint.name: hnlInitPrint
hnlInitPrint.syntax:
hnlInitPrint(
t_fileName
x_lineLength
t_prefix
t_postfix
t_commentStr
x_softLineLength
) 
=> t / nil
hnlInitPrint.desc: Opens the netlist output file specified as the filename and sets up the information required by the hnlPrintString function.

hnlIsAPatchCord.name: hnlIsAPatchCord
hnlIsAPatchCord.desc: Checks if the master of the given instance is a patchcord.

hnlIsAStoppingCell.name: hnlIsAStoppingCell
hnlIsAStoppingCell.desc: Checks if the cellview argument is a stopping cellview. A cell is a stopping point for expansion if its viewName is in the hnlViewList switch view list as well as the hnlStopList stopping list, or if the cell has a string property nlAction with stop as its value. This function is used throughout the netlister to determine when to stop expansion and whether to output a macro reference or a reference to a primitive device.

hnlIsCellNetlistable.name: hnlIsCellNetlistable
hnlIsCellNetlistable.desc: Determines if instantiation of the specified cellview can be netlisted to HNL. This procedure returns nil for a cellview that contains no connectivity and for a cellview that has the property nlAction set to the value ignore.

hnlIsCurrentInstStopping.name: hnlIsCurrentInstStopping
hnlIsCurrentInstStopping.desc: Checks if the current instance, hnlCurrentInst, is a stopping instance. An instance is a stopping point for expansion if the instance master is in the instance specific stopList. An instance is also a stopping point if the instance has a string property, nlAction with stop as its value. This function is used throughout the netlister to determine when to stop expansion and whether to output a macro reference or a reference to a primitive device.

hnllsCVInUserStopCVList.name: hnllsCVInUserStopCVList
hnllsCVInUserStopCVList.desc: Determines whether a cellview, which is present in hnlUerStopCVList, is considered a primitive or a stop view while netlisting.

hnlMakeNetlistFileName.name: hnlMakeNetlistFileName
hnlMakeNetlistFileName.syntax:
hnlMakeNetlistFileName( 
d_cellViewId
t_effectiveViewList
t_currentCellPath
t_configLibName
t_configCellName
t_configViewName
g_isTopConfigCell
)
=> name
hnlMakeNetlistFileName.desc: Returns the relative name of the netlist file for cellViewId. This relative name is the path in the current netlisting directory. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping cellview, which you can netlist.

hnlMapCellModuleName.name: hnlMapCellModuleName
hnlMapCellModuleName.syntax:
hnlMapCellModuleName( 
d_cellViewId 
[ t_viewList 
t_pathName 
t_LibName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
t_isCellTopCell ]
)
=> name
hnlMapCellModuleName.desc: Returns the netlist module name of the cellview, the cellViewId. It adds the <cell name><module name> mapped pair into the model section of the name map associated with the hnlCurrentCell variable. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping instance. For a design opened in the configuration view, you must specify the additional arguments.

args.name:
t_viewList 
t_pathName 
t_LibName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
t_isCellTopCell

hnlMapCellName.name: hnlMapCellName
hnlMapCellName.syntax:
hnlMapCellName( 
d_cellViewId
[ t_viewList ]
[ t_pathName ]
[ t_LibName ]
[ t_cellName ]
[ t_viewName ]
[ t_isCellTopCell ]
)
=> name
hnlMapCellName.desc: Returns the netlist module name of the cellview, which is the cellViewId. It adds the <cell name><module name> mapped pair into the model section of the name map associated with the hnlCurrentCell variable. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping instance.

hnlMapInstName.name: hnlMapInstName
hnlMapInstName.desc: Returns a new mapped name. The cdsName string is a mandatory parameter and the prefix string is an optional one. If the argument specified in cdsName is legal, the same name is returned. Otherwise, OSS searches for the prefix. In case, the prefix is legal, then the value of global counter, which starts with 0, is appended to the prefix. If the prefix is not legal or null, a new name using the global instance prefix and the global counter is generated. However, if both the prefix and the global instance prefix are illegal or null, then an error message is displayed.

hnlMapModelName.name: hnlMapModelName
hnlMapModelName.syntax:
hnlMapModelName( 
t_cdsName 
[ t_viewList
t_pathName
t_LibName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_isCellTopCell ]
)
=> name
hnlMapModelName.desc: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the string is returned. The hnlMapModelFirstChar, hnlMapModelInName, hnlMaxNameLength, and simModelNamePrefix variables are used to determine the mapping of the name.

args.name:
t_viewList
t_pathName
t_LibName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_isCellTopCell

hnlMapName.name: hnlMapName
hnlMapName.desc: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

hnlMapNetName.name: hnlMapNetName
hnlMapNetName.desc: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

hnlMapTermName.name: hnlMapTermName
hnlMapTermName.desc: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

hnlMultipleCells.name: hnlMultipleCells
hnlMultipleCells.desc: Checks if the cellname argument exists for more than one cell name or cellview in the list of all cells. This function is used to detect cases of cells having the same name, but which are found in more than one location of the design hierarchy. This happens when cells with the same name are found in more than one library.

hnlNameOfSignal.name: hnlNameOfSignal
hnlNameOfSignal.desc: Returns a string for the name of the signal that defines the given net-index pair. This name is considered to be the preferred name and is consistent even when called with two different nets whose ~> name field differs, but which are electrically equivalent at this level of the design hierarchy. If the netIndex is not in the range of bits for the given net, nil is returned.

hnlNetNameOnTerm.name: hnlNetNameOnTerm
hnlNetNameOnTerm.desc: Returns the signal name of the net attached to the given bit of the terminal of the given name on the current instance being expanded. This function guarantees the same name is returned even if the net is aliased, and this function is later called with a terminal attached to one of the aliases of this net.

hnlNetNameOnTermName.name: hnlNetNameOnTermName
hnlNetNameOnTermName.desc: Returns the signal name of the net attached to the terminal of the given name on the current instance being expanded. This function guarantees the same name is returned even if the net is aliased, and this function is later called with a terminal attached to one of the aliases of this net.

hnlNmpSetNameSpaces.name: hnlNmpSetNameSpaces
hnlNmpSetNameSpaces.desc: Specifies the nmp namespaces to perform namespace mapping during OSS netlisting. The function accepts Cadence nmp supported namespaces as arguments. You can run the %> nmp getSpaceNames command to display a list of valid namespaces.

hnlOpenTopCell.name: hnlOpenTopCell
hnlOpenTopCell.desc: Opens the top-level cellview. If the lib/cell/view is an HDB config, then open the config before opening the top-level cellview.

hnlPcellIsParamOverridden.name: hnlPcellIsParamOverridden
hnlPcellIsParamOverridden.desc: Finds if the Pcell parameter of a master is overridden at the instance.

hnlPostNetlistTriggerList.name: hnlPostNetlistTriggerList
hnlPostNetlistTriggerList.desc: Returns the list of functions registered through hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.

hnlPreNetlistTriggerList.name: hnlPreNetlistTriggerList
hnlPreNetlistTriggerList.desc: Returns the list of functions registered through hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.

hnlPrintDevices.name: hnlPrintDevices
hnlPrintDevices.desc: Sets up the global variables needed by the output functions to output the connectivity for a device and then calls the hnlPrintInst formatter function to print the connectivity for each iteration of each instance in the current cellview being netlisted. The current cellview is determined by the value of the hnlCurrentCell global variable. The global variables set up by this function, which can be used by the formatter function, are as follows:

hnlPrintMessage.name: hnlPrintMessage
hnlPrintMessage.desc: Prints the text argument to the stdout port if executed in the Cadence non-graphical environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

hnlPrintNetlist.name: hnlPrintNetlist
hnlPrintNetlist.desc: Prints the netlist header, then calls a function to output the connectivity for the netlist, and after that, prints the netlist footer. At this point, all cells are expected to be bound. Error detection for binding is done by the traversal functions.

hnlPrintSignal.name: hnlPrintSignal
hnlPrintSignal.desc: Finds and directs the netlisting of all signals in hnlCurrentCell. It processes each signal and sets up the needed variables for use later. It is responsible for calling the hnlPrintSignalHeader, hnlPrintInst, and hnlPrintSignalFooter functions.

hnlPrintString.name: hnlPrintString
hnlPrintString.desc: Prints the SKILL string text argument to the netlist file.

hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.name: hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger
hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.desc: Registers a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that is called after netlist generation.

hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.name: hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger
hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.desc: Registers a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that is called before the netlist generation.

hnlRunNetlister.name: hnlRunNetlister
hnlRunNetlister.desc: Runs the hierarchical netlister and is the entry point for HNL.

hnlScaleCapacitance.name: hnlScaleCapacitance
hnlScaleCapacitance.desc: Accepts the  given value as an argument, divides it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If simCapUnit isset to nil, then the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number.

hnlScaleMarginalDelay.name: hnlScaleMarginalDelay
hnlScaleMarginalDelay.desc: Accepts the value given as argument, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, multiplies it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest tenth. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil or simCapUnitis set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest tenth. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number.

hnlScaleTimeUnit.name: hnlScaleTimeUnit
hnlScaleTimeUnit.desc: Accepts the value given as argument, divides it by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number. If the property is of the string type, the property value is evaluated before it is scaled.

hnlSetCellFiles.name: hnlSetCellFiles
hnlSetCellFiles.desc: Opens all the files associated with hnlCurrentCell and reinitializes name-mapping functions.

hnlSetDef.name: hnlSetDef
hnlSetDef.desc: Sets variables in HNL. By using this function, the netlister only sets sVariable if it is not already set, or the symbol sVariable evaluates to null, thus allowing user-override of netlister variables by loading user-supplied defaults before loading the Cadence netlister.

hnlSetMappingType.name: hnlSetMappingType
hnlSetMappingType.desc: Sets namespace mapping type for nets, terminals, globals, and models to tabularOnly, nmpOnly, or nmpWithTabular.

hnlSetPrintLinePrefix.name: hnlSetPrintLinePrefix
hnlSetPrintLinePrefix.desc: Registers the line prefix to be used when printing individual subcircuits during auCdl netlisting to indicate the continuation of the text on the next line, when the line length exceeds the limit set by the HNL global variable hnlSoftLineLength.

hnlSetPseudoTermDir.name: hnlSetPseudoTermDir
hnlSetPseudoTermDir.desc: Sets the direction of pseudo ports, which are created to propagate inherited connections from a cellview to upper levels in the hierarchy. OSS-based formatter calls this function to set the direction of pseudo ports. If the formatter does not call it, you can specify a statement to call the function in the .simrc file.

hnlSetVars.name: hnlSetVars
hnlSetVars.desc: Sets all global-required variables for netlisting. Depending on the target simulator, the required netlist formatting functions are loaded.

hnlSortTerms.name: hnlSortTerms
hnlSortTerms.desc: Determines net order in the sorted lists of net names. It takes as argument two terminals and does a comparison by the name field. It is used as argument to the sort SKILL function.

hnlSortTermsToNets.name: hnlSortTermsToNets
hnlSortTermsToNets.desc: Returns a list of lists by accepting a list of terminals as argument. The first element in each list is the original terminal, the second element is the name of the net attached to that terminal. The list is sorted alphanumerically by the name of the terminal attached to the net.

hnlStopNetlist.name: hnlStopNetlist
hnlStopNetlist.desc: Cleans up after netlisting, closes open files, closes all open cellviews, and resets all global variables to nil.

hnlStringToList.name: hnlStringToList
hnlStringToList.desc: Accepts a string of white-space-separated strings, and returns a list of strings, that is, the string - silos schematic - returns the list (silos schematic).

hnlWriteBlockControlFile.name: hnlWriteBlockControlFile
hnlWriteBlockControlFile.syntax:
hnlWriteBlockControlFile(
d_cellView
[ t_viewList ] 
[ t_pathName ] 
[ t_LibName ] 
[ t_cellName ] 
[ t_viewName ] 
[ t_isCellTopCell ]
)
=> t / nil
hnlWriteBlockControlFile.desc: Creates the control file for the cellview. The control file records information for subsequent IHNL runs. The hnlCloseCellFiles function calls the hnlWriteBlockControlFile function.

hnlWriteMap.name: hnlWriteMap
hnlWriteMap.desc: Saves the name map tables in a file specified in an earlier call to the hnlInitMap function. This function takes no arguments.

iseCommToSimulator.name: iseCommToSimulator
iseCommToSimulator.desc: Sends the command specified as the text parameter to the simulator. This function should be used in conjunction with input filtering, if input filtering is in effect.

iseCompleteInteractive.name: iseCompleteInteractive
iseCompleteInteractive.desc: Completes an interactive simulation session by closing all windows opened for interactive simulation, and updates the ISE state machine so that ISE is aware that the interactive session has ended.

iseEnterNodeNamesList.name: iseEnterNodeNamesList
iseEnterNodeNamesList.desc: Prompts the user to enter node names into a form and returns the netlister-assigned names as a SKILL list of strings corresponding to the schematic names entered.

iseExitSimulator.name: iseExitSimulator
iseExitSimulator.desc: Terminates the simulation using the command string that is defined using the ISE variable iseExitSimulatorCommand. If the simulation is remote, this routine copies every file from the remote host back to the local simulation run directory. To use the iseExitSimulator function properly, write a function in which you call iseExitSimulator. After this function returns, you can do post-processing such as translating netlister-assigned names.

iseGetExtName.name: iseGetExtName
iseGetExtName.desc: Directs the enter points function to use the specified callback function. The iseGetExtName function returns the netlister-assigned name of the object being pointed at in the schematic window.

iseGetInputFromEncapWindow.name: iseGetInputFromEncapWindow
iseGetInputFromEncapWindow.desc: This procedure is registered to be called whenever something is typed into the input window of the encapsulation window.The  tmpStream argument is passed into the procedure to be packaged before it is sent to the simulator. This function also checks if the user has registered a function to be called so that the simulator inputs can be passed to this user-registered function for filtering. After filtering, the user can call the isePrintSimulatorCommand function such that the data will be sent to the simulator. All inputs typed into the encapsulation window are automatically reflected in the history section of the encapsulation window. If no user-function is registered then the inputs are sent directly to the simulator without filtering.

iseGetMappedProbeList.name: iseGetMappedProbeList
iseGetMappedProbeList.desc: Returns a SKILL list of the netlister-assigned names of all of the nets currently probed in the schematic window.

iseGetProbeList.name: iseGetProbeList
iseGetProbeList.desc: Returns a SKILL list of the user-assigned names of all nets currently probed in the schematic window.

iseInitSchematicWindow.name: iseInitSchematicWindow
iseInitSchematicWindow.desc: Reads in the design specified by the simLibName, simLibConfigName, simCellName, simViewName, and simVersionName variables in the schematic window maintained by ISE.

iseInterruptSimulator.name: iseInterruptSimulator
iseInterruptSimulator.desc: Issues a soft interrupt to the simulator.

iseNetExtNameCdsName.name: iseNetExtNameCdsName
iseNetExtNameCdsName.desc: Displays a form for the user to enter a netlister-assigned node name. A second form appears which displays both this name and its corresponding user-assigned name.

iseOpenWindows.name: iseOpenWindows
iseOpenWindows.desc: Opens three new windows and updates internal ISE structures required to keep track of the identifications of these windows. The first covers the bottom right quarter of the screen and is set to be the schematic window. The second occupies the upper half of the screen and is the waveform window. The third window occupies the lower left quarter of the screen and is used to run the simulator. The original windows are not altered, but instead are overlaid with the new windows. This is the default window configuration.

isePrintName.name: isePrintName
isePrintName.desc: Prints the netlister-assigned name of the object being pointed at in the schematic window to the input portion of the simulation window, starting from the current cursor position.

isePrintNameCB.name: isePrintNameCB
isePrintNameCB.desc: The callback function of isePrintName which is to be called by the enter points function in iseGetExtName.

isePrintSimulatorCommand.name: isePrintSimulatorCommand
isePrintSimulatorCommand.desc: Used when you create menu commands that interface with both the design and simulator.

iseReleaseNodeFrom.name: iseReleaseNodeFrom
iseReleaseNodeFrom.desc: After forcing a node to a preferred value, this function calls the function specified by the iseReleaseFunc variable to release the node from that value.

iseSearchForASchWindow.name: iseSearchForASchWindow
iseSearchForASchWindow.desc: If iseDontOpenSchematicWindowIfOneExists is set to t, this function searches for the first existing schematic window with the correct design opened for edit and uses that window as the ISE schematic window.

iseSendOutputToEncapHistory.name: iseSendOutputToEncapHistory
iseSendOutputToEncapHistory.desc: Writes the string passed in as a parameter to the history section of the encapsulation window.

iseSetEncapBindKeys.name: iseSetEncapBindKeys
iseSetEncapBindKeys.desc: Sets the bindkeys for the encapsulation window.

iseSetNodeTo.name: iseSetNodeTo
iseSetNodeTo.desc: Replaces the iseSet function. It calls the function specified by the iseSetFunc variable.

iseSimulate.name: iseSimulate
iseSimulate.desc: Calls the function specified by the iseSimulateFunc variable.

iseStartInteractive.name: iseStartInteractive
iseStartInteractive.desc: Sets up the default interactive simulation environment.

iseStartSimulator.name: iseStartSimulator
iseStartSimulator.desc: Issues the command to start the simulator in the simulator window by first evaluating the iseInvokeSimulatorFunc variable.

iseUpdateNetlist.name: iseUpdateNetlist
iseUpdateNetlist.desc: Generates a new netlist by calling the SE netlist function.

iseUpdateStimulus.name: iseUpdateStimulus
iseUpdateStimulus.desc: Runs the input name translation simin function.

netlist.name: netlist
netlist.desc: Performs all the steps needed to generate a netlist. If the simDoNetlist variable is not set to t, the function returns t and does not run.

runsim.name: runsim
runsim.desc: Runs the SKILL instructions stored in the simCommand variable, which is used to run the simulator for this simulation. The function then calls simOutWithArgs with the correct arguments to translate the textual simulator output stored in the simout.tmp file and generate the si.out file.

simAddProbeCapByName.name: simAddProbeCapByName
simAddProbeCapByName.desc: Displays the net capacitance of the supplied net name. This function is to be used in conjunction with the function simReadNetCapFile, which reads in the sim.cap file, initializing all the net names in the design with the associated capacitance values. This function refreshes the active display window by displaying the capacitance value of the given net name.

simAddProbeCapByScreen.name: simAddProbeCapByScreen
simAddProbeCapByScreen.desc: Displays all the nets capacitance on the current screen.

simAddProbeCapForBusBit.name: simAddProbeCapForBusBit
simAddProbeCapForBusBit.desc: Displays net capacitance on each bit of a bus.

simCheckExist.name: simCheckExist
simCheckExist.desc: Checks whether all of the variables in the variableNames list argument are defined and are not set to nil. Otherwise, prints an error message.

simCheckHeader.name: simCheckHeader
simCheckHeader.desc: Checks the header stamp of the net capacitance file pointer,sim.cap. The header stamp must be the first word on the first line of the sim.cap file, and it must be equal to Net_Capacitance_File. Use the infile function to open the sim.cap file before calling this function.

simCheckVariables.name: simCheckVariables
simCheckVariables.desc: Checks whether the variables simSimulator, simCellName, simLibName, simViewName, simRunDir, simViewList, simStopList, simSedFile, simCommand, simNlpGlobalLibName, and simNlpGlobalCellName have been set and their value is t. It does so by calling the simCheckExist function.

simCheckViewConfig.name: simCheckViewConfig
simCheckViewConfig.syntax:
simCheckViewConfig(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
)
=> t / nil
simCheckViewConfig.desc: Checks if the design you want to netlist is an HDB configuration.

simCleanRun.name: simCleanRun
simCleanRun.desc: Deletes files created by both SE and the analysis tool being used from the simulation run directory. The function deletes only files that can be recreated by renetlisting or resimulating. Files which are required to rerun the simulation, such as the si.env and control files, are not deleted. The function displays a dialog box so you can confirm that you intend to delete the information. If the deletion is confirmed, the files that SE creates are deleted along with the files specified by the simCleanFileList variable. The simCleanFileList variable is set differently by each application integrated into SE.

simDateStamp.name: simDateStamp
simDateStamp.desc: Prints the value contained in t_string argument followed by the date to standard output.

simDeleteRunDirFile.name: simDeleteRunDirFile
simDeleteRunDirFile.desc: Deletes the specified file in the simulation run directory.

simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.name: simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger
simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.desc: Deregisters a user-defined SKILL trigger that has been registered using simRegPostNetlistTrigger. For backward compatibility, hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.

simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.name: simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger
simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.desc: Deregisters a user-defined SKILL trigger that has been registered using simRegPreNetlistTrigger. For backward compatibility, hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.

simDesignVarCdsNameExtName.name: simDesignVarCdsNameExtName
simDesignVarCdsNameExtName.desc: Accepts the user-assigned variable name, cdsDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned name for it as it appears in the netlist. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

simDesignVarExtNameCdsName.name: simDesignVarExtNameCdsName
simDesignVarExtNameCdsName.desc: Accepts the netlister-assigned variable name, extDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the user-assigned name for it as it appears on the schematic. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

simDrain.name: simDrain
simDrain.desc: Performs the equivalent of drain( stdout ) when run in the non-graphic environment without accepting any arguments. No action is taken or required when this function is run in the Cadence graphics environment.

simEditFileWithName.name: simEditFileWithName
simEditFileWithName.desc: Calls the edit function internally to display the specified file.

simExecute.name: simExecute
simExecute.desc: Runs the UNIX command or program provided as its single argument.

simFindFile.name: simFindFile
simFindFile.desc: Finds the full file system pathname to t_filename in the install hierarchy, if it exists. The pathname this function searches for is specified by the prependInstallPath function.

simFlattenWithArgs.name: simFlattenWithArgs
simFlattenWithArgs.syntax:
simFlattenWithArgs(
t_simLibName
t_simCellName
t_simViewName
t_simRunDir
t_simNlpGlobalLibName
t_simNlpGlobalCellName
t_simNlpGlobalViewName
l_simViewList
l_simStopList
t_simGlobalErrFileName
t_simProbeFileName
t_simSimulator
f_simTimeUnit
f_simCapUnit
t_simFlatLibName
t_simFlatCellName
t_simFlatViewName
t_simFlatViewTypeName
)
=> t / nil
simFlattenWithArgs.desc: Runs the prFlatten tool. The design hierarchy is specified by the simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName variables. The global formatting properties are defined in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName. The function is defined in /bin/si and also in the Cadence graphics program.

simGetLoginName.name: simGetLoginName
simGetLoginName.desc: Returns the string-valued login name of the current user.

simGetTermList.name: simGetTermList
simGetTermList.syntax:
simGetTermList(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
)
=> l_list / nil
simGetTermList.desc: Collects all the terminals for a block and returns them as a list.

simIfNoProcedure.name: simIfNoProcedure
simIfNoProcedure.desc: Same as the SKILL keyword procedure, except the procedure definition given as an argument is only defined if it is not currently defined. This function is used instead of the SKILL procedure to permit the overriding of procedures defined in SE by procedures in .simrc.

simIlSleep.name: simIlSleep
simIlSleep.desc: Suspends the current process by the number of seconds specified as an argument. The current process in a replay file launches si in batch mode and waits for si to return before it runs the next command in the file.

simin.name: simin
simin.desc: Translates the user-assigned names for nets and instances in the control file to the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the si.inp file for input to the simulator. A message is printed stating that simin is being run, and then the simInWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

simInitControl.name: simInitControl
simInitControl.desc: Checks whether  a file called control exists in the simulation run directory.

simInitEnv.name: simInitEnv
simInitEnv.desc: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment.

simInitEnvWithArgs.name: simInitEnvWithArgs
simInitEnvWithArgs.syntax:
simInitEnvWithArgs( 
t_runDirName 
t_libName | nil
t_cellName | nil
t_viewName | nil
t_simulatorName | nil
g_forceInit
) 
=> t / nil
simInitEnvWithArgs.desc: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment. In addition to defining the SKILL environment needed for SE and the target application, the run directory is created and initialized as needed.

simInitRaw.name: simInitRaw
simInitRaw.desc: Creates the raw directory in the simulation run directory that stores the waveform file.

simInitRunDir.name: simInitRunDir
simInitRunDir.desc: Executes the list of functions specified by the variable simInitRunActions. If this variable is not set then simInitControl and simInitRaw are the default list of functions to be executed in this order, which initializes a simulation run directory.

simInitSimulator.name: simInitSimulator
simInitSimulator.desc: Calls the function with the same name as the simulator name specified by the simSimulator variable, for example,  silos. This function must be defined in a file with the same name with either the .il or the .ile suffix added and stored in the local/si/caplib directory.

simInstCdsNameExtName.name: simInstCdsNameExtName
simInstCdsNameExtName.desc: Accepts the user-assigned instance name as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned instance name for cdsInstName as it appears in the netlist. The exact name returned depends on the design.

simInstExtNameCdsName.name: simInstExtNameCdsName
simInstExtNameCdsName.desc: Accepts the netlister-assigned instance name as an argument extInstName and returns the user-assigned instance name as it appears in the schematic.

simInWithArgs.name: simInWithArgs
simInWithArgs.syntax:
simInWithArgs( 
l_fileList
t_runDirName 
t_libName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName
)
=> t / nil
simInWithArgs.desc: Translates the designer-assigned names for nets and instances in the input files into the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the files for input into the simulator.

simJobMonitor.name: simJobMonitor
simJobMonitor.desc: Displays a form listing the analysis jobs invoked in the background using the simRunNetAndSim and simRunNetAndSimWithArgs functions. The analysis job is listed on the form, along with its current status, time of invocation, and execution priority. Using this form, you can view the run log of a job, terminate the execution of an active job, suspend the execution of an active job, change the execution priority of a job, or delete a job from the form.

simLoadNetlisterFiles.name: simLoadNetlisterFiles
simLoadNetlisterFiles.desc: Loads the file specified as an argument from the local/fnl directory. If the tool does not find the file in the local/fnl directory, it searches in the etc/skill/fnl directory in the install hierarchy. If it does not exist, no error is generated.

simLoadSimulatorFiles.name: simLoadSimulatorFiles
simLoadSimulatorFiles.desc: Loads the simulator-specific file from the local/si/caplib directory. If it does not find the file in local/si/caplib, it searches etc/skill/si/caplib directory in the install hierarchy. If the file does not exist, no error is generated.

simNetCdsNameExtName.name: simNetCdsNameExtName
simNetCdsNameExtName.desc: Accepts  the user-assigned net name as an argument for cdsNetName and returns the netlister-assigned net name as it appears in the netlist.

simNetExtNameCdsName.name: simNetExtNameCdsName
simNetExtNameCdsName.desc: Accepts  the netlister-assigned net name as an argument and returns the user-assigned net name for extNetName as it appears in the schematic.

simNetlistWithArgs.name: simNetlistWithArgs
simNetlistWithArgs.syntax:
simNetlistWithArgs( 
t_simLibName
t_simCellName
t_simViewName 
t_simRunDir 
t_simNlpGlobalLibName
t_simNlpGlobalCellName
t_simNlpGlobalViewName
l_simViewList
l_simStopList 
t_simGlobalErrorFileName 
t_simProbeFileName 
t_simSimulator 
f_simTimeUnit 
f_simCapUnit 
t_simNetlistFileName
t_simFlatViewTypeName
)
=> t / nil
simNetlistWithArgs.desc: Generates a flattened description of the design hierarchy specified by simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName in the syntax described by the global formatting properties in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName.

simNoNetlist.name: simNoNetlist
simNoNetlist.desc: Sets the simNoNetlist variable to t to specify that no netlist is generated, and then callsthe sim function to perform a complete simulation, except for netlist generation.

simout.name: simout
simout.desc: Translates the netlister-assigned names for nets and instances in the simout.tmp file to the corresponding user-assigned names and produces the si.out file. The simout.tmp file is normally the simulator text output. A message is printed stating that simout is being run, and then the simOutWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

simOutWithArgs.name: simOutWithArgs
simOutWithArgs.syntax:
