[ ?targetPinSide l_targetPinSides ]
[ ?enableCongestion g_enableCongestion ]
[ ?congestionValue n_congestionValue ]
)
=> t / nil / List of (sbId lib:cell:view status)
vpaOptimizePins.desc: Runs pin optimization on the specified cellview or design based on the options you specify. You can specify only those parameters that you want to control. The parameters that you do not specify get their values from the corresponding LayoutXL environment variable.

mgAbutCB.name: mgAbutCB
mgAbutCB.desc: Attempts to abut the selected instances in the Modgen currently being edited.

mgAddBodyContact.name: mgAddBodyContact
mgAddBodyContact.desc: Adds a body contact on the specified side to the selected instances inside a Modgen. Side can be one of left, right, top, or bottom.

mgAddCopyDummies.name: mgAddCopyDummies
mgAddCopyDummies.syntax:
mgAddCopyDummies(
d_mgID
t_sideString
S_netName
l_insts
)
=> t / nil
mgAddCopyDummies.desc: Creates copies of the specified Modgen dummy and places them on the t_sideString side of the instance.

mgAddDummyBottomCB.name: mgAddDummyBottomCB
mgAddDummyBottomCB.desc: Adds dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyLeftCB.name: mgAddDummyLeftCB
mgAddDummyLeftCB.desc: Adds dummy devices to the left side of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyRCBottomCB.name: mgAddDummyRCBottomCB
mgAddDummyRCBottomCB.desc: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyRCLeftCB.name: mgAddDummyRCLeftCB
mgAddDummyRCLeftCB.desc: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the left of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyRCRightCB.name: mgAddDummyRCRightCB
mgAddDummyRCRightCB.desc: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the right of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyRCTopCB.name: mgAddDummyRCTopCB
mgAddDummyRCTopCB.desc: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyRightCB.name: mgAddDummyRightCB
mgAddDummyRightCB.desc: Adds dummy devices to the right side of the selected instances.

mgAddDummyTopCB.name: mgAddDummyTopCB
mgAddDummyTopCB.desc: Adds dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

mgAddEmptyRCCB.name: mgAddEmptyRCCB
mgAddEmptyRCCB.desc: Adds an empty row or column to the specified side of a selected instance. To add empty row or column only one instance should be selected.

mgAddGuardRingCB.name: mgAddGuardRingCB
mgAddGuardRingCB.desc: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

mgAddShapeToTopo.name: mgAddShapeToTopo
mgAddShapeToTopo.desc: Adds a user-generated shape, such as a rectangle, to a topology group, usually a topological strap.

mgAddTopologyToModgen.name: mgAddTopologyToModgen
mgAddTopologyToModgen.desc: Adds the specified topology object to the specified Modgen.

mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen.name: mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen
mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen.syntax:
mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen(
d_modgenConId
l_tpObjects
t_twigMatchType
[ t_trunkMatchType ]
)
=> t / nil
mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen.desc: Creates a matchGroup in the specified Modgen storage.

mgCreateModgenAsLayout.name: mgCreateModgenAsLayout
mgCreateModgenAsLayout.desc: Creates a Modgen from the list of specified instances and keeps the relative instance locations inside the Modgen, as similar as possible to the original instances in the layout. If instance list is not specified, the selected instances from the cellview are used.

mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout.name: mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout
mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout.syntax:
mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout(
d_cvId
l_InstanceList
[ l_AbuttedInstances ]
)
=> g_constraintID / nil
mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout.desc: Creates a Modgen constraint that uses the current layout to drive the initial Modgen constraint and row/column assignments.

mgCreateOrEdit.name: mgCreateOrEdit
mgCreateOrEdit.syntax:
mgCreateOrEdit(
d_cellViewId 
d_constraintId
[ d_figGroupId ]
)
=> t / nil
mgCreateOrEdit.desc: Opens the Modgen editor to create a new Modgen or to edit parameters of an existing Modgen. After making edits, the Modgen constraint is updated. If the source is a layout cellview, then the Modgen layout, the associated geometry, and the associated database objects are updated.

mgDeleteAllBodyContacts.name: mgDeleteAllBodyContacts
mgDeleteAllBodyContacts.desc: Deletes all body contacts of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen edit window.

mgDeleteAllDummies.name: mgDeleteAllDummies
mgDeleteAllDummies.desc: Deletes all dummies from the specified Modgen.

mgDeleteAllEmptyRowColumnCB.name: mgDeleteAllEmptyRowColumnCB
mgDeleteAllEmptyRowColumnCB.desc: Deletes all empty rows and columns of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen Editing window.

mgDeleteCB.name: mgDeleteCB
mgDeleteCB.desc: Deletes the selected dummy devices or body contacts.

mgDeleteEmptyRowColumnCB.name: mgDeleteEmptyRowColumnCB
mgDeleteEmptyRowColumnCB.desc: Interactively deletes an empty row or column in Modgen Editor.

mgDestroyMatchGroupOnObject.name: mgDestroyMatchGroupOnObject
mgDestroyMatchGroupOnObject.desc: Destroys the matchGroups that include the specified database object.

mgEditGuardRingCB.name: mgEditGuardRingCB
mgEditGuardRingCB.desc: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

mgExecNoConObs.name: mgExecNoConObs
mgExecNoConObs.desc: Disables the Modgen constraint observer and evaluates the expressions in the specified sequence. Next, the function updates the constraint with any changes encountered while evaluating the expressions. After the process is complete, the Modgen constraint observer is re-enabled. This function helps change geometries or parameters of a Modgen or its instances without requiring the Modgen to enforce any consistency constraints on the resulting geometries. For example, increasing the numRows Modgen parameter using this function will cause the Modgen to have more rows, but will not rearrange the Modgen instances to fit in the new number of rows. This function is a defmacro.

mgEvalInBackgroundModgen.name: mgEvalInBackgroundModgen
mgEvalInBackgroundModgen.syntax:
mgEvalInBackgroundModgen(
d_schCV
o_schCon
s_callback
[ g_updateSrcConstraint ]
) 
=> l_userCallbackReturnVal / nil
mgEvalInBackgroundModgen.desc: Creates a Modgen scratch cellview for the specified schematic Modgen constraint, evaluates the specified user callback in the Modgen context, and then closes and deletes the scratch cellview.

mgFGREnterHandEdit.name: mgFGREnterHandEdit
mgFGREnterHandEdit.desc: Enters the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. In this mode, the fluid guard rings are not regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. Therefore, all customizations remain. The guard rings that are not edited in the hand edit mode are regenerated, and all manual edits are lost. Use mgFGRExitHandEdit to exit the hand edit mode.

mgFGRExitHandEdit.name: mgFGRExitHandEdit
mgFGRExitHandEdit.desc: Exits the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. Unlike the hand edit mode, the fluid guard rings will now be regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. To enter the hand edit mode, use mgFGREnterHandEdit.

mgFGRIsHandEdit.name: mgFGRIsHandEdit
mgFGRIsHandEdit.desc: Checks the status of the hand edit mode of the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen.

mgFlattenModgens.name: mgFlattenModgens
mgFlattenModgens.desc: Flattens the specified Modgens in the specified cellview. When a Modgen is flattened, its constraint is removed, it is ungrouped, and all geometry created by it remains ungrouped in the layout cellview.

mgFlipHorizontalCB.name: mgFlipHorizontalCB
mgFlipHorizontalCB.desc: Horizontally flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

mgFlipVerticalCB.name: mgFlipVerticalCB
mgFlipVerticalCB.desc: Vertically flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

mgGetBoxLPPArea.name: mgGetBoxLPPArea
mgGetBoxLPPArea.syntax:
mgGetBoxLPPArea(
d_cellViewID
l_bBox
tx_layerName
t_purposeList
)
=> x_TotalModgenArea / nil
mgGetBoxLPPArea.desc: Calculates the total area on the specified layer within the specified bounding box. If you specify a Modgen ID as the l_bBox parameter, then the total Modgen area is calculated and displayed.

mgGetChannelTrunks.name: mgGetChannelTrunks
mgGetChannelTrunks.syntax:
mgGetChannelTrunks(
d_mgCon
n_channel
g_isHoriz
)
=> l_topologyTrunks / nil
mgGetChannelTrunks.desc: Returns a list of topology trunks that belong to the specified channel.

mgGetColumnRoutingChannelWidth.name: mgGetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
mgGetColumnRoutingChannelWidth.desc: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen column.

mgGetConstraintFromFG.name: mgGetConstraintFromFG
mgGetConstraintFromFG.desc: Returns the database ID of the Modgen constraint for the specified Modgen figGroup ID.

mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams.name: mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams
mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams.syntax:
mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams(
[ t_libName ]
[ t_cellName ]
[ t_paramName ]
)
=> l_registeredDummyDirectionalParams / nil
mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams.desc: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy directional parameters that match the specified library, cell, and parameter names.

mgGetGuardRingConnectObject.name: mgGetGuardRingConnectObject
mgGetGuardRingConnectObject.desc: Returns the guard ring object for the topology connection for the specified Modgen.

mgGetIsLocalTrunk.name: mgGetIsLocalTrunk
mgGetIsLocalTrunk.desc: Checks whether the specified trunk is local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

mgGetLayerSpacing.name: mgGetLayerSpacing
mgGetLayerSpacing.syntax:
mgGetLayerSpacing(
d_instance1
d_instance2
t_referenceLayer
t_direction
x_spacing
)
=> x_effectiveSpacing / nil
mgGetLayerSpacing.desc: Returns the effective spacing between two instances, given the spacing between a reference layer inside the instances. For example, if the reference layer is Oxide_thk drawing, then x_spacing would indicate the spacing between the bounding box of the Oxide_thk layer inside the instances. The t_direction argument specifies the position of the instances relative to each other, either horizontal (next to each other) or vertical (above and below each other).

mgGetMatchGroupMembers.name: mgGetMatchGroupMembers
mgGetMatchGroupMembers.desc: Displays a list of matchGroup members that belong to the same matchGroup as the specified database object d_dbObjectId.

mgGetModgenConstraintFromTopology.name: mgGetModgenConstraintFromTopology
mgGetModgenConstraintFromTopology.desc: Returns the Modgen constraint ID that is associated with the specified topology object.

mgGetModgenFigGroupFromTopology.name: mgGetModgenFigGroupFromTopology
mgGetModgenFigGroupFromTopology.desc: Retrieves the Modgen figGroup object that is associated with the specified topology object.

mgGetModgenFGFromConstraint.name: mgGetModgenFGFromConstraint
mgGetModgenFGFromConstraint.desc: Returns the database ID of the Modgen figGroup for a specified Modgen constraint ID in a specified cellview.

mgGetRegisteredDummyNetProc.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyNetProc
mgGetRegisteredDummyNetProc.desc: Returns a list of dummyNet procedures that are currently registered.

mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters
mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters.syntax:
mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters(
[ t_libName ]
[ t_cellName ]
[ t_paramType ]
)
=> l_registeredDummyOverrides / nil
mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters.desc: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy override parameters that match the specified library and cell names. If the library name is not specified, the function returns all registered overrides. If the cell name is not specified, the function returns all cell overrides that are registered for the given library.

mgGetRegUserProc.name: mgGetRegUserProc
mgGetRegUserProc.desc: Accepts a user function symbol and returns the names of the user functions that are registered corresponding to the specified user function symbol.

mgGetRowRoutingChannelWidth.name: mgGetRowRoutingChannelWidth
mgGetRowRoutingChannelWidth.desc: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen row.

mgGetStrapDirection.name: mgGetStrapDirection
mgGetStrapDirection.desc: Returns the direction of the specified strap. This function is valid if the strap has a single strap object. Otherwise, the router determines the strap direction.

mgGetStrapHasDirection.name: mgGetStrapHasDirection
mgGetStrapHasDirection.desc: Determines whether the strap direction is set for the specified strap.

mgGetStrapHasOffset.name: mgGetStrapHasOffset
mgGetStrapHasOffset.desc: Determines whether the specified strap has an associated offset value.

mgGetStrapOffset.name: mgGetStrapOffset
mgGetStrapOffset.desc: Returns the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strapObject.

mgGetStrapLongOffset1.name: mgGetStrapLongOffset1
mgGetStrapLongOffset1.desc: Returns the long offset attribute of the specified strap for the bottom or left edge. This value determines how far beyond the strap object that the strap can extend.

mgGetTopologyFromModgen.name: mgGetTopologyFromModgen
mgGetTopologyFromModgen.desc: Returns a list of topology objects that are available in the specified Modgen.

mgGetTopoTrunkShapes.name: mgGetTopoTrunkShapes
mgGetTopoTrunkShapes.desc: Retrieves the shapes associated with a topological trunk.

mgGetTopoShapes.name: mgGetTopoShapes
mgGetTopoShapes.desc: Retrieves all user-generated shapes from the specified topology group object, usually a topological strap.

mgGetTrunkChannel.name: mgGetTrunkChannel
mgGetTrunkChannel.desc: Returns the channel number in which the specified topological trunk pattern is located.

mgGetTrunkRefLayerPurpose.name: mgGetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
mgGetTrunkRefLayerPurpose.desc: Returns the reference layer and purpose of a topological trunk. This function returns a list containing the layer and purpose names.

mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure.name: mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure
mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure.syntax:
mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure(
d_instID
t_side
t_layerName
t_purposeName
)
=> x_enclosure / nil
mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure.desc: Returns the enclosure of a topological trunk reference layer and the purpose within an instance. For example, if the LPP of a trunk reference is Oxide drawing, then the function returns the distance from one side of the Oxide bounding box to the instance bounding box. This value is subtracted from the channel width of the topological trunk to derive the trunk-to-device spacing to the reference layer in the instances above (or to the right of) a trunk.

mgGetTrunkTopo.name: mgGetTrunkTopo
mgGetTrunkTopo.desc: Returns a list of topology trunks belonging to the specified pathSeg.

mgHilightEmptyRowColumnCB.name: mgHilightEmptyRowColumnCB
mgHilightEmptyRowColumnCB.desc: Turns on or off highlighting of empty rows and columns.

mgIsInBackAnnotation.name: mgIsInBackAnnotation
mgIsInBackAnnotation.desc: Checks if there are any Modgens currently running dummy backannotation. Use this function for user callbacks to allow changes to the Modgen constraint caused by backannotation, while preventing other changes to the Modgen constraint.

mgIsTopologyInsideModgen.name: mgIsTopologyInsideModgen
mgIsTopologyInsideModgen.desc: Checks whether the specified topology object belongs to a Modgen. For example, this function can be used to identify Modgen topologies or to find all topologies that are available in the Modgen specified by the optional d_figGroupId argument.

mgModgenHasTopology.name: mgModgenHasTopology
mgModgenHasTopology.desc: Checks whether the specified Modgen contains a topology.

mgObjectHasMatchGroup.name: mgObjectHasMatchGroup
mgObjectHasMatchGroup.desc: Checks whether the specified database object is part of a matchGroup.

mgRegenerateModgen.name: mgRegenerateModgen
mgRegenerateModgen.desc: Forces a Modgen-type group to rebuild its geometry.

mgRegisterDummyNetProc.name: mgRegisterDummyNetProc
mgRegisterDummyNetProc.desc: Registers a function that specifies a net for a specified dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters.name: mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters
mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters.syntax:
mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters(
t_libName
t_cellNameOrRegex
l_supplyParamsList
[ l_signalParamsList ]
)
=> t / nil
mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters.desc: Registers the parameter overrides to be applied to Modgen dummies. The order in which the override parameters are registered is the order in which the look up is processed.

mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection.name: mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection
mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection.syntax:
mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection(
t_libName
t_cellNameOrRegex
t_direction [ Horizontal | Vertical ]
l_paramsList
)
=> t / nil
mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection.desc: Registers Modgen dummy parameters and forcefully matches them to their nearest directional neighbor, left/right or top/bottom.

mgRegUserProc\n.name: mgRegUserProc
mgRegUserProc\n.desc: Accepts user functions based on their keywords and registers them in the Modgen code to enable callbacks.

mgRemoveMemberFromMatchGroup.name: mgRemoveMemberFromMatchGroup
mgRemoveMemberFromMatchGroup.desc: Removes the specified database object from its associated matchGroup.

mgRemoveTopologyFromModgen.name: mgRemoveTopologyFromModgen
mgRemoveTopologyFromModgen.desc: Removes the specified topology object from the specified Modgen.

mgRotateLeftCB.name: mgRotateLeftCB
mgRotateLeftCB.desc: Rotates the selected instance to the left. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

mgRotateMXCB.name: mgRotateMXCB
mgRotateMXCB.desc: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MX transform.

mgRotateMYCB.name: mgRotateMYCB
mgRotateMYCB.desc: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MY transform.

mgRotateR270CB.name: mgRotateR270CB
mgRotateR270CB.desc: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R270 transform.

mgRotateR90CB.name: mgRotateR90CB
mgRotateR90CB.desc: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R90 transform.

mgRotateRightCB.name: mgRotateRightCB
mgRotateRightCB.desc: Rotates the selected instance to the right. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

mgRouteCB.name: mgRouteCB
mgRouteCB.desc: Displays the Routing Style form for the current module.

mgRoutePToTCB.name: mgRoutePToTCB
mgRoutePToTCB.desc: Routes the currently open Modgen using the Modgen pin-to-trunk router.

mgSelectRowColCB.name: mgSelectRowColCB
mgSelectRowColCB.desc: Selects all of the instances in the current row or column from the currently selected instance.

mgSetIsLocalTrunk.name: mgSetIsLocalTrunk
mgSetIsLocalTrunk.desc: Sets the specified trunk as local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

mgSetStrapDirection.name: mgSetStrapDirection
mgSetStrapDirection.desc: Sets the strap direction. This value is valid only for straps with a single strap object. For straps with more than one strap objects, the router determines strap direction.

mgSetStrapHasDirection.name: mgSetStrapHasDirection
mgSetStrapHasDirection.desc: Specifies whether the given strap can have a direction.

mgSetStrapHasOffset.name: mgSetStrapHasOffset
mgSetStrapHasOffset.desc: Specifies whether the given strap has a valid offset value.

mgSetStrapLongOffset1.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset1
mgSetStrapLongOffset1.desc: Sets the long offset attribute for the bottom and left edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

mgSetStrapLongOffset2.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset2
mgSetStrapLongOffset2.desc: Sets the long offset attribute for the top and right edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

mgSetStrapOffset.name: mgSetStrapOffset
mgSetStrapOffset.desc: Sets the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strap object.

mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose.name: mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose.syntax:
mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose(
d_trunkId
t_layerName
[ t_purposeName ]
)
=> t / nil
mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose.desc: Sets the layer and purpose of a topological trunk that is anchored to an instance. The bounding box of the specified layer and purpose inside the instance is used to determine the trunk's location. In other words, the trunk's orthogonal offset is from one side of the reference layer and purpose bounding box. The purpose argument is optional. If not specified, then the purpose argument defaults to any. A trunk's reference layer and purpose can be removed by setting both the layer and purpose arguments to any.

mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth.name: mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth.syntax:
mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth(
d_constraintId
x_channelIndex
f_channelWidth
)
=> f_channelWidth / nil
mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth.desc: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen column.

mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth.name: mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth
mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth.syntax:
mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth(
d_constraintId
x_channelIndex
f_channelWidth
)
=> f_channelWidth / nil
mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth.desc: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen row.

mgSwapCB.name: mgSwapCB
mgSwapCB.desc: Swaps two selected instances, two rows of instances, or two columns of instances in Modgen.

mgUnAbutCB.name: mgUnAbutCB
mgUnAbutCB.desc: Unabuts the selected instances in the current Modgen in the specified cellview.

mgUnRegisterDummyNetProc.name: mgUnRegisterDummyNetProc
mgUnRegisterDummyNetProc.desc: Unregisters a function that specifies a net for a given dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

mgUnregisterDummyOverrideParameters.name: mgUnregisterDummyOverrideParameters
mgUnregisterDummyOverrideParameters.desc: Unregisters all registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides for the given library, if no library is specified, or all currently registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides.

mgUnregisterDummyParamRefDirection.name: mgUnregisterDummyParamRefDirection
mgUnregisterDummyParamRefDirection.desc: Unregister either all registered Modgen dummy directional parameters for the given library name or cellNameOrRegex or all currently registered Modgen dummy directional parameters.

mgUnRegUserProc.name: mgUnRegUserProc
mgUnRegUserProc.desc: Accepts user functions based on the keywords and unregisters them in the Modgen code.

mgUpdateCB.name: mgUpdateCB
mgUpdateCB.desc: Lets the Modgen ConObserver update the Modgen layout module.

mgUpdateEmptyRowColumnHilightCB.name: mgUpdateEmptyRowColumnHilightCB
mgUpdateEmptyRowColumnHilightCB.desc: Update highlights of empty rows to follow any other changes in the Modgen.

mgUpdateHoriAlignCB.name: mgUpdateHoriAlignCB
mgUpdateHoriAlignCB.desc: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of left, right, or center.

mgUpdateVertAlignCB.name: mgUpdateVertAlignCB
mgUpdateVertAlignCB.desc: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of top, bottom, or center.

gpeAddInstance.name: gpeAddInstance
gpeAddInstance.desc: Adds the given list of instances to the specified Modgen.

gpeClearPresetGenerators.name: gpeClearPresetGenerators
gpeClearPresetGenerators.desc: Deletes all the registered preset generator functions from the system.

gpeExtractReuseTemplate.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplate
gpeExtractReuseTemplate.syntax:
gpeExtractReuseTemplate(
u_constraint | d_fig | l_instIDs
g_structureName
t_fileName
)
=> t | nil
gpeExtractReuseTemplate.desc: Extracts the given Modgen into a reusable text file.

gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV
gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV.syntax:
gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV(
l_libNames
[ l_cellNames ]
[ l_viewNames ]
[ g_includeNonUserDefinedGroups ]
)
=> t | nil
gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV.desc: Extracts array reuse template files for recognized groups and arrays for all combinations of the specified libraries, cells, and views in the current design.

gpeExtractTemplateFromMG.name: gpeExtractTemplateFromMG
gpeExtractTemplateFromMG.desc: Generates a reusable template for each Modgen constraint present in the specified constraint cache.

gpeFindArrayPatternDiffs.name: gpeFindArrayPatternDiffs
gpeFindArrayPatternDiffs.desc: Compares array patterns of the specified Modgen constraints or sandbox objects and reports differences, if any.

gpeGetGridValue.name: gpeGetGridValue
gpeGetGridValue.desc: Returns the value of the cells in the Grid Pattern Editor table view.

gpeGetSelection.name: gpeGetSelection
gpeGetSelection.syntax:
gpeGetSelection(
g_tableView
)
=> list(row column) / list(bottom:left top:right)
gpeGetSelection.desc: Returns a list of currently selected cells or a range of cells in a grid-pattern-editor table format.

gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable.name: gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable
gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable.desc: Checks whether the given preset generator is displayed in the Preset drop-down of the Grid Pattern Editor for the selected Modgen.

gpeIsRegisteredPresetGen.name: gpeIsRegisteredPresetGen
gpeIsRegisteredPresetGen.desc: Checks whether the specified function is a registered preset generator function.

gpeLoadReuseTemplate.name: gpeLoadReuseTemplate
gpeLoadReuseTemplate.syntax:
gpeLoadReuseTemplate(
l_target
t_structureName
t_fileName
[ l_mapping ]
[ n_rows ]
)
=> u_sandbox / nil
gpeLoadReuseTemplate.desc: Creates a new Modgen constraint by applying the given Modgen reuse template to the specified list of instances.

gpeMove.name: gpeMove
gpeMove.syntax:
gpeMove(
g_tableView
[ g_cells ]
g_fromAnchor
g_toAnchor
)
=> t / nil
gpeMove.desc: Moves a list of cells within the Grid Pattern Editor table from one point to another.

gpePresetReorientResistor.name: gpePresetReorientResistor
gpePresetReorientResistor.desc: Flips the orientations of the members of a preselected Modgen to reduce the overall connectivity wire length. The placement of the members is not altered.

gpeRegisterPresetGen.name: gpeRegisterPresetGen
gpeRegisterPresetGen.syntax:
gpeRegisterPresetGen(
t_displayName 
t_functionName 
t_checkFunctionName
[ g_noStacks ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeRegisterPresetGen.desc: Registers the specified function as a preset generator.

gpeRemoveInstance.name: gpeRemoveInstance
gpeRemoveInstance.desc: Removes the given instances from the specified Modgen figGroup.

gpeRunPresetGen.name: gpeRunPresetGen
gpeRunPresetGen.desc: Invokes the specified preset generator function on the active figGroup. The figGroup is updated according to the preset generator logic. Ensure that the Grid Pattern Editor (GPE) assistant is open when running this command. Also ensure that the selection argument specifies a valid Modgen figGroup and that the preset is registered correctly.

gpeSelect.name: gpeSelect
gpeSelect.syntax:
gpeSelect(
g_tableView
[g_selectionList | g_type g_value]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSelect.desc: Select cells in the Grid Pattern Editor or Grid Pattern Mapping assistants.

gpeSetGridText.name: gpeSetGridText
gpeSetGridText.desc: Specifies a textual grid pattern for the Pattern field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

gpeSetGridValue.name: gpeSetGridValue
gpeSetGridValue.syntax:
gpeSetGridValue(
g_tableView
[ g_location ]
S_value
[ s_type ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetGridValue.desc: Sets the value of the Grid Pattern Editor table view cells. If there is a single cell selected before the call, the next cell will be selected automatically.

gpeSetOrientText.name: gpeSetOrientText
gpeSetOrientText.desc: Specifies the grid pattern orientation for the Orient field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

gpeSetSize.name: gpeSetSize
gpeSetSize.syntax:
gpeSetSize(
g_tableView
l_dimensions
['stable | 'nostable]
[ n_rows ]
[ n_columns ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetSize.desc: Resizes the specified Grid Pattern Editor table. If the table dimensions are smaller or larger than the new dimensions, then rows or columns are added or removed, as needed.

gpeUnregisterPresetGen.name: gpeUnregisterPresetGen
gpeUnregisterPresetGen.desc: Unregisters the given preset generator function from the Grid Pattern Editor.

gpeUpdateInstanceFromSchematic.name: gpeUpdateInstanceFromSchematic
gpeUpdateInstanceFromSchematic.desc: Updates the given Modgen instance parameters based on the binding schematic cellview.

gpeAbutGridEntries.name: gpeAbutGridEntries
gpeAbutGridEntries.syntax:
gpeAbutGridEntries(
u_sandbox
l_gridEntries
[ ?abutType { x_abutType | t_abutTypeName } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAbutGridEntries.desc: Abuts the specified list of instances or indexes using the given abutment type in the given sandbox object.

gpeAddDummy.name: gpeAddDummy
gpeAddDummy.syntax:
gpeAddDummy(
u_sandbox
t_direction
[ ?n x_rowsCols ]
[ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAddDummy.desc: Adds the specified number of dummy rows or columns in the given direction to the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells.name: gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells
gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells.syntax:
gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells(
u_sandbox
[ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells.desc: Fills the empty cells in the specified sandbox object with dummies.

gpeAddDummySurround.name: gpeAddDummySurround
gpeAddDummySurround.syntax:
gpeAddDummySurround(
u_sandbox
[ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAddDummySurround.desc: Adds a ring of dummies around the specified sandbox grid.

gpeCancelSandbox.name: gpeCancelSandbox
gpeCancelSandbox.syntax:
gpeCancelSandbox(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeCancelSandbox.desc: Discards the specified Modgen sandbox object. Changes made to the Modgen sandbox object are lost. This function can be run in both schematic and layout cellviews. If run from the schematic view, the associated scratch cellview is also deleted. The Modgen constraint is not transferred to the schematic view and the dummies are not backannotated.

gpeClearGridEntries.name: gpeClearGridEntries
gpeClearGridEntries.syntax:
gpeClearGridEntries(
u_sandbox
[ ?row x_row ]
[ ?col x_col ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_gridEntries / nil
gpeClearGridEntries.desc: Unplaces the grid entries that match the given identifiers in the given sandbox object.

gpeCopyColAbutment.name: gpeCopyColAbutment
gpeCopyColAbutment.syntax:
gpeCopyColAbutment(
u_sandbox
x_sourceCol
x_targetCol
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeCopyColAbutment.desc: Copies abutment information from one column to another.

gpeCopyRowAbutment.name: gpeCopyRowAbutment
gpeCopyRowAbutment.syntax:
gpeCopyRowAbutment(
u_sandbox
x_sourceRow
x_targetRow
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeCopyRowAbutment.desc: Copies abutment information from one row to another.

gpeCreateAbutEntries.name: gpeCreateAbutEntries
gpeCreateAbutEntries.syntax:
gpeCreateAbutEntries(
[ ?rows l_rows ]
[ ?cols l_columns ]
[ ?abutType l_abutType ]
[ ?template l_template ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_abutEntry / nil
gpeCreateAbutEntries.desc: Creates a list of abut entries that are in line with the information in the arguments.

gpeCreateAbutType.name: gpeCreateAbutType
gpeCreateAbutType.syntax:
gpeCreateAbutType(
[ ?syncChains { t | nil } ]
[ ?preserveRows { t | nil } ]
[ ?permute { t | nil } ]
[ ?mirrorEquivOrients { t | nil } ]
[ ?mirror { t | nil } ]
[ ?interdigitateChains { t | nil } ]
[ ?dummyFlexBothEndNets { t | nil } ]
[ ?chainLeftNet { Source | Drain | Either } ]
[ ?chainAlignPMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ]
[ ?chainAlignNMOS { Top | Center | Bottom } ]
[ ?allowSingleBulk { t | nil } ]
[ ?abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
) 
=> l_abutType / nil
gpeCreateAbutType.desc: Creates an abutType DPL, which can be passed to the gpeCreateAbutEntry API. The abutment then uses the chaining parameters specified in the abutType parameter. The defaults for the arguments are obtained from the Modgen environment if set. Otherwise, the defaults of lxChain are honored.

gpeCreateAlignment.name: gpeCreateAlignment
gpeCreateAlignment.syntax:
gpeCreateAlignment(
[ ?direction t_direction ]
[ ?type t_type ]
[ ?reflayer g_reflayer ]
[ ?spacing f_spacing ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_alignment / nil
gpeCreateAlignment.desc: Creates an alignment DPL, which can be passed as an alignment argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to set the member alignment and spacing of a grid entry. Specifying a direction, although not necessary for types other than center, is highly recommended.

gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing.name: gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing
gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing.syntax:
gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing(
u_sandbox
[?hAlignType { left | right | custom_left | custom_right | center }]
[?hSpacing f_spacing]
[?hRefLayer t_layerName]
[?hRefPurpose t_purposeName]
[?vAlignType { bottom | top | custom_bottom | custom_top | center }]
[?vSpacing f_spacing]
[?vRefLayer t_layerName]
[?vRefPurpose t_purposeName]
[?useDefaultForUnspecifiedArgs { t | nil } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeCreateAlignmentAndSpacing.desc: Specifies the alignment and spacing settings for all the grid entries in the given Modgen sandbox object.

gpeCreateDummyConfig.name: gpeCreateDummyConfig
gpeCreateDummyConfig.syntax:
gpeCreateDummyConfig(
[ ?master t_master]
[ ?source l_source ]
[ ?connectivity l_connectivity ]
[ ?parameters l_parameters ]
[ ?template l_template ]
[ ?defaultNet t_defaultNet ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_dummyConfig / nil
gpeCreateDummyConfig.desc: Creates a dummyConfig DPL, which can be used as an argument for gpeCreateGridEntry to create a dummy grid entry. If the master is not set, the source is used to determine the master. If the source is not set, the dummy uses the neighboring instances as its source.

gpeCreateDummyConfigNet.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigNet
gpeCreateDummyConfigNet.syntax:
gpeCreateDummyConfigNet(
t_termName
[ ?netName t_netName ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_dummyConfigNet / nil
gpeCreateDummyConfigNet.desc: Creates a dummyConfigNet DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigNet DPLs and passed as the connectivity argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

gpeCreateDummyConfigParam.name: gpeCreateDummyConfigParam
gpeCreateDummyConfigParam.syntax:
gpeCreateDummyConfigParam(
t_name
[ ?type t_type ]
[ ?value t_value ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
) 
=> l_dummyConfigParam / nil
gpeCreateDummyConfigParam.desc: Creates a dummyConfigParam DPL that can be added to a list with other dummyConfigParam DPLs and passed as the parameters argument to gpeCreateDummyConfig to create a dummyConfig DPL.

gpeCreateGridEntry.name: gpeCreateGridEntry
gpeCreateGridEntry.syntax:
gpeCreateGridEntry(
[ ?row x_row ]
[ ?col x_col ]
[ ?name t_name ]
[ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ]
[ ?orientation t_orientation ]
[ ?hAlign l_hAlign ]
[ ?vAlign l_vAlign ]
[ ?template l_template ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_gridEntry / nil
gpeCreateGridEntry.desc: Creates a Modgen sandbox grid entry DPL for an instance or a dummy. A grid entry can represent either an instance or a dummy.

gpeCreateMapEntry.name: gpeCreateMapEntry
gpeCreateMapEntry.syntax:
gpeCreateMapEntry(
[ ?schematicName t_schematicName ]
[ ?symbolName t_symbolName ]
[ ?template l_template ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_mapEntry / nil
gpeCreateMapEntry.desc: Creates a map entry DPL that stores the schematic name of an instance, along with its symbol mapping.

gpeCreateSandbox.name: gpeCreateSandbox
gpeCreateSandbox.syntax:
gpeCreateSandbox(
[ ?cv d_cellview ] 
[ ?ids l_figs ]
[ ?sync { t | nil } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> u_sandbox / nil
gpeCreateSandbox.desc: Creates a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. This function can be used to create Modgen sandbox objects in both schematic and layout cellviews. If none of the arguments are provided, the current edit cellview and selected instances are considered.

gpeDeleteDummyEntries.name: gpeDeleteDummyEntries
gpeDeleteDummyEntries.syntax:
gpeDeleteDummyEntries(
u_sandbox
g_includeInternal
g_unplaceOnly
g_fullRCOnly
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeDeleteDummyEntries.desc: Deletes dummy entries from the given Modgen sandbox object and compresses the grid based on the specified options.

gpeDeleteSandbox.name: gpeDeleteSandbox
gpeDeleteSandbox.syntax:
gpeDeleteSandbox(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeDeleteSandbox.desc: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object but does not delete its associated figGroup.

gpeEditSandbox.name: gpeEditSandbox
gpeEditSandbox.syntax:
gpeEditSandbox(
[ d_modgenID | d_figGroupID ]
[ g_sync ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> u_sandbox / nil
gpeEditSandbox.desc: Returns a Modgen sandbox object that represents the current Modgen or figGroup. The sandbox object can be edited using SKILL APIs.

gpeFinishSandbox.name: gpeFinishSandbox
gpeFinishSandbox.syntax:
gpeFinishSandbox(
u_sandbox
[ ?transfer { t | nil } ]
[ ?removeScratch { t | nil } ]
[ ?backAnnotate { t | nil } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeFinishSandbox.desc: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object. If run from the schematic view, the Modgen's associated scratch cellview is also deleted. If run from the layout view, the command optionally transfers the Modgen constraint to the schematic view and backannotates any dummies. gpeFinishSandbox must be used in tandem with the functions that create sandboxes, such as gpeCreateSandbox and gpeEditSandbox. It is recommend that all Modgen sandbox objects are finished by calling this function.

gpeGetAbut.name: gpeGetAbut
gpeGetAbut.syntax:
gpeGetAbut(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_abut / nil
gpeGetAbut.desc: Returns the Modgen abutment DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetAbutTypeList.name: gpeGetAbutTypeList
gpeGetAbutTypeList.syntax:
gpeGetAbutTypeList	(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_abutTypes / nil
gpeGetAbutTypeList.desc: Returns a list of abutment types for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetAbutTypeName.name: gpeGetAbutTypeName
gpeGetAbutTypeName.syntax:
gpeGetAbutTypeName	(
u_sandbox
x_abutType
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t_abutTypeName / nil
gpeGetAbutTypeName.desc: Returns the name corresponding to the given abutment type number from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetConstraints.name: gpeGetConstraints
gpeGetConstraints.syntax:
gpeGetConstraints(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> lu_constraintIDs / nil
gpeGetConstraints.desc: Returns a list of constraint IDs that are associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetDefaultAbutType.name: gpeGetDefaultAbutType
gpeGetDefaultAbutType.syntax:
gpeGetDefaultAbutType	(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t_abutTypeName / nil
gpeGetDefaultAbutType.desc: Returns the default abutment type name for the given Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetFigGroup.name: gpeGetFigGroup
gpeGetFigGroup.syntax:
gpeGetFigGroup(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> d_figGoupID / nil
gpeGetFigGroup.desc: Returns the ID of the Modgen figGroup that is associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetGrid.name: gpeGetGrid
gpeGetGrid.syntax:
gpeGetGrid(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_grid / nil
gpeGetGrid.desc: Returns the Modgen sandbox grid DPL that describes the grid placement of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetGridColCount.name: gpeGetGridColCount
gpeGetGridColCount.syntax:
gpeGetGridColCount(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> x_columnCount / nil
gpeGetGridColCount.desc: Returns the number of columns available in the grid of the given Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetGridEntry.name: gpeGetGridEntry
gpeGetGridEntry.syntax:
gpeGetGridEntry(
u_sandbox
[ ?ref d_refID ]
[ ?index l_index ]
[ ?name t_layoutName ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_gridEntry / nil
gpeGetGridEntry.desc: Returns a grid entry that matches the specified argument for the specified sandbox object. When calling this function, only one search argument of type reference, index, or layout name must be specified. If multiple arguments are specified, an error message is displayed.

gpeGetGridEntries.name: gpeGetGridEntries
gpeGetGridEntries.syntax:
gpeGetGridEntries(
u_sandbox
[ ?row x_row ]
[ ?col x_col ]
[ ?name t_name ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_gridEntries / nil
gpeGetGridEntries.desc: Returns a list of grid entries from the Modgen sandbox that match the specified identifiers. If you specify multiple identifiers, then the function returns a list of instances that satisfy all requirements.

gpeGetGridRowCount.name: gpeGetGridRowCount
gpeGetGridRowCount.syntax:
gpeGetGridRowCount(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> x_rowCount / nil
gpeGetGridRowCount.desc: Returns the number of rows available in the grid of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetGridSelection.name: gpeGetGridSelection
gpeGetGridSelection.syntax:
gpeGetGridSelection(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_gridSelection / nil
gpeGetGridSelection.desc: Returns a list of indexes that represent the grid selection in the GPE (Grid Pattern Editor) assistant. The DPL is a list of list of indexes, for example ((0 1) (1 3) ... ), that are associated with the specified userType (UT).

gpeGetMap.name: gpeGetMap
gpeGetMap.syntax:
gpeGetMap(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_map / nil
gpeGetMap.desc: Returns the Modgen sandbox map DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeGetMapEntry.name: gpeGetMapEntry
gpeGetMapEntry.syntax:
gpeGetMapEntry(
u_sandbox
t_name
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> l_mapEntry / nil
gpeGetMapEntry.desc: Returns the map entry DPL from the specified Modgen sandbox object that matches the specified schematic or symbol name. The function first looks for a matching schematic name; if not found, then looks for a matching symbol name and returns the first match.

gpeInsertEmptyColumns.name: gpeInsertEmptyColumns
gpeInsertEmptyColumns.syntax:
gpeInsertEmptyColumns(
u_sandbox
t_direction
x_startColumn
[ ?count n_count ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeInsertEmptyColumns.desc: Inserts empty columns in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified column.

gpeInsertEmptyRows.name: gpeInsertEmptyRows
gpeInsertEmptyRows.syntax:
gpeInsertEmptyRows(
u_sandbox
t_direction
x_startRow
[ ?count n_count ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeInsertEmptyRows.desc: Inserts empty rows in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified row.

gpeIsSandboxSync.name: gpeIsSandboxSync
gpeIsSandboxSync.syntax:
gpeIsSandboxSync(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeIsSandboxSync.desc: Checks whether the specified Modgen sandbox object is in sync with its associated Modgen constraint, and returns a Boolean that indicates the status.

gpeIsValidAbutType.name: gpeIsValidAbutType
gpeIsValidAbutType.desc: Validates the specified abutment type name or number for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpePlaceGridEntries.name: gpePlaceGridEntries
gpePlaceGridEntries.syntax:
gpePlaceGridEntries	(
u_sandbox
l_gridEntries
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpePlaceGridEntries.desc: Places the specified grid entries at the specified location in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns.name: gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns
gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns.syntax:
gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns(
u_sandbox
g_includeInternal
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns.desc: Removes empty rows and columns from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeSboxp.name: gpeSboxp
gpeSboxp.syntax:
gpeSboxp(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSboxp.desc: Checks whether the specified object is a valid Modgen sandbox object.

gpeSetAbut.name: gpeSetAbut
gpeSetAbut.syntax:
gpeSetAbut(
u_sandbox
g_abut
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetAbut.desc: Sets the abutment for the entire grid, without using individual abutment entries. The entire abutment object of the sandbox-in-place is replaced.

gpeSetAbutEntries.name: gpeSetAbutEntries
gpeSetAbutEntries.syntax:
gpeSetAbutEntries
u_sandbox
l_abutEntries
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
) 
=> t / nil
gpeSetAbutEntries.desc: Modifies the Modgen sandbox object by applying the abutment specified by the abutment entries. If there is any conflict between the new entry and any existing entry, the existing entry is removed and the new entry is used.

gpeSetGrid.name: gpeSetGrid
gpeSetGrid.syntax:
gpeSetGrid(
u_sandbox
l_grid
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetGrid.desc: Sets the entire grid without using individual grid entries. You can also use this function to update grid placement by providing a list of lists describing the row placement of instances.

gpeSetGridEntry.name: gpeSetGridEntry
gpeSetGridEntry.syntax:
gpeSetGridEntry(
u_sandbox
l_gridEntry
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetGridEntry.desc: Adds the specified grid entry to the grid portion of the specified Modgen sandbox object. If the grid location specified in the grid entry is already occupied, the existing entry is unplaced, and the specified grid entry is set.

gpeSetMap.name: gpeSetMap
gpeSetMap.syntax:
gpeSetMap(
u_sandbox
g_map
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetMap.desc: Updates the symbol mapping without using individual map entries. When a sandbox map DPL is specified, the current mapping of instances is replaced with the mapping specified by the provided map DPL. Symbol mapping can also be updated by providing a list of lists of strings. The first string in each sub-list holds the schematic name of an instance and the second string holds its updated mapping.

gpeSetMapEntry.name: gpeSetMapEntry
gpeSetMapEntry.syntax:
gpeSetMapEntry(
u_sandbox
l_mapEntry
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSetMapEntry.desc: Modifies the map portion of the Modgen sandbox object by updating the symbol mapping value with the specified map entry. The key in the map is the schematic name. If the sandbox has a schematic instance with the same name as the one specified in the map entry, then the symbol mapping of that instance in the sandbox is modified.

gpeSetMergeLayer.name: gpeSetMergeLayer
gpeSetMergeLayer.desc: Sets the MergeLayer parameter for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeStacksAreCompressed.name: gpeStacksAreCompressed
gpeStacksAreCompressed.syntax:
gpeStacksAreCompressed(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeStacksAreCompressed.desc: Determines whether the stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object are in the compressed state.

gpeStacksUncompress.name: gpeStacksUncompress
gpeStacksUncompress.syntax:
gpeStacksUncompress(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeStacksUncompress.desc: Uncompresses all stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeStartSandbox.name: gpeStartSandbox
gpeStartSandbox.syntax:
gpeStartSandbox(
[ ?ref l_reference ] 
[ ?cv d_cellview ] 
[ ?sync { t | nil } ]
[ ?updateSchConstraint { t | nil } ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> g_sandbox / nil
gpeStartSandbox.desc: Checks for a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. If one exists, the handle of the Modgen sandbox object is returned for editing with the GPE placement and routing APIs. If an existing object does not have the specified instances, a new Modgen sandbox object is created.

gpeSyncSandbox.name: gpeSyncSandbox
gpeSyncSandbox.syntax:
gpeSyncSandbox(
u_sandbox
[ g_transferConstraint ]
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeSyncSandbox.desc: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to sync mode, meaning that changes made to the state of the Modgen sandbox object cause an update to any associated Modgen constraint and layout placement.

gpeUnAbutGridEntries.name: gpeUnAbutGridEntries
gpeUnAbutGridEntries.syntax:
gpeUnAbutGridEntries(
u_sandbox
l_gridEntries
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeUnAbutGridEntries.desc: Unabuts the specified list of instances or indexes in the specified sandbox object.

gpeUnSyncSandbox.name: gpeUnSyncSandbox
gpeUnSyncSandbox.syntax:
gpeUnSyncSandbox(
u_sandbox
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeUnSyncSandbox.desc: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to the unsynchronized mode. In this mode, any change to the state of the Modgen sandbox object is not reflected in any associated Modgen constraint and the layout placement.

gpeAddMatchGroups.name: gpeAddMatchGroups
gpeAddMatchGroups.syntax:
gpeAddMatchGroups(
u_sandbox
l_matchGroups
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAddMatchGroups.desc: Adds the specified matched groups to the specified Modgen sandbox object. A matched group is a set of topological trunks with similar properties.

gpeAddStrapEntries.name: gpeAddStrapEntries
gpeAddStrapEntries.syntax:
gpeAddStrapEntries(
u_sandbox
l_straps
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
gpeAddStrapEntries.desc: Adds the specified straps to the topology (topo) section of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

gpeAddTrunkChains.name: gpeAddTrunkChains
gpeAddTrunkChains.syntax:
gpeAddTrunkChains(
u_sandbox
l_trunkChains
[ ?verbose { t | nil } ]
)

cphChangeEditMode.name: cphChangeEditMode
cphChangeEditMode.desc: Changes the physConfig from edit mode to the specified mode. If switching to read mode, r, and the physConfig has changed since the last edit, a prompt for saving or discarding the edits displays.

cphCloseConfig.name: cphCloseConfig
cphCloseConfig.desc: Closes the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The physical configuration view is not saved.

cphCloseWindow.name: cphCloseWindow
cphCloseWindow.desc: Closes the graphical user interface for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The physical configuration view is not saved.

cphGetWinConfig.name: cphGetWinConfig
cphGetWinConfig.desc: Returns the ID of the physical configuration view associated with a specified Configure Physical Hierarchy window.

cphGetWindowId.name: cphGetWindowId

cphIsConfigModified.name: cphIsConfigModified
cphIsConfigModified.desc: Returns whether or not the physical configuration view associated with the given ID has been modified since it was last saved.

cphIsLeaf.name: cphIsLeaf
cphIsLeaf.desc: Determines whether the specified occurrence is a leaf. An occurrence is considered a leaf if no hierarchy will be generated underneath it.

cphIsReadOnly.name: cphIsReadOnly
cphIsReadOnly.desc: Checks whether the physical configuration view is read only.

cphIsRemoveDevice.name: cphIsRemoveDevice
cphIsRemoveDevice.desc: Determines whether there is a Remove rule defined for the specified occurrence in the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID.

cphIsUnderPhysConfig.name: cphIsUnderPhysConfig
cphIsUnderPhysConfig.desc: Determines whether the specified occurrence exists under a sub physConfig.

cphLaunchFromLayout.name: cphLaunchFromLayout

cphGetStopList.name: cphGetStopList

cphGetViewList.name: cphGetViewList
cphGetViewList.desc: Returns the logical switch view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID or, if you specify the path to an occurrence, the effective logical switch view list used by that occurrence.

cphSetCstList.name: cphSetCstList
cphSetCstList.desc: Sets the constraint view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. This list specifies the names of the views containing constraint data.

cphSetLibList.name: cphSetLibList
cphSetLibList.desc: Sets the physical library list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. This list specifies the names of the libraries searched to find the corresponding physical cell for a given logical cell.

cphSetStopList.name: cphSetStopList
cphSetStopList.desc: Sets the physical stop view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The list specifies the view names that are used to determine the corresponding physical view for a given logical view. When traversing a hierarchy, Configure Physical Hierarchy uses the first view it encounters with one of the specified names.

cphSetViewList.name: cphSetViewList
cphSetViewList.desc: Sets the logical switch view list for the physical configuration view associated with the specified ID. The list specifies the view names used to descend into a hierarchical design to find schematic views.

All conditions that are enforced for these obstructions through GUI-based flow are applicable here. For example, only one placement blockage is applied per soft block. If a second placement blockage is applied through this API, a warning is issued.

odcRegBlockage.name: odcRegBlockage
odcRegBlockage.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for blockages. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegBoundary.name: odcRegBoundary
odcRegBoundary.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for boundaries. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegCPA.name: odcRegCPA

odcRegLabel.name: odcRegLabel

odcRegMarker.name: odcRegMarker
odcRegMarker.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for markers of type Tool, Short Message, and Severity information. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegModgen.name: odcRegModgen
odcRegModgen.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for modgen. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegPin.name: odcRegPin

odcRegRow.name: odcRegRow
odcRegRow.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for rows. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegRowRegion.name: odcRegRowRegion
odcRegRowRegion.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for row region in advanced node. The application must be specified. Currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegRuler.name: odcRegRuler
odcRegRuler.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for rulers. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapeCircle.name: odcRegShapeCircle
odcRegShapeCircle.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for circles. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapeDonut.name: odcRegShapeDonut
odcRegShapeDonut.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for donuts. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapeEllipse.name: odcRegShapeEllipse
odcRegShapeEllipse.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for donuts. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapeMPP.name: odcRegShapeMPP
odcRegShapeMPP.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for MPPs. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapePath.desc: Allows you to define a custom SKILL function to specify your own information to be displayed in the Info Balloon box for paths. The application must be specified and currently only Layout-XL is supported.

odcRegShapePathSeg.name: odcRegShapePathSeg

odcRegShapePolygon.name: odcRegShapePolygon

odcRegVirtualFigGroup.name: odcRegVirtualFigGroup
