leFinishTrunk.name: leFinishTrunk
leFinishTrunk.desc: When the Create Wire command is active, this function converts the current wire(s) being edited into trunks. It then uses Pin To Trunk routing to completes the connection between the converted trunk(s) and all possible pin targets that are orthogonal to the trunk(s). The default bindkey is 2.

leFinishWire.name: leFinishWire
leFinishWire.desc: When the Create Wire command is active, this function uses the point-to-point router to complete the current wire or wires being edited from their current end to the nearest viable target.

leHiAddWireVia.name: leHiAddWireVia
leHiAddWireVia.syntax:
leHiAddWireVia( 
[ w_windowId ] 
[ t_defaultTarget ] 
[ g_rotate ] 
) 
=> t / nil
leHiAddWireVia.desc: When the Create - Wire command is active, this function allows you to place a via on a path or pathSeg or opens the Select Via form and select a via. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

leHiCancelStitch.name: leHiCancelStitch
leHiCancelStitch.desc: Cancels the via that is being added in a layout and returns to an active wire editing command, such as Create Wire or Create Bus.

leHiCreateBus.name: leHiCreateBus
leHiCreateBus.desc: Starts the Create - Bus command in XL. You can press F3 to open the Create Bus form. The command lets you create buses.

leHiCreateGeometricWire.name: leHiCreateGeometricWire
leHiCreateGeometricWire.desc: Starts the Create - Shape - Geometric Wire command. You can press F3 to open the Create Geometric Wire form. Using this command, you can create geometric wires comprising of paths or pathSegs and vias outside of routes. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

leHiCreateStrandedWire.name: leHiCreateStrandedWire
leHiCreateStrandedWire.desc: Starts the Create - Stranded Wire command. You can press F3 to open the Create Stranded Wire form. The command lets you create a wire comprising of multiple strands in a single direction on a single net.

leHiCreateWire.name: leHiCreateWire
leHiCreateWire.desc: Starts the Create - Wire command in XL. You can press F3 to open the Create Wire form. The command lets you create symbolic wires comprising of pathSegs and vias in routes. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.

leHiP2P.name: leHiP2P
leHiP2P.desc: Invokes the interactive Point to Point routing command. The Point to Point command is supported only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

leHiStitchToLayer.name: leHiStitchToLayer
leHiStitchToLayer.syntax:
leHiStitchToLayer( 
t_layerName 
[ g_rotate ] 
[ w_windowId ]
) 
=> t / nil
leHiStitchToLayer.desc: Inserts a via between the current layer paths segment and the layer name provided in the parameter when the Create Wire or Create Bus command is active.

leWECycleControlWire.name: leWECycleControlWire
leWECycleControlWire.desc: Allows cycling through the extreme and middle control wires in the selected bus during interactive bus editing. This functions runs successfully only when the Create Wire command is active. This function is available only in Layout XL and higher tiers.

leWECycleSnap.name: leWECycleSnap
leWECycleSnap.desc: Allows cycling of highlight during the Create Wire command through level 1 or top-level pin edges available within the Aperture distance from the cursor. The highlighted edge represents the starting point of wire creation.

leWENoSnap.name: leWENoSnap
leWENoSnap.desc: Resets the point of starting wire creation to the current location of the cursor during the Create Wire command.

weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem.name: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem
weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem.syntax:
weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem(
t_name
t_customTransition
[ t_bindkey ]
)
=> t / nil
weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem.desc: Adds a menu item to the context-sensitive menu of the Create Bus command. You can use the added menu item to call the customer SKILL API. A bindkey is also assigned to the menu item.

weCWHoldWidth.name: weCWHoldWidth
weCWHoldWidth.desc: This function is used for the create wire command when smart snapping is active. The width that is highlighted by smart snapping is used by the next wire that is being created even if the wire is created at another position than the current one.

weCycleCutColorVia.name: weCycleCutColorVia
weCycleCutColorVia.desc: Cycles color of each cut when a via is inserted.

weCyclePatternGravityLayerTransitionType.name: weCyclePatternGravityLayerTransitionType
weCyclePatternGravityLayerTransitionType.desc: In a WSP design, the wires are snapped to the layer up or down WSPs, which is the default behavior. However, if you want the wire only to snap to layer up or layer down a WSP, then you can use the patternGravityLayerTransitionType environment variable to cycle the layer for snapping. The environment variable has three values: patternGravityLayerUp, patternGravityLayerDown, and patternGravityLayerAny. The default value is patternGravityLayerAny.

weGatherBusWires.name: weGatherBusWires
weGatherBusWires.desc: This function is used when the leHiCreateBus command is running. If the gap between the bus wires does not match the minSpacing rule, then the wires are gathered at the minimum spacing. If the wires are already at minSpacing, they will be spread to use the initial gap, which is the gap before executing the weGatherBusWires function.

weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks.name: weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks
weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks.syntax:
weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks( 
d_cellViewId
l_layerNum
l_purposeNum
l_direction
l_dimension
l_coordinates [ x_coord y_coord ]
)
=> l_trackInfo / nil
weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks.desc: Returns the Width Spacing Pattern (WSP) track information based on the inputs specified, such as layers, purposes, preferred directions, and shape dimensions, at a specific location.The purpose of the function is to check whether or not there are tracks at the given location.

weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems.name: weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems
weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems.desc: Returns a list of custom transitions that were added to the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

weGetPathSegWidth.name: weGetPathSegWidth
weGetPathSegWidth.desc: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal path segments when their width is being queried. Unlike dbGetPathSegWidth which returns the value stored in the OpenAccess database for the width of diagonal pathSegs, this API does the sqrt(2) conversion appropriately and return the width value as it appears in the property editor form or object inspector assistant.

weHiCopyRoute.name: weHiCopyRoute
weHiCopyRoute.desc: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Copy Route command. Press F3 in the canvas to open the Copy Route form. The command lets you copy layout geometries similar to a bus from a single routed net.

weHiCycleViaDefDown.name: weHiCycleViaDefDown
weHiCycleViaDefDown.desc: Returns the current via definition for the pending vias when you start either the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

weHiCycleViaDefUp.name: weHiCycleViaDefUp
weHiCycleViaDefUp.desc: Automatically cycles up the via definition for the pending vias, while using the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

weHiEditBus.name: weHiEditBus
weHiEditBus.desc: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Bus command in Layout XL and higher tiers. The command lets you edit the width and spacing of bus bits. If no window ID is specified, the current window is used.

weHiInteractiveRouting.name: weHiInteractiveRouting
weHiInteractiveRouting.desc: Maps the function to the leHiCreateGeometricWire (paths mode) SKILL function when the technology file is one of the fabric types, package, module, or board, and the active application is Virtuoso RF. Otherwise, the function is mapped to leHiCreateWire when the technology file is of the fabric type IC or the active application is not Virtuoso RF.

weHiWireTo45.name: weHiWireTo45
weHiWireTo45.desc: Starts the interactive command that lets you select wire corners to create chamfering.

weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem.name: weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem
weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem.desc: Removes a custom transition menu item from the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth.name: weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth
weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth.desc: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom out in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, decrease the width of the current wire.

weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth.name: weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth
weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth.desc: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, increase the width of the current wire.

weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment.name: weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment
weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment.desc: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment SKILL API scroll down the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment.name: weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment
weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment.desc: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment SKILL API scrolls up the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

weSetPathSegWidth.name: weSetPathSegWidth
weSetPathSegWidth.syntax:
weSetPathSegWidth( 
[ g_pathSegId ] 
float value
) 
=> t / nil
weSetPathSegWidth.desc: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal pathseg when the width is being changed. In addition, it also supports diagonal pathseg with custom extension and appropriately updates the values when the width is being changed.

sltSetContextSpecificationCells.name: sltSetContextSpecificationCells
sltSetContextSpecificationCells.desc: Defines a list of contexts for slotting. A slotting context has a name and an associated slotting specification cell in the format library/cell/view.

sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting.name: sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting
sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting.syntax:
sltShapeConsecutiveSlotting(
[ ?cv d_cellViewId ] 
[ ?all { t | nil } ]
[ ?region l_region ]
[ ?layers l_layers ]
[ ?objects l_objects ]
[ ?slotLength n_slotLength ]
[ ?slotWidth n_slotWidth ]
[ ?slotStaggered { t | nil } ]
[ ?lengthWidthRatio n_lengthWidthRatio ]
[ ?slotVia { t | nil } ]
[ ?excludePins { t | nil } ]
[ ?widthThreshold1 n_widthThreshold1 ]
[ ?widthThreshold2 n_widthThreshold2 ]
[ ?lSpacing1 n_lSpacing1 ]
[ ?lSpacing2 n_lSpacing2 ]
[ ?wSpacing1 n_wSpacing1 ]
[ ?wSpacing2 n_wSpacing2 ]
[ ?slotToEdge1 n_slotToEdge1 ]
[ ?slotToEdge2 n_slotToEdge2 ]
[ ?slotSpacingAtTurn1 n_slotSpacingAtTurn1 ]
[ ?slotSpacingAtTurn2 n_slotSpacingAtTurn2 ]
)
=> t / nil

drdAddTarget.name: drdAddTarget
drdAddTarget.desc: Sets the shape located at the specified point in the specified window as a DRD target. The function does not remove from the selection the shapes already set as DRD targets. If two or more shapes overlap at the specified point, the shape on the active layer is set as a DRD target.

drdBatchCheck.name: drdBatchCheck
drdBatchCheck.desc: Runs DRD checker on the specified area of the specified cellview. The hierarchy depth and batch checking rules specified in the DRD Options form are honored. Use this function to run a DRD check on read-only cellviews to view any DRC violations as warning messages in CIW.

drdBatchCheckLicenseAvailable.name: drdBatchCheckLicenseAvailable
drdBatchCheckLicenseAvailable.desc: Checks whether a Layout XL license is available. If the license is available, the function returns t. If the license is unavailable, it attempts to check out the license. If the attempt is successful, it checks the license back in and returns t.

drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem.name: drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem
drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem.syntax:
drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem( 
t_CategoryName
x_toggleValue
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdCheckedConstraintGroupItem.desc: Toggles the state of a constraint category in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdCheckedLayerGroupItem.name: drdCheckedLayerGroupItem
drdCheckedLayerGroupItem.syntax:
drdCheckedLayerGroupItem( 
t_layerCategoryName
x_toggleValue
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdCheckedLayerGroupItem.desc: Toggles the state of a layer category in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdCheckedRuleGroupItem.name: drdCheckedRuleGroupItem
drdCheckedRuleGroupItem.desc: Toggles the state of check boxes.

drdConstraintGroupHeaderClicked.name: drdConstraintGroupHeaderClicked
drdConstraintGroupHeaderClicked.desc: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the categories listed in the Constraint Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdConstraintHeaderClicked.name: drdConstraintHeaderClicked
drdConstraintHeaderClicked.desc: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the constraints listed in the Constraint column or sorts the constraints alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdConstraintItemClicked.name: drdConstraintItemClicked
drdConstraintItemClicked.syntax:
drdConstraintItemClicked(
t_constraintName
x_columnIndex
x_stateValue
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdConstraintItemClicked.desc: Toggles the state of a constraint for different checking modes, that is, Enforce, Notify, Post-Edit, and Batch, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdEnablePixelThreshold.name: drdEnablePixelThreshold
drdEnablePixelThreshold.desc: Enables a pixel threshold. When you move an object toward another object and you cross this pixel threshold, the object being moved is automatically snapped to the closest edge of the DRC halo or the target object, if DRD Smart Snap mode is enabled. You can disable this pixel threshold to temporarily disable smart snapping during interactive editing.

drdGetAllowedWidth.name: drdGetAllowedWidth
drdGetAllowedWidth.syntax:
drdGetAllowedWidth(
d_objID
t_layerName
[ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ]
[ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ]
[ ?upperLimit f_maxValue ]
)
=> l_integers / nil
drdGetAllowedWidth.desc: Returns a list of allowed widths for the specified layer.

drdGetMinSpacing.name: drdGetMinSpacing
drdGetMinSpacing.syntax:
drdGetMinSpacing(
d_techID
t_layerName
[ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ]
[ ?width1 f_width1Val ]
[ ?width2 f_width2Val ]
[ ?prl f_prlVal ]
[ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ]
[ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ]
)
=> f_minSpaceVal / nil
drdGetMinSpacing.desc: Returns the minimum spacing value defined by the minSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified width, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing.name: drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing
drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing.syntax:
drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing(
d_techID
t_layerName
[ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ]
[ ?span f_spanVal ]
[ ?prl f_prlVal ]
[ ?direction { any | horizontal | vertical } ]
[ ?sameMask { 0 | 1 } ]
)
=> f_minSpanSpaceVal / nil
drdGetMinSpanLengthSpacing.desc: Returns the minimum span length spacing value defined by the minSpanLengthSpacing constraint for the specified layer, based on the specified span, parallel run length (prl), direction, and mask values.

drdGetMinVoltageSpacing.name: drdGetMinVoltageSpacing
drdGetMinVoltageSpacing.syntax:
drdGetMinVoltageSpacing(
d_techID
t_layerName
[ ?constraintGroup t_constrGroupName ]
[ ?voltage1 f_voltage1Val ]
[ ?voltage2 f_voltage2Val ]
)
=> f_minVolSpaceVal / nil
drdGetMinVoltageSpacing.desc: Returns the minimum voltage-dependent spacing value defined by the minVoltageSpacing (One layer) constraint for the specified layer based on the specified voltages. The voltage difference is calculated as the absolute difference of the two input voltages, which correspond to the voltages set on the two objects for which you want to retrieve the minimum spacing.

drdIsPixelThresholdEnabled.name: drdIsPixelThresholdEnabled
drdIsPixelThresholdEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the pixel threshold is enabled or disabled.

drdLayerGroupHeaderClicked.name: drdLayerGroupHeaderClicked
drdLayerGroupHeaderClicked.desc: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layer categories listed in the Layer Category column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdLayerHeaderClicked.name: drdLayerHeaderClicked
drdLayerHeaderClicked.desc: Changes the state of the check boxes for all the layers listed in the Layer column or sorts the layers alphabetically, on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdLayerItemClicked.name: drdLayerItemClicked
drdLayerItemClicked.syntax:
drdLayerItemClicked(
t_layerName
x_columnIndex
x_stateValue
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdLayerItemClicked.desc: Toggles the state of a layer on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdListConstraintCategoryRules.name: drdListConstraintCategoryRules
drdListConstraintCategoryRules.syntax:
drdListConstraintCategoryRules(
[ ?cv d_cellViewID ]
[ ?outputFile s_fileName ]
[ ?active { t | nil } ]
[ ?splitTF { t | nil } ]
[ ?csv { t | nil } ]
)
=> t / nil
drdListConstraintCategoryRules.desc: Lists constraints supported by DRD in the version of the software that is currently running. The constraints' information can be saved in an ASCII file or listed in CIW, in a tabular format or as a comma-separated list.

drdOptionsSet.name: drdOptionsSet
drdOptionsSet.desc: Sets default states for fields in the configuration file for the DRD Options form.

drdOptionUpdateConstraint.name: drdOptionUpdateConstraint
drdOptionUpdateConstraint.syntax:
drdOptionUpdateConstraint( 
l_modeCategories
l_constraints
g_state
) 
=> t / nil
drdOptionUpdateConstraint.desc: Sets the default state for specified constraints and modes in the configuration file for the Filters tab of the DRD Options form. If the function is run without a maskLayout cellview open, the settings are discarded.

drdOptionUpdateLayer.name: drdOptionUpdateLayer
drdOptionUpdateLayer.desc: Sets the default state for specified layers in the configuration file for the Filters tab of the DRD Options form. If the function is run without a maskLayout cellview open, the settings are discarded.

drdRemoveTarget.name: drdRemoveTarget
drdRemoveTarget.desc: Unsets a DRD target that exists at the specified point in the specified window. If multiple DRD targets overlap at the specified point, the DRD target on the active layer is unset.

drdRuleGroupHeaderClicked.name: drdRuleGroupHeaderClicked
drdRuleGroupHeaderClicked.desc: Toggles Rule Groups check boxes. The state of the of check boxes in the right panel, Rule Types and Rule IDs is also toggled.

drdRuleIDHeaderClicked.name: drdRuleIDHeaderClicked
drdRuleIDHeaderClicked.desc: Toggles the state of check boxes of all rule IDs. The state of the associated Rule Group check box in the left panel and the associated rule type is also toggled.

drdRuleIDItemClicked.name: drdRuleIDItemClicked
drdRuleIDItemClicked.syntax:
drdRuleIDItemClicked(
t_ruleIDName
x_selectIndex
x_checkboxState
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdRuleIDItemClicked.desc: Modifies the check box of the rule ID on the left panel and the corresponding rule group and rule type.

drdRuleTypeHeaderClicked.name: drdRuleTypeHeaderClicked
drdRuleTypeHeaderClicked.desc: Toggles the state of check boxes of all rule types. The state of associated Rule Group check box in the left panel and the associated rule IDs are also toggled.

drdRuleTypeItemClicked.name: drdRuleTypeItemClicked
drdRuleTypeItemClicked.syntax:
drdRuleTypeItemClicked(
t_ruleTypeName
x_selectIndex
x_checkboxState
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdRuleTypeItemClicked.desc: Modifies the check box of rule type on the left panel and the corresponding rule group and rule ID.

drdSelectConstraintGroupItem.name: drdSelectConstraintGroupItem
drdSelectConstraintGroupItem.syntax:
drdSelectConstraintGroupItem(
t_constraintCategoryName
x_selectIndex
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdSelectConstraintGroupItem.desc: Selects the constraint category in the Constraint Category column and displays the corresponding constraints in the Constraint column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdSelectLayerGroupItem.name: drdSelectLayerGroupItem
drdSelectLayerGroupItem.syntax:
drdSelectLayerGroupItem(
t_layerCategoryName
x_selectIndex
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdSelectLayerGroupItem.desc: Selects the layer category in the Layer Category column and displays the corresponding layers in the Layer column on the Filters tab of the DRD Options form.

drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem.name: drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem
drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem.syntax:
drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem(
t_ruleGroupName
x_selectIndex
w_windowId
) 
=> t / nil
drdSelectSignOffRuleGroupItem.desc: Selects the sign off rule group category on the left panel and displays the corresponding rule type or rule ID in the right panel.

drdToggleSmartSnapMode.name: drdToggleSmartSnapMode
drdToggleSmartSnapMode.desc: Freezes DRC halos, which helps snap objects to the closest edge of the halo or the object.

drdToggleSmartSnapModeForDiscreteSpacing.name: drdToggleSmartSnapModeForDiscreteSpacing
drdToggleSmartSnapModeForDiscreteSpacing.desc: Freezes discrete spacing markers, which helps snap objects to the closest marker.

drdVerifySelSet.name: drdVerifySelSet
drdVerifySelSet.desc: Checks the objects selected in the specified design for rule violations and generates a marker for each rule violation found. If a design is not specified, it checks the objects selected in the design open in the current window.

leToggleDrdMode.name: leToggleDrdMode
leToggleDrdMode.desc: Cycles through DRD modes: Off, Notify, Enforce, and Enforce and Notify.

mptActivate.name: mptActivate
mptActivate.desc: Specifies whether to switch the Virtuoso Multi-Patterning Technology coloring engine ON or OFF.

mptCheckFlow.name: mptCheckFlow
mptCheckFlow.desc: Checks the flow settings by loading the check procedure of the specified flow or by comparing the current value of the related environment variables against the environment variables set by the set procedure of the flow.

mptCheckHierarchicalLocks.name: mptCheckHierarchicalLocks
mptCheckHierarchicalLocks.desc: Performs a check for hierarchical color lock (HCL) conflict in the cellview.

mptCleanClusters.name: mptCleanClusters
mptCleanClusters.desc: Cleans out-of-date cluster information in the cellview which can help to reduce the design size and/or improve performance.

mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer.name: mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer
mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer.syntax:
mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer(
d_cellViewID | g_libName
t_layerName
g_doHierarchy
)
=> t / nil
mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer.desc: Cleans layer-based color violations on the entire design hierarchy or library.

mptColorRemastering.name: mptColorRemastering
mptColorRemastering.syntax:
mptColorRemastering(
d_cellViewID 
?mode t_mode 
[ ?mappingFile t_mappingFile ]
[ ?fromView t_fromView ]
[ ?toView t_toView ]
[ ?invalidMappingWord t_invalidMappingWord ]
)
=> t / nil
mptColorRemastering.desc: Remasters color-shifted abstract views to corresponding layout views or color-shifted layout views to abstract views.

mptDeleteClusters.name: mptDeleteClusters
mptDeleteClusters.syntax:
mptDeleteClusters(
d_cellViewID 
[ ?layers l_layers ]
[ ?checkOnly g_checkOnly ]
[ ?thruHierarchy g_thruHierarchy ]
[ ?openForEdit g_openForEdit ]
)
=> t / nil
mptDeleteClusters.desc: Removes coloring clusters in the specified cellview.

mptDefineFlow.name: mptDefineFlow
mptDefineFlow.syntax:
mptDefineFlow(
t_flowName
s_setFunction
[ s_checkFunction ]
)
=> t / nil
mptDefineFlow.desc: Registers a flow by linking the flow name to a set and a check procedure. If the check procedure is not defined, the check defined in the cdsenv file is run. This function checks the environment variables defined in the set function against their current values.

mptDoColorChecks.name: mptDoColorChecks
mptDoColorChecks.syntax:
mptDoColorChecks(
d_cellViewID 
l_layers 
l_region
g_doColorShorts
g_doUncoloredShapes
g_doUnlockedShapes
g_doColorability
)
=> t / nil
mptDoColorChecks.desc: Performs coloring checks in the specified cellview.

mptDoToolbarAction.name: mptDoToolbarAction
mptDoToolbarAction.desc: Runs the specified Multiple Patterning toolbar function.

mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked.name: mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked
mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked.syntax:
mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked(
d_cellViewID 
[ l_layers
[ l_region
[ g_fixUncolored
[ g_fixUnlocked ]]]]
)
=> t / nil
mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked.desc: Searches for uncolored and unlocked, top-level shapes or vias, in the specified cellview and colors and locks them, respectively.

mptGetColoredPurposes.name: mptGetColoredPurposes
mptGetColoredPurposes.desc: Returns a list of the colored layer purpose pairs for the cellview.

mptGetColorShiftingLayers.name: mptGetColorShiftingLayers
mptGetColorShiftingLayers.desc: Returns a list of valid shifting layers set by the environment variable, colorShiftingLayers.

mptGetDefaultColoringMethod.name: mptGetDefaultColoringMethod
mptGetDefaultColoringMethod.desc: Returns the session default coloring method that was set using mptSetDefaultColoringMethod.

mptGetFlowNames.name: mptGetFlowNames
mptGetFlowNames.desc: Lists all available flow names that have been defined. It includes pre-defined and custom flow names.

mptGetFlowSettings.name: mptGetFlowSettings
mptGetFlowSettings.desc: Reports, the procedure used to set a flow, in the CIW and output.

mptGetLayerColoringMethod.name: mptGetLayerColoringMethod
mptGetLayerColoringMethod.syntax:
mptGetLayerColoringMethod(
d_cellViewID 
[ t_layerName ] 
)
=> t_coloringMethod / t_SDLcolorMethod / nil
mptGetLayerColoringMethod.desc: Returns either the coloring method for the given layer, or the coloring method for the session, the design, and layers with a specified coloring method.

mptGetLayerDefaultColor.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColor
mptGetLayerDefaultColor.syntax:
mptGetLayerDefaultColor(
d_techFileID 
[ t_layerName ] 
)
=> t_color / l_layerColor / nil
mptGetLayerDefaultColor.desc: Returns either the default color for the given layer, or a list of layer-default color pairs.

mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting
mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting.syntax:
mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting(
d_techFileID 
[ t_layerName ] 
[ b_getAll ]
)
=> t_color / l_layerColor / l_ColorSettings / nil
mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting.desc: Returns the default color setting for the specified layer.

mptGetLockDefaultColors.name: mptGetLockDefaultColors
mptGetLockDefaultColors.desc: Indicates whether the layer default color specified by mptSetLayerDefaultColor will be locked when assigned to a shape.

mptGetOutdatedDesigns.name: mptGetOutdatedDesigns
mptGetOutdatedDesigns.desc: Returns a list of the cellviews in the design hierarchy for which the color information is outdated. The list can optionally specify the outdated layers for each cellview in the returned list.

mptGetTrackPatternPattern.name: mptGetTrackPatternPattern
mptGetTrackPatternPattern.desc: Returns a list of the color patterns for the specified track pattern.

mptGetUpToDateDesigns.name: mptGetUpToDateDesigns
mptGetUpToDateDesigns.desc: Returns a list of the cellviews in the hierarchy for which the color information is up to date.

mptHiStitch.name: mptHiStitch
mptHiStitch.desc: Enables stitch mode to fix odd loop color violations by breaking shapes into two overlapping (stitched) shapes. The first click in the layout selects the shape to be stitched, and the second click sets the stitch location.

mptHiUnStitch.name: mptHiUnStitch
mptHiUnStitch.desc: Enables unstitch mode to revert stitches that were created while in stitch mode (enabled by mptHiStitch). Click a stitched shape in the layout to remove the stitch.

mptIsMaskColorShown.name: mptIsMaskColorShown
mptIsMaskColorShown.desc: Checks whether the specified mask color is visible for the layer.

mptLPPMergeToColor.name: mptLPPMergeToColor
mptLPPMergeToColor.syntax:
mptLPPMergeToColor(
d_cellviewID
g_libName
g_viewName
l_mapping
[ g_colorState ]
)
=> t / nil
mptLPPMergeToColor.desc: Converts the layout into Virtuoso multi-pattern conformance format for designs that use two or more separate layer-purpose pairs to represent multi-patterning mask information, so that Virtuoso coloring engine can perform further operations on it. You can choose to write the conversion result into a different library or/and a different view. In this case, new cells with the same cell name and the library or/and view name that you specify are used. The original cell is not changed. If you choose to write the result to the same cell, the original layer-purpose pair data is removed. This function is performed on the entire hierarchy starting from the specified cell.

mptLockAll.name: mptLockAll
mptLockAll.desc: Locks all the top-level shapes of the specified cellview with their current color. You can optionally lock only the shapes on specific colorable layers. Gray color shapes are not locked.

mptMarkersToColoredBlockages.name: mptMarkersToColoredBlockages
mptMarkersToColoredBlockages.desc: Transforms the shapes on the specified purposes of the colored layers in the given cellview to colored blockages on the same layer. This function works hierarchically on a layout.

mptMarkersToMaskColors.name: mptMarkersToMaskColors
mptMarkersToMaskColors.syntax:
mptMarkersToMaskColors(
l_purposes 
g_drawingPurpose 
d_cellViewID 
[ g_locked ]
[ g_removeMarker ]
[ g_recolorAll ]
[ g_save ]
)
=> t / nil
mptMarkersToMaskColors.desc: Transforms the shapes in the given cellview to the drawing purpose and assigns color to each shape based on its original marker purpose. This function works hierarchically on a layout. By default, the assigned color is locked and the marker purpose shapes are removed.

mptPropagateLocks.name: mptPropagateLocks
mptPropagateLocks.desc: Propagates all the locks visible from the top level to connected shapes through the hierarchy.

mptPropagateSameMaskGroups.name: mptPropagateSameMaskGroups
mptPropagateSameMaskGroups.desc: Propagates same mask groups in the given cellview through the hierarchy. This should be run following top-level editing of designs with same mask groups. This ensures that shapes in the hierarchy that are connected to same mask group shapes are included in that mask group.

mptPurgePcell.name: mptPurgePcell
mptPurgePcell.desc: Removes the color of Pcell or express Pcell colored by the coloring engine. Pcells are purged and the cache of the purged express Pcell is deleted. This is performed hierarchically. Before the color is removed, the coloring engine is deactivated to prevent recoloring of Pcells.

mptReColor.name: mptReColor
mptReColor.syntax:
mptReColor(
d_cellViewID 
[ l_layers ]
[ g_depth ] 
)
=> t / nil
mptReColor.desc: Rebuilds the color information for the cellview from the bottom hierarchically, according to the specified depth and layers.

mptReColorFromShapes.name: mptReColorFromShapes
mptReColorFromShapes.desc: Recolors the shapes in the list and the shapes that are connected to them. If the coloring method is colorSpacing, the color of the shapes that are within the same-mask spacing of the shapes in the list will be updated, according to the clustering algorithm described in Automatic Color Shifting in Virtuoso Multiple Patterning Technology User Guide.

mptReColorSelection.name: mptReColorSelection
mptReColorSelection.desc: Recolors the shapes specified in the selection set in the specified cellview.

mptReColorWsp.name: mptReColorWsp
mptReColorWsp.syntax:
mptReColorWsp(
d_cellViewID 
[ ?layers l_layers ]
[ ?region l_bBox ]
[ ?grayShapeOnly g_grayShapeOnly ]
[ ?trackPatterns l_trackPatterns ]
[ ?shapes l_shapes ]
[ ?checkWidth g_checkWidth ]
[ ?vias l_vias ]
)
=> l_coloredShapes / nil
mptReColorWsp.desc: Recolors shapes based on the color of WSPs only.

mptReconstructStitch.name: mptReconstructStitch
mptReconstructStitch.desc: Reconstructs stitches by creating stitch pairs from overlapping shapes on the specified purpose.

mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer.name: mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer
mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer.syntax:
mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer(
d_cellViewID 
t_layerName 
g_doHierarchy
g_createMarkers
)
=> t / nil
mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer.desc: Reports MPT flow settings. Reports the number of shapes, vias, and HCLs that have colored data on the specified layer, with a single mask. This function traverses the design and its sub cells and creates the report. If the g_createMarkers argument is set to t, markers are created for each error.

mptReportCurrentSettings.name: mptReportCurrentSettings
mptReportCurrentSettings.syntax:
mptReportCurrentSettings(
d_cellViewID 
[ t_fileName ]
g_reportDesign
)
=> t / nil

mptSetDefaultColoringMethod.name: mptSetDefaultColoringMethod
mptSetDefaultColoringMethod.desc: Sets the session default coloring method.

mptSetFlow.name: mptSetFlow
mptSetFlow.desc: Applies the flow settings by loading the procedure linked to the flow name.

mptSetLayerColoringMethod.name: mptSetLayerColoringMethod
mptSetLayerColoringMethod.desc: Sets the default coloring method for the technology database, the design, or specified layers in the design.

mptSetLayerDefaultColor.name: mptSetLayerDefaultColor
mptSetLayerDefaultColor.syntax:
mptSetLayerDefaultColor(
d_techFileID 
t_layerName 
t_color 
)
=> t / nil
mptSetLayerDefaultColor.desc: Sets the default color for a layer. This color will be assigned to newly created shapes and vias on the layer, and to gray shapes and vias on the layer when recoloring the design. The color will also be used to initialize the active color for this layer in the Palette.

mptSetLockDefaultColors.name: mptSetLockDefaultColors
mptSetLockDefaultColors.desc: Specifies whether the layer default color specified by mptSetLayerDefaultColor will be locked when assigned to a shape.

mptSetTrackPatternPattern.name: mptSetTrackPatternPattern
mptSetTrackPatternPattern.desc: Specifies the color pattern for the track pattern.

mptSetupComplianceChecker.name: mptSetupComplianceChecker
mptSetupComplianceChecker.syntax:
mptSetupComplianceChecker( 
dbObject 
[ x_startLevel ]
[ x_stopLevel ]
)
=> t / nil
mptSetupComplianceChecker.desc: Flags any objects that are not aligned with the current MPT setup.

mptShowMaskColor.name: mptShowMaskColor
mptShowMaskColor.syntax:
mptShowMaskColor(
t_layerName 
x_maskNumber 
g_toShow 
)
=> t / nil
mptShowMaskColor.desc: Shows or hides the color for the specified mask on the given layers.

mptUnlockAll.name: mptUnlockAll
mptUnlockAll.desc: Unlocks all the colored shapes that are locked at the top level of the specified cellview. You can optionally unlock only the shapes on specific colorable layers. Top-level shapes with color attribute locks (dbLocks) are unlocked with their current color. Hierarchical color locks at the current editing hierarchy level are removed.

mptUnpropagateLocks.name: mptUnpropagateLocks
mptUnpropagateLocks.desc: Removes the system locks created by the propagate locks command.

mptUpdateColor.name: mptUpdateColor
mptUpdateColor.syntax:
mptUpdateColor(
d_cellViewID 
[ l_layers ]
[ g_depth ] 
)
=> t / nil
mptUpdateColor.desc: Updates the color information from the bottom hierarchically, according to the specified depth and layers. This is useful when the color engine has been switched off/on, or a third party tool has been used to modify color information, leaving color information in an out-of-date state.

abeBlockagesFromCellView.name: abeBlockagesFromCellView
abeBlockagesFromCellView.syntax:
abeBlockagesFromCellView(
t_layerName
o_outLayer
g_queue
[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ] 
)
=> o_abeLayer / nil
abeBlockagesFromCellView.desc: Copies blockages from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new or existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied blockages to the specified ABE layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

abeBoundariesFromCellView.name: abeBoundariesFromCellView
abeBoundariesFromCellView.desc: Copies the boundaries from the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied boundaries to a specified layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

abeClearLayer.name: abeClearLayer
abeClearLayer.desc: Removes all the shapes on the ABE layer and frees the memory. This is useful for re-using ABE layers.

abeDone.name: abeDone
abeDone.desc: Closes the current ABE session and frees all the memory that was used by ABE.

abeElapsedTime.name: abeElapsedTime
abeElapsedTime.desc: Returns the elapsed time for the current ABE session.

abeInit.name: abeInit
abeInit.syntax:
abeInit(
d_cellViewId 
[ ?doInterrupts g_interrupts ] 
[ ?depth g_depth ] 
[ ?threads g_threadCount ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeInit.desc: Initializes an ABE session for the specified cellview. The ABE elapsed time clock is set to zero.

abeIslandIterator.name: abeIslandIterator
abeIslandIterator.desc: Returns the island iterator for the rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. Each entry is a list of points for a shape on the ABE layer.

abeLayerAbut.name: abeLayerAbut
abeLayerAbut.syntax:
abeLayerAbut(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerAbut.desc: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer for ABE layer1 shapes that abut with shapes on ABE layer2.

abeLayerAnd.name: abeLayerAnd
abeLayerAnd.syntax:
abeLayerAnd(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerAnd.desc: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on ABE layer1 overlap shapes on ABE layer2.

abeLayerAndNot.name: abeLayerAndNot
abeLayerAndNot.syntax:
abeLayerAndNot(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerAndNot.desc: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on layer1 do not overlap shapes on layer2.

abeLayerAvoid.name: abeLayerAvoid
abeLayerAvoid.syntax:
abeLayerAvoid(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ]
[ ?islandBased g_islandBased ]
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerAvoid.desc: Adds shapes on the output layer for shapes on layer1 that are completely outside of, and have no abutting edges with, shapes on layer2.

abeLayerFromCellView.name: abeLayerFromCellView
abeLayerFromCellView.syntax:
abeLayerFromCellView(
t_layerName 
[ ?bbox l_bbox ] 
[ ?bBox l_bBox ]
[ ?purpose t_purposeName ] 
[ ?excludePurpose l_purposeName ]
[ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer [ ?queue g_queue ] ]
[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ] 
[ ?startLevel g_startLevel ]
[ ?stopLevel g_stopLevel ] 
[ ?orientation g_orientation ]
[ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ] 
[ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ] 
)
=> o_abeLayer / nil
abeLayerFromCellView.desc: Copies the shapes from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied shapes to a specific area, purpose, mask color, or hierarchical depth. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

abeLayerFromFigSet.name: abeLayerFromFigSet
abeLayerFromFigSet.desc: Adds the shapes from a FigSet to an existing ABE layer or a new ABE layer.

abeLayerFromNet.name: abeLayerFromNet
abeLayerFromNet.syntax:
abeLayerFromNet(
t_layerName 
t_netName
[ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer ] 
[ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ] 
[ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ]
[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ] 
)
=> o_abeLayer / nil
abeLayerFromNet.desc: Adds the shapes from a net to an existing or new ABE layer. Logical connectivity is not preserved and therefore cannot be restored if the shapes are written back to the ABE session cellview.

abeLayerFromShapes.name: abeLayerFromShapes
abeLayerFromShapes.desc: Creates an ABE layer with shapes from the given list.

abeLayerGrow.name: abeLayerGrow
abeLayerGrow.syntax:
abeLayerGrow(
o_abeInputLayer 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?north g_sizeNorth ] 
[ ?south g_sizeSouth ] 
[ ?east g_sizeEast ] 
[ ?west g_sizeWest] 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerGrow.desc: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer that are ABE input layer shapes that have been increased in size along one or more directions in the north, south, east, and/or west.

abeLayerInside.name: abeLayerInside
abeLayerInside.syntax:
abeLayerInside(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerInside.desc: Adds ABE layer1 shapes that are completely inside an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

abeLayerMergeTiles.name: abeLayerMergeTiles
abeLayerMergeTiles.syntax:
abeLayerMergeTiles(
i_abeLayer
t_orientation
[ ?queue { t | nil } ] 
=> o_outputLayer / nil
abeLayerMergeTiles.desc: Uses an existing ABE layer to recreate maximum tiles based on the specified orientation.

abeLayerOr.name: abeLayerOr
abeLayerOr.syntax:
abeLayerOr(
o_abeInputLayer 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerOr.desc: Adds shapes from the input ABE layer to the ABE output layer.

abeLayerOrPtArray.name: abeLayerOrPtArray
abeLayerOrPtArray.desc: Adds a polygon that is represented by a list of points to the ABE output layer.

abeLayerOutside.name: abeLayerOutside
abeLayerOutside.syntax:
abeLayerOutside(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerOutside.desc: Adds to the ABE output layer the ABE layer1 shapes that are completely outside the ABE layer2 shapes. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

abeLayerShrink.name: abeLayerShrink
abeLayerShrink.syntax:
abeLayerShrink(
o_abeInputLayer 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?north g_sizeNorth ] 
[ ?south g_sizeSouth ] 
[ ?east g_sizeEast ] 
[ ?west g_sizeWest] 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerShrink.desc: Decreases the size of shapes from the input ABE layer and outputs them to the ABE output layer. Shapes can be reduced by different distances in the north, south, east, and west directions.

abeLayerSize.name: abeLayerSize
abeLayerSize.syntax:
abeLayerSize(
o_abeInputLayer 
o_abeOutputLayer 
g_size 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerSize.desc: Adds shapes that have been increased or decreased in size from the ABE input layer to the ABE output layer.

abeLayerStraddle.name: abeLayerStraddle
abeLayerStraddle.syntax:
abeLayerStraddle(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerStraddle.desc: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that partially overlap an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

abeLayerToBlockages.name: abeLayerToBlockages
abeLayerToBlockages.syntax:
abeLayerToBlockages(
o_abeInputLayer 
t_layerName 
[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ] 
[ ?blockageType g_blockageType ] 
[ ?tiles g_tiles 
| ?noHoles g_noHoles ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerToBlockages.desc: Adds shapes as blockage objects from the ABE layer to the specified layer. Optional arguments specify a mask color and blockage type for the blockage objects, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether shapes are copied as tiles instead of islands.

abeLayerToCellView.name: abeLayerToCellView
abeLayerToCellView.syntax:
abeLayerToCellView(
o_abeLayer 
t_layerName 
[ ?tiles g_tiles 
| ?noHoles g_noHoles ] 
[ ?purpose t_purposeName ] 
[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ] 
[ ?cell t_cellName ]
[ ?view t_viewName ] 
[ ?cvId d_cellviewID ] 
[ ?shapeIds { t | nil} }
)
=> l_shapeIDs / t / nil
abeLayerToCellView.desc: Copies shapes from the ABE layer to the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview. Optional arguments specify the layer purpose, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as islands instead of primitive tiles.

abeLayerToHilightSet.name: abeLayerToHilightSet
abeLayerToHilightSet.syntax:
abeLayerToHilightSet(
o_abeInputLayer 
h_hilightSetId 
[ ?tiles g_tiles 
| ?noHoles g_noHoles ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerToHilightSet.desc: Adds the rectangles and polygons on the specified ABE layer to the specified highlight set. Optional arguments specify whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as primitive tiles instead of islands.

abeLayerTouch.name: abeLayerTouch
abeLayerTouch.syntax:
abeLayerTouch(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
[ ?includeCorners g_includeCorners ]
[ ?islandBased g_islandBased ]
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerTouch.desc: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that touch (completely overlap, partially overlap, or abut) an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

abeLayerXor.name: abeLayerXor
abeLayerXor.syntax:
abeLayerXor(
o_abeLayer1 
o_abeLayer2 
o_abeOutputLayer 
[ ?queue g_queue ] 
)
=> t / nil
abeLayerXor.desc: Adds rectangles and polygons to the ABE output layer where ABE layer1 shapes and ABE layer2 shapes do not overlap.

abeMTdebug.name: abeMTdebug
abeMTdebug.desc: Enables the output of additional messages to monitor progress when multithreading is used.

abeRunQueue.name: abeRunQueue
abeRunQueue.desc: Runs all the ABE operations that are queued for processing.

abeShapesInside.name: abeShapesInside
abeShapesInside.syntax:
abeShapesInside(
d_cellViewId 
l_insideShapeObj 
l_outsideShapeObj 
)
=> l_shapeObj / nil
abeShapesInside.desc: Returns a list of shapes from the inside list that are completely inside a shape from the outside list. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

abeShapesOutside.name: abeShapesOutside
abeShapesOutside.syntax:
abeShapesOutside(
d_cellViewId 
l_outsideShapeObj 
l_insideShapeObj 
)
=> l_shapeObj / nil
abeShapesOutside.desc: Returns a list of shapes from the outside list that are completely outside of shapes from the inside list. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

abeTileIterator.name: abeTileIterator
abeTileIterator.desc: Returns the tile iterator for the primitive rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. The iterator can be restricted to a region of the layer.

spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly.name: spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly
spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly.syntax:
spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly(
d_lhsInst
d_rhsInst
n_minOd
n_minPoly
)
=> n_odSpacing
spdCalcOdSpacingWithPoly.desc: Calculates the required oxide diffusion spacing between two adjacent instances based on minimum oxide diffusion spacing and polysilicon spacing constraints.

spdGetAbutName.name: spdGetAbutName
spdGetAbutName.desc: Returns the user abutment name associated with the specified abutment strategy registered using the spdGetUserAbutProc function.

spdGetAbutStrategy.name: spdGetAbutStrategy
spdGetAbutStrategy.desc: Returns the abutment strategy associated with the specified user abutment name registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

spdGetSymDeviceInfo.name: spdGetSymDeviceInfo
spdGetSymDeviceInfo.desc: Returns an object containing information, such as length, width, fingers, and binding related to the specified symbolic device. This information can be used to write user callback functions.

spdGetUserAbutProc.name: spdGetUserAbutProc
spdGetUserAbutProc.desc: Returns an object containing the registered user abutment options with associated user callbacks and the description that were registered using the spdRegUserAbutProc function.

spdPerformAbutment.name: spdPerformAbutment
spdPerformAbutment.syntax:
spdPerformAbutment(
d_lhsInst
d_rhsInst
x_keepContacts
t_abutStrategy { sdFirst | dummyFirst }
)
=> ld_chain / nil
spdPerformAbutment.desc: Performs abutment on two adjacent instances according to the specified arguments and the SPD P/N chain alignment setting.

spdRegUserAbutProc.name: spdRegUserAbutProc
spdRegUserAbutProc.syntax:
spdRegUserAbutProc(
l_abutNames
t_abutProc
t_checkProc
t_restoreProc
[ ?libName t_libName ]
[ ?description t_description ]
[ ?checkOdAbut t | nil ]
)
=> t / nil
spdRegUserAbutProc.desc:
Registers callback to check the design for OD abutment.

Registers a list of user-defined abutments and related callbacks to perform these abutments in the SPD Editing or SPD Preview window or when a layout generated using SPD is brought back to the SPD Editing window. You can register them globally or by name of the library. If the design contains instances from different libraries, SPD loads the user-defined abutments and related callbacks from only one of registered libraries.

spdUnregUserAbutProc.name: spdUnregUserAbutProc
spdUnregUserAbutProc.desc: Unregisters the current user abutment callback for the specified library. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

spdGetUserFlowProc.name: spdGetUserFlowProc
spdGetUserFlowProc.desc: Returns an object containing the user flow callbacks that were registered using the spdRegUserFlowProc function.

spdRegUserFlowProc.name: spdRegUserFlowProc
spdRegUserFlowProc.syntax:
spdRegUserFlowProc(
[ ?postGen t_postGenProc ]
[ ?preGen t_preGenProc ]
[ ?postGenLayout t_postGenLayProc ]
[ ?symPreviewInstParam t_symPreviewInstParamProc ] 
)
=> t / nil
spdRegUserFlowProc.desc: Registers user-defined callbacks to further customize the design in specific steps of the SPD flow.

spdUnregUserFlowProc.name: spdUnregUserFlowProc
spdUnregUserFlowProc.desc: Unregisters the current user flow callback. You cannot unregister a callback during an SPD session because it is still in use.

lobGetRegisteredAdjacentFillDefsProc.name: lobGetRegisteredAdjacentFillDefsProc
lobGetRegisteredAdjacentFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Returns the name of the function that is registered as the adjacent fill definition procedure.

lobGetRegisteredFillOverrideParameters.name: lobGetRegisteredFillOverrideParameters
lobGetRegisteredFillOverrideParameters.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Returns the first set of registered fill override parameters that matches the specified library and cell names.

lobGetRegisteredTransitionFillDefsProc.name: lobGetRegisteredTransitionFillDefsProc
lobGetRegisteredTransitionFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Returns the name of the function that is registered as the transition fill definition procedure.

lobGetRegUserProc.name: lobGetRegUserProc
lobGetRegUserProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Returns a list of strings that contain the name of the specified registered user procedure.

lobRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc.name: lobRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc
lobRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers the specified user function symbol as the adjacent fill definition procedure.

lobRegisterFillOverrideParameters.name: lobRegisterFillOverrideParameters
lobRegisterFillOverrideParameters.syntax:
lobRegisterFillOverrideParameters(
t_libName
t_cellNameOrRegex
l_paramsList
)
=> t / nil
lobRegisterFillOverrideParameters.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers parameter overrides to be used by dummy fill. Lookup processes parameter overrides in the order in which they are registered.

lobRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc.name: lobRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc
lobRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers the specified user function symbol as the transition fill definition procedure.

lobRegUserProc.name: lobRegUserProc
lobRegUserProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers a user-defined function for a specific purpose, as needed by layout objects. This function is currently used to register procedures to retrieve adjacent fill definitions.

lobUnRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc.name: lobUnRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc
lobUnRegisterAdjacentFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Unregisters the specified user function symbol, which is currently registered as the adjacent fill definition procedure.

lobUnregisterFillOverrideParameters.name: lobUnregisterFillOverrideParameters
lobUnregisterFillOverrideParameters.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Unregisters either all registered fill parameter overrides for the given library name or all the currently registered fill parameters for all libraries.

lobUnRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc.name: lobUnRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc
lobUnRegisterTransitionFillDefsProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Unregisters the specified user function symbol that is currently registered as the transition fill definition procedure.

lobUnRegUserProc.name: lobUnRegUserProc
lobUnRegUserProc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Accepts user functions based on keyword and unregisters them.

apCustomPDKSettings.name: apCustomPDKSettings
apCustomPDKSettings.syntax:
apCustomPDKSettings(
t_pdkName
[ ?paramList l_paramsList | ?paramFunc s_paramFunc ]
[ ?cdsEnvs l_cdsEnvars ]
[ ?regFile t_regFile ]
[ ?fillParams l_fillParams ]
[ ?modgenDummyParams l_ModgenDummyParams ]
)
=> t / nil
apCustomPDKSettings.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Registers PDK-specific instance parameters, environment variables, custom constraint registration procedures, fill instance parameters, and Modgen dummy parameters that must be honored while running each step of the automated placement and routing flow.

apEnableM0OnFlow.name: apEnableM0OnFlow
apEnableM0OnFlow.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Forces M0 flow to be turned on or off. Typically, the tool checks the Pcell parameters to automatically determine whether the flow must be turned on or off. You can use this SKILL API to force start or stop the flow. This API is valid only in certain advanced node flows.

apPDKSetupGetCdsEnvs.name: apPDKSetupGetCdsEnvs
apPDKSetupGetCdsEnvs.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of CDS environment variables with values that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetFillParams.name: apPDKSetupGetFillParams
apPDKSetupGetFillParams.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of instance fill parameters that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetModgenDummyParams.name: apPDKSetupGetModgenDummyParams
apPDKSetupGetModgenDummyParams.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of Modgen dummy instance parameters that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetParamFunc.name: apPDKSetupGetParamFunc
apPDKSetupGetParamFunc.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves the PDK-specific instance parameter function that is registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetParamList.name: apPDKSetupGetParamList
apPDKSetupGetParamList.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of instance parameters that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetRegProcs.name: apPDKSetupGetRegProcs
apPDKSetupGetRegProcs.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Retrieves a list of custom constraint registration procedures that are registered to the specified PDK for the automated placement and routing flow.

apPDKSetupGetVtNameList.name: apPDKSetupGetVtNameList
apPDKSetupGetVtNameList.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Searches for PDK-specific voltage threshold (VT) CDF parameter names and cell names registered to a particular PDK in the automated device placement and routing flow.

apPlaceAuto.name: apPlaceAuto
apPlaceAuto.syntax:
apPlaceAuto(
d_cellviewID
[ ?fixedAR f_fixedAR ]
[ ?fixedW f_fixedW ]
[ ?areaCost f_areaCost ]
[ ?wireLenCost f_wireLenCost ]
[ ?symAxis t_symAxis ]
[ ?fillPopup g_fillPopup ]
[ ?pOverN g_pOverN ]
[ ?groupAbut g_groupAbut ]
[ ?adjustBoundary g_adjustBoundary ]
[ ?incr g_incr ]
[ ?fillPopup g_fillPopup ]
)
=> t / nil
apPlaceAuto.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Runs the Virtuoso device-level automatic placer with the specified parameters.

apPlaceAutoMatureNode.name: apPlaceAutoMatureNode
apPlaceAutoMatureNode.syntax:
apPlaceAutoMatureNode(
d_cellviewID
x_effortLevel
g_updatePRBoundary
g_incremental
)
=> t / nil
apPlaceAutoMatureNode.desc: Runs the Virtuoso Analog Placer available at mature nodes.

apResetPDKSetup.name: apResetPDKSetup
apResetPDKSetup.syntax:
apResetPDKSetup(
t_pdkName
[ ?paramList g_paramsList | ?paramFunc g_paramFunc ]
[ ?cdsEnvs g_cdsEnvars ]
[ ?regFile g_regFile ]
[ ?fillParams g_fillParams ]
)
=> t / nil
apResetPDKSetup.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Unregisters instance parameters, environment variables, custom constraint registration procedures, fill instances parameters, or instance parameter function from the specified PDK.

apSnapInsts.name: apSnapInsts
apSnapInsts.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Snaps the specified instances to rows and snap grids.

lobAddCopyFill.name: lobAddCopyFill
lobAddCopyFill.syntax:
lobAddCopyFill(
d_cellviewID
l_source
t_targetArea
l_netName
t_createAsMode
g_hierarchy
)
=> l_fillFigIDs / nil
lobAddCopyFill.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Identifies gaps in the row regions in the given target area and fills them with the specified target fill cells.

lobBaseLayerDummyFillCB.name: lobBaseLayerDummyFillCB
lobBaseLayerDummyFillCB.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Invokes the Fill tab of the Auto P&R assistant.

lobBaseLayerDummyFillWrapperCB.name: lobBaseLayerDummyFillWrapperCB
lobBaseLayerDummyFillWrapperCB.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Checks for license availability before invoking the Fill tab of the Auto P&R assistant.

lobIsCopyFill.name: lobIsCopyFill
lobIsCopyFill.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Checks whether the specified object has been created using the copy fill functions.

lobRemoveCopyFill.name: lobRemoveCopyFill
lobRemoveCopyFill.desc: (Virtuoso Layout Suite EXL) Removes all objects copy that were created using the copy fill functions from the specified cellview.

vreDeletePhysicalCells.name: vreDeletePhysicalCells
vreDeletePhysicalCells.syntax:
vreDeletePhysicalCells(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_style ]
[ S_eName ]
) 
=> t / nil
vreDeletePhysicalCells.desc: Deletes physical-only instances for specified cell types. It uses the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant GUI or set by vreSetOption.

vreDeletePowerRouting.name: vreDeletePowerRouting
vreDeletePowerRouting.syntax:
vreDeletePowerRouting(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_rStyle ]
[ S_rName ]
) 
=> t / nil
vreDeletePowerRouting.desc: Deletes power routing data for the specified scope of the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

vreDeleteRowRegions.name: vreDeleteRowRegions
vreDeleteRowRegions.syntax:
vreDeleteRowRegions(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_style ]
[ S_eName ]
) 
=> t / nil
vreDeleteRowRegions.desc: Deletes all automatically created rows and row regions using the options specified in the Auto P&R assistant GUI or set by vreSetOption.

vreDeleteSignalRouting.name: vreDeleteSignalRouting
vreDeleteSignalRouting.syntax:
vreDeleteSignalRouting(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_rStyle ]
[ S_rName ]
) 
=> t / nil
vreDeleteSignalRouting.desc: Deletes signal routing data for specified scope based of the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

vreFinishRouting.name: vreFinishRouting
vreFinishRouting.syntax:
vreFinishRouting(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_rStyle ]
[ S_rName ]
) 
=> l_result / nil
vreFinishRouting.desc: Runs finish routing based on the given routing style or router using the options specified in the Routing Assistant or set by vreSetOption.

vreGenerateWSPs.name: vreGenerateWSPs
vreGenerateWSPs.syntax:
vreGenerateWSPs(
[ d_cvid ]
[ S_rStyle ]
[ S_rName ]
) 
=> d_wsspDefId / nil
vreGenerateWSPs.desc: Generates WSPs for the selected cellview. This SKILL API uses the options specified in the Routing Assistant or through vreSetOption based on the given routing style or router.

vreGetCellView.name: vreGetCellView

cleStretchMalformedSpine.desc:
Specifies whether the Stretch command can recognize a malformed spine and move it together if possible. For example, a malformed spine is a spine without a turn containing several collinear pathSegs with non-coincident end points. 

By default, this is disabled in a Concurrent Layout design (manager or designer mode) so that stretching a split pathSeg inside a design partition will not attempt to move an outside pathSeg in the same spine or do the opposite, even when the Spine option is enabled in the Selection Options form.
