ciRemoveLeadingSlash.name: ciRemoveLeadingSlash
ciRemoveLeadingSlash.desc: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

ciRemoveProcessRules.name: ciRemoveProcessRules
ciRemoveProcessRules.desc: Removes all process rules associated with the given object.

ciRemoveTrailingSlash.name: ciRemoveTrailingSlash
ciRemoveTrailingSlash.desc: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

ciReopenCellView.name: ciReopenCellView
ciReopenCellView.desc:
Reopens the constraint view in read or edit mode.

Note: This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

ciReorderAssistants.name: ciReorderAssistants
ciReorderAssistants.desc: Reorders the listing of Circuit Prospector assistants (categories). The new ordering should be a list of the existing category names in the order that you wish them to appear in the Circuit Prospector category drop-down list.

ciResistorArrayUpdateRowColVal.name: ciResistorArrayUpdateRowColVal
ciResistorArrayUpdateRowColVal.desc: Increases or decreases the row and column values of the series or parallel resistor array template that contains the currently selected modgen. If the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Row, the value displayed in the Col field is updated using this function. Conversely, if the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Col, the value displayed in the Row field is updated.

ciResolveBulkNet.name: ciResolveBulkNet
ciResolveBulkNet.syntax:
ciResolveBulkNet( 
t_device
l_hierContext
[ ?viewNameList g_viewNameList ]
[ ?stopViewList g_stopViewList ]
)
=> list / nil
ciResolveBulkNet.desc: This function is used with Circuit Prospector finder expressions to retrieve the bulk net on a device and resolves the net to the highest level in the design.

ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator.name: ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator
ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator.syntax:
ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator( 
t_strength
d_insts
u_cache
)
=> t / nil
ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator.desc: This SKILL function is run by the Matching(Strength) constraint generator expression and used to create matching template constraints.

ciSelectedConstraints.name: ciSelectedConstraints
ciSelectedConstraints.desc: Returns a list of selected constraint IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

ciSelectedTemplates.name: ciSelectedTemplates
ciSelectedTemplates.desc: Returns a list of selected template IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

ciSetHaloOptions.name: ciSetHaloOptions
ciSetHaloOptions.desc: Invokes a user interface that allows you to set the various constraint visualization options.

ciSetHaloPolicy.name: ciSetHaloPolicy
ciSetHaloPolicy.desc: Sets the policy for object haloing and grouping.

ciSetMaxHaloGroupSize.name: ciSetMaxHaloGroupSize
ciSetMaxHaloGroupSize.desc: Allows the setting of a limit on the number of database objects to be haloed and grouped together when a constraint is selected in the Constraint Manager. The setting of a group size limit is only possible when minDisplay has been set as the halo policy using ciSetHaloPolicy.

ciSetModgenTopology.name: ciSetModgenTopology
ciSetModgenTopology.desc: Sets the database topology on the modgen and deletes any pre-existing database topologies.

ciSetSymmetricAxes.name: ciSetSymmetricAxes
ciSetSymmetricAxes.desc: Where symmetry constraints exist with multiple axes, forces a single axis of symmetry to be the most commonly used axis.

ciSigTypeMatchesNetType.name: ciSigTypeMatchesNetType
ciSigTypeMatchesNetType.desc: This function creates a net predicate that checks whether or not the sigType attribute of a net matches a given net type.

ciSimpleName.name: ciSimpleName
ciSimpleName.desc: Expands the passed name and simplifies it (removes duplicates). If the resulting name is a single string then this is returned otherwise the original name string is returned.

ciSortedOpenCellViews.name: ciSortedOpenCellViews
ciSortedOpenCellViews.desc: Returns a list of open constraint caches from ciGetOpenCellViews sorted using ciConstraintViewLessp.

ciTemplateAddCons.name: ciTemplateAddCons
ciTemplateAddCons.desc: Adds one or more ci constraints to a ci constraint template.

ciTemplateCreate.name: ciTemplateCreate
ciTemplateCreate.syntax:
ciTemplateCreate( 
u_cache
t_templateDefinitionName
[ ?name t_name ]
[ ?members l_members ]
[ ?params l_params ]
[ ?userParams t_userParams ]
)
=> templateId / nil

ciTemplateCreateDefinition.name: ciTemplateCreateDefinition
ciTemplateCreateDefinition.syntax:
ciTemplateCreateDefinition(
t_typeName
s_checkSymbolName
s_createSymbolName
[ ?params l_params ]
[ ?acceptsUserParams s_acceptsUserParams ]
[ ?transferSymbolName s_transferSymbolName ]
[ ?preDestroySymbolName s_preDestroySymbolName ]
)
=> t / nil

ciTemplateCreateExpanded.name: ciTemplateCreateExpanded
ciTemplateCreateExpanded.syntax:
ciTemplateCreateExpanded( 
u_cache
t_templateDefinitionName
[ ?name t_name ]
[ ?members l_members ]
[ ?params g_params ]
[ ?userParams g_userParams ]
[ ?compress g_compress ]
)
=> templateId / nil
ciTemplateCreateExpanded.desc:
The same functionality as ciTemplateCreate, but first expands any iterated or repeated members. For example, MN1<0:2> gets expanded to MN1<0>, MN1<1>, and MN1<2>. 

In the case of net repetitions, such as <*3>inp, by default these get expanded N times as inp, inp, inp. However, if the optional compress argument is set to t, then <*3>inp will be expanded to just inp. The same applies to net bundles that contain repetitions. For example <*3>inp,a,b,c,inp,inp will by default be expanded to inp,inp,inp,a,b,c,inp,inp but with compress set to t will be expanded to inp,a,b,c.

ciTemplateDefinitionExists.name: ciTemplateDefinitionExists
ciTemplateDefinitionExists.desc: Verifies whether a template definition with a given name exists.

ciTemplateDeleteCons.name: ciTemplateDeleteCons
ciTemplateDeleteCons.syntax:
ciTemplateDeleteCons( 
u_templateId
l_listOfConstraints
[ s_doDelete t | nil ]
)
=> t / nil
ciTemplateDeleteCons.desc: This function deletes or removes one or more CI constraints from a CI constraint template.

ciTemplateGetCache.name: ciTemplateGetCache
ciTemplateGetCache.desc: Returns the constraint cache that contains the template.

ciTemplateGetComment.name: ciTemplateGetComment
ciTemplateGetComment.desc: Returns the comment that shows the template status.

ciTemplateGetCreatedTime.name: ciTemplateGetCreatedTime
ciTemplateGetCreatedTime.desc: This function returns the creation time of a template, which is the time and date close to a second when the template has been created.

ciTemplateGetNote.name: ciTemplateGetNote
ciTemplateGetNote.desc: Returns the note parameter of a template.

ciTemplateGetType.name: ciTemplateGetType
ciTemplateGetType.desc: Returns the symbolic name of the given template type, such as commonCentroid.

ciTemplateListParamNames.name: ciTemplateListParamNames
ciTemplateListParamNames.desc: Returns a list of template parameter names if the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

ciTemplateListParams.name: ciTemplateListParams
ciTemplateListParams.desc: Returns a list of template parameter name, type, and value, provided the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

ciTemplatep.name: ciTemplatep
ciTemplatep.desc: Checks if an object is a valid constraint template ID.

ciTemplateResetAllParams.name: ciTemplateResetAllParams
ciTemplateResetAllParams.desc: Resets all template parameters to their default values.

ciTemplateResetParams.name: ciTemplateResetParams
ciTemplateResetParams.desc: Resets one or more template parameters to their default value.

ciTemplateSetNote.name: ciTemplateSetNote
ciTemplateSetNote.desc: Sets the note parameter of a template.

ciTemplateSetStatus.name: ciTemplateSetStatus
ciTemplateSetStatus.syntax:
ciTemplateSetStatus( 
u_templateId
s_statusSymbol
t_statusComment
)
=> t / nil

ciTemplateSortParamDefs.name: ciTemplateSortParamDefs
ciTemplateSortParamDefs.desc: Sorts parameter definitions of a template type, by name and returns a list of parameter definitions sorted in alphabetical order.

ciTemplateUpdateParams.name: ciTemplateUpdateParams
ciTemplateUpdateParams.desc: This function updates the parameter values of the listed parameters for templates that have one or more parameter definitions.

ciToFloat.name: ciToFloat
ciToFloat.desc: Returns a floating point number for the passed value. If the value is a string, then it will be evaluated and the result returned.

ciTransferConstraintsInProgress.name: ciTransferConstraintsInProgress
ciTransferConstraintsInProgress.desc: Returns a Boolean to indicate whether constraint transfer is in progress.

ciTypeBindingParameter.name: ciTypeBindingParameter
ciTypeBindingParameter.desc: Returns the name of the registered binding parameter for a constraint type or an empty string if none is registered.

ciTypeDefBaseType.name: ciTypeDefBaseType
ciTypeDefBaseType.desc: Returns the base type of the passed custom constraint type. You can define multiple versions of a custom constraint type in config.xml by assigning a unique constraint type name to different constraint types that all share the same base type name. This allows multiple versions of the same base constraint type to exist at the same time. To return the version number of a constraint type, see ciTypeDefVersion.

ciTypeDefVersion.name: ciTypeDefVersion
ciTypeDefVersion.desc: Returns the version number of the passed constraint type. The default version number is 1. Custom constraint types defined through config.xml can specify the version number of the constraint through a version tag.

ciTypeHasBindingParameter.name: ciTypeHasBindingParameter
ciTypeHasBindingParameter.desc: Checks if a binding parameter has been registered for the specified constraint type.

ciTypeIsType.name: ciTypeIsType
ciTypeIsType.desc: Checks if the specified typeName is a constraint type name, which may be a built-in type, such as distance, or a user-defined custom constraint type that has been specified in a config.xml file.

ciTypeIsUserDefined.name: ciTypeIsUserDefined
ciTypeIsUserDefined.desc: Checks if the specified typeName is a user-defined custom constraint type that is specified in a config.xml file.

ciTypeListCon.name: ciTypeListCon
ciTypeListCon.syntax:
ciTypeListCon( 
u_cache
t_constraintType
[ g_includeOutOfContext ]
)
=> l_designObject / nil
ciTypeListCon.desc: Lists all the constraints of a given type for a given cache.

ciUniqueMembers.name: ciUniqueMembers
ciUniqueMembers.desc: This utility function returns the unique members from the specified member list. It is typically used for member lists that can contain repeated member names due to mFactor expansion.

ciUnregisterAssistant.name: ciUnregisterAssistant
ciUnregisterAssistant.desc: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) that was previously registered using ciRegisterAssistant.

ciUnregisterConstraintEditor.name: ciUnregisterConstraintEditor
ciUnregisterConstraintEditor.desc: Unregisters a previously registered constraint editor. If the constraint editor appears in the Constraint Manager's Constraint Editors menu, then running this function removes it from the menu list.

ciUnregisterNetSuperType.name: ciUnregisterNetSuperType
ciUnregisterNetSuperType.desc: Removes a net super-type, leaving its sub-types intact.

ciUnRegisterTerm.name: ciUnRegisterTerm
ciUnRegisterTerm.syntax:
ciUnregisterTerm( 
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_termName
)
=> t / nil
ciUnRegisterTerm.desc: Unregisters the terminal of a l/c/v if that terminal has already been registered with a default net.

ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes.name: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes
ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes.syntax:
ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes( 
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ g_hierarchical ]
)
=> t / nil
ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes.desc: Updates the existing notes on the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

ciUprevEAConstrs.name: ciUprevEAConstrs
ciUprevEAConstrs.desc: Modifies and corrects those constraints in the 610EA (early adopter) release which became obsolete in the full 610 release. Specifically, this command will update any layout structure constraints to be modgen, cluster, or cluster boundary constraints.

ciUtilsAddNTimes.name: ciUtilsAddNTimes
ciUtilsAddNTimes.syntax:
ciUtilsAddNTimes(
g_val
x_n
t_valFmt
g_addQuotes
t_sep
)
=> x_str
ciUtilsAddNTimes.desc: This utility function is used in modgen constraint generation for creating a string with repeated values.

ciUtilsAddQuotes.name: ciUtilsAddQuotes
ciUtilsAddQuotes.desc: This function is used in constraint generation for converting a list of strings into a string where each string in the list will have double quotes when added to the string.

ciUtilsBuildString.name: ciUtilsBuildString
ciUtilsBuildString.desc: This is a utility function for building a string from a list of values. The values are converted to strings by applying the passed string format and separated by the passed separator.

ciUtilsMakeUnique.name: ciUtilsMakeUnique
ciUtilsMakeUnique.desc: This function takes a list of items, which can contain duplicate items and returns a list without any duplicate items.

ciUtilsRemoveNils.name: ciUtilsRemoveNils
ciUtilsRemoveNils.desc: Removes the nil elements from a list.

ciUtilsRepeatNTimes.name: ciUtilsRepeatNTimes
ciUtilsRepeatNTimes.desc: This is a utility function for creating a list containing a single value repeated the specified number of times.

ciUtilsReplaceNils.name: ciUtilsReplaceNils
ciUtilsReplaceNils.desc: This is a utility function for replacing any nil elements in a list with the specified value. See also, ciUtilsRemoveNils and ciUtilsMakeUnique.

ciWithinConstraint.name: ciWithinConstraint
ciWithinConstraint.desc: Returns the constraints that contain the specified objects as members of the given constraint type.

ciActiveSameCellAndSizeIterator.name: ciActiveSameCellAndSizeIterator
ciActiveSameCellAndSizeIterator.desc: Returns a list of devices where each sub-list corresponds to two or more active devices that have the same cell and size in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the device is ignored.

ciAlignPinsOnCellSide.name: ciAlignPinsOnCellSide
ciAlignPinsOnCellSide.syntax:
ciAlignPinsOnCellSide( 
u_cache
l_memberList
[ ?side t_side ]
)
=> t / nil
ciAlignPinsOnCellSide.desc: Generates alignment constraints for pins on the same side.

ciAPRCascodeIterator.name: ciAPRCascodeIterator
ciAPRCascodeIterator.desc: Iterator for advanced place and route cascoded structures.

ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator.name: ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator
ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator.syntax:
ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator( 
d_cellview
t_finderExpr
[ ?trigger g_trigger ]
[ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ]
)
=> list / nil
ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator.desc: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects with common source or drain terminal names that are assigned to L and R local variables. This iterator is customized for the Auto-Device Placement and Routing flow and is used by the Circuit Prospector ADA finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs with common source or drain terminal names, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

ciBasicGetParamValue.name: ciBasicGetParamValue
ciBasicGetParamValue.desc: This API is similar to ciGetParamValue, except it does not evaluate iPar or pPar expressions. It gets the parameter value of the user defined parameter. The user-defined parameter was mapped to its PDK names by the ciMapParam function.

ciBlockResistorArrayIterator.name: ciBlockResistorArrayIterator
ciBlockResistorArrayIterator.desc: Iterates over all resistor devices in the cellview based on the result of evaluating the passed or matched expression. This function is used by the Block Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

ciBuildModgenParams.name: ciBuildModgenParams
ciBuildModgenParams.syntax:
ciBuildModgenParams( 
g_cache
l_devInfo
l_pattern
r_nil
l_args
)
=> l_modgenParamsAndMembers
ciBuildModgenParams.desc: Creates modgen parameter and member list. This is a utility function.

ciBundleSignalsIterator.name: ciBundleSignalsIterator
ciBundleSignalsIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to iterate over all named bundle and bus nets. It returns the list of corresponding signals. The signals are grouped according to the result of the match expression. If the match expression evaluates to nil the signal list is ignored.

ciCanCGBeUsed.name: ciCanCGBeUsed
ciCanCGBeUsed.syntax:
ciCanCGBeUsed(
g_ciCon 
t_CGDefName
g_CG
) 
=> t / nil
ciCanCGBeUsed.desc: The default callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified for determining if a constraint group should be used or not.

ciCascodeSeriesCurrentMirrorIterator.name: ciCascodeSeriesCurrentMirrorIterator
ciCascodeSeriesCurrentMirrorIterator.desc: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match cascode series current mirror structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

ciCategoryListFinderNames.name: ciCategoryListFinderNames
ciCategoryListFinderNames.desc: Lists all the finder names for a given category in Circuit Prospector.

ciClusterBoundaryForCluster.name: ciClusterBoundaryForCluster
ciClusterBoundaryForCluster.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Cluster Boundary constraint to an existing Cluster constraint. The flexibleFlag parameter of the Cluster Boundary is set to 1 (true).

ciCommonGateAndSourceIterator.name: ciCommonGateAndSourceIterator
ciCommonGateAndSourceIterator.desc: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common gate and source structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

ciCommonGateIterator.name: ciCommonGateIterator
ciCommonGateIterator.desc: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common gate structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

ciCommonSourceIterator.name: ciCommonSourceIterator
ciCommonSourceIterator.desc: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common source structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

ciCPRegistrationFromLAM.name: ciCPRegistrationFromLAM
ciCPRegistrationFromLAM.desc: Used in conjunction with ciGetLAMComponentTypes to create a string containing ci registration function calls to register the device, terminal, and parameter mappings specified in a cph.lam file associated with a particular PDK. The device and terminal registrations are needed for the Circuit Prospector finders, iterators, and generators to function with the selected PDK. The returned string can either be evaluated using evalstring() to call the ci registration functions, or the string can be printed out using printf so that the ci registration calls can be placed in a file loaded by the libInit.il file of the PDK.

ciCreateRoutePriorityCon.name: ciCreateRoutePriorityCon
ciCreateRoutePriorityCon.syntax:
ciCreateRoutePriorityCon( 
u_cache
l_instsNetsPins
v_value
)
=> ciCon / nil
ciCreateRoutePriorityCon.desc: Used by Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate routing priority constraints.

ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredParams.name: ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredParams
ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredParams.desc: Returns the parameters registered for the specified device type.

ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredTerminals.name: ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredTerminals
ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredTerminals.desc: Returns the terminals registered for the specified device type.

ciDeviceInfoRegisterParams.name: ciDeviceInfoRegisterParams
ciDeviceInfoRegisterParams.desc: Registers or unregisters parameters for a device type, such as bjt, mos, and so on.

ciDeviceInfoRegisterTerminals.name: ciDeviceInfoRegisterTerminals
ciDeviceInfoRegisterTerminals.desc: Registers or unregisters terminals for a device type, such as bjt, mos, and so on.

ciDeviceInfoRegistry.name: ciDeviceInfoRegistry
ciDeviceInfoRegistry.desc: Returns the registry where information about all the device types is stored. This registry is used by ciCollectDeviceInfo.

ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultParamNames.name: ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultParamNames
ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultParamNames.desc: Restores device parameters to default parameters.

ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultTerminalNames.name: ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultTerminalNames
ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultTerminalNames.desc: Restores device terminals to default terminals.

ciDeviceInfoTerminalsAreValid.name: ciDeviceInfoTerminalsAreValid
ciDeviceInfoTerminalsAreValid.desc: Checks whether the specified device terminals are valid inputs for ciCollectDeviceInfo.

ciEnableAssistant.name: ciEnableAssistant
ciEnableAssistant.desc: Enables or disables a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) so that it is visible/not visible in the list of Circuit Prospector categories.

ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs.name: ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs
ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs.syntax:
ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs( 
u_cache
t_defaultCGen
l_instNetsPinsTerms
[ ?triggerCBinMode t_triggerCBinMode ]
[ ?argValuesToUpdate l_argValuesToUpdate ]
)
=> l_argumentValues
ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs.desc: Evaluates the specified constraint generator argument values.

ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo.name: ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo
ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo.desc: Expands any iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo.

ciFindObjectInHier.name: ciFindObjectInHier
ciFindObjectInHier.syntax:
ciFindObjectInHier( 
d_cache
t_objectFullPathName
s_objectType
)
=> dbId / nil
ciFindObjectInHier.desc: Finds the database ID of the specified hierarchical object. This function is used by Circuit Prospector constraint generators.

ciGenerateConstraintGroup.name: ciGenerateConstraintGroup
ciGenerateConstraintGroup.syntax:
ciGenerateConstraintGroup(
g_ciCon
t_CGDefName
t_CGName
) 
=> t / nil
ciGenerateConstraintGroup.desc: The default constraint group generation callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified.

ciGeneratorCheckInstsNetsPinsInstTerms.name: ciGeneratorCheckInstsNetsPinsInstTerms
ciGeneratorCheckInstsNetsPinsInstTerms.desc: Checks whether the constraint generator has been called with the expected number of instances, nets, pins, and instTerms. This function is used within the constraint generators. If a wrong number of instances, nets, pins, or instTerms have been provided then a warning message will be displayed in the CIW.

ciGeneratorForInstSymmetry.name: ciGeneratorForInstSymmetry
ciGeneratorForInstSymmetry.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate instance symmetry constraints.

ciGeneratorForNetSymmetry.name: ciGeneratorForNetSymmetry
ciGeneratorForNetSymmetry.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate net symmetry constraints.

ciGetAction.name: ciGetAction
ciGetAction.desc: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated with the specified action name. This function is an alias for the ciGetGenerator function. The purpose of this alias is to emphasize the fact that constraint generator SKILL expressions can do everything possible in SKILL and not just create constraints.

ciGetConstraintGroupsEnum.name: ciGetConstraintGroupsEnum
ciGetConstraintGroupsEnum.desc: Returns a string to be used as an enum variable for selecting the default constraint group to be used by the Pin to Trunk router. The result can be used as the value of an argument for a constraint generator. The resulting enum variable is the same as the one used by the Pin to Trunk GUI of the Modgen Pattern Editor. Consistent with the Modgen Pattern Editor, it sets the default to virtuosoDefaultSetup if that choice is available.

ciGetCPSelectedResults.name: ciGetCPSelectedResults
ciGetCPSelectedResults.desc: Returns a list of finder results selected in Circuit Prospector. Each item in the list is a finder result which contains the list of devices and the finder name.

ciGetDeviceBulkTermName.name: ciGetDeviceBulkTermName
ciGetDeviceBulkTermName.desc: Returns the name of the bulk terminal for the passed device.

ciGetDeviceInfo.name: ciGetDeviceInfo
ciGetDeviceInfo.desc: Returns the disembodied property list (DPL) associated with a particular device type.

ciGetDeviceNames.name: ciGetDeviceNames
ciGetDeviceNames.desc: Returns all devices registered to the user-defined device name.

ciGetDeviceTermName.name: ciGetDeviceTermName
ciGetDeviceTermName.desc: Returns the terminal name of a device based on the device database ID and the user-defined parameter termName.

ciGetFinder.name: ciGetFinder
ciGetFinder.desc: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated with the specified finder. This DPL is the same that was used to register the finder using ciRegisterFinder.

ciGetFirstDeviceTermName.name: ciGetFirstDeviceTermName
ciGetFirstDeviceTermName.desc: Returns the first terminal name on the specified device that matches one of the terminal names specified in the termNames list.

ciGetFluidGuardRingDeviceEnum.name: ciGetFluidGuardRingDeviceEnum
ciGetFluidGuardRingDeviceEnum.desc:
Returns a space delimited string of the fluid guard ring devices in the technology file. This string can be used to define an enum for constraint generators that require fluid guard ring device selection.

Also, see ciSetStructArgs and ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

ciGetGenerator.name: ciGetGenerator
ciGetGenerator.desc: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified constraint generator. This DPL is the same that was used to register the constraint generator using ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

ciGetIterator.name: ciGetIterator
ciGetIterator.desc: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified iterator. This DPL is the same that was used to register the iterator using ciRegisterIterator.

ciGetLAMComponentTypes.name: ciGetLAMComponentTypes
ciGetLAMComponentTypes.desc: Returns a list of the device, terminal, and parameter mappings specified in a cph.lam file associated with a particular PDK. This SKILL function can be used in conjunction with the ciCPRegistrationFromLAM SKILL function to create the device, terminal, and parameter registrations needed for the Circuit Prospector finders, iterators, and generators to function with the selected PDK.

ciGetMappedDeviceNames.name: ciGetMappedDeviceNames
ciGetMappedDeviceNames.desc: Returns all default device names (fet, nfet, pfet, and BJT) that have been registered using ciRegisterDevice.

ciGetNetNames.name: ciGetNetNames
ciGetNetNames.desc: Retrieves the net names, regular expressions and predicates that make up a net type.

ciGetNetSubTypes.name: ciGetNetSubTypes
ciGetNetSubTypes.desc: Retrieves the sub-types contained in a net super-type.

ciGetNetSuperTypes.name: ciGetNetSuperTypes
ciGetNetSuperTypes.desc: Returns the list of registered net super-types.

ciGetParamMapping.name: ciGetParamMapping
ciGetParamMapping.desc: Returns all the parameters mapped for a given parameter name.

ciGetParamName.name: ciGetParamName
ciGetParamName.desc: Returns the parameter name of the user-defined parameter that is mapped to the given parameter placeholder name.

ciGetParamValue.name: ciGetParamValue
ciGetParamValue.syntax:
ciGetParamValue( 
d_deviceId
t_parameterPlaceholderName
[ ?path t_path ]
[ ?convertNumberStrings g_convertNumberStrings ]
)
=> paramValue / nil
ciGetParamValue.desc: Returns the parameter value for the user-defined parameter that is mapped to the given parameter placeholder name.

ciGetParamValueOrDefault.name: ciGetParamValueOrDefault
ciGetParamValueOrDefault.syntax:
ciGetParamValueOrDefault( 
d_obj
t_paramName
g_defValue
[ ?warnUnmapped g_warnUnmapped ]
[ ?warnUnfound g_warnUnfound ]
[ ?aelEnv g_aelEnv ]
)
=> d_paramVal
ciGetParamValueOrDefault.desc: Retrieves the value of the named parameter on the passed database object. The parameter name should have been registered ciMapParam. If the parameter is not found then the default value will be returned.

ciGetParamValues.name: ciGetParamValues
ciGetParamValues.syntax:
ciGetParamValues( 
d_deviceId
l_parameterNames
[ ?path t_path ]
[ ?asDPL g_asDPL ]
)
=> l_paramValues / nil
ciGetParamValues.desc: Returns the values of the specified parameters for the specified device. By default, the values are returned as a disembodied property list (DPL), but can also be returned as a simple list.

ciGetStructure.name: ciGetStructure
ciGetStructure.desc: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified structure. This DPL is the same that was used to register the structure using ciRegisterStructure.

ciGetTechFile.name: ciGetTechFile
ciGetTechFile.desc: Retrieves the technology file for the current window.

ciGetTechMPPNames.name: ciGetTechMPPNames
ciGetTechMPPNames.desc: Returns a list of the MPP names for the current technology file. The MPP names are used in the creation of guard rings.

ciGetTermNames.name: ciGetTermNames
ciGetTermNames.desc: Returns all the terminal names mapped to the user-defined parameter, termName.

ciGuardRingForCluster.name: ciGuardRingForCluster
ciGuardRingForCluster.syntax:
ciGuardRingForCluster( 
u_cache
l_instances
[ ?mppName t_mppName ]
)
=> l_guardRing / nil
ciGuardRingForCluster.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Guard Ring constraint to an existing Cluster constraint.

ciGuardRingForModgen.name: ciGuardRingForModgen
ciGuardRingForModgen.syntax:
ciGuardRingForModgen( 
u_cache
l_instances
[ ?mppName t_mppName ]
)
=> l_guardRing / nil
ciGuardRingForModgen.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Guard Ring constraint to an existing Modgen constraint.

ciHaveSameParamValues.name: ciHaveSameParamValues
ciHaveSameParamValues.syntax:
ciHaveSameParamValues( 
l_devices
l_paramNames
[ ?path t_path ]
)
=> t / nil
ciHaveSameParamValues.desc: Returns t if the specified parameters have the same values on all the passed devices. The parameter names should be the PDK independent parameter names specified using the ciMapParam SKILL command.

ciHierarchicalSeriesIterator.name: ciHierarchicalSeriesIterator
ciHierarchicalSeriesIterator.desc: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the series structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

ciIgnoreDevice.name: ciIgnoreDevice
ciIgnoreDevice.desc: This is a utility function that can be used in finder or constraint generator expressions. It returns t if the passed device should be ignored.

ciInstGetSplitFingers.name: ciInstGetSplitFingers
ciInstGetSplitFingers.desc: Returns a Boolean value to identify whether the specified instance has been set to use Split Fingers. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

ciInstIterator.name: ciInstIterator
ciInstIterator.syntax:
ciInstIterator( 
d_cellview
t_matchExpr
[ l_hierCellViews ]
)
=> list / nil
ciInstIterator.desc: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all design instances, collating them into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed (match) expression.

ciInstListSplitFingers.name: ciInstListSplitFingers
ciInstListSplitFingers.desc: Returns the names of the instances that use Split Fingers. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

ciInstSetSplitFingers.name: ciInstSetSplitFingers
ciInstSetSplitFingers.syntax:
ciInstSetSplitFingers( 
u_cache
t_instancePath
g_split
)
=> t / nil
ciInstSetSplitFingers.desc: Specifies whether an instance uses Split Fingers, that is, a separate instance per finger in layout. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

ciInstsNetsPinsFromSelSet.name: ciInstsNetsPinsFromSelSet
ciInstsNetsPinsFromSelSet.desc: Returns a list of instances, nets, pins, or instTerms (InstsNetsPins) for the current selection.

ciInstTermIterator.name: ciInstTermIterator
ciInstTermIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all design instance terminals in the passed cellview. Instance terminals (instTerms) are grouped together based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderInstTermExpr).

ciIsDevice.name: ciIsDevice
ciIsDevice.desc: Checks whether a device belongs to a particular device type.

ciIsNet.name: ciIsNet
ciIsNet.syntax:
ciIsNet( 
d_netId
t_netType
[ ?regexIgnoreBundles g_regexIgnoreBundles ]
)
=> t / nil
ciIsNet.desc: Checks whether a particular netId belongs to a particular netType.

ciListAllCategoryNames.name: ciListAllCategoryNames
ciListAllCategoryNames.desc: Lists all the categories in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterAssistant. By default, it only lists the enabled assistants.

ciListAllFinderNames.name: ciListAllFinderNames
ciListAllFinderNames.desc: Lists all the finders in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterFinder.

ciListAllGeneratorNames.name: ciListAllGeneratorNames
ciListAllGeneratorNames.desc: Lists all the constraint generators in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

ciListAllIteratorNames.name: ciListAllIteratorNames
ciListAllIteratorNames.desc: Lists all the iterators in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterIterator.

ciListAllStructureNames.name: ciListAllStructureNames
ciListAllStructureNames.desc: Lists all the structures in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterStructure.

ciListGeneratableConstraintGroups.name: ciListGeneratableConstraintGroups
ciListGeneratableConstraintGroups.desc: The default generatable constraint group listing callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified.

ciMakeHierContext.name: ciMakeHierContext
ciMakeHierContext.desc: Used by Circuit Prospector iterators that are required to run on flattened hierarchies. The iterators need to define a local variable, hierContext, to be referenced by finders that use that iterator. This function is used to initialize that local variable.

ciMakeObjectInfo.name: ciMakeObjectInfo
ciMakeObjectInfo.desc: A utility function for constructing a disembodied property list to be used by Circuit Prospector iterators to return hierarchical path information about the found objects.

ciMapParam.name: ciMapParam
ciMapParam.desc: Maps a parameter placeholder name to the parameter names used in the PDK.

ciMapTerm.name: ciMapTerm
ciMapTerm.desc: Maps the user-defined termName to the terminal names used in the PDK.

ciMatchedFingerWidth.name: ciMatchedFingerWidth
ciMatchedFingerWidth.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Matched Parameters constraint to the selected instance members.

ciMatchedParametersForCurrent_Mirror.name: ciMatchedParametersForCurrent_Mirror
ciMatchedParametersForCurrent_Mirror.desc: Used the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected instance members.

ciMatchedParamsForInstanceSymmetry.name: ciMatchedParamsForInstanceSymmetry
ciMatchedParamsForInstanceSymmetry.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected pair of instance members.

ciMatchedParamsForSameSizeInstances.name: ciMatchedParamsForSameSizeInstances
ciMatchedParamsForSameSizeInstances.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected instance members.

ciMergeParams.name: ciMergeParams
ciMergeParams.desc: Merges two lists of constraint parameters into a single list. By default, if the parameter being merged already exists in the list of parameters, the parameter value will be overwritten with the new value. The optional overwrite parameter can be set to nil to prevent parameter value overwrites.

ciModgenForSameCellSizeAndBulk.name: ciModgenForSameCellSizeAndBulk
ciModgenForSameCellSizeAndBulk.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to create Modgen constraints on groups of devices that have the same size and bulk connection.

ciMOSActiveLoadStructIterator.name: ciMOSActiveLoadStructIterator
ciMOSActiveLoadStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS active load structures.

ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator.name: ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator
ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS cascoded current mirror structures.

ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator.name: ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator2
ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS cascoded current mirror structures, with at least one of the leading pairs being diode connected.

ciMOSCommonGateStructIterator.name: ciMOSCommonGateStructIterator
ciMOSCommonGateStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS common gate structures in a design.

ciMOSCrossCoupledDifferentialPairStructI.name: ciMOSCrossCoupledDifferentialPairStructIterator
ciMOSCrossCoupledDifferentialPairStructI.desc: Iterator for a MOS cross-coupled differential pair structure in a design. A MOS cross-coupled differential pair is a pair of MOS transistors that have the GATE of one transistor connected to the DRAIN of the other. The SOURCE of both transistors are connected to each other. By default, the SOURCE of the transistors cannot be connected to a POWER SUPPLY. This behavior can be changed by setting the environment variable crossCoupleDiffPairRequireSourceNotSupply to nil. To revert to the default behavior, set the environment variable back to t.

ciMOSCrossCoupledQuadStructIterator.name: ciMOSCrossCoupledQuadStructIterator
ciMOSCrossCoupledQuadStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS cross coupled quad structures in a design.

ciMOSCurrentMirrorStructIterator.name: ciMOSCurrentMirrorStructIterator
ciMOSCurrentMirrorStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS current mirror structures.

ciMOSDifferentialPairStructIterator.name: ciMOSDifferentialPairStructIterator
ciMOSDifferentialPairStructIterator.desc: Iterator for MOS differential pair structures in a design.

ciMOSInverterStructIterator.name: ciMOSInverterStructIterator
ciMOSInverterStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS inverter structures in a design.

ciMOSParallelStructIterator.name: ciMOSParallelStructIterator
ciMOSParallelStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS parallel structures.

ciMOSTransmissionGateStructIterator.name: ciMOSTransmissionGateStructIterator
ciMOSTransmissionGateStructIterator.desc: Iterator for all MOS transmission gate structures.

ciNetIterator.name: ciNetIterator
ciNetIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to iterate over all design nets, collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderNetExpr). All nets which have the same finderNetExpr result are grouped together. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, then the net is ignored.

ciNetNames.name: ciNetNames
ciNetNames.desc: Returns the list of net names registered for t_netType.

ciNetOnTerm.name: ciNetOnTerm
ciNetOnTerm.desc: Utility function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to retrieve the design instance connected to a named instance terminal.

ciNetPredicates.name: ciNetPredicates
ciNetPredicates.desc: Returns the net predicates registered for t_netType.

ciNetRegexs.name: ciNetRegexs
ciNetRegexs.desc: Returns the list of regular expressions registered for t_netType.

ciNextConName.name: ciNextConName
ciNextConName.desc: Returns the next unique constraint name based on the given constraint name prefix. This function assumes that the constraints have names of the format <prefix><number>.

ciNextObjName.name: ciNextObjName
ciNextObjName.desc: Returns the next unique object name based on the given base object name prefix and a list of existing object names. This function assumes the objects have names of the format <baseName><number>.

ciNextTemplateName.name: ciNextTemplateName
ciNextTemplateName.desc: Returns the next unique template name based on the given template name prefix. This function assumes the templates have names of the format <prefix><number>.

ciNumTermsEQ2.name: ciNumTermsEQ2
ciNumTermsEQ2.desc: Utility function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to check if the passed design net Id is connected to two terminals.

ciOrientationForModgen.name: ciOrientationForModgen
ciOrientationForModgen.syntax:
ciOrientationForModgen( 
u_cache
l_instances
[ ?restrictTo t_orientation ]
)
=> l_orientation / nil
ciOrientationForModgen.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set an Orientation constraint to an existing Modgen constraint.

ciParallelNetResistorArrayIterator.name: ciParallelNetResistorArrayIterator
ciParallelNetResistorArrayIterator.desc: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of parallelly-arranged resistors that start and end on the same net. This function is used by the Parallel Net Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

ciParallelResistorArrayIterator.name: ciParallelResistorArrayIterator
ciParallelResistorArrayIterator.desc: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of parallelly-arranged resistors that are all of the same length when their m-factor and iteration are expanded. This function is used by the Parallel Resistor Array (Length) finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

ciPinIterator.name: ciPinIterator
ciPinIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to iterate over all design pins, collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed finder expression (finderPinExpr). All pins which have the same finderPinExpr result are grouped together. If the finderPinExpr evaluates to nil, then the pin is ignored.

ciPlacerControlledWellGeneration.name: ciPlacerControlledWellGeneration
ciPlacerControlledWellGeneration.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a placerControlledWell property for each given instance that is registered as a pfet.

ciPrintMappedDefaultNetNames.name: ciPrintMappedDefaultNetNames
ciPrintMappedDefaultNetNames.desc: Returns the default net name registered with a particular terminal. Also returns details of the corresponding lib/cell/view.

ciPrintMappedDeviceNames.name: ciPrintMappedDeviceNames
ciPrintMappedDeviceNames.desc: Prints all default device names (for fets, BJTs, and so on) that have been registered using ciRegisterDevice.

ciPrintMappedNetNames.name: ciPrintMappedNetNames
ciPrintMappedNetNames.desc: Prints all net categories registered using ciRegisterNet.

ciPrintMappedParams.name: ciPrintMappedParams
ciPrintMappedParams.desc: Prints all the parameters mapped by ciMapParam.

ciPrintMappedTerminals.name: ciPrintMappedTerminals
ciPrintMappedTerminals.desc: Prints all the parameters mapped by ciMapTerm.

ciRegisterAction.name: ciRegisterAction
ciRegisterAction.desc: Registers a list of attributes associated with an action and optionally adds the action to the constraints-related context menu, the Constraint Manager assistant's Constraint Menu, or both. This function is an alias for the ciRegisterConstraintGenerator function. The purpose of this alias is to emphasize the fact that constraint generator SKILL expressions can do everything possible in SKILL and not just create constraints.

ciRegisterAssistant.name: ciRegisterAssistant
ciRegisterAssistant.desc: Registers a new assistant (category) with the Circuit Prospector assistant. Assistants (categories) are groups of related Circuit Prospector finders. A category may represent a set of finders for a particular device type, for example fet, or a category could represent a top down/bottom up constraints flow. Categories can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/categories directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The category registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example: .cadence/dfII/ci/categories/myCategory.il.

ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.name: ciRegisterConstraintGenerator
ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.syntax:
ciRegisterConstraintGenerator( list(nil
'name              t_name
'description       t_description
'expression        t_expression
[ 'addToToolbar    g_addToToolbar ]
[ 'args            l_args ]
[ 'callback        t_callbackExpr ]
[ 'iconName        t_iconName ]
[ 'menu            g_menu ]
[ 'precondition    t_preconditionExpr ]
[ 'settings        l_settings ]
[ 'size            l_size ]
[ 'title           t_title ]
[ 'useCGenForEdit  g_useCGenForEdit ]
)
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.desc: Registers a constraint generator with the Constraint Manager and, optionally, will make it available as an entry in the Constraint Creation toolbar drop-down list of the Constraint Manager and in the Generate Constraints list in the context-menu. The constraint generator can then be set as the default generator for a Circuit Prospector finder or used explicitly in the Constraint Manager to create constraints.

args.name:
list(nil
'name              t_name
'description       t_description
'expression        t_expression
[ 'addToToolbar    g_addToToolbar ]
[ 'args            l_args ]
[ 'callback        t_callbackExpr ]
[ 'iconName        t_iconName ]
[ 'menu            g_menu ]
[ 'precondition    t_preconditionExpr ]
[ 'settings        l_settings ]
[ 'size            l_size ]
[ 'title           t_title ]
[ 'useCGenForEdit  g_useCGenForEdit ]

ciRegisterDefaultNetName.name: ciRegisterDefaultNetName
ciRegisterDefaultNetName.syntax:
ciRegisterDefaultNetName( 
t_deviceCategory
l_lcvNames
t_terminalCategory
t_termName
t_defaultNetName
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterDefaultNetName.desc: Registers a default net name for the given terminal for either: the cellview of the same category or all lib/cell/view specified.

ciRegisterDevice.name: ciRegisterDevice
ciRegisterDevice.desc: Function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to register a list of fet, nfet, pfet, BJT and passive device names to be used by ciIsDevice.

ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory.name: ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory
ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory.syntax:
ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory( 
t_libName
t_categoryName
t_deviceTypeName
)
=> l_regdDevices / nil
ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory.desc: Calls the ciRegisterDevice function to register all cells of the t_categoryName PDK category in the t_libName library as a device of type, t_deviceTypeName. In addition, the ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory function returns the list of devices registered because of the current action. This list does not includes the devices that were registered with the given device type name previously.

ciRegisterDynamicParamDef.name: ciRegisterDynamicParamDef
ciRegisterDynamicParamDef.syntax:
ciRegisterDynamicParamDef( 
s_consTypeName
t_paramTypeName
l_paramDef
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterDynamicParamDef.desc:
Registers dynamic parameter definition for a constraint type.

Only a native constraint type can have a set of dynamic parameters in addition to the predefined (static) parameters defined in Virtuoso. Unlike a normal constraint parameter, a user specifies and registers a dynamic parameter definition at run time in SKILL. Dynamic parameter definitions for custom constraint types can be added by creating different definitions of the constraint using config.xml. These definitions can be dynamically loaded using the ciLoadConfigXML or ciLoadConfigXMLFromString function. However, ensure that you must not change the definition while a design is open using a different definition.

ciRegisterFinder.name: ciRegisterFinder
ciRegisterFinder.syntax:
ciRegisterFinder( 
t_name
t_description
t_iterator
t_expression
t_defaultCGen
[ g_partialGroupingOk ]
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterFinder.desc: Registers a new finder with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Finder form). Finders are used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over a design and collect together groups of instances, nets, and pins that share common characteristics. The finder expression will determine how these objects are grouped together. Finders can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/finders directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The finder registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example .cadence/dfII/ci/finders/netTermCountFinder.il.

ciRegisterIterator.name: ciRegisterIterator
ciRegisterIterator.syntax:
ciRegisterIterator( 
t_name
t_description
t_iteratorFnName
t_expression
t_defaultCGen
g_supportsFlattenedHier
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterIterator.desc: Registers a new iterator with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Iterator form). Iterators are used by the Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over the design in a specific way, applying a finder expression which determines how objects are grouped.

ciRegisterNet.name: ciRegisterNet
ciRegisterNet.syntax:
ciRegisterNet( 
t_netType
l_netNameList
[ ?regexNetNames l_regExpressionList ]
[ ?predicate g_predicate ]
)
=> t / nil
ciRegisterNet.desc: Registers the net names, regular expressions and predicates that make up a net type. A net belongs to t_netType if its name is one of l_netNameList, or if it matches one of l_regExpressionList, or if g_predicate returns t.

ciRegisterNetNames.name: ciRegisterNetNames
ciRegisterNetNames.desc: Registers a list of net names recognized by ciIsNet().

ciRegisterNetPredicate.name: ciRegisterNetPredicate
ciRegisterNetPredicate.desc: Registers a net predicate function used by ciIsNet().

ciRegisterNetRegexs.name: ciRegisterNetRegexs
ciRegisterNetRegexs.desc:
Registers a list of regular expressions recognized by ciIsNet().

A net belongs to t_netType if its name matches any of these expressions.

ciRegisterStructure.name: ciRegisterStructure
ciRegisterStructure.desc: Registers a structure with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using Capturing New Structures).

ciRemoveDuplicateMembers.name: ciRemoveDuplicateMembers
ciRemoveDuplicateMembers.desc: Removes duplicate constraint members from constraints which do not support duplicate members.

ciResolveNet.name: ciResolveNet
ciResolveNet.syntax:
ciResolveNet( 
d_netDBid
g_hierContext
[ ?simplify t_simplify ]
)
=> g_resolvedNetInfo / nil
ciResolveNet.desc: Resolves the passed net to the highest equivalent design net. Used by Circuit Prospector finders when run on flattened hierarchies. For example, the Active Common Gate finder.

ciRunFinder.name: ciRunFinder
ciRunFinder.syntax:
ciRunFinder( 
t_finderName
t_iteratorFnName
t_finderExpression
t_constraintGenExpr
[ g_iteratorSupportFlatHier ]
[ t_hierScope ]
[ n_depth ]
[ g_cache ]
[ s_predicate ]
)
=> list
ciRunFinder.desc: Runs a Circuit Prospector finder and returns a list of objects grouped according to the finder expression evaluation result. If the depth argument is specified and the hierScope argument is 'depthCellViews, the finder searches only up to the specified depth. If cache is specified, the finder runs on that cache; otherwise, the search results are obtained from the current window. See also ciRegisterFinder and ciRegisterIterator.

ciRunFindersAndGenerators.name: ciRunFindersAndGenerators
ciRunFindersAndGenerators.syntax:
ciRunFindersAndGenerators(
g_cache
t_categoryName
[ ?runGenerators g_runGenerators ]
[ ?deleteExisting g_deleteExisting ]
[ ?addHierNotes g_addHierNotes ]
[ ?printFinderResults g_printFinderResults ]
[ ?updateArgsExpr g_updateArgsExpr ]
[ ?triggerCBinMode g_triggerCBinMode ]
)
=> list
ciRunFindersAndGenerators.desc: Runs all the finders and their corresponding generators for the specified constraint cache and Circuit Prospector category. The finders first find all the results and then the constraint generators are ran on those results to create constraints and templates.

ciRunGenerator.name: ciRunGenerator
ciRunGenerator.syntax:
ciRunGenerator(
g_cache
t_cGenName
l_instsNetsPins
[ ?argValuesToUpdate g_argValuesToUpdate ]
[ ?triggerCBinMode g_triggerCBinMode ]
)
=> list
ciRunGenerator.desc: Given a constraint cache, a generator name and a list of objects(insts, nets, pins & terminals), the function Runs the specified constraint generator in the given constraint cache for the specified list of objects, that is, instances, nets, pins, and terminals. This function is called by ciRunFindersAndGenerators to run the constraint generator.

ciRunPrecondition.name: ciRunPrecondition
ciRunPrecondition.syntax:
ciRunPrecondition(
g_cache
t_cGenName
l_instsNetsPins
)
=> l_templates / t / nil
ciRunPrecondition.desc: Runs all the precondition checks that are needed before a constraint generator can be run.

ciSameCellIterator.name: ciSameCellIterator
ciSameCellIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all design instances with the same master collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderDeviceExpr). This iterator ensures that the devices within a group have the same master. All devices with the same master, which have the same finderDeviceExpr result, are grouped together. If the finderDeviceExpr evaluates to nil then the device is ignored.

ciSeparateInstsNetsPins.name: ciSeparateInstsNetsPins
ciSeparateInstsNetsPins.desc: Converts the instsNetsPins list into a disembodied property list to allow easier access to the instances, nets, pins, and instTerms in the sub-lists. This function is used within constraint generators.

ciSeriesResistorArrayIterator.name: ciSeriesResistorArrayIterator
ciSeriesResistorArrayIterator.desc: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of sequentially-arranged resistors that create the longest serial chain between two nets. The serial chain splits at a T-junction point. This function is used by the Series Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks.name: ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks
ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks.desc: Controls the constraint groups that are visible in the Constraint Manager.

ciSetDefaultConstraintEditor.name: ciSetDefaultConstraintEditor
ciSetDefaultConstraintEditor.desc: Sets the specified editor as the default constraint editor. The change will take effect at the next start-up of the Virtuoso Schematic Editor or Virtuoso Layout Editor. To keep the change persistent on each start-up of Virtuoso, set this function in an initialization file.

ciSetStructArgVal.name: ciSetStructArgVal
ciSetStructArgVal.desc: Replaces the specified structure argument value with the specified value. This SKILL function can be used to override the default settings for the predefined structures.

ciSignalIterator.name: ciSignalIterator
ciSignalIterator.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all signals in the passed cellview, and return a list of corresponding signals.

ciUnexpandDeviceInfo.name: ciUnexpandDeviceInfo
ciUnexpandDeviceInfo.desc:
Contracts any mfactored device names and optionally any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The mfactored device names used in the layout are of the format |<instName>.<mFactorIndx>, such as |MN1.3, and the iterated device names may be schematic device names like MN1<0> or layout device names like |MN1(0). In the layout, the device names may be mfactored and iterated, such as|MN1(3).4.

When a collection of mfactored device names are contracted (for example, |MN1.2, |MN1.3, |MN1.4) a single device will appear in the returned deviceInfo list using the base device name like |MN1, and the mfactor property will be set to the total number of devices that were contracted, in this case 3.

ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo.name: ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo
ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo.desc: Contracts any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The iterated device names may be schematic device names, such as MN1<0>, or layout device names, such as |MN1(0).

ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator.name: ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator
ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator.desc: Unregisters a previously registered constraint generator.

ciUnregisterIterator.name: ciUnregisterIterator
ciUnregisterIterator.desc: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector iterator that was previously registered by using ciRegisterIterator. If successful, the iterator will no longer appear in the Edit Finder list or the Edit Iterator list.

ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth.name: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth
ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth.syntax:
ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth( 
u_cache
l_instsNetsPins
[ ?minFingerWidth t_minWidth ]
[ ?maxFingerWidth t_maxWidth ]
)
=> nil
ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth.desc: Used by the Circuit Prospector as a generator to set a variantInfo property to each given instance registered as a fet, when the parameter value for the parameter registered as fingerWidth is greater than the given minWidth value, and smaller than the maxWidth value.

ciXYInstSymmetricIterator.name: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator
ciXYInstSymmetricIterator.syntax:
ciXYInstSymmetricIterator( 
d_cellview
t_finderExpr
[ ?trigger g_trigger ]
[ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ]
)
=> list / nil
ciXYInstSymmetricIterator.desc: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects that are assigned to L and R local variables. Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

ciXYNetSymmetricIterator.name: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator
ciXYNetSymmetricIterator.syntax:
ciXYNetSymmetricIterator( 
d_cellview
t_finderExpr
[ ?trigger g_trigger ]
[ ?likeSchemaSym g_likeSchemaSym ]
)
=> list / nil
ciXYNetSymmetricIterator.desc: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric nets, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

ciXYPinSymmetricIterator.name: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator
ciXYPinSymmetricIterator.syntax:
ciXYPinSymmetricIterator( 
d_cellview
t_finderExpr
[ ?trigger g_trigger ]
[ ?likeSchemaSym t_likeSchemaSym ]
)
=> list / nil
ciXYPinSymmetricIterator.desc: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric pins, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

ciXYSortInsts.name: ciXYSortInsts
ciXYSortInsts.desc: Sorts a list of dbInstID, first by their X coordinates and then by their Y coordinates. This will order the instances, from top to bottom and left to right, in terms of where they are located on the canvas.

ciXYSymmetricIterator.name: ciXYSymmetricIterator
ciXYSymmetricIterator.desc: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects assigned to L and R local variables. The L and R variables can be referenced in the finderExpr. Iterates all pairs of symmetric design instances/pins (objects) collecting them together into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil. The Circuit Prospector assistant finders use this function.

ciAddStructArg.name: ciAddStructArg
ciAddStructArg.syntax:
ciAddStructArg( 
s_structType
l_newArg
[ ?afterArgName g_afterArgName ]
)
=> t / nil
ciAddStructArg.desc: Adds a new constraint generator argument to the list of existing arguments registered for the passed structType. By default, the argument is appended to the current list of arguments for the structType. Optionally, the new argument can be inserted after the end of the argument or after a existing argument name.

ciCollectDeviceInfo.name: ciCollectDeviceInfo
ciCollectDeviceInfo.syntax:
ciCollectDeviceInfo( 
g_cache
l_devices
[ ?devParamNames l_devParamNames ]
[ ?devTerminalNames l_devTerminalNames ]
[ ?warnParamUnfound g_warnParamUnfound ]
[ ?warnUnmapped g_warnUnmapped ]
[ ?parents g_parents ]
)
=> devs
ciCollectDeviceInfo.desc: Returns a disembodied property list containing information collected about the passed devices in the generators instsNetsPins list.

ciConvertParamsDPLToParams.name: ciConvertParamsDPLToParams
ciConvertParamsDPLToParams.desc: Converts a disembodied property list of parameter names and values into the list format required for specifying constraint parameters and constraint member parameters. This function is the complement of ciConvertParamsToDPL.

ciConvertParamsToDPL.name: ciConvertParamsToDPL
ciConvertParamsToDPL.desc: Converts a constraint parameter list into a disembodied property list of parameter names and values. This function is the complement of ciConvertParamsDPLToParams. Converting the parameter list into a DPL makes it easier to change values in the list.

ciConvertToConArg.name: ciConvertToConArg
ciConvertToConArg.desc: Converts a GUI-friendly parameter name (which can contain spaces) into a legal constraint parameter name (must not contain spaces).

ciCreateGuardRing.name: ciCreateGuardRing
ciCreateGuardRing.desc: Default function used by the Rapid Analog Prototype constraint generators for creating guard rings. If the modgen is already associated with a guard ring, ciCreateGuardRing updates the parameters of the existing guard ring.

ciCreateModgen.name: ciCreateModgen
ciCreateModgen.syntax:
ciCreateModgen( 
g_cache
l_instsNetsPins
s_structType
l_args
[ ?createModgenTemplate g_createModgenTemplate ]
)
=> templateID / constraintID
ciCreateModgen.desc: A constraint generation utility function, which simplifies the process of generating modgens for specified structure types. This function calls expressions to create the modgen device pattern and guard ring that have been pre-registered for the specified structure type. For example, DiffPair and CurrentMirror.

ciCreateModgenDummy.name: ciCreateModgenDummy
ciCreateModgenDummy.syntax:
ciCreateModgenDummy( 
g_cache 
d_refDev
x_row
x_col
g_abut
[ ?dummyNetToUse x_dummyNetToUse ]
[ ?orient s_orient ]
[ ?dummyParams l_dummyParams ]
[ ?extraParams l_extraParams ]
)
=> l_result
ciCreateModgenDummy.desc: A utility function for creating a modgen member parameter for specifying a dummy device.

ciCreateModgenForStructure.name: ciCreateModgenForStructure
ciCreateModgenForStructure.syntax:
ciCreateModgenForStructure(
g_cache 
l_instsNetsPins
s_structType
l_args
)
=> l_modgen
ciCreateModgenForStructure.desc: A function performs the same basic function as ciCreateModgen, but does not have the createModgenTemplate argument.

ciCreateRoutingLayerEnumString.name: ciCreateRoutingLayerEnumString
ciCreateRoutingLayerEnumString.desc: Utility function for creating layer name enums, which will retrieve the list of layer names from the technology file and make layerNumber the default by adding the associated layer name to the end of the list.

ciDeleteClusterMembersWithinModgens.name: ciDeleteClusterMembersWithinModgens
ciDeleteClusterMembersWithinModgens.desc: A utility function for removing devices from cluster constraints if those devices are also members of a modgen.

ciDeleteGuardRing.name: ciDeleteGuardRing
ciDeleteGuardRing.desc: If the passed modgen constraint has a Guard Ring constraint associated with it then delete it.

ciDeleteStructArg.name: ciDeleteStructArg
ciDeleteStructArg.desc: Deletes the named argument from the registered argument list for the passed structType. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

ciDeleteSymmetriesWithinModgens.name: ciDeleteSymmetriesWithinModgens
ciDeleteSymmetriesWithinModgens.desc: Removes the devices from symmetry constraints if those devices are also members of a modgen.

ciExpandAndRepeatName.name: ciExpandAndRepeatName
ciExpandAndRepeatName.syntax:
ciExpandAndRepeatName( 
t_name 
x_numRepetitions 
s_type 
)
=> t / nil
ciExpandAndRepeatName.desc: Expands iterated device names and repeats the expanded name the required number of times. The repetition is necessary where the iterated device is also M factored.

ciExtractRowNumber.name: ciExtractRowNumber
ciExtractRowNumber.desc: Extracts the row number from a string of the form row followed by a rowNumber.

ciFindDeviceArraysForDev.name: ciFindDeviceArraysForDev
ciFindDeviceArraysForDev.desc: This function is used for extracting the list of devices which have the same master and are connected in series or parallel chains. This can be used to identify series/parallel resistors/capacitors. The bulk connections of these devices are ignored.

ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc.name: ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc
ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc.syntax:
ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc( 
g_cache 
l_devInfo 
l_pattern 
args
)
=> t_channelDesc
ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc.desc: Generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for Passive Device Array structures. This function is called as part of the constraint generation process in the routing expression for Passive Device Array structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('PassiveDeviceArray ...).

ciGenerateBestFitPattern.name: ciGenerateBestFitPattern
ciGenerateBestFitPattern.syntax:
ciGenerateBestFitPattern( 
l_devInfo 
args
[ ?expandInsts g_expandInsts ]
[ ?forcedRows x_forcedRows ]
)
=> l_pattern
ciGenerateBestFitPattern.desc: Generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Passive Device Array structure. This function is called as part of the constraint generation process in the pattern expression for Passive Device Array structures that are registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('PassiveDeviceArray ...).

ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorChannelDe.name: ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorChannelDesc
ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorChannelDe.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Cascoded Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Cascoded Current Mirrors structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CascodedCurrentMirror ...).

ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorPattern.name: ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorPattern
ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorPattern.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Cascoded Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Cascoded Current Mirror structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CascodedCurrentMirror ...).

ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc.name: ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc
ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc.syntax:
ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc( 
g_cache
l_devInfo
l_pattern
args

)
=> t_channelDesc
ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Current Mirror structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CurrentMirror ...).

ciGenerateCurrentMirrorPattern.name: ciGenerateCurrentMirrorPattern
ciGenerateCurrentMirrorPattern.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Current Mirror structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CurrentMirror ...).

ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc.name: ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc
ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc.syntax:
ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc( 
g_cache 
l_devInfo 
l_pattern 
args
)
=> t_channelDesc
ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Diff Pair structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Diff Pair structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('DiffPair ...).

ciGenerateDiffPairPattern.name: ciGenerateDiffPairPattern
ciGenerateDiffPairPattern.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Differential Pair structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Differential Pair structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('DiffPair ...).

ciGenerateLargeMfactorPattern.name: ciGenerateLargeMfactorPattern
ciGenerateLargeMfactorPattern.desc: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Large Mfactor structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Large Mfactor structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('LargeMfactor ...).

ciGetGuardRing.name: ciGetGuardRing
ciGetGuardRing.desc: Returns the guard ring constraint associated with the passed modgen constraint, if it has one.

ciGetGuardRingMPPName.name: ciGetGuardRingMPPName
ciGetGuardRingMPPName.desc: This function returns the registered technology file Guard Ring MPP name for the passed device based on the device type (nfet or pfet).

ciGetParamValFromParameters.name: ciGetParamValFromParameters
ciGetParamValFromParameters.syntax:
ciGetParamValFromParameters( 
t_paramName
l_params
[ ?valPos x_valPos ]
)
=> l_val / nil
ciGetParamValFromParameters.desc: Retrieves the specified parameter value from a constraint parameter list. It can be used to retrieve values of constraint parameters or constraint member parameters.

ciGetRoutingLayer.name: ciGetRoutingLayer
ciGetRoutingLayer.desc: Retrieves the named routing layer from the technology file associated with the current window. See also, ciGetTechFile, ciGetRoutingLayers, techGetLayerNum, techGetLayerMaskNumber, techFindLayer, and techGetLayerFunctions.

ciGetRoutingLayers.name: ciGetRoutingLayers
ciGetRoutingLayers.desc: Retrieves the names of all the routing layers from the technology file associated with the current window. See also ciGetTechFile, ciGetRoutingLayer, techGetLayerNum, techGetLayerMaskNumber, techFindLayer, and techGetLayerFunctions.

ciGetRule.name: ciGetRule
ciGetRule.syntax:
ciGetRule( 
t_layerName 
t_ruleName
g_defVal
)
=> g_ruleValue / g_defVal
ciGetRule.desc: Retrieves the required rule value from the technology file. If the rule cannot be found, then the default value is returned.

ciGetStructArg.name: ciGetStructArg
ciGetStructArg.desc: Retrieves the named structure argument for the specified structure type. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, and ciDeleteStructArg.

ciGetStructArgs.name: ciGetStructArgs
ciGetStructArgs.desc: Retrieves all the structure arguments for the specified structure type. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, and ciDeleteStructArg.

ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions.name: ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions
ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions.desc: Retrieves the constraint generator expressions registered for the passed structure type. The generator expressions are returned within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen SKILL function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciListStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

ciGetStructPDKMult.name: ciGetStructPDKMult
ciGetStructPDKMult.desc: Retrieves the PDK specific multiplier for the passed structure type. The PDK name is determined from the technology file associated with the current window. If multiplier has been registered then the default value of 1.0 will be returned. The PDK multipliers are typically used within constraint generator argument expressions to scale the values in a PDK independent way. See also, ciSetStructPDKMult.

ciGUIArgsToConArgs.name: ciGUIArgsToConArgs
ciGUIArgsToConArgs.desc: A simple wrapper around ciConvertToConArg for converting disembodied property lists of GUI args to a list of list of lists where each sublist is a constraint parameter list.

ciHighestLevelNet.name: ciHighestLevelNet
ciHighestLevelNet.desc: This function returns the dbId of the highest level net associated with the passed lower level hierarchical net name. If the net is local to the cellview, which is contained within then the function returns info on that net. See also ciResolveNet.

ciListStructGeneratorExpressions.name: ciListStructGeneratorExpressions
ciListStructGeneratorExpressions.desc: Returns a list of all the registered structure generator expressions that are returned within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen SKILL function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

ciListStructPDKMults.name: ciListStructPDKMults
ciListStructPDKMults.desc: This function prints a list of all the registered structure PDK multipliers and returns a table of the registered structure type/PDK combinations. See also, ciSetStructPDKMult and ciGetStructPDKMult.

ciListStructTypes.name: ciListStructTypes
ciListStructTypes.desc: Returns a list of the registered structure types used by the Circuit Prospector. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciSetStructPDKMult ciAddStructArg, ciGetStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciRegexReplaceStructArgs.

ciListTemplateTypes.name: ciListTemplateTypes
ciListTemplateTypes.desc: Generates a list of the current constraint template types dictionary, outputs its details.

ciMemberIndexToModgenPatternSymbol.name: ciMemberIndexToModgenPatternSymbol
ciMemberIndexToModgenPatternSymbol.desc: This function returns the modgen pattern symbol for a member where member index is the count of the number of unique member names that have so far been processed in the list of members.

ciModgenDummyNetName.name: ciModgenDummyNetName
ciModgenDummyNetName.desc: Determines the modgen dummy net name based on bulk connectivity of the specified devices or the power/ground nets in the design. See also, ciCreateModgenDummy.

ciNumDevices.name: ciNumDevices
ciNumDevices.desc: Returns the number of physical devices for a given device name in the schematic, which effectively retrieves the mfactor for the device.

ciPadModgenPattern.name: ciPadModgenPattern
ciPadModgenPattern.syntax:
ciPadModgenPattern(
l_pattern
x_rowCount
x_colCount
[ ?addDummies l_addDummies ]
)
=> l_pattern
ciPadModgenPattern.desc: Adds any missing elements in the modgen pattern list for the specified row and column counts.

ciRegexReplaceStructArgs.name: ciRegexReplaceStructArgs
ciRegexReplaceStructArgs.desc: For the passed constraint generator argument list replace any strings matching the passed regular expression with the passed string replacement. This function is useful for customizing the default constraint generator arguments registered for a given structure. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

ciReinitStructTemplateDefs.name: ciReinitStructTemplateDefs
ciReinitStructTemplateDefs.desc: Re-initializes the template definitions created by the Circuit Prospector for registered structures. This is necessary if any of the structure arguments are modified. Typically, these modifications will be in the libInit.il file loaded when the PDK library is loaded or in a .cdsinit file.

ciRemoveSymmetricPinAlignments.name: ciRemoveSymmetricPinAlignments
ciRemoveSymmetricPinAlignments.desc: This utility function used by the Rapid Analog Prototype Enforce Precedence constraint generator to remove alignment constraints on symmetric pins.

ciReplaceStructArg.name: ciReplaceStructArg
ciReplaceStructArg.syntax:
ciReplaceStructArg( 
s_structType
t_argName
l_newArg
)
=> t / nil
ciReplaceStructArg.desc: For the passed structure type this function replaces the named constraint generator argument with a new argument definition. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

ciSaveConstraintGenerator.name: ciSaveConstraintGenerator
ciSaveConstraintGenerator.desc: Saves a constraint generator in the .cadence/dfII/ci/generators directory with the name given to it. The spaces in the constraint generator's name are replaced by underscores.

ciSetStructArgs.name: ciSetStructArgs
ciSetStructArgs.desc: Sets the constraint generator arguments for the passed structure type. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg. ciReplaceStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions.name: ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions
ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions.desc: Sets the constraint generator expressions for the passed structure type. The generator expressions are specified within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciListStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

ciSetStructPDKMult.name: ciSetStructPDKMult
ciSetStructPDKMult.desc: Sets the PDK specific multiplier for the passed structure type and PDK name. The PDK multipliers are typically used within constraint generator argument expressions to scale the values in a PDK independent way. See also, ciGetStructPDKMult.

ciSortDeviceInfoByFingerWidth.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByFingerWidth
ciSortDeviceInfoByFingerWidth.desc: Returns devs ordered by finger width. The device with the largest finger width will appear first in the list.

ciSortDeviceInfoByMfactor.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByMfactor
ciSortDeviceInfoByMfactor.desc: Returns devices ordered by mfactor. The device with the largest mfactor will appear first in the list.

ciSortDeviceInfoByX.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByX
ciSortDeviceInfoByX.desc: Returns devices ordered by increasing X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X coordinates.

ciSortDeviceInfoByXY.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByXY
ciSortDeviceInfoByXY.desc: Returns devices ordered by increasing X and increasing Y where, devices have same X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

ciSortDeviceInfoByY.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByY
ciSortDeviceInfoByY.desc: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent Y coordinates.

ciSortDeviceInfoByYX.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByYX
ciSortDeviceInfoByYX.desc: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y and increasing X where devices have same Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo.name: ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo
ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo.desc: This is a utility function used in modgen generation for converting a physical devInfo disembodied property list into a logical devInfo disembodied property list. The devInfo disembodied property lists are created by calling ciCollectDeviceInfo for schematic (logical) and layout (physical) devices.

ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers.name: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers
ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers.syntax:
ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers(
