g_modgen 
l_newModgenParams 
l_newModgenMembers
)
=> t / nil
ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers.desc: A utility function, which updates the passed modgen constraint parameters and members.

ciUtilsGetArgVal.name: ciUtilsGetArgVal
ciUtilsGetArgVal.syntax:
ciUtilsGetArgVal( 
l_args 
t_argName 
t_argAltName 
[ ?defVal g_defVal ]
)
=> g_val
ciUtilsGetArgVal.desc: This is a utility function for accessing constraint generator argument values from a disembodied property list where the argument names may take one of two forms.

ciUtilsMakeNumberRange.name: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange
ciUtilsMakeNumberRange.syntax:
ciUtilsMakeNumberRange( 
x_from 
x_to 
[ ?descending g_descending ] 
[ ?fmt t_fmt ]
)
=> l_result
ciUtilsMakeNumberRange.desc: This function returns a list containing a sequence of numbers ranging from the passed from value to the passed to value. Optionally, this function reverses the list into descending order and applies a sprintf format to the numbers.

drvCheckLists.name: drvCheckLists
drvCheckLists.desc: Returns a list of the registered Design Review checklists. Each checklist is a disembodied property list of the form list(nil 'category <categoryName> 'checks list(<checkDescription1> ... <checkDescriptionN>).

drvGetReviewInfo.name: drvGetReviewInfo
drvGetReviewInfo.syntax:
drvGetReviewInfo(
d_cvId
t_rname
[?name g_name]
[?reviewText g_reviewText]
[?implStatus g_implStatus]
[?signedOff g_signedOff]
[?checkList g_checkList]
[?defects g_defects]
)
=> l_propertynames
drvGetReviewInfo.desc: Returns information for the specified review in the given cellview.

drvListLayoutReviews.name: drvListLayoutReviews
drvListLayoutReviews.desc: Returns the design review names for the specified layout cell view.

drvRegisterCheckLists.name: drvRegisterCheckLists
drvRegisterCheckLists.desc: Registers Design Review checklists. Each checklist is a disembodied property list of the form list(nil 'category <categoryName> 'checks list(<checkDescription1> ... <checkDescriptionN>).

tedSaveCSV.name: tedSaveCSV
tedSaveCSV.desc: Saves the specified Table Editor in a specified CSV file as comma-separated values.

tedSaveXML.name: tedSaveXML
tedSaveXML.desc: Saves the specified Table Editor in a specified XML file as comma-separated values.

cstCreateConstraint.name: cstCreateConstraint
cstCreateConstraint.syntax:
cstCreateConstraint(
g_cstConstraintGroupID
t_constraintDefName
g_layers
g_value
[ l_params ]
[ g_isHard ]
[ g_append ]
[ t_name ]
)
=> g_cstConstraintID / nil
cstCreateConstraint.desc: Creates a constraint in the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID) with the specified constraint definition name (t_constraintDefName), layers, constraint value, constraint parameters, hard attribute, the position of the constraint with the members of the constraint group and the name of the constraint.

cstDeleteConstraint.name: cstDeleteConstraint
cstDeleteConstraint.desc: Deletes the constraint from any of the constraint groups it is a part of. Its value and constraint parameters are also deleted.

cstFindCutClassConstraintByName.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintByName
cstFindCutClassConstraintByName.syntax:
cstFindCutClassConstraintByName(
d_constraintGroupId
tx_layer
t_name
)
=> d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
cstFindCutClassConstraintByName.desc: Returns the database ID of the cut class constraint with a given cut class name, layer, and constraint group.

cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize.name: cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize
cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize.syntax:
cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize(
d_constraintGroupId
tx_layer
n_width
n_length
g_checkOrientation
)
=> d_cutClassConstraintId / nil
cstFindCutClassConstraintBySize.desc: Searches the specified layer in the specified constraint group and returns the first cut class constraint with the specified width and length. If g_checkOrientation is set to t, the orientation of the cut class will also be included as part of the search.

cstGetUnreferencedConstraints.name: cstGetUnreferencedConstraints
cstGetUnreferencedConstraints.desc: Returns all the unreferrenced constraints not belonging to any constraint group in a database (a technology database or a cellview).

cstGet1DTableValue.name: cstGet1DTableValue
cstGet1DTableValue.desc: Returns the value of the table for the given index. The index varies depending on the constraint. It can be a width or a length.

cstGet2DTableValue.name: cstGet2DTableValue
cstGet2DTableValue.desc: Returns the value of the table for the given indexes.

cstGetTwoWidthTableValue.name: cstGetTwoWidthTableValue
cstGetTwoWidthTableValue.syntax:
cstGetTwoWidthTableValue( 
d_ConstraintID 
n_index1
n_index2
n_index3
)
=> n_value
cstGetTwoWidthTableValue.desc: Applies to the twoWidth table. It only returns the spacing value for a given width1, width2, and length.

cstIsId.name: cstIsId
cstIsId.desc: Returns a Boolean that indicates whether the specified ID is a constraint ID.

cstAddToConstraintGroup.name: cstAddToConstraintGroup
cstAddToConstraintGroup.syntax:
cstAddToConstraintGroup(
g_cstConstraintGroupID
g_memberConstraintGroupID
[ g_append ]
)
=> t / nil
cstAddToConstraintGroup.desc:
Adds a constraint group to be a member constraint group of the containing constraint. You can position the constraint group at the beginning of the members or at the end of the members with g_append. The default value for g_append is nil, which means that add the constraint group to the beginning of the members. The member constraint group cannot be owned by other objects. 

Note: A member constraint group cannot be added to itself.

cstCreateConstraintGroupIn.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupIn
cstCreateConstraintGroupIn.syntax:
cstCreateConstraintGroupIn(
{ d_techID | d_cellViewID }
t_constraintGroupName
[ t_constraintGroupDefName ]
[ g_operator ]
)
=> g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
cstCreateConstraintGroupIn.desc: Creates a constraint group in the technology database (that is, techDb) or a cellview with arguments of the database ID, constraint group name, constraint group definition name and operator symbol.

cstCreateConstraintGroupOn.name: cstCreateConstraintGroupOn
cstCreateConstraintGroupOn.syntax:
cstCreateConstraintGroupOn(
g_object
t_constraintGroupDefName
[ g_operator ]
)
=> g_cstConstraintGroupID / nil
cstCreateConstraintGroupOn.desc: Creates a constraint group on an object (for example, net, term, and so on) with arguments of the object ID, constraint group definition name, and operator symbol. The constraint group definition name is required while constraint group operators are optional for this SKILL function.

cstDeleteConstraintGroup.name: cstDeleteConstraintGroup
cstDeleteConstraintGroup.desc: Deletes the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID). The contained constraints in the constraint group are not automatically deleted when the constraintGroup is deleted.

cstFindConstraintGroupIn.name: cstFindConstraintGroupIn
cstFindConstraintGroupIn.desc: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from a database ID with constraint group name and a Boolean flag (g_localOnly).

cstFindConstraintGroupOn.name: cstFindConstraintGroupOn
cstFindConstraintGroupOn.desc: Returns a constraint group ID (g_cstConstraintGroupID) from an object (g_object) with constraint group definition name.

cstFindFirstConstraint.name: cstFindFirstConstraint
cstFindFirstConstraint.syntax:
cstFindFirstConstraint(
d_ConstraintGroupID
t_constraintDefName
[ ( tx_layer [ tx_purpose ] )... ]
[ l_params ]
[ g_onlyHard ]
)
=> d_ConstraintID / nil
cstFindFirstConstraint.desc: Searches a constraint group in the hierarchical order and returns the ID of the first constraint found with the given name, layers, purposes, and params. If the onlyHard argument is not specified, the first matching constraint is returned and it is possible that it is a hard constraint. If the onlyHard argument is specified, then the first matching hard constraint is returned.

cstGetConstraintGroups.name: cstGetConstraintGroups
cstGetConstraintGroups.desc: Returns all the containing constraint groups for the constraint (g_cstConstraintID).

cstGetDefaultConstraintGroupName.name: cstGetDefaultConstraintGroupName
cstGetDefaultConstraintGroupName.desc: Gets the name of the constraint group that is used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

cstGetFoundryCGName.name: cstGetFoundryCGName
cstGetFoundryCGName.desc: Returns the name of the alternate foundry constraint group. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the name of the foundry constraint group.

cstGetFoundryConstraintGroup.name: cstGetFoundryConstraintGroup
cstGetFoundryConstraintGroup.desc: Returns the database ID of the alternate foundry constraint group specified for a given technology file. If there is no alternate foundry constraint group specified, it returns the ID of the foundry constraint group.

cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName.name: cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName
cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName.syntax:
cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName(
d_cellview
t_constraintGroupName
t_type
)
=> t / nil
cstSetDefaultConstraintGroupName.desc: Sets the specified constraint group name to be used as the default constraint group on the objects of the cellview according to the specified application type.

ciAPRDIDeviceGroupIterator.name: ciAPRDIDeviceGroupIterator
ciAPRDIDeviceGroupIterator.desc: Runs an iterator to identify advanced place and route Design Intent structures in the specified design.

ciAPRDINetIterator.name: ciAPRDINetIterator
ciAPRDINetIterator.desc: Iterates through all nets that are associated with an APR Net Design Intent in the cellview. The iterator expression is the APR Net DI profile name, for example, APR Net Shielding.

ciCheckDINetHierConsistency.name: ciCheckDINetHierConsistency
ciCheckDINetHierConsistency.syntax:
ciCheckDINetHierConsistency(
t_profileName
[ ?profileProps l_profilePropsAndValues ]
[ ?cv g_cellview ]

)
=> t / nil
ciCheckDINetHierConsistency.desc: Checks that the propagated design intent is consistent with the reference design intent for the selected nets. If no nets are selected, consistency is checked for all nets in the current cellview. Warns about mismatches in profile property values for Design Intent on the same net through the hierarchy or if the Design Intent is missing on a net at a particular level in the hierarchy. The basis for the comparison can be one of the following:

ciDevGroupBoxIterator.name: ciDevGroupBoxIterator
ciDevGroupBoxIterator.desc: Iterates all device groups within a cellview that are enclosed by a text box.

ciDIGetRegisteredIgnoredTerminals.name: ciDIGetRegisteredIgnoredTerminals
ciDIGetRegisteredIgnoredTerminals.desc: Returns the list of terminals that have been registered to be ignored when creating a design intent.

ciDIHierConsistencyCheck.name: ciDIHierConsistencyCheck
ciDIHierConsistencyCheck.desc: Runs the design intent consistency checks in the selected cellview.

ciDIHierPushDown.name: ciDIHierPushDown
ciDIHierPushDown.desc: Pushes the selected net or HighCurrent design intent down the hierarchy. You can choose whether to replace or update any existing design intent at the lower level.

ciDIHierPushDownDIWithPaths.name: ciDIHierPushDownDIWithPaths
ciDIHierPushDownDIWithPaths.desc: Pushes the selected nets or HighCurrent design intents down the hierarchy. You can use the hierarchy path to specify multiple nets or design intents. You can choose whether to replace or update any existing design intents at the lower level.

ciDIHierPushUp.name: ciDIHierPushUp
ciDIHierPushUp.desc: Pushes the selected net or HighCurrent design intent to the top of the hierarchy. You need to descend edit into the design and select a design intent to push from that level to the top of the hierarchy.

ciDIHierPushUpDIWithPaths.name: ciDIHierPushUpDIWithPaths
ciDIHierPushUpDIWithPaths.desc: Pushes the selected nets or HighCurrent design intents to the top of the hierarchy. You need to descend edit into the design and select a design intent to push from that level to the top of the hierarchy. You can also use the hierarchy path to specify multiple nets or design intents.

ciDiMinMaxVPropertyCallback.name: ciDiMinMaxVPropertyCallback
ciDiMinMaxVPropertyCallback.desc: Runs a callback to check that customized property definitions using minimum and maximum voltage property values are set correctly so that Min Voltage is less than or equal to Max Voltage. When these properties are set incorrectly in the Create Design Intent form or Edit Design Intent form, the properties are highlighted and the form is prevented from closing until the values are corrected.

ciDiPostTransferHighCurrent.name: ciDiPostTransferHighCurrent
ciDiPostTransferHighCurrent.desc: Runs a callback to enslure that when a customized HighCurrent design intent is transferred from Schematics XL to Layout XL, the current is split evenly between the mfactored members in Layout XL. This function is specified using the postTransferCallback for the HighCurrent design intent properties.

ciDiPostTransferMinMaxVoltage.name: ciDiPostTransferMinMaxVoltage
ciDiPostTransferMinMaxVoltage.desc: Runs a callback to propagate the design intent properties Min Voltage, Max Voltage, Signal Type, Power Sensitivity, and Ground Sensitivity on the associated design intent objects after transfer from schematic to layout.

ciDIRegisterIgnoredTerminals.name: ciDIRegisterIgnoredTerminals
ciDIRegisterIgnoredTerminals.desc: Registers a list of terminals per master cellview that should be ignored when creating a design intent. Bulk terminals are always ignored regardless of the registration status of the terminals. Ignoring terminals when creating design intent is useful when some terminals exist in the schematic but not in the layout.

ciDiReplaceOrAddPropertyGroupDef.name: ciDiReplaceOrAddPropertyGroupDef
ciDiReplaceOrAddPropertyGroupDef.desc: Adds or replaces customized design intent property group definitions.

ciDiReportGenReport.name: ciDiReportGenReport
ciDiReportGenReport.syntax:
ciDiReportGenReport(
[ ?cv d_cellviewID ]
[ ?depth x_depth ]
[ ?title t_reportName ]
[ ?path t_path ]
[ ?launch { t | nil } ]
[ ?date t_reportDate ]
)
=> t / nil
ciDiReportGenReport.desc: Generates a report summarizing the design intent in the current design based on the specified criteria and optionally opens the report in the browser.

ciResetDIImplementation.name: ciResetDIImplementation
ciResetDIImplementation.desc: Resets the implementation status, implementation notes, and signed off status of all design intents in the constraints cache so that the cellview can be reused.

ciSetDIPropertyGroupDefs.name: ciSetDIPropertyGroupDefs
ciSetDIPropertyGroupDefs.desc: Sets the design intent property group definitions to the specified definitions. All existing property group definitions are deleted.

ciTemplateChangeDIProfile.name: ciTemplateChangeDIProfile
ciTemplateChangeDIProfile.desc: Replaces the property profile currently selected for a design intent template.

ciTemplateCreateDI.name: ciTemplateCreateDI
ciTemplateCreateDI.syntax:
ciTemplateCreateDI(
g_cache
t_templateType { diDevices | diNets | diPins | diMaxVoltageDrop |     diHighCurrent | diCell }
t_name
l_memberNamesTypes
[ ?profile t_profileName ]
[ ?params l_paramNameAndValue ]
[ ?propNameValue l_propNameValue ]
)
=> u_templateId / nil
ciTemplateCreateDI.desc: Creates a design intent template for the specified template type.

ciTemplateDIProfileName.name: ciTemplateDIProfileName
ciTemplateDIProfileName.desc: Returns the name of the profile associated with the specified design intent template.

ciTemplateDIPropDef.name: ciTemplateDIPropDef
ciTemplateDIPropDef.desc: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of the named property in the form of a DPL.

ciTemplateDIPropGroupDef.name: ciTemplateDIPropGroupDef
ciTemplateDIPropGroupDef.desc: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of all the properties in the form of a DPL.

ciTemplateDIPropValue.name: ciTemplateDIPropValue
ciTemplateDIPropValue.desc: For the specified design intent template, returns the value of a named property.

ciTemplateIsKindOfDI.name: ciTemplateIsKindOfDI
ciTemplateIsKindOfDI.desc: Confirms if the specified constraint template is a design intent template. The available design intent templates are: diDevices, diNets, diPins, diMaxVoltageDrop, diHighCurrent, and diCell.

ciTemplateListDIProps.name: ciTemplateListDIProps
ciTemplateListDIProps.desc: For the specified design intent template, returns a list of the property names, types, and values.

ciTemplateUpdateDIProps.name: ciTemplateUpdateDIProps
ciTemplateUpdateDIProps.desc: For the specified design intent template, updates the value of the named property.

ciUpdateObjPropsFromDI.name: ciUpdateObjPropsFromDI
ciUpdateObjPropsFromDI.desc: Runs a callback to propagate design intent properties to the associated design intent objects. The function can be called when the Create Design Intent form or Edit Design Intent form are submitted.

ocnxlEndXLMode.name: ocnxlEndXLMode
ocnxlEndXLMode.desc: This command indicates the end of the current XL mode. This command releases the license that was checked out for the XL mode.

ocnSetXLMode.name: ocnSetXLMode
ocnSetXLMode.desc: Sets the OCEAN mode to XL. In this mode, the simulation setup can contain multiple tests, corners, or advanced run modes, such as MonteCarlo. The OCEAN XL mode can be used to run simulations for ADE XL, ADE Explorer, or ADE Assembler. Accordingly, it checks out the required license. Once the mode is set to XL, it cannot be reverted.

ocnxlBeginTest.name: ocnxlBeginTest
ocnxlBeginTest.desc: This command indicates the beginning of the test specified by testName. Subsequent commands populate this test. The test specification ends when ocnxlEndTest() command is given.

ocnxlDisableTest.name: ocnxlDisableTest
ocnxlDisableTest.desc: Lets you disable a test. A disabled test will not be run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

ocnxlEndTest.name: ocnxlEndTest
ocnxlEndTest.desc: This command indicates the end of the current test's specification.

ocnxlGetTests.name: ocnxlGetTests
ocnxlGetTests.desc: Returns a list of test names.

ocnxlMTSBlock.name: ocnxlMTSBlock
ocnxlMTSBlock.syntax:
ocnxlMTSBlock( 
s_blockName 
[ ?isMtsBlock  g_isMtsBlock ] 
[ ?includeFile l_includeFile ] 
[ ?modelFiles  l_modelFiles ]
[ ?simOptions t_simOptions ]
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlMTSBlock.desc: Enables a block for multi-technology simulation (MTS) and specifies the include files and model files associated with the block.

ocnxlSetMTSMode.name: ocnxlSetMTSMode
ocnxlSetMTSMode.syntax:
ocnxlSetMTSMode( 
s_blockName 
[ ?enableMTS g_enableMTSBlock ]
[ ?modelFiles  l_modelFiles ]
[ ?simOptions t_simOptions ]
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlSetMTSMode.desc: Enables a block for multi-technology simulation (MTS) and specifies the model files associated with the block.

ocnxlMTSEnable.name: ocnxlMTSEnable
ocnxlMTSEnable.desc: Enables or disables multi-technology simulation (MTS) mode for the current test. The current test's specification begins with ocnxlBeginTest(). See help on ocnxlBeginTest().

ocnxlSelectTest.name: ocnxlSelectTest
ocnxlSelectTest.desc: Lets you select a test. List of test names can be obtained by ocnxlGetTests() command. See help on ocnxlGetTests().

ocnxlDeleteNote.name: ocnxlDeleteNote
ocnxlDeleteNote.desc: Deletes a note from the given test, history, corner, or variable.

ocnxlDisableSweepParam.name: ocnxlDisableSweepParam
ocnxlDisableSweepParam.desc: Lets you disable a sweep parameter. A disabled parameter is not run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

ocnxlDisableSweepVar.name: ocnxlDisableSweepVar
ocnxlDisableSweepVar.desc: Lets you disable a sweep variable. A disabled sweep is not run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

ocnxlEnableSweepParam.name: ocnxlEnableSweepParam
ocnxlEnableSweepParam.desc: Enables a sweep parameter. A disabled sweep parameter is not run when the ocnxlRun() command is run.

ocnxlEnableSweepVar.name: ocnxlEnableSweepVar
ocnxlEnableSweepVar.desc: Enables a sweep variable. A disabled sweep variable is not run when the ocnxlRun() command is run.

ocnxlEnableTest.name: ocnxlEnableTest
ocnxlEnableTest.desc: Enables a test. A disabled test will not be run when the ocnxlRun() command is run.

ocnxlGetJobId.name: ocnxlGetJobId
ocnxlGetJobId.desc: Returns the ID of the current simulation job. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

ocnxlJobSetup.name: ocnxlJobSetup
ocnxlJobSetup.desc: Specifies various job setup details for a simulation job.

ocnxlLoadSetupState.name: ocnxlLoadSetupState
ocnxlLoadSetupState.syntax:
ocnxlLoadSetupState( 
t_state
t_mode
[ ?tests t_tests ]
[ ?vars t_vars ] 
[ ?parameters t_parameters ] 
[ ?currentMode t_currentMode ]
[ ?runOptions t_runOptions ]
[ ?specs t_specs ] 
[ ?corners t_corners ] 
[ ?modelGroups t_modelGroups ] 
[ ?extensions t_extensions]
[ ?relxanalysis t_relxanalysis ] 
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlLoadSetupState.desc: Restores the settings in the specified setup state to the active setup.

ocnxlMaxJobFail.name: ocnxlMaxJobFail
ocnxlMaxJobFail.desc: Specifies the maximum number of times the application should restart an ICRP job if it fails to start. This variable is used in batch mode to ensure that the job retries do not go into an infinite loop.

ocnxlMainSimSession.name: ocnxlMainSimSession
ocnxlMainSimSession.desc: Returns the session object for the main simulation session. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

ocnxlProjectDir.name: ocnxlProjectDir

ocnxlSimResultsLocation.desc: Sets the simulation results directory to the specified location. All simulation data goes into this location. If the simulation results directory is not set using this function, the simulation results are saved at any one of the following locations:

ocnxlStimuliData.name: ocnxlStimuliData

ocnxlSweepVar.name: ocnxlSweepVar

ocnxlEnableCornerForTest.desc: Enables a corner for a test.

ocnxlPutEnabledChecksAssertsCellViews.desc: Specifies a list of library/cell/view lists that define the names of cellviews within a test for which the checks and asserts defined in the Checks/Asserts assistant will be netlisted.
