ocnxlPreRunScript.name: ocnxlPreRunScript
ocnxlPreRunScript.desc: Specifies the pre-run script file containing the OCEAN commands that need to be run before the simulation starts. This function must be used within a test setup block (starting with ocnxlBeginTest and ending with ocnxlEndTest ) in your OCEAN script file.

ocnxlReEvaluatePointVariables.name: ocnxlReEvaluatePointVariables
ocnxlReEvaluatePointVariables.desc: Re-evaluates the eval() expressions that include or are dependent on the variables updated through ocnxlUpdatePointVariable during the pre-run stage.

ocnxlRunCalibration.name: ocnxlRunCalibration
ocnxlRunCalibration.desc: Starts the simulation required to calibrate the simulation setup. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

ocnxlSetCalibration.name: ocnxlSetCalibration
ocnxlSetCalibration.desc: Sets up a single iteration Monte Carlo calibration run by inheriting statistical parameter information from the main Monte Carlo simulation run. The starting iteration number for the calibration run is set to the current iteration number of the main Monte Carlo simulation run. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

ocnxlSetMCdut.name: ocnxlSetMCdut
ocnxlSetMCdut.desc: Sets a design instance to be used in a pre-run script for Monte Carlo calibration. If set, the specified subcircuit instance has process and mismatch variations applied to it and the unspecified instances only have process variations. All subcircuits instantiated under the specified instance also have process and mismatch enabled. By default, mismatch variations are applied to all the subcircuit instances in the design and process variations are applied globally. This allows the testbench to change and not affect the variations seen by the original design.

ocnxlSetPreRunScriptEnabled.name: ocnxlSetPreRunScriptEnabled
ocnxlSetPreRunScriptEnabled.desc: Specifies if running the pre-run scripts through OCEAN scripts should be enabled.

ocnxlUpdatePointVariable.name: ocnxlUpdatePointVariable
ocnxlUpdatePointVariable.desc: Updates the value of a parameter or variable in the simulation setup. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

ocnxlAddRelxSetup.name: ocnxlAddRelxSetup
ocnxlAddRelxSetup.syntax:
ocnxlAddRelxSetup(
t_relxSetupName
t_freshTest
t_stressTest
t_agedTest
[ ?stressVarList l_stressVarList ]
[ ?agedVarList l_agedVarList ]
[ ?freshTestEnabled t_freshTestEnabled ]
[ ?stressTestEnabled t_stressTestEnabled ]
[ ?agedTestEnabled t_agedTestEnabled ]
[ ?stressFile t_stressFile ]
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlAddRelxSetup.desc: Adds a new reliability analysis setup with the specified fresh, stress, and aged tests and any variables for which the values need to be overridden.

ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup.name: ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup
ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup.syntax:
ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup(
t_relxName
t_freshTest
t_stressTest
t_agedTest
[ ?freshTestEnabled t_freshTestEnabled ]
[ ?stressTestEnabled t_stressTestEnabled ]
[ ?agedTestEnabled t_agedTestEnabled ]
[ ?scenariosList t_scenariosList ]
[ ?relxOptions t_relxOptions ]
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlAddRelxScenariosSetup.desc: Adds a new scenario setup in the reliability analysis setup.

ocnxlDisableRelxScenariosSetup.name: ocnxlDisableRelxScenariosSetup
ocnxlDisableRelxScenariosSetup.desc: Disables the specified reliability scenario setup.

ocnxlDisableRelxSetup.name: ocnxlDisableRelxSetup
ocnxlDisableRelxSetup.desc: Disables the specified reliability analysis setup.

ocnxlSetRelxAnalysisEnabled.name: ocnxlSetRelxAnalysisEnabled
ocnxlSetRelxAnalysisEnabled.desc: Enables or disables reliability analysis for the setup based on the input argument.

ocnxlSetRelxScenariosEnabled.name: ocnxlSetRelxScenariosEnabled
ocnxlSetRelxScenariosEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the complete reliability scenarios setup.

ocnxlSetRelxEnabledForPreRun.name: ocnxlSetRelxEnabledForPreRun
ocnxlSetRelxEnabledForPreRun.desc: Updates the reliability setup based on the corresponding setup from the current environment. Use this function in the pre-run script to print the reliability setup in the pre-run netlist.

ocnxlEADAddMeasurement.name: ocnxlEADAddMeasurement
ocnxlEADAddMeasurement.desc: Specifies the name of the current or voltage data to be saved from simulation results. A new output is created in the outputs setup of the adexl or maestro view.

ocnxlEADCreateDataSet.name: ocnxlEADCreateDataSet
ocnxlEADCreateDataSet.syntax:
ocnxlEADCreateDataSet(
[ ?lib t_libName ]
[ ?cell t_cellName ]
[ ?view t_viewName ]
[ ?userDataSetName t_dataSetName ]
)
=> t / nil
ocnxlEADCreateDataSet.desc: Creates and saves an EAD dataset for all or for the specified master DUTs. . This command is equivalent to the Create command in the EAD results view of ADE XL or ADE Assembler.

ocnxlEADEnableLiveProcessing.name: ocnxlEADEnableLiveProcessing
ocnxlEADEnableLiveProcessing.desc: Specifies whether the current waveform has to be processed during simulation or post simulation.

ocnxlEADEnableVoltageConstraints.name: ocnxlEADEnableVoltageConstraints
ocnxlEADEnableVoltageConstraints.desc: Specifies whether a user-defined function is called to create voltage constraints, deltaV and voltageSyncedNets.

ocnxlEADSelectAllSignals.name: ocnxlEADSelectAllSignals
ocnxlEADSelectAllSignals.desc: Specifies whether the current (or voltage) data is to be saved for all the instance terminals and terminals (or signals for the voltage data); or only for a selected set of instance terminals and terminals (or signals for the voltage data) in the selected design. This command is equivalent to the All Signals field on the EAD Setup form. The signals can be selected using the Parasitics & Electrical Setup assistant in Virtuoso Schematic Editor XL.

ocnxlEADSetDutMaster.name: ocnxlEADSetDutMaster
ocnxlEADSetDutMaster.desc: Saves the library and cell names of the DUT master for which EM analysis is to be performed.

ocnxlEADSetHierarchyLevel.name: ocnxlEADSetHierarchyLevel
ocnxlEADSetHierarchyLevel.desc: Sets the value for the design hierarchy level upto which the current or voltage data for all the instance terminals, and terminals or signals will be saved. This command is equivalent to the Hierarchy Stop Level field on the EAD Setup form.

ocnxlEADSetWaveFormClipping.name: ocnxlEADSetWaveFormClipping
ocnxlEADSetWaveFormClipping.desc: Sets a start time and an end time for which an electrical waveform is to be processed. This command is equivalent to the Clip Waveforms - From and To fields on the EAD Setup form.

tcDumpTechFile.name: tcDumpTechFile
tcDumpTechFile.syntax:
tcDumpTechFile(
d_techID 
t_dumpFile
[ l_sectionList t_mode 
g_dumpEmptySectionHdrs ]
)
=> t / nil
tcDumpTechFile.desc: Dumps the technology data in the specified binary technology database to the specified ASCII file.

tcLoadTechFile.name: tcLoadTechFile
tcLoadTechFile.syntax:
tcLoadTechFile(
d_techID 
t_sourceFile
[ t_mode [ l_sections ] ]
)
=> t / nil
tcLoadTechFile.desc: Compiles the ASCII source file, opens the technology database in a (append) mode, and updates it with the compiled data. The default action is to merge the newly compiled data with the technology database already loaded into virtual memory. If you set t_mode to w, the system deletes the data in virtual memory and loads the newly compiled data. If you specify the sections to compile, this function compiles only the specified sections and preserves the data in the other sections.

tcRegPostAttachTrigger.name: tcRegPostAttachTrigger
tcRegPostAttachTrigger.desc: Registers a trigger function the system calls after attaching a design library to a technology library. You can use this function to keep track of the technology library of a design library is attached to.

tcRegPostDumpTrigger.name: tcRegPostDumpTrigger
tcRegPostDumpTrigger.desc:
Registers a trigger function the system calls after it dumps a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with three arguments: the database identifier of the technology database, the port (or print destination) for the dump file, and the name of the dump file.

Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it is executed after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

tcRegPostLoadTrigger.name: tcRegPostLoadTrigger
tcRegPostLoadTrigger.desc:
Registers a trigger function the system calls after loading a technology file. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with two arguments: the database identifier of the technology database and the name of the ASCII technology file you are loading.

Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

tcRegPostSetRefTrigger.name: tcRegPostSetRefTrigger
tcRegPostSetRefTrigger.desc: Registers a trigger function that the system calls after setting the reference for the specified technology database. You can use this function to keep track of the technology database reference when a technology database is updated.

tcRegPreDumpTrigger.name: tcRegPreDumpTrigger
tcRegPreDumpTrigger.desc:
Registers a trigger function the system calls before dumping a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with three arguments: the database identifier of the technology database, the port (or print destination) for the dump file, and the name of the dump file.

Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

tcRegPreLoadTrigger.name: tcRegPreLoadTrigger
tcRegPreLoadTrigger.desc:
Registers a trigger function the system calls before loading a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with two arguments: the database identifier of the technology database and the name of the ASCII technology file you are loading. 

Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

tcUnregPostAttachTrigger.name: tcUnregPostAttachTrigger
tcUnregPostAttachTrigger.desc: Unregisters post attach trigger so the system does not call the function after attaching a design library to a technology library.

tcUnregPostDumpTrigger.name: tcUnregPostDumpTrigger
tcUnregPostDumpTrigger.desc: Unregisters the specified postdump trigger function so the system does not call it after dumping a technology database.

tcUnregPostLoadTrigger.name: tcUnregPostLoadTrigger
tcUnregPostLoadTrigger.desc: Unregisters the specified trigger function so the system does not call it after loading a technology file.

tcUnregPostSetRefTrigger.name: tcUnregPostSetRefTrigger
tcUnregPostSetRefTrigger.desc: Unregisters a specified trigger function so that the system does not call it after setting the reference for the specified technology database.

tcUnregPreDumpTrigger.name: tcUnregPreDumpTrigger
tcUnregPreDumpTrigger.desc: Unregisters the specified predump trigger function so the system does not call it before dumping a technology database.

tcUnregPreLoadTrigger.name: tcUnregPreLoadTrigger
tcUnregPreLoadTrigger.desc: Unregisters the specified preload trigger function so the system does not call it before loading a technology file.

techBindTechFile.name: techBindTechFile
techBindTechFile.syntax:
techBindTechFile(
g_ID 
[ t_techLibName 
[ t_binaryName
[ updateDev ] ] ]
)
=> t / nil
techBindTechFile.desc: Attaches the specified DFII library to the specified technology database by creating techLib and techFile properties. To get the design data identifier for a DFII library, use the ddGetObj function.

techCloseTechFile.name: techCloseTechFile
techCloseTechFile.desc: Changes the status of the technology database to closed and decrements the close count. The technology database is not purged from virtual memory until the system needs to use the memory. Internally, the system maintains a count of the number of times you open and close a specific technology database. The count increments when you open and decrements when you close. When the close count is 0 and the system needs more virtual memory, it purges the technology database from virtual memory.

techCopyTechFile.name: techCopyTechFile
techCopyTechFile.syntax:
techCopyTechFile( 
d_techID 
t_newTechDBName
t_path
[ g_deleteOriginal ] 
) 
=> d_newtechID / nil
techCopyTechFile.desc: Copies a technology database to a new location and optionally deletes the original. This function is especially useful for separating technology data out of libraries that contain both design data and technology data as it will copy only the technology data.

techDeleteTechFile.name: techDeleteTechFile
techDeleteTechFile.desc: Deletes a technology database. This function is useful for deleting redundant technology data from design libraries that have been updated to share technology databases.

techDeleteTechLibName.name: techDeleteTechLibName
techDeleteTechLibName.desc: Deletes the techLib property for the specified DFII library. This property is one of two that attach a library to a technology database.

techGetDefaultTechName.name: techGetDefaultTechName
techGetDefaultTechName.desc: Returns the default name of the binary technology database.

techGetOpenTechFiles.name: techGetOpenTechFiles
techGetOpenTechFiles.desc: Returns a list of the database identifiers of the technology databases that are open.

techGetTechFile.name: techGetTechFile
techGetTechFile.desc: Returns the identifier of the technology database attached to the specified DFII library.

techGetTechFileDdId.name: techGetTechFileDdId
techGetTechFileDdId.desc: Returns the design data identifier for the technology database identified by the specified techID. This function is a wrapper for the ddGetObj function specifically designed to return the design data identifier of a technology database.

techGetTechFileName.name: techGetTechFileName
techGetTechFileName.desc: Returns the value of the techFile property for the specified DFII library. This property is one of two that attach a library to a technology database.

techGetTechLibName.name: techGetTechLibName
techGetTechLibName.desc: Returns the value of the techLib property set for the specified library. This property is one of two that attach a library to a technology database.

techGetTimeStamp.name: techGetTimeStamp
techGetTimeStamp.desc: Returns the last save time of the technology database loaded. The time stamp is updated every time you save the technology database. The time stamp is an integer representing the number of seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 GMT, January 1, 1970.

techMakeVirtuosoIccInfo.name: techMakeVirtuosoIccInfo
techMakeVirtuosoIccInfo.syntax:
techMakeVirtuosoIccInfo(
d_techID
[ g_iccRuleFileName ]
[ g_constraintGroupName ]
[ b_replaceConstraintGroup ]
[ b_removeParams ]
)
=> t / nil
techMakeVirtuosoIccInfo.desc: Creates a constraint group from Virtuoso chip assembly router rules. Also creates a separate abstract rules file when iccConductors and/or iccKeepouts are specified. The router rules can be either in a separate ASCII icc rules file or in the technology file techParams section.

techOpenDefaultTechFile.name: techOpenDefaultTechFile
techOpenDefaultTechFile.desc:
Loads the Cadence-supplied default binary technology database into virtual memory in read mode and returns the database identifier.The default technology database resides at the following location:

your_install_dir/tools/dfII/etc/cdsDefTechLib/tech.db

techOpenTechFile.name: techOpenTechFile
techOpenTechFile.syntax:
techOpenTechFile( 
t_libName 
t_binaryName
[ t_mode ] 
) 
=> d_techID / nil
techOpenTechFile.desc: Loads a binary technology database in virtual memory with the specified mode (r, w, and a) and returns the database identifier of that database.

techPurgeTechFile.name: techPurgeTechFile
techPurgeTechFile.desc: Deletes the database from virtual memory if the close count for the file is 0. Internally, the system maintains a count of the number of times you open and close a specific technology database. The count increments when you open and decrements when you close. When the close count is 0 and the system needs more virtual memory, it automatically purges the technology database to free the memory. This function lets you manually purge the technology database.

techRefreshTechFile.name: techRefreshTechFile
techRefreshTechFile.desc: Deletes the technology database loaded in virtual memory and reloads the binary database stored on disk. The edit mode (append, read, or write) of the database remains the same. If you refresh a technology database open in append mode, any changes you made and did not save are lost. If you refresh a technology database open in write mode, the empty disk file is loaded into virtual memory.

techReopenTechFile.name: techReopenTechFile
techReopenTechFile.desc: Changes the mode of a technology database that has been opened. Use this function to upgrade the mode from r (read only) to a (append).

techSaveTechFile.name: techSaveTechFile
techSaveTechFile.desc: Saves the specified technology database from virtual memory to the disk file from which it was opened.

techSetEvaluate.name: techSetEvaluate
techSetEvaluate.desc: Sets an internal flag that indicates whether the tcDumpTechFile and techGet functions evaluate expressions or read expressions as strings. The system automatically sets this internal flag to nil when it dumps a technology file so that expressions and controls are preserved. This function lets you manually set the flag.

techSetPrecision.name: techSetPrecision
techSetPrecision.desc: Sets the precision, or number of digits following the decimal point, to be used in floating-point calculations.

techSetTechLibName.name: techSetTechLibName
techSetTechLibName.desc: Updates the techLib property of the specified library. This property is one of two that attach a library to a technology database.

techSetTimeStamp.name: techSetTimeStamp
techSetTimeStamp.desc: Updates the internal time stamp of the technology database to the current time. The time stamp is an integer representing the number of seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 GMT, January 1, 1970.

techTruncateTechFile.name: techTruncateTechFile
techTruncateTechFile.desc: Deletes the contents of the technology database stored on disk.

techUnattachTechFile.name: techUnattachTechFile
techUnattachTechFile.desc: Unattaches a technology database from a design library. This function unattach the technology library from the design library without remaster the devices in the design library. However, the device master cellviews remain unchanged.

techVerifyTechFileId.name: techVerifyTechFileId
techVerifyTechFileId.desc: Determines whether the specified database identifier is for a technology database.

techGetFabricType.name: techGetFabricType
techGetFabricType.desc: Returns the fabric type of a technology database.

techGetMfgGridResolution.name: techGetMfgGridResolution
techGetMfgGridResolution.desc: Returns the value of the manufacturing grid resolution defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgGridResolution subsection in the controls section. When specified, it establishes that grid snapping must be a multiple of the value of g_resolution.

techGetParam.name: techGetParam
techGetParam.desc: Returns the value of the named control parameter in the specified technology database.

techGetParams.name: techGetParams
techGetParams.desc: Returns the list of control parameters that are set in the specified technology database.

techGetPermission.name: techGetPermission
techGetPermission.desc: Returns the permissions explicitly applied to the specified section in the specified technology database.

techGetPermissions.name: techGetPermissions
techGetPermissions.desc: Returns the permissions explicitly applied to the specified technology database.

techGetProcessNode.name: techGetProcessNode
techGetProcessNode.desc: Returns the local processNode value of the specified technology database. The function does not consider incremental technology databases.

techGetViewTypeUnits.name: techGetViewTypeUnits
techGetViewTypeUnits.desc: Gets the units that are set for the each cellview type in the specified technology database.

techIsMfgGridResolutionSet.name: techIsMfgGridResolutionSet
techIsMfgGridResolutionSet.desc: Checks whether the value used for grid snapping (the default manufacturing grid resolution for design sessions) is set in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgGridResolution subsection in the controls section.

techIsReadPermission.name: techIsReadPermission
techIsReadPermission.desc: Indicates whether the current user has read permission explicitly set on the specified section in the specified technology database.

techSetFabricType.name: techSetFabricType
techSetFabricType.desc: Sets the fabric type for a technology database.

techSetMfgGridResolution.name: techSetMfgGridResolution
techSetMfgGridResolution.desc: Updates or sets the value used for grid snapping in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgGridResolution subsection in the controls section.

techSetParam.name: techSetParam
techSetParam.syntax:
techSetParam(
d_techFileID
t_paramName 
g_paramValue
) 
=> t / nil
techSetParam.desc: Updates the value of the specified control parameter in the specified technology database. If the parameter does not exist, this function creates it.

techSetReadPermission.name: techSetReadPermission
techSetReadPermission.syntax:
techSetReadPermission(
d_techFileID
t_sectionname
t_rUser
) 
=> t / nil
techSetReadPermission.desc: Sets read permission on the specified section in the specified technology database for the specified user.

techSetReadWritePermission.name: techSetReadWritePermission
techSetReadWritePermission.syntax:
techSetReadWritePermission(
d_techFileID
t_sectionname
t_rwUser
) 
=> t / nil
techSetReadWritePermission.desc: Sets read/write permission on the specified section in the specified technology database for the specified user.

analysisAttributeLocks.name: analysisAttributeLocks
analysisAttributeLocks.desc: Specifies the technology class to define layer analysis attribute lock.

techCreateDerivedLayer.name: techCreateDerivedLayer
techCreateDerivedLayer.syntax:
techCreateDerivedLayer(
d_techID
x_derivedLayerNum
t_derivedLayerName
tx_layer1
t_op
[ tx_layer2 ]
[ l_options ]
)
=> d_techLayerID / nil
techCreateDerivedLayer.desc: Creates a derived layer in the specified technology database.

techCreateLayer.name: techCreateLayer
techCreateLayer.syntax:
techCreateLayer( 
d_techID
x_layerNumber
t_layerName 
[ t_layerAbbrev ]
) 
=> d_layerID / nil
techCreateLayer.desc: Creates a layer in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used. If a techLayers subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techCreateLP.name: techCreateLP
techCreateLP.syntax:
techCreateLP( 
d_techID
l_layerPurpose
t_lpName
) 
=> d_lpID / nil
techCreateLP.desc: Creates a named layer-purpose pair in the specified technology database. Layer-purpose pairs are used to define how layers are displayed. A layer is paired with a purpose, assigned a display packet and display attributes (in the techDisplays subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the ASCII technology file).

techCreatePurpose.name: techCreatePurpose
techCreatePurpose.syntax:
techCreatePurpose( 
d_techID
x_purposeNumber
t_purposeName 
[ t_purposeAbbrev ]
) 
=> t / nil
techCreatePurpose.desc: Creates a purpose in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data. If a techPurposes subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techCreatePurposeDef.name: techCreatePurposeDef
techCreatePurposeDef.syntax:
techCreatePurposeDef(
d_techfileId
x_purposeNumber
t_purposeName
[ t_purposeAbbrev ]
)
=> d_purposeDefId / nil
techCreatePurposeDef.desc: Creates a purpose in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data. If a techPurposes subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techDeleteLayer.name: techDeleteLayer
techDeleteLayer.desc: Deletes the specified layer from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techDeleteLP.name: techDeleteLP
techDeleteLP.desc: Deletes the specified layer-purpose pair from the current technology database. ASCII technology file location: in the techLayerPurposePriorities and techDisplays subsections of the layerDefinitions section.

techDeletePurpose.name: techDeletePurpose
techDeletePurpose.desc: Deletes the specified purpose from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data.

techDeletePurposeDef.name: techDeletePurposeDef
techDeletePurposeDef.desc: Deletes the specified purpose from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data.

techDeleteTwoLayerProp.name: techDeleteTwoLayerProp
techDeleteTwoLayerProp.syntax:
techDeleteTwoLayerProp(
d_techID
tx_layer1 
tx_layer2 
t_name 
) 
=> t / nil
techDeleteTwoLayerProp.desc: Deletes the specified two-layer property from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design.

techFindLayer.name: techFindLayer
techFindLayer.desc: Returns the layerID in the specified technology database or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database. This function returns the layerID as per the specified layer name or layer number.

techFindPurposeDef.name: techFindPurposeDef
techFindPurposeDef.desc: Returns the purposeDefID in the specified technology database or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database. This function returns the purposeDefID as per the specified purpose name or purpose number.

techGetDerivedLayer.name: techGetDerivedLayer
techGetDerivedLayer.syntax:
techGetDerivedLayer(
d_techID
tx_layer1
t_op
tx_layer2
)
=> d_techLayerID / nil
techGetDerivedLayer.desc: Returns the database identifier for the derived layer created from the two specified layers with the specified operation in the specified technology database.

techGetEquivLayers.name: techGetEquivLayers
techGetEquivLayers.desc: Returns a list of the equivalent layers defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: equivalentLayers subsection in the layerRules section; it lists layers that represent the same kind of material.

techGetLabelLayers.name: techGetLabelLayers
techGetLabelLayers.desc: Returns a list of the label layers defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: labels subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetLayerAbbrev.name: techGetLayerAbbrev
techGetLayerAbbrev.desc: Returns the abbreviation of the specified layer from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techGetLayerAnalysisAttribute.name: techGetLayerAnalysisAttribute
techGetLayerAnalysisAttribute.syntax:
techGetLayerAnalysisAttribute(
d_techfileID
tx_layer
t_attributeName
) 
=> g_attributeValue / nil
techGetLayerAnalysisAttribute.desc: Returns the value of a specified attribute for a layer with a layer function that supports attribute analysis.

techGetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock.name: techGetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock
techGetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock.desc: Returns the state of the lock on layer analysis attributes for changes related to addition of new layers or updates of attributes.

techGetLayerFunction.name: techGetLayerFunction
techGetLayerFunction.desc: Returns the function (material) assigned to the specified layer in the specified technology database.

techGetLayerFunctions.name: techGetLayerFunctions
techGetLayerFunctions.desc: Returns a list of the functions (materials) and mask numbers assigned to the user-defined layers in the specified technology database. Returns function unknown for layers without an assigned function.

techGetLayerMaskNumber.name: techGetLayerMaskNumber
techGetLayerMaskNumber.desc: Returns the mask number assigned to the specified layer in the specified technology database.

techGetLayerMfgResolution.name: techGetLayerMfgResolution
techGetLayerMfgResolution.syntax:
techGetLayerMfgResolution(
d_techID 
tx_layer
)
=> g_value / g_mfgGridResolution / nil
techGetLayerMfgResolution.desc: Returns the manufacturing grid resolution assigned to the specified layer in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: layerRules section in the specified technology file.

techGetLayerMfgResolutions.name: techGetLayerMfgResolutions
techGetLayerMfgResolutions.desc: Returns each layer assigned a layer manufacturing grid resolution and the layer manufacturing grid resolution applied to it in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgResolutions subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetLayerName.name: techGetLayerName
techGetLayerName.desc: Returns the name of the layer associated with the specified layer number defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techGetLayerNum.name: techGetLayerNum
techGetLayerNum.desc: Returns the layer number associated with the specified layer name defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techGetLayerProp.name: techGetLayerProp
techGetLayerProp.syntax:
techGetLayerProp(
d_techID
tx_layer 
t_propName 
) 
=> g_propValue / nil
techGetLayerProp.desc: Returns the value of the specified layer property from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design.

techGetLayerRoutingDirections.name: techGetLayerRoutingDirections
techGetLayerRoutingDirections.desc: Returns a list of the layer routing directions for the routing layers in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetLayerRoutingGrid.name: techGetLayerRoutingGrid
techGetLayerRoutingGrid.desc: Returns the layer routing direction, pitch, and offset for the specified routing layer in the specified technology database.

techGetLayerRoutingGrids.name: techGetLayerRoutingGrids
techGetLayerRoutingGrids.desc: Returns the layer routing direction, pitch, and offset assigned to layers in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetLP.name: techGetLP
techGetLP.desc: Returns the database identifier of the specified layer-purpose pair specified in the current technology database.

techGetLPAttr.name: techGetLPAttr
techGetLPAttr.desc: Returns the list of attributes for the specified layer-purpose pair in the current technology database. The attributes (display priority, visibility, selectability, if the layer is visible when dragged, and validity) are defined in the techLayerPurposePriorities and techDisplays subsections of the ASCII technology file associated with the layer-purpose pair. If the layer-purpose pair does not exist, this function returns nil.

techGetLPPacketName.name: techGetLPPacketName
techGetLPPacketName.desc: Returns the name of the display packet defined for the specified layer-purpose pair in the current technology database. ASCII technology file location: techDisplays subsection of the ASCII technology file associated with the layer-purpose pair.

techGetLPPriorityInContext.name: techGetLPPriorityInContext
techGetLPPriorityInContext.desc: Gets the drawing priority of the specified layer-purpose pair in the effective technology database rooted at the specified technology database.

techGetLPProp.name: techGetLPProp
techGetLPProp.desc: Returns the value of the specified property from the specified LP. The techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section of the ASCII technology file specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design.

techGetLPsByPriority.name: techGetLPsByPriority
techGetLPsByPriority.desc: Returns a list of database identifiers of all layer-purpose pairs (LPPs) from the specified technology file, from the lowest to the highest priority.

techGetOrderLeLsw.name: techGetOrderLeLsw
techGetOrderLeLsw.syntax:
techGetOrderLeLsw(
t_techLibName
)
=> list( (t_layer t_purpose n_priority)...) / nil
techGetOrderLeLsw.desc: Returns the ordered list of layer-purpose pairs associated with the specified technology library as defined by the function techOrderLeLsw.

techGetOrderLPPriorityInContext.name: techGetOrderLPPriorityInContext
techGetOrderLPPriorityInContext.syntax:
techGetOrderLPPriorityInContext(
t_techLibName
)
=> list( (t_layer t_purpose n_priority)...) / nil
techGetOrderLPPriorityInContext.desc: Returns the ordered list of layer-purpose pairs associated with the specified technology library as defined by the function techOrderLPPriorityInContext.

techGetOuterViaLayers.name: techGetOuterViaLayers
techGetOuterViaLayers.desc: Given the via layer, or the middle layer of the via, returns the bottom and top layers used with the via layer in standard via definitions in the specified technology database.

techGetPurposeAbbrev.name: techGetPurposeAbbrev
techGetPurposeAbbrev.desc: Returns the abbreviation of the specified purpose from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data.

techGetPurposeName.name: techGetPurposeName
techGetPurposeName.desc: Returns the purpose name of the specified purpose number defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data.

techGetPurposeNum.name: techGetPurposeNum
techGetPurposeNum.desc: Returns the purpose number associated with the specified purpose name from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techPurposes subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layer purposes used with technology data.

techGetStampLabelLayers.name: techGetStampLabelLayers
techGetStampLabelLayers.desc: Returns a list of the stamp label layers defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: stampLabels subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetTrimLayerPairs.name: techGetTrimLayerPairs
techGetTrimLayerPairs.desc: Get list of layer pairs for given layer of trim material type.

techGetTwoLayerProp.name: techGetTwoLayerProp
techGetTwoLayerProp.syntax:
techGetTwoLayerProp(
d_techID
tx_layer1 
tx_layer2 
t_propName 
) 
=> g_propValue / nil
techGetTwoLayerProp.desc: Returns the value of the specified two-layer property from the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design.

techGetViaLayers.name: techGetViaLayers
techGetViaLayers.desc: Returns a list of the sets of layers used in the standard via definitions defined in the specified technology database.

techHasLayerAnalysisAttribute.name: techHasLayerAnalysisAttribute
techHasLayerAnalysisAttribute.syntax:
techHasLayerAnalysisAttribute(
d_techfileID
tx_layer
t_attributeName
) 
=> t / nil
techHasLayerAnalysisAttribute.desc: Checks if a specified attribute has been set for a layer with a layer function that supports attribute analysis.

techIsLPValidBase.name: techIsLPValidBase
techIsLPValidBase.desc: Returns boolean indication whether the layer-purpose pair valid attribute is true.

techIsViaLayer.name: techIsViaLayer
techIsViaLayer.desc: Indicates whether the specified layer is defined as the middle, or via, layer in one or more standard via definitions in the specified technology database.

techOrderLPPriorityInContext.name: techOrderLPPriorityInContext
techOrderLPPriorityInContext.desc: Defines the relative priority for a dynamic set of layer-purpose pairs (LPPs) to be drawn on the canvas. The larger the number, the higher the priority and the lower the LPP is in the list. The LPP with the highest priority is drawn on top of all other LPPs.

techSetEquivLayer.name: techSetEquivLayer
techSetEquivLayer.desc: Appends the specified set of equivalent layers to the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: equivalentLayers subsection in the layerRules section; it lists layers that represent the same kind of material.

techSetEquivLayers.name: techSetEquivLayers
techSetEquivLayers.desc: Updates the equivalentLayers subsection of the specified technology database with the specified set or sets of equivalent layers. ASCII technology file location: equivalentLayers subsection in the layerRules section; it lists layers that represent the same kind of material. If an equivalentLayers subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data. If the technology database already defines equivalent layers, this function deletes and replaces them with the specified data.

techSetLabelLayer.name: techSetLabelLayer
techSetLabelLayer.desc: Appends the specified label layer to the label layers list in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: labels subsection in the layerRules section; it lists label layers followed by their associated sets of layers of any type. If the label layer already has a specification in the labels subsection, this function replaces it with the new specification. If the labels subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetLabelLayers.name: techSetLabelLayers
techSetLabelLayers.desc: Replaces the label layers in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: labels subsection in the layerRules section; it lists label layers followed by their associated sets of layers of any type. If the labels subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data. If the labels subsection does exist, this function deletes and replaces it with the specified data.

techSetLayerAbbrev.name: techSetLayerAbbrev
techSetLayerAbbrev.syntax:
techSetLayerAbbrev(
d_techID
tx_layer 
t_layerAbbrev
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerAbbrev.desc: Updates the abbreviation of the specified layer in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techSetLayerAnalysisAttribute.name: techSetLayerAnalysisAttribute
techSetLayerAnalysisAttribute.syntax:
techSetLayerAnalysisAttribute(
d_techfileID
tx_layer
t_attributeName
g_attributeValue
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerAnalysisAttribute.desc: Sets a specified attribute value for a layer with a layer function that supports attribute analysis.

techSetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock.name: techSetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock
techSetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock.syntax:
techSetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock(
d_techID
s_analysisAttributeLockType
g_value
)
=> t / nil
techSetLayerAnalysisAttributeLock.desc: Sets a lock on layer analysis attributes for changes related to addition of new layers or updates to attributes.

techSetLayerFunction.name: techSetLayerFunction
techSetLayerFunction.syntax:
techSetLayerFunction( 
d_techID 
tx_layer
g_function
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerFunction.desc: When the specified layer is not already assigned a function (material), sets the function assignment in the specified technology database. If the layer is already assigned a function, techSetLayerFunction returns a message to that effect and does not update the technology database. ASCII technology file location: functions subsection in the layerRules section; it assigns functions to layers. If a functions subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetLayerFunctions.name: techSetLayerFunctions
techSetLayerFunctions.desc: When the specified layers are not already assigned functions (materials), sets the function assignments in the specified technology database. If any layer is already assigned a function, techSetLayerFunctions returns a message to that effect and does not change that function assignment, but does change the others. ASCII technology file location: functions subsection in the layerRules section; it assigns functions to layers. If a functions subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetLayerMaskNumber.name: techSetLayerMaskNumber
techSetLayerMaskNumber.syntax:
techSetLayerMaskNumber( 
d_techID 
tx_layer
x_maskNumber
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerMaskNumber.desc: Updates the mask number of the specified layer in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: functions subsection in the layerRules section; it assigns functions and mask numbers to layers.

techSetLayerMfgResolution.name: techSetLayerMfgResolution
techSetLayerMfgResolution.syntax:
techSetLayerMfgResolution(
d_techID 
tx_layer
g_value
)
=> t / nil
techSetLayerMfgResolution.desc: Sets or updates the layer manufacturing grid resolution to be applied to the specified layer in the specified technology specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgResolutions subsection in the layerRules section. If a mfgResolutions subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetLayerMfgResolutions.name: techSetLayerMfgResolutions
techSetLayerMfgResolutions.desc: Replaces the layer manufacturing grid resolution data in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: mfgResolutions subsection in the layerRules section. If a mfgResolutions subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetLayerName.name: techSetLayerName
techSetLayerName.syntax:
techSetLayerName(
d_techID
tx_layer
t_layerName 
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerName.desc: Updates the name of the specified layer in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayers subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it lists the layers that can be used.

techSetLayerProp.name: techSetLayerProp
techSetLayerProp.syntax:
techSetLayerProp(
d_techID
tx_layer 
l_propertyValue 
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerProp.desc: Updates the value of the specified layer property in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design. If the techLayerProperties subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data. If the property does not exist, the function creates a new layer property and sets the value to the specified value.

techSetLayerRoutingGrid.name: techSetLayerRoutingGrid
techSetLayerRoutingGrid.syntax:
techSetLayerRoutingGrid(
d_techID 
tx_layer
t_preferredDir
[ g_pitch [ g_offset ] ]
)
=> t / nil
techSetLayerRoutingGrid.desc: Updates the routing direction, pitch, and offset for the specified layer in the specified technology database. The pitch is the minimum allowable spacing, center-to-center, between two regular geometries on different nets. The offset is the distance between the placement grid and the routing grid when there is a routing grid between two placement grids.

techSetLayerRoutingGrids.name: techSetLayerRoutingGrids
techSetLayerRoutingGrids.desc: Replaces the layer routing direction, pitch, and offset for the specified layers in the specified technology database. The pitch is the minimum allowable spacing, center-to-center, between two regular geometries on different nets. The offset is the distance between the placement grid and the routing grid when there is a routing grid between two placement grids.

techSetLPAttr.name: techSetLPAttr
techSetLPAttr.desc: Updates layer attributes for the specified layer-purpose pair in the current technology database. The layer attributes are specified as a list and include the display priority, visibility, selectability, if the layer is visible when dragged, and validity. ASCII technology file location: techDisplays and techLayerPurposePriorities subsections of the layerDefinitions section.

techSetLPPacketName.name: techSetLPPacketName
techSetLPPacketName.desc: Updates the display packet assigned to the specified layer-purpose pair in the current technology database. ASCII technology file location: techDisplays subsection. The display packet must be defined in the display resource file before you can assign it.

techSetLPPriorityInContext.name: techSetLPPriorityInContext
techSetLPPriorityInContext.syntax:
techSetLPPriorityInContext(
d_tfId
d_techLPId
x_priority
) 
=> d_lppId / nil
techSetLPPriorityInContext.desc: Sets the drawing priority of a layer-purpose pair in an effective technology database. The larger the number, the higher the priority. The layer-purpose pair must exist in the graph rooted at the specified technology database; it does not need to exist locally in the specified technology database.

techSetStampLabelLayer.name: techSetStampLabelLayer
techSetStampLabelLayer.desc: Appends the specified stamp label layers to the label layers list in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: stampLabels subsection in the layerRules section; it lists label layers followed by their associated sets of layers of connected type. If the label layer already has a specification in the stampLabels subsection, this function replaces it with the new specification. If the stampLabels subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data.

techSetStampLabelLayers.name: techSetStampLabelLayers
techSetStampLabelLayers.desc: Replaces the specified stamp label layers in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: stampLabels subsection in the layerRules section; it lists label layers followed by their associated sets of layers of connected type. If the stampLabels subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data. If the stampLabels subsection does exist, this function deletes and replaces it with the specified data.

techSetTwoLayerProp.name: techSetTwoLayerProp
techSetTwoLayerProp.syntax:
techSetTwoLayerProp(
d_techID
tx_layer1 
tx_layer2 
l_propertyValue 
) 
=> t / nil
techSetTwoLayerProp.desc: Updates the value of the specified two-layer property in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: techLayerProperties subsection in the layerDefinitions section; it specifies special properties that you want to place on the layers in your design. If the techLayerProperties subsection does not exist, this function creates one with the specified data. If the property does not exist, the function creates a new two-layer property and sets the value to the specified value.

techSupportsLayerAnalysisAttributes.name: techSupportsLayerAnalysisAttributes
techSupportsLayerAnalysisAttributes.desc: Checks if the given layer has a function that supports layer analysis attributes.

techCreateSpacingRuleTable.name: techCreateSpacingRuleTable
techCreateSpacingRuleTable.syntax:
techCreateSpacingRuleTable( 
d_techID 
t_constraintName 
l_indexDefinitions 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techCreateSpacingRuleTable.desc: Creates a spacing table and indexes for the named constraint in the specified technology database. This new table does not overwrite an existing one. ASCII technology file location: spacingTables subsection in the foundry constraint group. To create table entries, use techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry. If a spacingTables subsection does not exist, this function creates one.

techGetOrderedSpacingRules.name: techGetOrderedSpacingRules
techGetOrderedSpacingRules.desc: Returns a list of all of the ordered spacing constraints defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: orderedSpacings subsection(s) in the foundry constraint group.

techGetSpacingRules.name: techGetSpacingRules
techGetSpacingRules.desc: Returns a list of the spacing constraints defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: spacings subsection(s) in the foundry constraint group.

techGetSpacingRuleTable.name: techGetSpacingRuleTable
techGetSpacingRuleTable.syntax:
techGetSpacingRuleTable(
d_techID 
t_constraintName 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> l_tables / nil
techGetSpacingRuleTable.desc: Returns the table data for the specified constraint defined in the specified technology database and applied to the specified layer or layers. ASCII technology file location: spacingTables subsection in the foundry constraint group.

techGetSpacingRuleTableEntry.name: techGetSpacingRuleTableEntry
techGetSpacingRuleTableEntry.syntax:
techGetSpacingRuleTableEntry( 
d_techID 
t_constraintName
g_index | l_index
tx_layer1
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> g_value / nil
techGetSpacingRuleTableEntry.desc: Returns the value of the table constraint in the specified technology database that (a) is in the foundry constraint group, (b) is applied to the specified layer or layers, and (c) is the value for the table entry with the specified index or indexes.

techGetSpacingRuleTables.name: techGetSpacingRuleTables
techGetSpacingRuleTables.desc: Returns a list of the spacing tables and the layers to which they apply as defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: spacingTables subsection in the foundry constraint group.

techGetViaStackLimit.name: techGetViaStackLimit
techGetViaStackLimit.desc: Returns the first viaStackingLimits constraint in the foundry constraint group in the specified technology database.

techGetViaStackLimits.name: techGetViaStackLimits
techGetViaStackLimits.desc: Returns a list of the stacked via limit data defined in the technology database. ASCII technology file location: foundry constraint group.

techSetViaStackLimits.name: techSetViaStackLimits
techSetViaStackLimits.desc: Updates the viaStackingLimits in the foundry constraint group in the specified technology database with one or more sets of viaStackingLimits data. This function updates the number for any layer range already in viaStackingLimits and adds a new entry for any layer range not already in viaStackingLimits. If a viaStackingLimits section does not already exist, this function creates one.

techSetOrderedSpacingRule.name: techSetOrderedSpacingRule
techSetOrderedSpacingRule.syntax:
techSetOrderedSpacingRule(
d_techID 
t_constraint 
g_value 
tx_layer1 
tx_layer2
) 
=> t / nil
techSetOrderedSpacingRule.desc: Updates the value of the constraint in the specified technology database that (a) is in the foundry constraint group, (b) is the first hard constraint with the specified name in an orderedSpacings subsection, and (c) is applied to the specified layers. If the specified constraint does not already exist, this function creates a new orderedSpacings section containing the constraint.

techSetSpacingRule.name: techSetSpacingRule
techSetSpacingRule.syntax:
techSetSpacingRule(
d_techID 
t_constraint 
g_value 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techSetSpacingRule.desc: Updates the value of the constraint in the specified technology database that (a) is in the foundry constraint group, (b) is the first hard constraint with the specified name in a spacings subsection, and (c) is applied to the specified layer or layers. If the specified constraint does not already exist, this function creates a new spacings section containing the constraint.

techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry.name: techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry
techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry.syntax:
techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry( 
d_techID 
t_constraintName
g_index | l_index
g_value
tx_layer1
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techSetSpacingRuleTableEntry.desc: Updates the specified spacing table in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: spacingTables subsection in the foundry constraint group. If the specified index or index pair is in the table, this function updates the value assigned. If the specified index or index pair is not in the table, this function adds an entry to the table with the specified data.

techSetViaStackLimit.name: techSetViaStackLimit
techSetViaStackLimit.syntax:
techSetViaStackLimit(
d_techID 
g_number
[ tx_bottomLayer tx_topLayer ]
)
=> t / nil
techSetViaStackLimit.desc: Updates a viaStackingLimits constraint in the foundry constraint group in the specified technology database with one set of via stack limit data. If the specified layer range is not already specified in the database, this function creates a new constraint with the data. If the viaStackingLimits subsection does not exist in the foundry constraint group, this function creates it with the specified data.

techCreateElectricalRuleTable.name: techCreateElectricalRuleTable
techCreateElectricalRuleTable.syntax:
techCreateElectricalRuleTable( 
d_techID 
t_constraintName 
l_indexDefinitions 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techCreateElectricalRuleTable.desc: Creates a current density table and indexes for the named layer attribute in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensityTables subsection of the layerRules section. To create table entries, use techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry. If a currentDensityTables subsection does not exist, this function creates one. If a current density table already exists for the named attribute applied to the specified layer or layers, this function replaces it; the original table entries are deleted.

techGetCurrentDensityRules.name: techGetCurrentDensityRules
techGetCurrentDensityRules.desc: Returns a list of the current density attributes for layers from the specified technology database.

techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable.name: techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable
techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable.syntax:
techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable(
d_techID
t_ruleTableName
tx_layer
)
=> l_currentDensityRuleTable / nil
techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable.desc: Returns the named current density attribute table for the specified layer in the specified technology database.

techGetCurrentDensityRuleTables.name: techGetCurrentDensityRuleTables
techGetCurrentDensityRuleTables.desc: Returns a list of the current density attribute tables for layers in the specified technology database.

techGetElectricalRules.name: techGetElectricalRules
techGetElectricalRules.desc: Returns a list of all of the current density layer attributes and antenna models constraints defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensity subsection of the layerRules section and the antennaModels section of the foundry constraint group.

techGetElectricalRuleTable.name: techGetElectricalRuleTable
techGetElectricalRuleTable.syntax:
techGetElectricalRuleTable( 
d_techID 
t_constraint 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> l_tables / nil
techGetElectricalRuleTable.desc: Returns the table data for the specified layer attribute defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensityTables subsection of the layerRules section. Preferred: Use techGetCurrentDensityRuleTable function.

techGetElectricalRuleTableEntry.name: techGetElectricalRuleTableEntry
techGetElectricalRuleTableEntry.syntax:
techGetElectricalRuleTableEntry( 
d_techID 
t_constraint
l_index
tx_layer1
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> g_value / nil
techGetElectricalRuleTableEntry.desc: Returns the value of the specified index in the specified current density table in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensityTables subsection of the layerRules section.

techGetElectricalRuleTables.name: techGetElectricalRuleTables
techGetElectricalRuleTables.desc: Returns a list of the current density tables defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensityTables subsection in the layerRules section. Preferred: Use techGetCurrentDensityRuleTables function.

techGetOrderedElectricalRules.name: techGetOrderedElectricalRules
techGetOrderedElectricalRules.desc: Returns a list of all of the ordered electrical constraints specified in the technology database. ASCII technology file location: orderedElectrical constraints in the foundry constraint group. This is a legacy section of the technology file used to store data converted from a technology file containing an obsolete subclass.

techSetElectricalRule.name: techSetElectricalRule
techSetElectricalRule.syntax:
techSetElectricalRule(
d_techID 
t_constraint 
g_value 
tx_layer1 
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techSetElectricalRule.desc: Updates the value of the layer attribute in the specified technology database that (a) is the first layer attribute with the specified name in a currentDensity subsection of the layerRules section, and (b) is applied to the specified layer or layers. If the specified attribute does not already exist, this function creates a new currentDensity subsection containing the layer attribute. You cannot update or add antennaModels constraints with this function.

techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry.name: techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry
techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry.syntax:
techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry( 
d_techID 
t_constraint
l_index
g_value
tx_layer1
[ tx_layer2 ]
) 
=> t / nil
techSetElectricalRuleTableEntry.desc: Updates the specified current density table in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: currentDensityTables subsection of the layerRules section. If the specified index or index pair is in the table, this function updates the value assigned. If the specified index or index pair is not in the table, this function adds an entry to the table with the specified data.

techSetOrderedElectricalRule.name: techSetOrderedElectricalRule
techSetOrderedElectricalRule.syntax:
techSetOrderedElectricalRule(
d_techID 
t_constraint 
g_value 
tx_layer1 
tx_layer2
) 
=> t / nil
techSetOrderedElectricalRule.desc: Updates the value of the first ordered electrical constraint for the specified layers in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: orderedElectrical subsection in the foundry constraint group. This is a legacy section of the technology file used to store data converted from a technology file containing the obsolete orderedCharacterizationRules subclass.

techSetPrRoutingLayers.name: techSetPrRoutingLayers
techSetPrRoutingLayers.desc: Updates the specified technology database to change or add the preferred routing direction for each of the specified layers. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection in the layerRules section.

techSetPrRoutingLayer.name: techSetPrRoutingLayer
techSetPrRoutingLayer.syntax:
techSetPrRoutingLayer(
d_techID 
tx_routingLayer 
t_direction
) 
=> t / nil
techSetPrRoutingLayer.desc: Updates the specified technology database to change or add the preferred routing direction for the specified layer. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection in the layerRules section.

techGetPrRoutingLayers.name: techGetPrRoutingLayers
techGetPrRoutingLayers.desc: Returns a list of layers and their preferred routing directions. In the ASCII technology file, the layers are defined in the validLayers constraint in the interconnect subsection of the LEFDefaultRouteSpec constraint group. The preferred routing directions of the layers are specified in the routingDirections subsection of the layerRules section.

techGetPrRoutingDirection.name: techGetPrRoutingDirection
techGetPrRoutingDirection.desc: Returns the direction assigned to the specified routing layer technology database. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection in the layerRules section.

techIsPrRoutingLayer.name: techIsPrRoutingLayer
techIsPrRoutingLayer.desc: Indicates whether the specified layer is a routing layer, assigned a routing direction in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: routingDirections subsection of the layerRules section.

techSetPrViaTypes.name: techSetPrViaTypes
techSetPrViaTypes.desc: Adds the specified via definitions for the specified cell and cellview to the list of valid vias for the specified constraint group in the specified technology database.

techSetPrViaType.name: techSetPrViaType
techSetPrViaType.syntax:
techSetPrViaType(
d_techID 
l_viaDef 
t_constraintGroupName
) 
=> t / nil
techSetPrViaType.desc: Adds the specified via definition to the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: validVias section of the specified constraint group.

techGetPrViaTypes.name: techGetPrViaTypes
techGetPrViaTypes.desc: Returns a list of the vias defined in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: validVias sections.

techGetPrViaType.name: techGetPrViaType
techGetPrViaType.desc: Returns all constraint groups in which the specified via definition is listed as a valid via in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: validVias section.

techIsPrViaDevice.name: techIsPrViaDevice
techIsPrViaDevice.desc: Indicates whether the specified via definition is listed in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: in any validVias section the specified technology file.

techSetPrStackVias.name: techSetPrStackVias
techSetPrStackVias.desc: Updates the specified technology database to mark the listed pairs of via layers stackable. ASCII technology file location: stackable subsection in the spacings section of the foundry constraint group for the specified via layer pairs.

techSetPrStackVia.name: techSetPrStackVia
techSetPrStackVia.syntax:
techSetPrStackVia(
d_techID 
tx_viaLayer1 
tx_viaLayer2
) 
=> t / nil
techSetPrStackVia.desc: Updates the specified technology database to mark the specified pair of via layers stackable in the foundry constraint group. If the stackable section does not already exist, this function creates it.

techGetPrStackVias.name: techGetPrStackVias
techGetPrStackVias.desc: Returns a list of the via layer pairs defined as stackable in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: stackable in the foundry constraint group of specified technology file.

techIsPrStackVia.name: techIsPrStackVia
techIsPrStackVia.syntax:
techIsPrStackVia(
d_techID 
tx_viaLayer1 
tx_viaLayer2
) 
=> t / nil
techIsPrStackVia.desc: Indicates whether the specified via layer pair is defined as stackable in the specified technology database. ASCII technology file location: foundry constraint group.

techSetPrMastersliceLayers.name: techSetPrMastersliceLayers
techSetPrMastersliceLayers.desc:
Verifies that the specified layers in the specified technology database are valid masterslice layers. A masterslice layer is any layer that meets both of the following conditions:

1. The layer is explicitly assigned one of the following functions: nwell, pwell, ndiff, pdiff, or poly. ASCII technology file location: in the functions subsection of the layerRules section.

techSetMPPTemplate.name: techSetMPPTemplate
techSetMPPTemplate.syntax:
techSetMPPTemplate(
		( 	d_techID
			t_mppTemplateName
			l_template
		) ;end of template
		) ;end of techSetMPPTemplate

		; l_template arguments
		(
			l_masterPathArgs
			[l_offsetSubpathArgs...]
			[l_enclosureSubpathArgs...]
			[l_subrectangleArgs...]
		) ; end of template argument lists

		; l_masterPathArgs
		(
			txl_layer
			[n_width]
			[g_choppable]
			[t_endType]
			[n_beginExt]
			[n_endExt]
			[t_justification]
			[n_offset]
			[l_rodConnectivityArgs for master path]
		) ;end of masterPathArgs list

		; l_offsetSubpathArgs
		(
			(
				txl_layer
				[n_width]
				[g_choppable]
				[n_sep]
				[t_justification]
				[n_beginOffset]
				[n_endOffset]
				[l_rodConnectivityArgs for offset subpath]
			) ; end of first offset subpath list
			...
		) ; end of all offset subpath lists

		; l_enclosureSubpathArgs
		(
			(
				txl_layer
				[n_enclosure]
				[g_choppable]
				[n_beginOffset]
				[n_endOffset]
				[l_rodConnectivityArgs for enclosure subpath]
			) ; end of first enclosure subpath list
			...
		) ; end of all enclosure subpath lists

		; l_subRectangleArgs
		(
			(
				txl_layer
				[n_width]
				[n_length]
				[g_choppable]
				[n_sep]
				[t_justification]
				[n_space]
				[n_beginOffset]
				[n_endOffset]
				[n_gap]
				[l_rodConnectivityArgs for subrectangles]
				[n_beginSegmentOffset]
				[n_endSegmentOffset]

			) ; end of first subrectangle list
			...
		) ; end of all subrectangle lists

		; l_rodConnectivityArgs
		(
			[t_termIOType]
			[g_pin]
			[tl_pinAccessDir]
			[g_pinLabel]
			[n_pinLabelHeight]
			[txl_pinLabelLayer]
			[t_pinLabelJust]
			[t_pinLabelFont]
			[g_pinLabelDrafting]
			[t_pinLabelOrient]
			[t_pinLabelRefHandle]
			[l_pinLabelOffsetPoint]
		) ; end of ROD Connectivity Argument list
techSetMPPTemplate.desc: Defines a single template in your technology library in virtual memory that specifies a relative object design (ROD) multipart path (MPP). A multipart path is a single ROD object consisting of one or more parts at level zero in the hierarchy on the same or on different layers. The purpose of an MPP template is to let you create MPPs in layout cellviews using predefined values from your technology library. You can define any number of MPP templates in your technology library; each template must be identified by a unique template name (t_mppTemplateName).

If the layer display in the Palette assistant is currently controlled by leLswLayers, the list of layers is accordingly updated.

techSetLeLswLayer.name: techSetLeLswLayer
techSetLeLswLayer.desc: Appends the specified layer-purpose pair at the end of the layer display definition in the leLswLayers subsection of the leRules section in the specified technology database. If the leRules section and the leLswLayers subsection do not exist, they are created with the specified data. If the layer display in the Palette assistant is currently controlled by leLswLayers, the list of layers is updated with the new layer-purpose pair.

techGetLeLswLayers.name: techGetLeLswLayers
techGetLeLswLayers.desc: Returns the leLswLayers layers from the technology database identified by techID, if found. If leLswLayers is not found in the technology database identified by techID, the function searches any open technology databases in the graph for leLswLayers and returns the first set that is found. The function does not open any technology databases that are explicitly closed.

techIsLeLswLayer.name: techIsLeLswLayer
techIsLeLswLayer.desc: Indicates whether the specified layer-purpose pair is listed in the layer display definition in the leLswLayers subsection of the leRules section in the specified technology database.

drDeleteDisplay.name: drDeleteDisplay
drDeleteDisplay.desc: Deletes the specified display device. You can use the drLoadDrf SKILL function to load a file containing this function.

drDeleteColor.name: drDeleteColor
drDeleteColor.desc: Deletes the definition of the specified color for the specified display device from virtual memory. The program does not check to see if any other definitions use this display device.

drDeleteLineStyle.name: drDeleteLineStyle
drDeleteLineStyle.desc: Deletes the specified line style from virtual memory. The program does not check to see if any of the packet definitions use this line style.

drDeletePacket.name: drDeletePacket
drDeletePacket.desc: Deletes the definition of the specified packet for the specified display device from virtual memory. The program does not check to see if any layer definitions use this packet.

drDeleteStipple.name: drDeleteStipple
drDeleteStipple.desc: Deletes the definition of the specified stipple for the specified display device from virtual memory. The program does not check to see if any of the packet definitions use this stipple.

drDumpDrf.name: drDumpDrf
drDumpDrf.desc: Dumps all of the display resource data from virtual memory or only the changes made in virtual memory into a file.

drFindPacket.name: drFindPacket
drFindPacket.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns a list of attributes of the specified packet for the specified display device.

drGetActiveDisplayDrf.name: drGetActiveDisplayDrf
drGetActiveDisplayDrf.desc: Displays the absolute path of the currently active display resource file display.drf.

drGetColor.name: drGetColor
drGetColor.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the display device name, color name, and the red, green, blue, and blink values for the color.

drGetDisplay.name: drGetDisplay
drGetDisplay.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the display device identifier for the specified display device name.

drGetDisplayIdList.name: drGetDisplayIdList
drGetDisplayIdList.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns a complete list of display device identifiers.

drGetDisplayName.name: drGetDisplayName
drGetDisplayName.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the display device name of the specified display device identifier.

drGetDisplayNameList.name: drGetDisplayNameList
drGetDisplayNameList.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns a complete list of display device names.

drGetLineStyle.name: drGetLineStyle
drGetLineStyle.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the display device name and the line style name, thickness, and pattern.

drGetLineStyleIndexByName.name: drGetLineStyleIndexByName
drGetLineStyleIndexByName.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the line style index number for the specified line style for the specified display device.

drGetPacket.name: drGetPacket
drGetPacket.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the definition of the specified display packet for the specified display device.

drGetPacketList.name: drGetPacketList
drGetPacketList.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns a list of the names of all of the display packets defined for the specified display device.

drGetPacketAlias.name: drGetPacketAlias
drGetPacketAlias.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns a list of packets that are aliased to the specified packet.

drGetPacketFillStyle.name: drGetPacketFillStyle
drGetPacketFillStyle.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the fill style number of the specified packet for the specified display device.

drGetStipple.name: drGetStipple
drGetStipple.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the display device name and the stipple name, width, height, and pattern.

drGetStippleIndexByName.name: drGetStippleIndexByName
drGetStippleIndexByName.desc: Reads virtual memory and returns the stipple index number.

drLoadDrf.name: drLoadDrf
drLoadDrf.desc: Loads the display resource file (usually named display.drf) from any location.

drSetPacket.name: drSetPacket
drSetPacket.syntax:
drSetPacket( 
tx_display 
t_packetName
t_stippleName 
t_lineStyleName
t_fillColorName 
t_outlineColorName
[ t_fillStyle ]
) 
=> t / nil
drSetPacket.desc: Updates the value of the specified packet for the specified display device in virtual memory.

techGetIntegrationColorModel.name: techGetIntegrationColorModel
techGetIntegrationColorModel.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Returns the value of the integration color model constraint for the current technology file. Possible return values are any or locked.

techGetLayerNumColorMasks.name: techGetLayerNumColorMasks
techGetLayerNumColorMasks.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Returns the number of allowed color masks on the layer, if coloring is supported on it.

techGetStdViaDefCutColoring.name: techGetStdViaDefCutColoring
techGetStdViaDefCutColoring.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Returns the cut coloring pattern to use for the cut patterns created for this type of stdVia.

techGetTechCutColoring.name: techGetTechCutColoring
techGetTechCutColoring.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard)(Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Returns the default cut coloring pattern to use for the cut patterns created for all of the StdVias defined in the technology file. The default checkerboard pattern is returned if the cutPattern coloring is not explicitly specified.

techIsStdViaDefCutColoringSet.name: techIsStdViaDefCutColoringSet
techIsStdViaDefCutColoringSet.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Returns a boolean value indicating whether the cut coloring pattern was explicitly set on the specified stdViaDef.

techSetIntegrationColorModel.name: techSetIntegrationColorModel
techSetIntegrationColorModel.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Sets the value of the integration color model constraint for the current technology file. Valid values for the integration color model are any or locked.

techSetLayerNumColorMasks.name: techSetLayerNumColorMasks
techSetLayerNumColorMasks.syntax:
techSetLayerNumColorMasks( 
d_techfile_Id
xt_layer 
x_numColorMasks
) 
=> t / nil
techSetLayerNumColorMasks.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Assigns the number of allowed color masks on the specified layer. 0, 2, and 3 are valid numbers that can be set. This function does not allow you to set the attribute on a DFII system-reserved layer.

techSetStdViaDefCutColoring.name: techSetStdViaDefCutColoring
techSetStdViaDefCutColoring.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Sets the cut coloring pattern to use for the cut patterns created for the specified type of stdVia.

techSetTechCutColoring.name: techSetTechCutColoring
techSetTechCutColoring.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Sets the default cut coloring pattern to use for the cut patterns created for all stdVias defined in the technology file.

techManagerOpenTechToolBox.name: techManagerOpenTechToolBox
techManagerOpenTechToolBox.desc: Opens the Technology Tool Box form. It is equivalent to the CIW Tools - Technology File Manager command.

techManagerOpenDisplayToolBox.name: techManagerOpenDisplayToolBox
techManagerOpenDisplayToolBox.desc: Opens the Display Resources Tool Box. It is equivalent to the CIW Tools - Display Resource Manager command.

tcDisplayNewTechForm.name: tcDisplayNewTechForm
tcDisplayNewTechForm.desc: Opens the New Technology Library form. It is equivalent to clicking the New command in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcNewLibDisplayRefTechForm.name: tcNewLibDisplayRefTechForm
tcNewLibDisplayRefTechForm.desc: Opens the Reference Existing Technology Libraries form that displays the reference technology file library choices for the newly created technology library with the specified name.

tcDisplayTechGraphForm.name: tcDisplayTechGraphForm
tcDisplayTechGraphForm.desc: Opens the Technology Database Graph form. It is equivalent to clicking the Graph button in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcDisplayAttachTechForm.name: tcDisplayAttachTechForm
tcDisplayAttachTechForm.desc: Opens the Attach Technology Library to Design Library form. It is equivalent to clicking the Attach button in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcDisplayLoadTechForm.name: tcDisplayLoadTechForm
tcDisplayLoadTechForm.desc: Opens the Load Technology File form. It is equivalent to clicking the Load button in the Technology Tool Box form. It is also equivalent to the tcDisplayCompTechForm SKILL function.

tcDisplayCompTechForm.name: tcDisplayCompTechForm
tcDisplayCompTechForm.desc: Opens the Load Technology File form. It is equivalent to clicking the Load button in the Technology Tool Box form. It is also equivalent to the tcDisplayLoadTechForm SKILL function.

tcDisplayDumpTechForm.name: tcDisplayDumpTechForm
tcDisplayDumpTechForm.desc: Opens the Dump Technology File form. It is equivalent to clicking the Dump button in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcDisplayDiscardTechForm.name: tcDisplayDiscardTechForm
tcDisplayDiscardTechForm.desc: Opens the Discard Edits To Technology File form. It is equivalent to clicking the Discard button in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcDisplaySaveTechForm.name: tcDisplaySaveTechForm
tcDisplaySaveTechForm.desc: Opens the Save Technology File form. It is equivalent to clicking the Save button in the Technology Tool Box form.

tcQcInstallDevices.name: tcQcInstallDevices
tcQcInstallDevices.desc: Opens the Install Device form. This is equivalent to clicking the Install Device button in the Technology Tool Box form.

dreInvokeDre.name: dreInvokeDre
dreInvokeDre.desc: Opens the Display Resource Editor form. It is equivalent to clicking the Edit button in the Display Resources Tool Box.

techCreateSnapPatternDef.name: techCreateSnapPatternDef
techCreateSnapPatternDef.syntax:
techCreateSnapPatternDef(
d_techFileId
