=> d_snapPatternDefId / nil
techCreateSnapPatternDef.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Creates a snapPatternDef by using the specified parameters.

techDeleteSnapPatternDef.name: techDeleteSnapPatternDef
techDeleteSnapPatternDef.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Deletes the specified snapPatternDef object.

techFindSnapPatternDefByLP.name: techFindSnapPatternDefByLP
techFindSnapPatternDefByLP.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Finds a snapPatternDef in the current technology database by layer or purpose.

techFindSnapPatternDefByName.name: techFindSnapPatternDefByName
techFindSnapPatternDefByName.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Standard) Finds a snapPatternDef in the current technology database by name.

techCreateWidthSpacingPattern.name: techCreateWidthSpacingPattern
techCreateWidthSpacingPattern.syntax:
techCreateWidthSpacingPattern(
d_techFileId
t_name
l_patternSpecs
[ g_offset ]
[ b_repeatOffset ]
[ b_shiftColor ]
[ t_allowedRepeatMode ]
[ t_defaultRepeatMode ]
)
=> d_WidthSpacingPatternId / nil
techCreateWidthSpacingPattern.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified technology file.

techCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.name: techCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.syntax:
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor(
d_techFileId
t_name
l_patternSpecs
t_startingColor
[ g_offset ]
[ b_repeatOffset ]
[ t_allowedRepeatMode ]
[ t_defaultRepeatMode ]
)
=> d_WidthSpacingPatternId / nil
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternWithColor.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Creates a width spacing pattern in the specified technology file. This function requires you to specify the color for only the first track, referred to as the starting color. All other tracks are colored automatically by shifting colors.

techDeleteWidthSpacingPattern.name: techDeleteWidthSpacingPattern
techDeleteWidthSpacingPattern.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Deletes the specified width spacing pattern.

techFindWidthSpacingPattern.name: techFindWidthSpacingPattern
techFindWidthSpacingPattern.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern with the specified name in the specified technology file or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database.

techGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatM.name: techGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatMode
techGetWidthSpacingPatternAllowedRepeatM.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns the allowed repeat mode set for a width spacing pattern.

techGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatM.name: techGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatMode
techGetWidthSpacingPatternDefaultRepeatM.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns the default repeat mode set for a width spacing pattern.

techGetWidthSpacingPatterns.name: techGetWidthSpacingPatterns
techGetWidthSpacingPatterns.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns a list of all the width spacing pattern IDs in the specified technology file or in ITDB graph of the specified technology database.

techSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.name: techSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode
techSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.syntax:
techSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode(
d_wspId 
t_allowedRepeatMode 
t_defaultRepeatMode
) 
=> t / nil
techSetWidthSpacingPatternRepeatMode.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Sets the allowed and default repeat modes for a width spacing pattern.

techCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.name: techCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.syntax:
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup(
d_techFileId
t_name
l_patternNames
)
=> d_WidthSpacingPatternGroupId / nil
techCreateWidthSpacingPatternGroup.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Creates a group of width spacing patterns in the specified technology file.

techDeleteWidthSpacingPatternGroup.name: techDeleteWidthSpacingPatternGroup
techDeleteWidthSpacingPatternGroup.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Deletes the specified width spacing pattern group.

techFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup.name: techFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup
techFindWidthSpacingPatternGroup.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Searches for the width spacing pattern group with the specified name in the specified technology file or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database.

techGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups.name: techGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups
techGetWidthSpacingPatternGroups.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns a list of all the width spacing pattern group IDs in the specified technology file.

techCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.name: techCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
techCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.syntax:
techCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef(

t_defaultPatternName
l_snappingLayers
[ g_offset ]
[ l_patternNames ]
[ l_patternGroupNames ]
[ g_gridType ]
)
=> d_widthSpacingSnapPatternDefId / nil
techCreateWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object in the specified technology file.

techDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.name: techDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
techDeleteWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Deletes the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object.

techGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP.name: techGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP
techGetWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefsByLP.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Retrieves from the specified technology file a list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs defined in a layer-purpose pair.

techFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName.name: techFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName
techFindWidthSpacingSnapPatternDefByName.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Searches for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef object with the specified name in the specified technology file or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database.

techCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.name: techCreateRelatedSnapPatterns
techCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.syntax:
techCreateRelatedSnapPatterns(
d_techFileId
t_name
l_relatedSnapPatterns
[l_extraLPP]   
[f_regionSnapPitchHorizontal]    
[f_regionSnapPitchVertical]
)
=> d_techRelatedSnapPatternsId / nil
techCreateRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Creates a group of related snap patterns in the specified technology file.

techDeleteRelatedSnapPatterns.name: techDeleteRelatedSnapPatterns
techDeleteRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Deletes the specified set of related snap patterns.

techFindRelatedSnapPatterns.name: techFindRelatedSnapPatterns
techFindRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Searches for the related snap patterns group with the specified name in the specified technology file or a referenced technology database in an ITDB graph of the specified technology database.

techGetRelatedSnapPatterns.name: techGetRelatedSnapPatterns
techGetRelatedSnapPatterns.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns a list of all related snap pattern IDs in the specified technology file.

techGetTrimLayer.name: techGetTrimLayer
techGetTrimLayer.syntax:
techGetTrimLayer(
d_techFileID 
tx_layer 
[ t_color t_colorState ] 
) 
=> l_trimLayer / nil
techGetTrimLayer.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns the trim layer that trims tx_layer (metal or poly layer) with the specified color and color state combination. If only d_techFileID and tx_layer are specified, it returns a list of trim layers that trim tx_layer for all valid color and color state combinations.

techGetTrimLayers.name: techGetTrimLayers
techGetTrimLayers.syntax:
techGetTrimLayers(
d_techFileID 
tx_layer 
[ t_color t_colorState ] 
) 
=> l_trimLayers / nil
techGetTrimLayers.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns a list of the trim layers that trim tx_layer (metal or poly layer) with the specified color and color state combination. If only d_techFileID and tx_layer are specified, it returns a list of the trim layers that trim tx_layer for all valid color and color state combinations. If all arguments are specified, it returns a list of the trim layers that trim tx_layer for the specified color and color state combinations.

techGetTrimmedLayers.name: techGetTrimmedLayers
techGetTrimmedLayers.syntax:
techGetTrimmedLayers(
d_techFileID 
tx_layer 
[ t_color t_colorState ] 
) 
=> l_trimmedLayers / nil
techGetTrimmedLayers.desc: (Virtuoso Advanced Node for Layout Only) Returns a list of metal or poly layers trimmed by tx_layer with the specified color and color state combination. If only d_techFileID and tx_layer are specified, it returns a list of metal or poly layers trimmed by tx_layer for all valid color and color state combinations.

techCreateFingerDef.name: techCreateFingerDef
techCreateFingerDef.syntax:
techCreateFingerDef(
d_techFileID 
t_name
l_typeSpec
)
=> d_fdID / nil
techCreateFingerDef.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a finger definition in the specified technology file.

techCreateWireProfile.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a wire profile object in the specified technology file.

techCreateWireProfileGroup(

l_wireProfileNames
[?vendor t_vendor ]

techCreateWireProfileGroup.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a wire profile group object in the specified technology file.

techDeleteFingerDef.name: techDeleteFingerDef
techDeleteFingerDef.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Deletes a specified finger definition.

techDeleteWireProfile.name: techDeleteWireProfile
techDeleteWireProfile.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Deletes a specified wire profile.

techDeleteWireProfileGroup.name: techDeleteWireProfileGroup
techDeleteWireProfileGroup.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Deletes a specified wire profile group.

techFindFingerDef.name: techFindFingerDef
techFindFingerDef.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns the ID of a specified finger definition, if located in a specified technology file.

techFindWireProfile.name: techFindWireProfile
techFindWireProfile.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns the ID of a specified wire profile name, if located in a specified technology file.

techFindWireProfileGroup.name: techFindWireProfileGroup
techFindWireProfileGroup.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Returns the ID of a specified wire profile group name, if located in a specified technology file.

techImportWireProfileSet.name: techImportWireProfileSet
techImportWireProfileSet.syntax:
techImportWireProfileSet(
d_techID
x_fileName
t_groupName
)
=> t / nil
techImportWireProfileSet.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Imports wire profile data from an XML file into a technology database. If a profile already exists in the technology database, it is overwritten with the profile specified in the XML file.

techExportWireProfileSet.name: techExportWireProfileSet
techExportWireProfileSet.desc: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Exports wire profile data from a technology database into an XML file. You can export either all profiles in the technology database or only those that are in a particular group. Default values are not exported.

absImportGDS.name: absImportGDS
absImportGDS.desc: Creates cellviews from GDSII layout data.

absImportLogical.name: absImportLogical
absImportLogical.desc: Creates cellviews from existing logical information, typically represented in LIB or Verilog formats.

absImportCTLF.name: absImportCTLF
absImportCTLF.desc: Creates cellviews from CTLF logical data.

absImportVerilog.name: absImportVerilog
absImportVerilog.desc: Creates cellviews from Verilog logical data.

absImportOptions.name: absImportOptions
absImportOptions.desc: Loads a previous session's saved options file from the specified location.

absExportLEF.name: absExportLEF
absExportLEF.desc: Generates LEF files for cells in one or more bins. All exported LEF data is contained in the LEF filename.

absExportReport.name: absExportReport
absExportReport.desc: Outputs a summary of the cells in your library to a report file.

absExportOptions.name: absExportOptions
absExportOptions.desc: Save the options settings for the current session to a specified location.

absGetLibrary.name: absGetLibrary
absGetLibrary.desc: Returns the name of the current library.

absSetLibrary.name: absSetLibrary
absSetLibrary.desc: Specifies the library that you want to process through Abstract Generator. This involves either creating a new library and setting into it or setting into an existing library.

absAttachTechLib.name: absAttachTechLib
absAttachTechLib.desc: Attaches the named technology library to the current library.

absSelect.name: absSelect
absSelect.desc: Selects cells according to the specified options.

absSelectAllBins.name: absSelectAllBins
absSelectAllBins.desc: Selects all the bins in the current library.

absSelectCells.name: absSelectCells
absSelectCells.desc: Selects all cells in the selected bins.

absSelectBin.name: absSelectBin
absSelectBin.desc: Selects the named bin. This makes the specified bin current for use with other functions.

absSelectBinFrom.name: absSelectBinFrom
absSelectBinFrom.desc: Selects a range of bins. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bins pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are selected.

absGetSelectedCells.name: absGetSelectedCells
absGetSelectedCells.desc: Returns the list of cells selected in the Cell pane. The cells might belong to different bins.

absSelectCellFrom.name: absSelectCellFrom
absSelectCellFrom.desc: Selects a range of cells. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are selected.

absSelectCellsInList.name: absSelectCellsInList
absSelectCellsInList.desc: Selects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

absDeselectCells.name: absDeselectCells
absDeselectCells.desc: Deselects all cells in the current bins.

absDeselectBinFrom.name: absDeselectBinFrom
absDeselectBinFrom.desc: Deselects a range of bins. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bin pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are deselected.

absDeselectCellFrom.name: absDeselectCellFrom
absDeselectCellFrom.desc: Deselects a range of cells. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are deselected.

absDeselectCellsInList.name: absDeselectCellsInList
absDeselectCellsInList.desc: Deselects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

absGetBins.name: absGetBins
absGetBins.desc: Displays the list of available bins. The list returned includes the five system bins as well as the user bins, if any.

absGetBinType.name: absGetBinType
absGetBinType.desc: Returns the type of the bin passed as an argument. Both system and user bins can be specified as arguments.

absGetSelectedBins.name: absGetSelectedBins
absGetSelectedBins.desc: Returns the list of bins selected in the Bin pane. The order of the bins in the list matches the order in which they appear in the Bin pane.

absMoveSelectedCellsToBin.name: absMoveSelectedCellsToBin
absMoveSelectedCellsToBin.desc: Moves any currently selected cells to a named bin. This can be one of the five system bins or a user-defined bin.

absRenameBin.name: absRenameBin
absRenameBin.desc: Renames a previously created user bin.

absNewBin.name: absNewBin
absNewBin.desc: Creates a new user bin to store library cells.

absDeleteBin.name: absDeleteBin
absDeleteBin.desc: Deletes the named user bin. You cannot delete a system bin.

absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo.name: absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo
absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo.desc: Deletes a named user bin and moves any cells in that bin to another specified bin.

absCopyBinOptions.name: absCopyBinOptions
absCopyBinOptions.desc: Copies bin option settings from one bin to another.

absGetOption.name: absGetOption
absGetOption.desc: Returns the value of the specified global option.

absSetOption.name: absSetOption
absSetOption.desc: Sets values for all abstract generator global options. The SKILL function to apply the absSetOption settings is run after the absSetOption function has been set.

absGetBinOption.name: absGetBinOption
absGetBinOption.desc: Returns the value of a specified option in a given bin.

absSetBinOption.name: absSetBinOption
absSetBinOption.syntax:
absSetBinOption(
bin
option
value
)
=> t / nil
absSetBinOption.desc: Sets a value for a specified option in a specified bin.

absPins.name: absPins
absPins.desc: Runs the Pins step for the selected cells and creates a pins view for those cells based on options set using absSetBinOption.

absExtract.name: absExtract
absExtract.desc: Runs connectivity extraction for the selected cells and creates an extracted view for these cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

absAbstract.name: absAbstract
absAbstract.desc: Runs the Abstract step for selected cells and creates an abstract view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

absVerify.name: absVerify
absVerify.desc: Runs the Verify step for selected cells and creates a verify view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

absGetCellProp.name: absGetCellProp
absGetCellProp.desc: Returns the specified property value for a cell.

absSetCellProp.name: absSetCellProp
absSetCellProp.desc: Specifies a property value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property.

absGetTerminalProp.name: absGetTerminalProp
absGetTerminalProp.desc: Returns the value of the specified property for the specified terminal. Specify only cells that have already been processed by absPins. The Pins step generates the cell terminals.

absSetTerminalProp.name: absSetTerminalProp
absSetTerminalProp.syntax:
absSetTerminalProp(
cell
terminal
property { direction | termType | shape | netExpr | suppSensitivity | groundSensitivity }
value
)
=> 0 / 1
absSetTerminalProp.desc: Specifies a terminal value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property setting.

absDisableUpdate.name: absDisableUpdate
absDisableUpdate.desc: Both the absDisableUpdate and absEnableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by Abstract Generator into the record file.

absDistributeCells.name: absDistributeCells
absDistributeCells.desc: Distributes cells between bins according to the options set.

absEnableUpdate.name: absEnableUpdate
absEnableUpdate.desc: Both the absEnableUpdate and absDisableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by Abstract Generator into the record file.

absRevalidateSelectedCells.name: absRevalidateSelectedCells
absRevalidateSelectedCells.desc: Revalidates all invalid views for cells selected in the Cell pane. If the view has an error or warning, this remains. The view status is no longer grayed out.

absSort.name: absSort
absSort.desc: Sets sort criteria for those cells in the current bin.

absVersion.name: absVersion
absVersion.desc: Returns version, build, and operating system information.

iagCreateMenuItem.name: iagCreateMenuItem
iagCreateMenuItem.desc: Creates a custom menu item with the user-specified name and adds it to the integrated Abstract Generator. The menu is created if it is not already available, and the menu item is added under it. Function name is the callback procedure for the menu item.

iagGenAbstract.name: iagGenAbstract
iagGenAbstract.syntax:
iagGenAbstract(
t_libName
l_cellNames
t_viewName
t_binName
t_optionsFilePath
)
=> t / nil
iagGenAbstract.desc: Runs Integrated Abstract Generator on the specified cellviews with the given settings.

annToggleInfoBalloonVisibilityStatus.name: annToggleInfoBalloonVisibilityStatus
annToggleInfoBalloonVisibilityStatus.desc: Toggles the visibility of the annotation balloons on the schematic canvas. Also, displays and removes the pinned balloons on all open schematic windows.

annPinCurrentInfoBalloon.name: annPinCurrentInfoBalloon
annPinCurrentInfoBalloon.desc: Pins the current unpinned annotation balloon on the specified schematic window.

cdsName.name: cdsName
cdsName.desc: The cdsName function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsName is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available. The cdsName will display label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing7, near the cell name or instance name.

cdsNetExpr.name: cdsNetExpr
cdsNetExpr.desc: The cdsNetExpr function is used inside the ILLabel that is created using the Create - Net Expression command. This function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsNetExpr is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available.

cdsParam.name: cdsParam
cdsParam.desc: The cdsParam function displays label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing, about the parameter values or backannotated parameter values. This function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsParam is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available.

cdsTerm.name: cdsTerm
cdsTerm.desc: The function cdsTerm displays label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing8, near the pin or a net attached to the pin. It is also attached to a cell symbol view when you use the Add Symbol Label form, and the Annotation Setup Form is used to control the display of this label type.

heHiEditConfig.name: heHiEditConfig
heHiEditConfig.desc: Opens the hierarchy editor if the current editing window has a design opened within the context of a configuration.

heHiSetInstBinding.name: heHiSetInstBinding
heHiSetInstBinding.desc: Sets the instance bindings of an instance in a cellview of open configurations. The form associated with this function is updated with current binding information. The new bindings are communicated to the hierarchy editor.

heHiShowViewsFound.name: heHiShowViewsFound
heHiShowViewsFound.desc: Shows the current view being used for each instance in a form.

heHiUpdate.name: heHiUpdate
heHiUpdate.desc: Updates the information in the hierarchy editor after you edit the configuration.

schAddSelectPt.name: schAddSelectPt
schAddSelectPt.desc: Selects the object under the cursor. Maintains the selected set and adds the object to the selected set. Usable when editing schematics. Is equivalent to the Graphics Editor mouseAddSelectPt function. Provides other functions with the identity of the most recently selected object, which is required for extended selection.

schDirectEdit.name: schDirectEdit
schDirectEdit.desc: Directly edits or manipulates the object under the cursor. Usable when editing schematics and symbols.

schExtendSelectPt.name: schExtendSelectPt
schExtendSelectPt.desc: Extends the selection of the object under the current cursor position by selecting objects around the current object. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiAbout.name: schHiAbout
schHiAbout.desc: Opens the product information window, which indicates the schematic editor release number and copyright information.

schHiAlternateView.name: schHiAlternateView
schHiAlternateView.desc: Changes the view name of a single component by toggling through the list of possible views. Usable only while editing a schematic cellview. Operates on one instance at a time.

schHiAlign.name: schHiAlign
schHiAlign.desc: Aligns the objects on the canvas. If the objects are already selected on the canvas, the pre-select mode is used; otherwise, the post-select mode is used for aligning the objects.

schHiCellViewProperty.name: schHiCellViewProperty
schHiCellViewProperty.desc: Displays the options form showing the properties for the current cellview. Usable only when editing schematic or symbol cellviews.

schHiChangeEditMode.name: schHiChangeEditMode
schHiChangeEditMode.desc: Sets the mode for the design in the current window to read or append. The mode is the same as that supplied to dbOpenCellViewByType.

schHiCheck.name: schHiCheck
schHiCheck.desc: Checks the connectivity of a schematic and optionally starts the schematic rules checker (SRC) or the cross-view checker (VIC). Usable only when editing schematics. A dialog box shows the total number of errors and warnings detected when the function is complete. The schematic can be read-only or editable.

schHiCheckAndSave.name: schHiCheckAndSave
schHiCheckAndSave.desc: Performs the checks specified by the check options and saves the schematic to disk under the same cell name and view name, and in the same library. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCheckHier.name: schHiCheckHier
schHiCheckHier.desc: Performs the specified checks on the current schematic and the hierarchy below it. Also updates the connectivity as needed and runs the schematic rules checker (SRC), the cross-view checker (VIC), or both. Usable only when editing schematics. Only processes schematics found in the hierarchy starting from the current cellview. The view name list used to control the traversal is taken from the window in which the function is run.

schHiCloneSymbol.name: schHiCloneSymbol
schHiCloneSymbol.desc: Copies graphics from an existing symbol library into the symbol design you are currently editing. Usable only when editing symbols. If you do not specify any argument, the options form appears and prompts you for the values of these fields.

schHiComputePinRef.name: schHiComputePinRef
schHiComputePinRef.syntax:
schHiComputePinRef( 
[ ?reportFile t_reportFile ] 
[ ?display t_display ] 
[ ?formatString t_formatString ]
[ ?reportDups t_reportDups ] 
[ ?sortByDir t_sortByDir ] 
)
=> t
schHiComputePinRef.desc: Displays the Cross-Reference Options form for current index or sheet schematic, which computes, stores, and lists zone references for all pins and offsheet connectors in a multisheet schematic. The zone references identify where pins on other sheets reference the same net. Uses stored references to identify pin locations. The pin references can be displayed in the schematic alongside each pin or written to a report file. Can be used only when editing either the index or a sheet of a multisheet design. The index requires checking before zones can be computed.

schHiCopy.name: schHiCopy
schHiCopy.syntax:
schHiCopy( 
[ ?formFlag g_formFlag ]
[ ?rows x_numrows ]
[ ?columns x_numcols ]
[ ?useSelSet t_useSelSet ] 
)
=> t
schHiCopy.desc: Copies objects and data such as object properties. Objects can be copied between different schematic cellviews. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiCreateBlockInst.name: schHiCreateBlockInst
schHiCreateBlockInst.syntax:
schHiCreateBlockInst( 
[ ?libraryName t_libraryName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?viewName t_viewName ]
[ ?blockSampleName t_blockSampleName ] 
[ ?instanceName t_instanceName ]
[ ?pinNameSeed t_pinNameSeed ] 
)
=> t
schHiCreateBlockInst.desc: Creates a block and places an instance of a block in a schematic. Usable only when editing schematics. If you do not type a library, cell, view, and instance name as arguments, the options form appears and prompts you for these values. The block choices are defined by the schBlockTemplate variable in the schConfig.il file. If you type freeform, the schematic editor prompts you to type a rectangular shape by clicking on two points of the rectangle.

schHiCreateInst.name: schHiCreateInst
schHiCreateInst.syntax:
schHiCreateInst(
[ ?libraryName t_libraryName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?viewName t_viewName ]
[ ?instanceName t_instanceName ]
[ ?rows x_rows ]
[ ?columns x_columns ] 
)
=> t
schHiCreateInst.desc: Places an instance of a cellview in a schematic. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCreateInstBox.name: schHiCreateInstBox
schHiCreateInstBox.desc: Creates an instance box for the symbol you are editing. An instance box defines a rectangular region in which an instance of a symbol is selectable. Usable only when editing symbols.

schHiCreateKanjiSymbol.name: schHiCreateKanjiSymbol
schHiCreateKanjiSymbol.syntax:
schHiCreateKanjiSymbol(
[ ?kanjiFile t_kanjiFile ]
[ ?libName t_libName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?viewName t_viewName ] 
)
=> t / nil
schHiCreateKanjiSymbol.desc: Creates a symbol view containing kanji characters based on the information in an EUC-packed format kanji file. The software generates a symbol cellview that contains kanji character graphics.

schHiCreateMappingSchematic.name: schHiCreateMappingSchematic
schHiCreateMappingSchematic.desc: Displays the Create a Mapping Schematic form.

schHiCreateNetExpression.name: schHiCreateNetExpression
schHiCreateNetExpression.syntax:
schHiCreateNetExpression( 
[ ?netExpr t_netExpr ]
[ ?justify t_justify ]
[ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ]
[ ?fontHeight n_fontHeight ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateNetExpression.desc: Creates an inherited connection and the corresponding net expression label. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiCreateNoteLabel.name: schHiCreateNoteLabel
schHiCreateNoteLabel.syntax:
schHiCreateNoteLabel( 
[ ?text t_text ]
[ ?justify t_justify ]
[ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ]
[ ?fontHeight n_fontHeight ]
[ ?type t_type ] 
)
=> t
schHiCreateNoteLabel.desc: Creates a note label to annotate the design for documentation purposes. These shapes do not affect connectivity. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiCreateNoteShape.name: schHiCreateNoteShape
schHiCreateNoteShape.desc: Creates a shape to annotate the design for documentation purposes. These shapes do not affect connectivity. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiCreatePatchcord.name: schHiCreatePatchcord
schHiCreatePatchcord.desc: Displays the Create Patchcord form where you can create, and add, a patchCord instance on a schematic along with appropriately named net stubs.

schHiCreatePin.name: schHiCreatePin
schHiCreatePin.syntax:
schHiCreatePin(
[ ?terminalName t_terminalName ]
[ ?direction t_direction ]
[ ?usage t_usage ]
[ ?interpret t_interpret ]
[ ?mode t_mode ] 
[ ?netExpr t_netExpr ]
[ t_justify ]
[ t_fontStyle ]
[ n_fontHeight ]
)
=> t
schHiCreatePin.desc: Creates a pin of a specified type in your schematic. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCreateSheet.name: schHiCreateSheet
schHiCreateSheet.desc: Creates a sheet for a multisheet schematic. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCreateSymbolLabel.name: schHiCreateSymbolLabel
schHiCreateSymbolLabel.syntax:
schHiCreateSymbolLabel(
[ ?labelChoice t_labelChoice ]
[ ?text t_text ]
[ ?justify t_justify ]
[ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ]
[ ?fontHeight n_fontHeight ]
[ ?type t_type ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateSymbolLabel.desc: Places labels in a symbol. Usable only when editing symbols.

schHiCreateSymbolPin.name: schHiCreateSymbolPin
schHiCreateSymbolPin.syntax:
schHiCreateSymbolPin(
[ ?terminalName t_terminalName ]
[ ?type t_type ]
[ ?direction t_direction ]
[ ?interpret t_interpret ]
[ ?mode t_mode ]
[ ?incrCount n_incrCount ]
[ ?location t_location ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateSymbolPin.desc: Creates pins in a symbol. Usable only when editing symbols.

schHiCreateSymbolShape.name: schHiCreateSymbolShape
schHiCreateSymbolShape.syntax:
schHiCreateSymbolShape(
[ ?shape t_shape ]
[ ?style t_style ]
[ ?width x_width ]
[ ?nonModal g_nonModal ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateSymbolShape.desc: Creates a line or shapes that describe a symbol. Usable only when editing symbols.

schHiCreateWire.name: schHiCreateWire
schHiCreateWire.syntax:
schHiCreateWire(
[ ?width n_width ]
[ ?drawMode g_drawMode ]
[ ?routeMethod t_routeMethod ]
[ ?lockAngle t_lockAngle ]
[ ?nonModal g_nonModal ]
[ ?color t_color ]
[ ?lineStyle t_lineStyle ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateWire.desc: Creates different style wires that represent net connections in a schematic. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCreateWireLabel.name: schHiCreateWireLabel
schHiCreateWireLabel.syntax:
schHiCreateWireLabel(
[ ?text t_text ]
[ ?purpose t_purpose ]
[ ?justify t_justify ]
[ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ]
[ ?fontHeight n_fontHeight ]
[ ?interpret t_interpret ]
[ ?mode t_mode ]
[ ?netExprFlag g_netExprFlag ]
[ ?bundleDisplay t_bundleDisplay ]
)
=> t
schHiCreateWireLabel.desc: Creates wire labels in a schematic. Physical contact between a label and wire is not required. You can move a label independently from a wire. When you move a wire that has a label glued to it, the label also moves. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiCreateWireStubs.name: schHiCreateWireStubs
schHiCreateWireStubs.desc: Starts the Create Wire Stubs and Names command.

schHiDefaultAction.name: schHiDefaultAction
schHiDefaultAction.desc: Performs the default editing action for the object under the cursor.

schHiDelete.name: schHiDelete
schHiDelete.desc: Deletes selected objects. Usable when editing schematics or symbols. This function cannot be used to delete a sheet border (use schHiEditSheetSize).

schHiDeleteIndex.name: schHiDeleteIndex
schHiDeleteIndex.desc: Converts a multisheet schematic having one drawing sheet and one index sheet into a single-sheet schematic. Usable only when editing an index schematic. Use schHiDeleteSheet to first remove extra drawing sheets. The index schematic must contain only one sheet.

schHiDeleteSheet.name: schHiDeleteSheet
schHiDeleteSheet.desc: Deletes a sheet or range of sheets from a multisheet schematic. Usable only when editing an index of a multisheet schematic. This function cannot be undone.

schHiDescend.name: schHiDescend
schHiDescend.desc: Traverses down the hierarchy and displays the child cellview of a specified instance and view you select, provided you have edit permission. If you do not have edit permission, a dialog box prompts you to use read mode.

schHiDescendEdit.name: schHiDescendEdit
schHiDescendEdit.desc: Traverses down the hierarchy and displays the child cellview of a specified instance and view you select, provided you have edit permission. If you do not have edit permission, a dialog box prompts you to use read mode.

schHiDescendRead.name: schHiDescendRead
schHiDescendRead.desc: Traverses down the hierarchy and displays the child cellview in read mode of a specified instance and view you select. The cellview is not editable.

schHiDisplayOptions.name: schHiDisplayOptions
schHiDisplayOptions.desc: Sets options associated with the window display. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiDistribute.name: schHiDistribute
schHiDistribute.desc: Arranges the objects on the canvas at equal distance from each other. If the objects are already selected on the canvas, the pre-select mode is used; otherwise, the post-select mode is used for distributing the objects.

schHiDrawSymbolPin.name: schHiDrawSymbolPin
schHiDrawSymbolPin.desc: Draws a polygon that represents a symbol pin. Usable only when editing symbols.

schHiEditInPlace.name: schHiEditInPlace
schHiEditInPlace.desc: Edits the master of a user-selected instance within the context of its parent schematic. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiEditText.name: schHiEditText
schHiEditText.desc: Starts the direct text edit command in the current window, allowing you to perform an in-place edit of notes, names, parameters, and so on.

schHiEditorOptions.name: schHiEditorOptions
schHiEditorOptions.desc: Sets variables that affect the environment. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiEditPinOrder.name: schHiEditPinOrder
schHiEditPinOrder.desc: Creates or modifies the property on the cellview that specifies the ordering of the pins in the current cellview. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiEditSheetSize.name: schHiEditSheetSize
schHiEditSheetSize.desc: Edits the sheet border size of a schematic. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiEditTitleBlock.name: schHiEditTitleBlock
schHiEditTitleBlock.desc: Changes the properties of a title block in a schematic sheet. Usable only when editing schematics that have a sheet border.

schHiEnvSaveLoad.name: schHiEnvSaveLoad
schHiEnvSaveLoad.desc: Saves or loads the schematic environment variables. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiEscape.name: schHiEscape
schHiEscape.desc: Closes an open form or clears the current canvas selection. You would typically use this function to successively close the open forms on your desktop, even if they are hidden behind other windows. If there is only one form open, it is closed. If there are multiple forms open, the first form returned by the hiGetCurrentForm SKILL API is closed. If there are no forms open, the current canvas selection is cleared.

schHiExtractConn.name: schHiExtractConn
schHiExtractConn.desc: Sets extraction options and runs the schematic extractor. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiFind.name: schHiFind
schHiFind.desc: Finds objects that match specified search criteria in a schematic or symbol view. You can specify the object filter as well as a property name or value expression that matches the objects. Usable when editing schematics or symbols. Matching is supported only for strings, integers, floating-point numbers, and time. Other property types are not supported.

schHiFindMarker.name: schHiFindMarker
schHiFindMarker.desc: Searches for the error and warning markers generated by the schematic rules checker (SRC) and displays a form that contains a list of the markers. Usable when editing a schematic or a symbol.

schHiFlatten.name: schHiFlatten
schHiFlatten.desc: Starts the schematic Flatten command. Flattening brings the contents of the flattened instance up to the current level to allow editing while preserving the connectivity of the flattened instance. If no single, valid instance is pre-selected, it prompts you to select an instance to flatten. When a valid instance is selected, it prompts you to select a point to place the flattened content. In the case of schematic-in-schematic, the flattened content is placed immediately, without prompting for an additional point.

schHiFollowPin.name: schHiFollowPin
schHiFollowPin.desc: Changes the cellview to one that contains the specified pin or offsheet connector. Operates on the selected set. Brings in the cellview that contains the first reference of the selected pin or offsheet connector. Usable only when editing a sheet of a multisheet schematic.

schHiFontUpdate.name: schHiFontUpdate
schHiFontUpdate.desc: Interactive command for updating the font size of text on a schematic.

schHiGotoSheet.name: schHiGotoSheet
schHiGotoSheet.desc: Traverses sheets in a multisheet schematic. Usable only when editing an index or sheet of a multisheet schematic.

schHiGridOptions.name: schHiGridOptions
schHiGridOptions.desc: Sets options associated with the grid.

schHiHiliteLabel.name: schHiHiliteLabel
schHiHiliteLabel.desc: Highlights labels of wires and instances. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiIgnore.name: schHiIgnore
schHiIgnore.desc: Ignores the instances in the schematic canvas. This function works as a toggle switch, that is, it is used for adding ignore properties to an instance or for removing any existing ones. When the instances are already selected on the canvas, the pre-select mode is used; otherwise, the post-select mode is used for ignoring the instances.

schHiInstToView.name: schHiInstToView
schHiInstToView.desc: Generates a cellview from an instance of a symbol. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiMakeCell.name: schHiMakeCell
schHiMakeCell.desc: Starts the schematic Make Cell command. Make Cell cuts out a rectangular region of the schematic, moving it into a new schematic cellview, and fills in the gap with a new hierarchical instance. The command adjusts the design hierarchy without changing the connectivity. You can define the rectangular area you wish to cut.

schHiMousePopUp.name: schHiMousePopUp
schHiMousePopUp.desc: Displays a pop-up menu at the location of the cursor. The menu displayed is sensitive to the location of the cursor and the mode of the cellview in the window. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiMove.name: schHiMove
schHiMove.desc: Moves objects to a different location. You can move objects between different schematic and symbol cellviews. Usable when editing schematics or symbols. Partially selected objects cannot be moved to a different cellview. Does not support change in orientation for partially selected objects.

schHiNetExprAvailProps.name: schHiNetExprAvailProps
schHiNetExprAvailProps.desc: Displays the Net Expression Available Property Names form. Use this form to find the net expression property names that are available for setting on the selected instances.

schHiNetExprEvalNames.name: schHiNetExprEvalNames
schHiNetExprEvalNames.desc: Displays the Net Expression Evaluated Names form. Use this form to view the net names that result from the evaluation of all net expressions that are found in the hierarchy below the selected instances.

schHiNewCellView.name: schHiNewCellView
schHiNewCellView.desc: Displays the Create New File form. This function needs to be invoked from a window that contains either schematic or symbol data.

schHiObjectProperty.name: schHiObjectProperty
schHiObjectProperty.desc: Displays a form that lets you modify the properties of selected objects. Usable only when editing a schematic or symbol cellview.

schHiOpenCellView.name: schHiOpenCellView
schHiOpenCellView.desc: Displays the Open File form. You specify the library name, cell name, view name, and edit mode in this form. The specified cellview is displayed in the current window. Usable for opening schematic and symbol design windows.

schHiOpenOtherView.name: schHiOpenOtherView
schHiOpenOtherView.syntax:
schHiOpenOtherView(
d_cellViewID 
[ t_viewNames ] 
[ w_windowID ]
[ w_sessionWindowID ]
)
=> nil / windowID
schHiOpenOtherView.desc: Allows you to switch between schematic and symbol views.

schHiOpenSymbolOrSchematicView.name: schHiOpenSymbolOrSchematicView
schHiOpenSymbolOrSchematicView.desc: Takes the current viewtype, schematic or symbol, then calls schHiOpenOtherView to then switch between the views.

schHiPinListToView.name: schHiPinListToView
schHiPinListToView.syntax:
schHiPinListToView(
[ ?libName t_libName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?viewName t_viewName ]
[ ?inPinList t_inPinList ]
[ ?outPinList t_outPinList ]
[ ?ioPinList t_ioPinList ]
[ ?swPinList t_swPinList ]
[ ?dataType t_dataType ]
[ ?jpPinList t_jpPinList ]
[ ?trPinList t_trPinList ]
[ ?unPinList t_unPinList ]
)
=> t
schHiPinListToView.desc: Generates a cellview from a pin list. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiPlot.name: schHiPlot
schHiPlot.desc: Brings up the Submit Plot form to let you generate schematic plots. Usable when viewing schematics or symbols.

schHiPlotQueueStatus.name: schHiPlotQueueStatus
schHiPlotQueueStatus.desc: Displays the plot jobs in the spooling queues. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiRaiseCurrentForm.name: schHiRaiseCurrentForm
schHiRaiseCurrentForm.desc: Brings the most recently-used open form to the front. If there are no open forms, the command does nothing. Bound to F3 by default.

schHiRegisterWireStubs.name: schHiRegisterWireStubs
schHiRegisterWireStubs.desc: Invokes the Register Net Name per Terminal form.

schHiRenumberAllSheet.name: schHiRenumberAllSheet
schHiRenumberAllSheet.desc: Sequentially renumbers all sheets in a multisheet schematic. Usable only when editing an index schematic.

schHiRenumberInstances.name: schHiRenumberInstances
schHiRenumberInstances.desc: Opens the Renumber Instances form which can be used to renumber instances automatically.

schHiRenumberSheet.name: schHiRenumberSheet
schHiRenumberSheet.desc: Changes the number of a sheet in a multisheet schematic. Changes the cell name of the renumbered schematic to match the destination sheet number. If a sheet already exists with the destination number, the renumbered sheet is inserted before it. All succeeding sheets will be renumbered accordingly.

schHiReplace.name: schHiReplace
schHiReplace.syntax:
schHiReplace(
[ ?replaceAll g_replaceAll ]
[ ?propName t_propName ]
[ ?condOp t_condOp ]
[ ?propValue t_propValue ]
[ ?newPropName t_newPropName ]
[ ?newPropValue t_newPropValue ]
)
=> t
schHiReplace.desc: Replaces objects that match the specified search criteria with a specified value. Usable when editing symbols or schematics. You must have write access to each of the cellviews. Only supports matching of strings, integers, floating-point numbers, and time. This function does not support other property types.

schHiResetInvisibleLabels.name: schHiResetInvisibleLabels
schHiResetInvisibleLabels.desc: Causes the highlighted labels to either remain visible or reverse to the invisible state in the design. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiReturn.name: schHiReturn
schHiReturn.desc: Returns up the hierarchy. Usable when editing schematics or symbols after completing a descend or edit-in-place action.

schHiReturnToTop.name: schHiReturnToTop
schHiReturnToTop.desc: Returns to the top-level cellview in the hierarchy. Usable when editing schematics or symbols after completing a series of descend commands.

schHiRotate.name: schHiRotate
schHiRotate.desc: Rotates objects. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiRouteFlightLine.name: schHiRouteFlightLine
schHiRouteFlightLine.desc: Routes logical connections shown as flight lines. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiRouteNamedConnection.name: schHiRouteNamedConnection
schHiRouteNamedConnection.desc: Starts an interactive command for converting existing wire-by-name connections into wired connections.

schHiSaveCellView.name: schHiSaveCellView
schHiSaveCellView.desc: Saves the design in the current window.

schHiSelectAll.name: schHiSelectAll
schHiSelectAll.desc: Opens a form that you use either to add all specified objects to the selected set or to delete all specified objects from the selected set. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiSelectByProperty.name: schHiSelectByProperty
schHiSelectByProperty.syntax:
schHiSelectByProperty(
[ ?select t_select ]
[ ?propName t_propName ]
[ ?condOp t_condOp ]
[ ?propValue t_propValue ]
)
=> t
schHiSelectByProperty.desc: Adds objects that match specified search criteria in a schematic or symbol view to the selected set or removes objects that match specified search criteria in a schematic or symbol view from the selected set. Usable when editing schematics or symbols. Supports only selection of strings, integers, floating-point numbers, and time. This function does not support other property types.

schHiSetSymbolOrigin.name: schHiSetSymbolOrigin
schHiSetSymbolOrigin.desc: Relocates the origin point of a symbol and prompts you for a location of the new symbol origin point. All objects in the symbol are moved so when you later place the symbol, it is positioned on the dragging pointer relative to the new origin point.

schHiShowScope.name: schHiShowScope
schHiShowScope.desc: Displays a dialog box describing the current hierarchical scope in the window. Usable when editing or reading schematics or symbols. The scope contains a list of instance names and the corresponding cell names.

schHiSnapToGrid.name: schHiSnapToGrid
schHiSnapToGrid.desc: Places the objects on the grid in the given window. If the objects are already selected, the Snap To Grid command runs in the pre-select mode. If no object is selected in the given window, the command runs in the post-select mode.

schHiSolder.name: schHiSolder
schHiSolder.desc: Creates a solder dot over a + or T wire segment. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiSRC.name: schHiSRC
schHiSRC.desc: Sets schematic rules checker (SRC) options, and runs the schematic rules checker. Usable only when editing schematics.

schHiStretch.name: schHiStretch
schHiStretch.desc: Moves objects or partially selected objects and maintains connectivity with rubberband lines. Usable only when editing schematics. You cannot stretch objects between two different cellviews.

schHiSymStretch.name: schHiSymStretch
schHiSymStretch.desc: Moves partially selected objects in the symbol editor. Can only be used when editing a symbol. Stretching between two different cellviews is not supported. When stretching an edge of a device border, the pin stubs attached to it are not dragged.

schHiTree.name: schHiTree
schHiTree.desc: Used to display the design hierarchy listed in text format in the Tree Output window.

schHiUpdatePinOrder.name: schHiUpdatePinOrder
schHiUpdatePinOrder.desc: Creates or modifies the property on the cellview that specifies the ordering of the pins in the current cellview. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiVHDLProperty.name: schHiVHDLProperty
schHiVHDLProperty.desc: Edits properties specific to the schematic and VHDL netlister. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiUpdatePinsFromView.name: schHiUpdatePinsFromView
schHiUpdatePinsFromView.desc: Updates the pin information in the current cellview from another view of the same cell. This works from schematic to symbol cellview, and vice-versa.

schHiVIC.name: schHiVIC
schHiVIC.desc: Runs the cross-view checker (VIC) to check the consistency of the interface of one or more cellviews against the cellview you are editing. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schHiVICAndSave.name: schHiVICAndSave
schHiVICAndSave.desc: Runs the cross-view checker (VIC) on the cellview in the current active window and saves the cellview.

schHiViewToView.name: schHiViewToView
schHiViewToView.syntax:
schHiViewToView(
[ ?libName t_libName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?viewNameFrom t_viewNameFrom ]
[ ?viewNameTo t_viewNameTo ]
[ ?dataType t_dataType ]
)
=> t
schHiViewToView.desc: Generates one type of cellview from another.

schHiZoomToSelSet.name: schHiZoomToSelSet
schHiZoomToSelSet.desc: Zooms to selected objects in the current window. If no objects are selected prior to actioning the function, you will be prompted to draw a selection area.

schHiSetOrigin.name: schHiSetOrigin
schHiSetOrigin.desc: Enables to change the origin point of a symbol or schematic. If you place the cell after specifying the origin point, it is automatically placed at the new origin point.

schSelectByLine.name: schSelectByLine
schSelectByLine.desc: Selects objects by drawing a path across the Virtuoso Schematic Editor window. The objects are highlighted based on what is specified in the Schematic Selection Filter form.

schSetSelectOptions.name: schSetSelectOptions
schSetSelectOptions.desc: Sets the filter for the selection function. You can select object types by turning toggle switches on or off. You can also choose partial or full selection. Usable when editing schematics or symbols.

schSingleSelectPt.name: schSingleSelectPt
schSingleSelectPt.desc: Selects the object under the cursor after first deselecting all objects in the selected set. Usable when editing schematics.

annLoadAnnotationData.name: annLoadAnnotationData
annLoadAnnotationData.desc: Loads the saved annotation setup files into the current schematic design. You can specify multiple annotation setup files to load.

annSaveAnnotationData.name: annSaveAnnotationData
annSaveAnnotationData.desc: Saves the current annotation setup in a file. You can specify the complete file path where the setup file needs to be saved.

defcell.name: defcell
defcell.syntax:
defcell(
t_cellName
t_pinType
t_pinName
defsymbol
t_viewname
symbolProps
t_propName
g_propValue
defTermProp
t_defPinName
defVisibleProp
labelAttr
symbolParam
f_spacing
f_length
f_vLength
f_hLength
t_connector
t_origin
symbolLabels
t_labelText
controlParam
g_boolean
pinNumSpec
t_pinName
x_pinNumber
pinLocSpec
t_leftPinName
t_rightPinName
t_topPinName
t_bottomPinName
pinGraphicSpec
t_pinGraph
pinLogicSpec
t_posPin
t_negPin
clockPins
t_clockPin
)
=> t / nil
defcell.desc: Used with TSG template files to call lmdefcell.

hsmDeselect.name: hsmDeselect
hsmDeselect.syntax:
hsmDeselect(
[ ?type d_type ]
[ ?path g_path ]
[ ?name g_name ]
[ ?spec l_spec ]
)
=> t / nil
hsmDeselect.desc: Deselects named objects in the design hierarchy.

hsmGetSelectedSet.name: hsmGetSelectedSet
hsmGetSelectedSet.syntax:
hsmGetSelectedSet(
[ ?top g_top ]
[ ?type d_type ]
[ ?pathStyle g_pathStyle ]
[ ?includeExtra g_includeExtra ]
[ ?cellview d_cellview ]
[ ?path g_path ]
)
=> list / nil

hsmSelect.name: hsmSelect
hsmSelect.syntax:
hsmSelect(
[ ?type d_type ]
[ ?path g_path ]
[ ?name g_name ]
[ ?spec l_spec ]
)
=> t / nil
hsmSelect.desc: Selects named objects in the design hierarchy.

opcAddListToSet.name: opcAddListToSet
opcAddListToSet.desc: Adds a list of objects to the specified set.

opcAddObjectToSet.name: opcAddObjectToSet
opcAddObjectToSet.desc: Adds an object to the specified set.

opcAllSetsInCellView.name: opcAllSetsInCellView
opcAllSetsInCellView.desc: Returns a list of all the sets present in the specified cellview.

opcClearSet.name: opcClearSet
opcClearSet.desc: Removes all objects from a set without modifying the specific objects.

opcCreateCondition.name: opcCreateCondition
opcCreateCondition.syntax:
opcCreateCondition( 
?attrName s_attrName
?opName g_opName
?value t_value
)
=> nil / list
opcCreateCondition.desc: Defines a condition to be used in Navigator custom queries.

opcCreateExpression.name: opcCreateExpression
opcCreateExpression.syntax:
opcCreateExpression( 
?dataSource s_dataSource
?dataType t_dataType
[ ?conditions l_conditions ]
)
=> nil / list
opcCreateExpression.desc: Defines an expression to be used in Navigator custom queries.

opcCreatePersistentSet.name: opcCreatePersistentSet
opcCreatePersistentSet.desc: Creates an OPC set that has a persistent storage in the cellview.

opcCreateQuery.name: opcCreateQuery
opcCreateQuery.syntax:
opcCreateQuery( 
?name t_name
[ ?category t_category ]
[ ?appName t_appName ]
[ ?expressions l_expressions ]
)
=> t / nil
opcCreateQuery.desc: Defines a query that can be instantiated in a cellview to generate a set of objects matching the expressions that constitute the Navigator custom query.

opcDeleteQuery.name: opcDeleteQuery
opcDeleteQuery.desc: Deletes the definition of a query along with any sets that have been created using the query.

opcEditQuery.name: opcEditQuery
opcEditQuery.desc: Edits the definition of a query in a modal popup form.

opcFindSet.name: opcFindSet
opcFindSet.desc: Searches for the specified OPC set name in the given cellview.

opcInstantiateQuery.name: opcInstantiateQuery
opcInstantiateQuery.syntax:
opcInstantiateQuery( 
?query t_query
?cv d_cv
[ ?category t_category ]
)
=> t / nil
opcInstantiateQuery.desc: Instantiates a query in a cellview. If a category is specified, the query is instantiated in the specified category. Otherwise, the query is instantiated in the same category as the query.

opcLoadQueries.name: opcLoadQueries
opcLoadQueries.desc: Loads all the queries defined in the specified file.

opcSaveQueries.name: opcSaveQueries
opcSaveQueries.desc: Saves the list of queries in the specified file.

schAddIgnoreProp.name: schAddIgnoreProp
schAddIgnoreProp.syntax:
schAddIgnoreProp( 
t_name
t_prompt
t_type
t_value
g_enable
)
=> t / nil
schAddIgnoreProp.desc: Registers an ignore property. You can view the set of registered ignore properties on the Ignore Properties tab by clicking Options - Editor in the schematic window.

schAlign.name: schAlign
schAlign.desc: Aligns the objects in the specified direction in the schematic or symbol view.

schAttachLibToPackageTech.name: schAttachLibToPackageTech
schAttachLibToPackageTech.desc: Attaches a package technology to the given library.

schCheck.name: schCheck
schCheck.desc: Performs a check on the specified cellview. This includes extracting connectivity, running the schematic rules checker, and running the cross-view checker. You must have write permission to any cellview that is to be checked. The given cellview ID can be read-only or editable schematic.

schCheckHier.name: schCheckHier
schCheckHier.syntax:
schCheckHier( 
d_cvId 
t_viewNames 
t_refLibs 
[ l_instViewListTable ] 
) 
=> l_errors / nil
schCheckHier.desc: Performs a check of the hierarchy that starts at the given cellview.

schCheckHierConfig.name: schCheckHierConfig
schCheckHierConfig.syntax:
schCheckHierConfig( 
h_cfgId 
[ v_pathVector [ g_refLibs ] ] 
) 
=> l_errors / nil
schCheckHierConfig.desc: Performs a check of the hierarchy. The check starts with the top cellview that is specified in the given hierarchy configuration. The hierarchy traversed is defined by information in this hierarchy configuration. Usually, the hierarchy is confined to the library of the given cellview, but you can specify a list of reference libraries to process if the hierarchy extends beyond the current library.

schClearConn.name: schClearConn
schClearConn.desc: Removes the schematic connectivity from a specified cellview to restart extraction using schExtractConn.

schCloneSymbol.name: schCloneSymbol
schCloneSymbol.syntax:
schCloneSymbol( 
d_cvId 
d_masterId 
l_origin 
t_orient 
) 
=> t / nil
schCloneSymbol.desc: Copies or clones graphics from an existing symbol into the target symbol cellview with the given location and orientation.

schCmdOption.name: schCmdOption
schCmdOption.desc: Cycles through a predefined set of values. By default, this function is bound to the middle mouse button. When you click the right mouse button during an active command, the command applies the next value in the predefined set.

schComputePinRef.name: schComputePinRef
schComputePinRef.syntax:
schComputePinRef( 
d_cellView 
[ ?reportFile t_reportFile ] 
[ ?display t_display ] 
[ ?formatString t_formatString ] 
[ ?reportDups t_reportDups ] 
[ ?sortByDir t_sortByDir ] 
[ ?separator t_separator ] 
[ ?inputDesignator t_inputDesignator ] 
[ ?outputDesignator t_outputDesignator ] 
[ ?ioDesignator t_ioDesignator ] 
[ ?charsPerLine x_charsPerLine ] 
)
=> t / nil
schComputePinRef.desc: Creates offsheet pin references for multisheet designs. The pin references can be displayed in the schematic next to each pin or in a report file. This function creates an offsheet pin reference report that lists each pin followed by a list of all other locations of this pin. The pin references can also be displayed in the schematic next to each pin.

schCopy.name: schCopy
schCopy.syntax:
schCopy( 
d_fig 
d_destCV 
l_transform 
)
=> d_object / nil
schCopy.desc: Copies the given object to the given destination cellview. The object location and orientation can be specified before it is placed at the destination location by the given transformation argument. The copied figure is first rotated and reflected about the origin as specified by the orientation of the transform, then translated by the offset of the transform.

schCreateInst.name: schCreateInst
schCreateInst.syntax:
schCreateInst( 
d_cvId 
d_masterId 
t_instanceName 
l_origin 
t_orient 
[ n_magnification ] 
)
=> d_inst / nil
schCreateInst.desc: Creates an instance of the given master cellview in the specified cellview at the given location with the given orientation. You can specify the magnification to set for the instance. Although not fully supported, you can use this property to scale the appearance of an instance.

schCreateInstBox.name: schCreateInstBox
schCreateInstBox.desc: Creates an instance box in the given symbol cellview. This function uses a bounding box you specify or determines a bounding box from the pins and device shapes.

schCreateNetExpression.name: schCreateNetExpression
schCreateNetExpression.syntax:
schCreateNetExpression( 
d_cvId 
t_netExpr 
d_glueId 
l_point 
t_justify 
t_orient 
t_fontStyle 
n_fontHeight 
)
=> d_id / nil
schCreateNetExpression.desc: Creates an inherited connection and the corresponding net expression label. Attaches the given net expression to the given database object. It validates the syntax of the expression and attaches a net expression label to the database object. If the object is a schematic wire, you must run the schematic extractor to create the inherited connection. Before calling this function, you must acquire all the required arguments of the function.

schCreateNoteLabel.name: schCreateNoteLabel
schCreateNoteLabel.syntax:
schCreateNoteLabel( 
d_cvId 
l_point 
t_text 
t_just 
t_orient 
t_fontStyle 
n_fontHeight 
t_type 
)
=> d_label / nil
schCreateNoteLabel.desc: Creates note labels in a schematic or symbol cellview with the attributes and properties you specify. These labels do not affect the connectivity but can be useful for annotation.

schCreateNoteShape.name: schCreateNoteShape
schCreateNoteShape.syntax:
schCreateNoteShape( 
d_cvId 
t_type 
t_lineStyle 
l_points 
[ n_width ] 
)
=> d_shape / nil
schCreateNoteShape.desc: Creates note shapes in a schematic or symbol cellview with the attributes and properties you specify. These shapes do not affect the connectivity but can be useful for annotation.

schCreatePin.name: schCreatePin
schCreatePin.syntax:
schCreatePin( 
d_cvId 
d_master 
t_termName 
t_direction 
g_offSheetP 
l_origin 
t_orientation
[ g_powerSens ]
[ g_groundSens ]
[ g_sigType ]
)
=> d_pin / nil
schCreatePin.desc: Creates instances that are used to represent pins of terminals in a schematic cellview. Creates only a pin in a schematic cellview. The destination cellview must not be the same as the master cellview and must be editable.

schCreateSheet.name: schCreateSheet
schCreateSheet.syntax:
schCreateSheet( 
d_cvId 
x_number 
t_borderLibrary 
t_borderCell 
t_borderView 
)
=> d_sheetInstId / nil
schCreateSheet.desc: Creates a new sheet for a multisheet schematic.

schCreateSplitPrimarySymbol.name: schCreateSplitPrimarySymbol
schCreateSplitPrimarySymbol.desc: Searches for split symbol views within the given cell and creates a split-primary symbol by assembling all the terminals from the gathered views. The generated split-primary cellview has the view name as symbol. This function removes an existing split-primary cellview, if any, and replaces it with a new one.

schCreateSymbolLabel.name: schCreateSymbolLabel
schCreateSymbolLabel.syntax:
schCreateSymbolLabel( 
d_cvId 
l_point 
t_labelChoice 
t_text 
t_justify 
t_orient 
t_fontStyle 
n_fontHeight 
t_type 
)
=> d_label / nil
schCreateSymbolLabel.desc: Creates a label in only a symbol cellview with the specified attributes that is opened in append mode.

schCreateSymbolPin.name: schCreateSymbolPin
schCreateSymbolPin.syntax:
schCreateSymbolPin( 
d_cvId 
d_master 
t_termName 
t_direction 
l_origin 
t_orientation 
[ g_flatten ]
[g_powerSens]
[g_groundSens]
[g_sigType]
)
=> t_pinFigId / nil
schCreateSymbolPin.desc: Creates a pin in the given cellview with the name, direction, and orientation you specify.

schCreateSymbolShape.name: schCreateSymbolShape
schCreateSymbolShape.syntax:
schCreateSymbolShape( 
d_cvId 
t_shape 
t_style 
l_points 
[ n_width ] 
)
=> d_shapeId / nil
schCreateSymbolShape.desc: Creates the specified shape using the given fill style and the list of points in the given cellview.

schCreateWire.name: schCreateWire
schCreateWire.syntax:
schCreateWire( 
d_cvId 
t_entryMethod 
t_routeMethod 
l_points 
n_xSpacing 
n_ySpacing 
n_width 
[ t_color ]
[ t_lineStyle ]
)
=> l_wireId
schCreateWire.desc: Creates flight lines, wide wires, or narrow wires in the specified schematic cellview.

schCreateWireLabel.name: schCreateWireLabel
schCreateWireLabel.syntax:
schCreateWireLabel( 
d_cvId 
d_glue 
l_point 
t_text 
t_justify 
t_orient 
t_fontStyle 
n_fontHeight 
g_aliasP 
)
=> d_labelId / nil
schCreateWireLabel.desc: Creates wire labels and glues them to the object you specify.

schDelete.name: schDelete
schDelete.desc: Deletes the figure or object you specify only from schematic or symbol cellviews.

schDeleteIndex.name: schDeleteIndex
schDeleteIndex.desc: Deletes an index schematic if there is one remaining sheet. Converts the remaining sheet into an ordinary schematic with the cell name of the index schematic and replaces any offsheet pins with schematic pins.

schDeleteSheet.name: schDeleteSheet
schDeleteSheet.desc: Deletes a sheet from a multisheet schematic design.

schDeselectAllFig.name: schDeselectAllFig
schDeselectAllFig.desc: Deselects all objects in a specified cellview. Bypasses the selection filter.

schDistribute.name: schDistribute
schDistribute.desc: Arranges objects at equal distance in the specified direction in the schematic or symbol view.

schDrawSymbolPin.name: schDrawSymbolPin
schDrawSymbolPin.syntax:
schDrawSymbolPin( 
d_cvId 
t_termName 
t_direction 
l_points 
)
=> t_pinFigId / nil
schDrawSymbolPin.desc: Creates a symbol pin in the specified cellview by creating a terminal of the given name with the given direction and a polygon shape specified by the given list of points.

schEditPinOrder.name: schEditPinOrder
schEditPinOrder.syntax:
schEditPinOrder( 
d_cvId 
l_pinList 
g_updateInstLastChanged 
)
=> t / nil
schEditPinOrder.desc: Updates the pin ordering for schematic or symbol cellviews given a list of pin names contained in the cellview and their desired order.

schEditSheetSize.name: schEditSheetSize
schEditSheetSize.syntax:
schEditSheetSize( 
d_cvId 
t_borderLib 
t_borderCell 
t_borderView 
)
=> t / nil
schEditSheetSize.desc: Places or replaces a sheet border instance in a schematic. This function works for both multisheet and non-multisheet schematics.

schExportSVG.name: schExportSVG
schExportSVG.syntax:
schExportSVG( 
d_cellview 
?path s_path
?background s_background
?grid s_grid
?stipple s_stipple
?drawBBox g_drawBBox
?nameCallback g_nameCallback
)
=> t / nil
schExportSVG.desc: Exports a schematic as a vector image in SVG format.

schExtendSelSet.name: schExtendSelSet
schExtendSelSet.desc: Extends the selection of the object in the specified position by selecting the object around the current object.

schExtractConn.name: schExtractConn
schExtractConn.desc: Runs the schematic connectivity extractor on the cellview you specify.

schExtractStatus.name: schExtractStatus
schExtractStatus.desc: Checks for error and warning markers before returning the schematic extraction status for the specified schematic cellview. When the schematic is read-only, schExtractStatus() will also check whether any instance masters have been updated since the schematic was last saved.

schFindIgnorePropByName.name: schFindIgnorePropByName
schFindIgnorePropByName.desc: Searches for an ignore property in the registered property set. You can view the registered ignore property set by clicking Options - Editor - Ignore Properties tab in the schematic window.

schGetAllIgnoreProps.name: schGetAllIgnoreProps
schGetAllIgnoreProps.desc: Returns a disembodied property list for all the ignore properties that are currently registered. You can view the set of registered ignore properties set on the Ignore Properties tab by clicking Options - Editor in the schematic window.

schGetBundleDisplayMode.name: schGetBundleDisplayMode
schGetBundleDisplayMode.desc: Takes a label Id and returns its display mode. This only works for label type objects. If the specified object Id is not a label object, then the API will return nil. This will only work when the cellview is editable.

schGetCellViewListInSearchScope.name: schGetCellViewListInSearchScope
schGetCellViewListInSearchScope.syntax:
schGetCellViewListInSearchScope( 
d_cvId 
t_scope 
d_topCV 
t_viewNameList 
t_libName 
t_mode 
)
=> l_cvList / nil
schGetCellViewListInSearchScope.desc: Returns a list of cellviews in the search scope you specify. Only cellviews of the same view type as the base cellview are returned.

schGetCheckGroups.name: schGetCheckGroups
schGetCheckGroups.desc: Returns an association list of all the custom schematic checker groups created using schRegisterCheckGroup().

schGetEnv.name: schGetEnv
schGetEnv.desc: Gets the value of a schematic environment variable.

schGetIgnoredStatus.name: schGetIgnoredStatus
schGetIgnoredStatus.desc: Returns the ignored status of the given instance ID. This function can be used only when the instance IDs are known.

schGetMatchingObjects.name: schGetMatchingObjects
schGetMatchingObjects.syntax:
schGetMatchingObjects( 
d_cvId 
t_propName 
t_condOp 
t_propValue 
g_useSelSet 
)
=> l_objects / nil
schGetMatchingObjects.desc: Finds the set of objects that match the specified search criteria in a cellview. You can search by property to limit the search in the selected set.

schGetPinOrder.name: schGetPinOrder
schGetPinOrder.desc: Returns the pin list, as defined in the portOrder property (if present) or as the default pin list.

schGetPostCheckTriggers.name: schGetPostCheckTriggers
schGetPostCheckTriggers.desc: Lists all the post-check triggers registered using schRegPostCheckTrigger.

schGetPreCheckTriggers.name: schGetPreCheckTriggers
schGetPreCheckTriggers.desc: Lists all the pre-check triggers registered using schRegPreCheckTrigger.

schGetPropertyDisplay.name: schGetPropertyDisplay
schGetPropertyDisplay.syntax:
schGetPropertyDisplay( 
?object d_object
[?name S_name]
)
=> l_textDisplays / s_visibility / nil
schGetPropertyDisplay.desc: Returns the attribute, property, and parameter textDisplays enabled for an object.

schGetShapeStyle.name: schGetShapeStyle
schGetShapeStyle.desc: Returns a Disembodied property list (DPL) containing the style attributes of a given shape.

schGetSignalTypeIntegrity.name: schGetSignalTypeIntegrity
schGetSignalTypeIntegrity.syntax:
schGetSignalTypeIntegrity( 
t_netSigType
t_termNetSigType
t_termDirection
)
=> t_severity / nil
schGetSignalTypeIntegrity.desc: Gets the conflict severity for signal type integrity check for connections between nets of specified signal type, and instance pins of specified signal type and direction.

schGetSplitInstances.name: schGetSplitInstances
schGetSplitInstances.desc: Returns a list of split instance IDs that are associated with the given split-primary instance.

schGetSplitInstTerms.name: schGetSplitInstTerms
schGetSplitInstTerms.desc: Returns a list of split instance terminals that have the same name as that of the given split-primary instance.

schGetSplitPrimaryInst.name: schGetSplitPrimaryInst
schGetSplitPrimaryInst.desc: Returns the split-primary instance associated with the given split symbol.

schGetSplitPrimaryInstTerm.name: schGetSplitPrimaryInstTerm
schGetSplitPrimaryInstTerm.desc: Returns the terminal of the split-primary instance that has the same terminal name as the specified split instance terminal.

schGetWireColor.name: schGetWireColor
schGetWireColor.desc: Returns the color used to draw a wire segment.

schGetWireLineStyle.name: schGetWireLineStyle
schGetWireLineStyle.desc: Returns the line style used to draw a wire segment.

schGlueLabel.name: schGlueLabel
schGlueLabel.desc: Glues the label to the figure you specify using a database child/parent relationship in which the label is the child. You can glue a pin label to a pin only when the label defines the name for that pin. You can glue a wire label only to a wire, a pin of a component, or a pin of a schematic. The label defines the name of the net associated with the wire, the pin of the component, or the pin of the schematic. You can glue note labels to any object.

schHdlPrintVars.name: schHdlPrintVars
schHdlPrintVars.desc: Prints the current values of the schematic HDL variables.

schHDLReturn.name: schHDLReturn
schHDLReturn.desc: Returns up the hierarchy from a Verilog view window.

schIgnore.name: schIgnore
schIgnore.desc: Adds or removes the ignore properties from the specified instance. You can view the registered ignore properties on the Ignore Properties tab by clicking Options - Editor.

schInhConFind.name: schInhConFind
schInhConFind.desc: Given a windowId and an optional list of instances (or all instances in the window if none are explicitly specified), will return a list of inherited connections eligible for override beneath these instances.

schInhConSet.name: schInhConSet
schInhConSet.syntax:
schInhConSet( 
t_inhCon
[ ?name t_name ] 
[ ?default t_default ]
[ ?value t_value ]
[ ?pinName t_pinName ]
[ ?pinDir t_pinDir ]
[ ?pinPos t_pinPos ]
)
=> t / nil
schInhConSet.desc: Manipulates inherited connections located using schInhConFind.

schInstallHDL.name: schInstallHDL
schInstallHDL.syntax:
schInstallHDL( 
g_library 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
t_srcName 
[ g_createSymbol ]
[ g_overrideIfExist ]
)
=> t / nil
schInstallHDL.desc: Installs a Verilog HDL source file as an HDL cellview and creates the cell, view, and cellview objects in the library if necessary. This function can also create a matching symbol cellview.

schInstToView.name: schInstToView
schInstToView.syntax:
schInstToView( 
d_inst 
t_viewTo 
t_fromFunc 
t_toFunc 
)
=> t / nil
schInstToView.desc: Generates a cellview type from an instance of a symbol.

schIsFlightLine.name: schIsFlightLine
schIsFlightLine.desc: Checks if the specified object is a flight line on a net.

schIsHDLCapEnabled.name: schIsHDLCapEnabled
schIsHDLCapEnabled.desc: Validates that a license supporting the schematic editing feature is already checked out and does a recheck to ensure that the license has not timed out. Otherwise, attempts to check out a license.

schIsInCheckHier.name: schIsInCheckHier
schIsInCheckHier.desc: Identifies and performs the specific actions, as mentioned in the SKILL code, when checking a design hierarchy as opposed to a single cellview during a schematic hierarchy check. When you check a design hierarchy or a single cellview, the schematic checker runs any pre or post check triggers and custom checker rules that you have previously registered.

schIsIndexCV.name: schIsIndexCV
schIsIndexCV.desc: Tests whether the given cellview is an index schematic cellview.

schIsSchEditOk.name: schIsSchEditOk
schIsSchEditOk.syntax:
schIsSchEditOk( 
d_cvId 
[ ?skipWritableCheck g_skipWritableCheck ]
[ ?dialog g_dialog ] 
)
=> t / nil
schIsSchEditOk.desc: Checks if the given cellview is a schematic view, whether it is writable, and also whether the edit capability (VSE license successfully checked out) is enabled.

schIsSheetCV.name: schIsSheetCV
schIsSheetCV.desc: Tests whether the given cellview is a multisheet schematic cellview.

schIsSplitInst.name: schIsSplitInst
schIsSplitInst.desc: Tests if a specified instance is a split instance. An instance is a split instance if its master is a split symbol.

schIsSplitPrimaryInst.name: schIsSplitPrimaryInst
schIsSplitPrimaryInst.desc: Tests if a specified instance is a split-primary instance.

schIsSplitPrimarySymbol.name: schIsSplitPrimarySymbol
schIsSplitPrimarySymbol.desc: Tests if a specified cellview is a split-primary symbol.

schIsSplitSymbol.name: schIsSplitSymbol
schIsSplitSymbol.desc: Tests if a specified cellview is a split symbol.

schIsSymEditOk.name: schIsSymEditOk
schIsSymEditOk.syntax:
schIsSymEditOk( 
d_cvId 
[ ?skipWritableCheck g_skipWritableCheck ]
[ ?dialog g_dialog ] 
)
=> t / nil
schIsSymEditOk.desc: Checks if the given cellview is a schematic symbol view, whether it is writable, and also whether the edit capability (VSE license successfully checked out) is enabled.

schIsTextEditable.name: schIsTextEditable
schIsTextEditable.desc: Queries whether or not a label (optionally inside an instance) can be edited directly on the canvas.

schIsUsingSplitFeature.name: schIsUsingSplitFeature
schIsUsingSplitFeature.desc: Indicates if a specified cellview uses the split feature. This implies that a schematic cellview has split instances with correctly set split-primary instances and a symbol cellivew is a split or has a split-primary symbol.

schIsWire.name: schIsWire
schIsWire.desc: Checks if the specified object is a wire.

schIsWireLabel.name: schIsWireLabel
schIsWireLabel.desc: Tests whether the given database figure is a schematic wire label.

schLayoutToPinList.name: schLayoutToPinList
schLayoutToPinList.desc: Translates a layout cellview into an intermediate pin list format. The pin list represents all of the terminals in the layout and their directions. The pin list also represents the cellview level properties in the maskLayout.

schMapMCCleanup.name: schMapMCCleanup
schMapMCCleanup.desc: Cleans up the migration running directory from the directories and files generated during migration. Additionally, it removes definitions and folders of temporary libraries.

schMapMCCreateTargets.name: schMapMCCreateTargets
schMapMCCreateTargets.desc: Creates targets for routing after placing the missing devices in the target cellviews.

schMapMCFinalizeTargets.name: schMapMCFinalizeTargets
schMapMCFinalizeTargets.desc: Finalizes the assembly of the target cells and libraries. This SKILL function is equivalent to the Finalize Multiple Target Schematics (Part 3) option. In CIW, this option is available in Tools - Migrate - Multiple Schematics Mapping.

schMapMCSaveSourceData.name: schMapMCSaveSourceData
schMapMCSaveSourceData.desc: Prepares all the cells, which are defined in the cell list file for migration. This SKILL function is equivalent to the Save Multiple Source Schematics Data (Part 1) option. In CIW, this option is available in Tools - Migrate - Multiple Schematics Mapping.

schMapMCSettings.name: schMapMCSettings
schMapMCSettings.syntax:
schMapMCSettings (
[?rundir x_rundir]
[?mcrundir x_inputdatadir]
[?tgtlibsdir x_targetlibsdir]
[?cellsfile x_cellfilename]
[?tgtprefix x_temptargetlibsprefix]
[?dfntgtlibsbn g_redefinetargetlibs]
) 
=> t
schMapMCSettings.desc: Assigns values to the settings that are used to carry out the batch multicell schematic migration. This SKILL function is equivalent to the Multiple Schematics Mapping - Settings option. In CIW, this option is available in Tools - Migrate.

schMouseApplyOrFinish.name: schMouseApplyOrFinish
schMouseApplyOrFinish.desc: Adds a point and applies or finishes the active enter function command based on the setting of the modalCommands schematic environment variable. It is designed to be used for double-clicking with the left mouse button.

schMove.name: schMove
schMove.syntax:
schMove( 
d_fig 
d_destCV 
l_transform 
)
=> d_object / nil
schMove.desc: Moves the object you specify to a destination cellview. The object location and orientation can be specified before the object is placed at the destination location by the given transformation argument. The copied figure is first rotated and reflected about the origin as specified by the orientation of the transform, then translated by the offset of the transform.

schNetExprAvailProps.name: schNetExprAvailProps
schNetExprAvailProps.desc: Returns a list of available properties, and their evaluated values, for the various occurrences passed.

schNetExprEvalNames.name: schNetExprEvalNames
schNetExprEvalNames.syntax:
schNetExprEvalNames( 
l_designSpec
l_instPaths
