pcHIDisplayRefPointObject.desc: Highlights a reference point group in the current cellview window and opens the Show Reference Point text window with information about the highlighted group. When there is more than one reference point group, click OK in the text window to view the next one.

pcHIDisplayRepeat.name: pcHIDisplayRepeat
pcHIDisplayRepeat.desc: Highlights a repeat group in the current cellview window and displays one of the following text windows, depending on the type of group you selected: Show Repeat in X, Show Repeat in Y, or Show Repeat in X and Y with information about the highlighted group. When there is more than one repeat group, click OK in the text window to view the next one.

pcHIDisplaySteppedObject.name: pcHIDisplaySteppedObject
pcHIDisplaySteppedObject.desc: Highlights the objects in a repetition along shape group in the current cellview window and opens the Show Repetition Along Shape text window with information about the highlighted group. When there is more than one repetition along shape group, click OK in the text window to view the next one.

pcHIEditParameters.name: pcHIEditParameters
pcHIEditParameters.desc: Lets you change the data type and/or value for parameters already defined for the Pcell by displaying the Edit Parameters form.

pcHIModifyCondition.name: pcHIModifyCondition
pcHIModifyCondition.desc: Lets you add objects to a conditional inclusion group by prompting you to select an object in the inclusion group you want to modify. The system highlights all objects in the selected group and prompts you to select shapes to be added to the group. When you complete selecting the objects, the system displays the Modify Conditional Inclusion form.

pcHIModifyLabel.name: pcHIModifyLabel
pcHIModifyLabel.desc: Prompts you to select the parameterized label you want to modify. After you select the label, displays the Modify Parameterized Label form to let you change the values for the selected label.

pcHIModifyLayer.name: pcHIModifyLayer
pcHIModifyLayer.desc: Lets you add shapes to a parameterized layer group by prompting you to select an object in the layer group you want to modify. The system highlights all objects in the selected group and prompts you to select shapes to be added to the group. When you complete selecting the shapes, the system displays the Modify Parameterized Layer form.

pcHIModifyParams.name: pcHIModifyParams
pcHIModifyParams.desc: Lets you change the data type and/or value for parameters already defined for the Pcell by displaying the Edit Parameters form. This function is equivalent to the pcHIEditParameters function.

pcHIModifyRefPointObject.name: pcHIModifyRefPointObject
pcHIModifyRefPointObject.desc: Lets you add objects to a reference group by prompting you to select an object in the group you want to modify. The system highlights all objects in the selected group and prompts you to select shapes to be added to the group. When you complete selecting the shapes, the system lets you change the reference point by displaying either the Reference Point by Parameter form or the Reference Point by Path Endpoint form, depending on the type of group you selected. There can be only one reference point parameter and only one reference point by path endpoint defined for a Pcell.

pcHIModifyRepeat.name: pcHIModifyRepeat
pcHIModifyRepeat.desc: Lets you add shapes to a repeat group by prompting you to select a shape in the repeat group you want to modify. After you select an object, the system highlights all shapes in the group and prompts you to select shapes to be added to the group. When you complete selecting shapes, the system displays one of the following forms, depending on the type of repeat group you selected: Modify Repeat in X, Modify Repeat in Y, or Modify Repeat in X and Y.

pcHIModifySteppedObject.name: pcHIModifySteppedObject
pcHIModifySteppedObject.desc: Lets you add shapes to a repetition along shape group by prompting you to select a shape in the group you want to modify. After you select a shape, the system highlights all shapes in the group and displays the Modify Repetition Along Shape form.

pcHIModifyStretchLine.name: pcHIModifyStretchLine
pcHIModifyStretchLine.desc: Prompts you to select the stretch line you want to modify. After you select a stretch line, displays the Stretch in X or Stretch in Y form, depending on whether you are modifying an X stretch line or a Y stretch line, to let you change the values for the selected stretch line.

pcHIQualifyStretchLine.name: pcHIQualifyStretchLine
pcHIQualifyStretchLine.desc: Lets you add shapes to be affected by a stretch line by prompting you to select the stretch line. After you select a stretch line, prompts you to select the shapes to be affected. No form is displayed.

pcHIRedefineStretchLine.name: pcHIRedefineStretchLine
pcHIRedefineStretchLine.desc: Lets you redefine a previously defined stretch control line or change the parameters assigned to a stretch control line by prompting you to select the stretch line. After you select a stretch line, the system prompts you to draw a stretch line to replace the selected stretch line. After you draw the line, the system displays the Stretch in X or Stretch in Y form, depending on whether you are redefining an X stretch line or a Y stretch line, to let you change the values for the redefined stretch line.

pcHISummarizeParams.name: pcHISummarizeParams
pcHISummarizeParams.desc: Displays the Pcell Parameter Summary text window with information about the parameters defined for the Pcell.

pcIsParamSlot.name: pcIsParamSlot
pcIsParamSlot.desc: Checks whether the specified propName is a parameter slot of the specified device.

pcModifyParam.name: pcModifyParam
pcModifyParam.syntax:
pcModifyParam( 
d_cvId
S_param
t_type
g_value
)
=> d_paramId / nil
pcModifyParam.desc: Lets you modify the parameter type and default value for parameters assigned to a compiled Pcell.

pcRedefineStretchLine.name: pcRedefineStretchLine
pcRedefineStretchLine.syntax:
pcRedefineStretchLine( 
d_lineId 
g_paramExpr 
t_direction 
f_defval
f_minval 
f_maxval 
g_stretchRepeated 
) 
=> d_StretchId / nil
pcRedefineStretchLine.desc: Redefines the attributes of an existing stretch control line. You can also specify a new location for the stretch control line with this command.

pcRestrictStretchToObjects.name: pcRestrictStretchToObjects
pcRestrictStretchToObjects.desc: Lets you specify the objects affected by a particular stretch control line. Objects not specified are not moved or stretched by this stretch control line.

pcRound.name: pcRound
pcRound.desc: Lets you round a number to the closest integer, using the value of the decimal place specified by x_tolerance; additional decimal places are ignored. If the value of the specified decimal place is less than 5, the system drops all decimal places; if the value of the specified decimal place is greater than or equal to 5, the system drops all decimal places and adds one to the integer.

pcSetFTermWidth.name: pcSetFTermWidth
pcSetFTermWidth.desc: Creates a net or terminal name and assigns a width.

pcSetParamSlotsFromMaster.name: pcSetParamSlotsFromMaster
pcSetParamSlotsFromMaster.desc: Sets the class slot values of a specified device to the corresponding Pcell parameter values on a specified Pcell super master or sub master.

pcSetParamSlotValue.name: pcSetParamSlotValue
pcSetParamSlotValue.desc: Sets the value of the specified parameter slot, propName, of the given device.

pcSkillGen.name: pcSkillGen
pcSkillGen.syntax:
pcSkillGen(
d_cellViewId
t_outputFile
g_isSkillFile
[ `disablePrompt ]
)
=> t / nil
pcSkillGen.desc: Converts a specified cellview into a SKILL file. A SKILL file can be edited and loaded back to a cellview after modification. Loading a SKILL file generates a SKILL master; however, the cellview contains only a label with the text: Warning: The master is defined by the SKILL procedure associated with the cellview.

pcStepAlongShape.name: pcStepAlongShape
pcStepAlongShape.syntax:
pcStepAlongShape(
d_shape1Id
l_stepDetails(
l_shape2Points
)
=> t / nil
pcStepAlongShape.desc: Replicates a shape (d_shape1Id) along a second shape (l_shape2Points) by specifying a disembodied property list to define the stepping distance, gap between successive replications, starting offset, ending offset, and object type. The pitch is determined by the offset of the origin of d_shape1Id from the point 0:0. You specify the second shape (l_shape2Points) with a list of coordinates.

pcUserAdjustParameters.name: pcUserAdjustParameters
pcUserAdjustParameters.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any objects. The procedure is normally used to generate code to transform user-specified parameter values, such as to snap them to an even value. Parameters can then be referenced as variables in the SKILL code that is generated.

pcUserGenerateArray.name: pcUserGenerateArray
pcUserGenerateArray.syntax:
pcUserGenerateArray( 
d_mosaic 
t_masterTag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserGenerateArray.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any simple arrays (mosaics) in a master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress array generation or to modify arrays.

pcUserGenerateInstance.name: pcUserGenerateInstance
pcUserGenerateInstance.syntax:
pcUserGenerateInstance( 
d_inst 
t_masterTag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserGenerateInstance.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any instances in a master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress instance generation or to modify instances.

pcUserGenerateInstancesOfMaster.name: pcUserGenerateInstancesOfMaster
pcUserGenerateInstancesOfMaster.syntax:
pcUserGenerateInstancesOfMaster( 
d_masterCV 
l_instanceList
t_tag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserGenerateInstancesOfMaster.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler for every master Pcell in a master Pcell. The compiler calls the procedure before it generates code for instances (but not arrays) for the master. The procedure is normally used to generate code to switch masters.

pcUserGenerateLPP.name: pcUserGenerateLPP
pcUserGenerateLPP.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes shapes belonging to layer-purpose pairs in the master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress shape-set generation.

pcUserGeneratePin.name: pcUserGeneratePin
pcUserGeneratePin.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes pins on any terminals in the master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress pin generation or to modify pins.

pcUserGenerateProperty.name: pcUserGenerateProperty
pcUserGenerateProperty.syntax:
pcUserGenerateProperty( 
d_object 
d_prop
t_tag
p_port 
)
=> t / nil
pcUserGenerateProperty.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes properties on any objects. The procedure is normally used to suppress property generation in the master Pcell.

pcUserGenerateShape.name: pcUserGenerateShape
pcUserGenerateShape.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any shapes in the master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress shape generation or to modify shapes.

pcUserGenerateTerminal.name: pcUserGenerateTerminal
pcUserGenerateTerminal.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any terminals in the master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to suppress terminal generation or to modify terminals.

pcUserInitRepeat.name: pcUserInitRepeat
pcUserInitRepeat.syntax:
pcUserInitRepeat( 
l_stepX 
l_stepY
l_repeatX
l_repeatY 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserInitRepeat.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any repetitions. The procedure is normally used to generate code to set the values of variables for repetition parameters.

pcUserPostProcessCellView.name: pcUserPostProcessCellView
pcUserPostProcessCellView.syntax:
pcUserPostProcessCellView( 
d_cv 
t_tag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserPostProcessCellView.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler after it processes any object in a Pcell. The procedure is normally used to generate code to process a list of objects that was built during compilation.

pcUserPostProcessObject.name: pcUserPostProcessObject
pcUserPostProcessObject.syntax:
pcUserPostProcessObject( 
d_obj 
t_tag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserPostProcessObject.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler after it processes any object (instance, shape, terminal, and so forth) in a master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to generate code to modify a generated object.

pcUserPreProcessCellView.name: pcUserPreProcessCellView
pcUserPreProcessCellView.syntax:
pcUserPreProcessCellView( 
d_cv 
t_tag 
p_port 
) 
=> t / nil
pcUserPreProcessCellView.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any objects in a Pcell. The procedure is normally used to generate code to initialize variables before the compiler processes individual objects.

pcUserSetTermNetName.name: pcUserSetTermNetName
pcUserSetTermNetName.desc: A user-defined procedure called by the compiler before it processes any pins on any terminals that are part of a repetition group in the master Pcell. The procedure is normally used to customize the connectivity of replicated pins. SKILL code generated by this procedure should assign the net name to the SKILL variable pcTermNetName. This is the net name used in the code generated by the compiler to create terminals in the submaster Pcell. The SKILL variables pcIndexX and pcIndexY are available for incorporation into pcTermNetName if you need to make different nets for each different repeated pin.

dbClearPcellCache.name: dbClearPcellCache
dbClearPcellCache.syntax:
dbClearPcellCache(
[ t_libName ]
[ t_cellName ]
[ t_viewName ]
)
=> t / nil
dbClearPcellCache.desc: Deletes all the submasters of the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName from the Express Pcell cache on disk at the location specified by the CDS_EXP_PCELL_DIR environment variable. If no argument is specified then it deletes the complete cache.

dbSavePcellCache.name: dbSavePcellCache
dbSavePcellCache.desc: If there is a mismatch in the timestamps of the supermaster, the existing submasters in the cache are deleted, and only the new submasters generated in virtual memory are saved to the Express Pcell cache on disk.

dbSavePcellCacheForCV.name: dbSavePcellCacheForCV
dbSavePcellCacheForCV.syntax:
dbSavePcellCacheForCV(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ n_openLevels ]
)
=> t / nil
dbSavePcellCacheForCV.desc: Opens the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName and saves all the existing submasters generated or updated in virtual memory to the Express Pcell cache (including any other pre-existing submasters in virtual memory) on disk at the location specified by the CDS_EXP_PCELL_DIR environment variable.

dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly.name: dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly
dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly.syntax:
dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ n_depth ]
)
=> t / nil
dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly.desc: Opens the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName and saves all the Pcell submasters specified in the given cell in the Express Pcell Cache.

xpcDumpCache.name: xpcDumpCache
xpcDumpCache.desc: This SKILL API dumps the Express Pcell cache information to CIW and in the specified file.

dbUpdatePcellCache.name: dbUpdatePcellCache
dbUpdatePcellCache.syntax:
dbUpdatePcellCache(
[ t_libName ] 
[ t_cellName ] 
[ t_viewName ] 
[ g_checkTimeStamp ]
)
=> t / nil
dbUpdatePcellCache.desc: Updates and saves the submasters that exist in cache by re-evaluating the Pcells. If Library, cell, and view is specified, it updates the submasters only for the specified supermaster.

xpcEnableExpressPcell.name: xpcEnableExpressPcell
xpcEnableExpressPcell.desc: Enables or disables the Express Pcell cache.

maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler.name: maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler
maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler.syntax:
maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler(
l_stateList
t_maestroLib
t_maestroCell
[ ?maestroView t_maestroView ]
[ ?migrateFrom t_migrateFrom ]
[ ?rootPath t_rootPath ]
[ ?testNameList t_testNameList ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> l_cellviewDetails / nil
maeConvertAndCombineMultiADELToAssembler.desc: Combines two or more ADE L states into one maestro cellview for ADE Assembler. In the resulting maestro cellview, the tests are created in the same order in which the states are specified in the list of states to be migrated.

maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro.name: maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro
maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro.syntax:
maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro(
t_stateLib
t_stateCell
t_stateName
[ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ]
[ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ]
[ ?maestroView t_maestroView ]
[ ?migrateFrom s_migrateFrom ]
[ ?statePath t_statePath ]
[ ?simulator t_simulator ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> l_cellviewDetails / nil
maeMigrateADELStateToMaestro.desc: Migrates the given ADE L state to a maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Explorer.

maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro.name: maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro
maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro.syntax:
maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro(
t_stateLib
t_stateCell
t_stateName
[ ?maestroLib t_maestroLib ]
[ ?maestroCell  t_maestroCell ]
[ ?maestroView t_maestroView ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
[ ?skipHistory g_skipHistory ]
)
=> t / nil
maeMigrateADEXLToMaestro.desc: Migrates the given ADE XL view to a new maestro cellview that can be opened in ADE Assembler.

maeAddOutput.name: maeAddOutput
maeAddOutput.syntax:
maeAddOutput(
t_outputName
t_testName
[ ?outputType t_outputType ]
[ ?signalName t_signalName ]
[ ?expr t_expr ]
[ ?plot g_plot ]
[ ?save g_save ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeAddOutput.desc: Adds an output for the given test in the currently active setup.

maeApplyCornerEditingOptions.name: maeApplyCornerEditingOptions
maeApplyCornerEditingOptions.desc: Applies the updates specified through maeSetCornerEditingOptions to the Corners Setup form.

maeCreateTest.name: maeCreateTest
maeCreateTest.syntax:
maeCreateTest(
t_testName 
[ ?sourceTest t_sourceTest ] 
[ ?lib t_lib ] 
[ ?cell t_cell ]
[ ?view t_view ]
[ ?simulator t_simulator ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCreateTest.desc: Creates a new test and adds it to the given maestro session. The design name for this test is set using the library, cell, and view name. If a source test name is given, it creates a copy of that test.

maeCloseSession.name: maeCloseSession
maeCloseSession.desc: Closes the sessions opened using maeOpenSetup in the SKILL code. This function cannot be used to close the sessions opened from the Virtuoso user interface.

maeConvertViewForReferencedAndLocalRunPl.name: maeConvertViewForReferencedAndLocalRunPlanCorners
maeConvertViewForReferencedAndLocalRunPl.desc: Converts all local and referenced corners created in cellviews saved using IC6.1.8 ISR9 or ICADVM18.1 ISR9 to referenced corners supported in earlier versions.

maeConvertViewForIntegratedHistoryManage.name: maeConvertViewForIntegratedHistoryManagement
maeConvertViewForIntegratedHistoryManage.syntax:
maeConvertViewForIntegratedHistoryManagement(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?newLib t_newLibName ]
[ ?newCell t_newCellName ]
[ ?newView t_newViewName ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> t / nil
maeConvertViewForIntegratedHistoryManage.desc: Converts the enhanced maestro view, in which separate history management is enabled, to the previous format in which histories are integrated with the main setup database.

maeConvertViewForSeparateHistoryManageme.name: maeConvertViewForSeparateHistoryManagement
maeConvertViewForSeparateHistoryManageme.syntax:
maeConvertViewForSeparateHistoryManagement(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?newLib t_newLibName ]
[ ?newCell t_newCellName ]
[ ?newView t_newViewName ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> t / nil
maeConvertViewForSeparateHistoryManageme.desc: Converts the maestro views in which history setup is integrated with the main setup database to an enhanced format in which separate history management is enabled.

maeDeleteCorner.name: maeDeleteCorner
maeDeleteCorner.desc: Deletes the specified corner from the setup database.

maeDeleteMultiWildCardOutputs.name: maeDeleteMultiWildCardOutputs
maeDeleteMultiWildCardOutputs.syntax:
maeDeleteMultiWildCardOutputs(
l_outputNamesWithWildCards
[ ?custom_column l_customColumnValue ]
[ ?customColumnName t_customColumnName ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteMultiWildCardOutputs.desc: Deletes the named outputs from the active setup. You can also delete outputs conditionally, based on a specified value in a custom column. You can use wildcard characters in the list of output names.

maeDeleteOutput.name: maeDeleteOutput
maeDeleteOutput.syntax:
maeDeleteOutput(
t_outputName
t_testName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteOutput.desc: Deletes the specified output from the setup database.

maeDeleteExplorerHistory.name: maeDeleteExplorerHistory
maeDeleteExplorerHistory.desc: Deletes the specified ADE Explorer history from the given maestro session.

maeDeleteParameter.name: maeDeleteParameter
maeDeleteParameter.desc: Deletes the specified parameter from the setup database.

maeDeleteTags.name: maeDeleteTags
maeDeleteTags.syntax:
maeDeleteTags(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?variables l_variableNames ]
[ ?corners l_cornerNames ]
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteTags.desc: Deletes the tags from the given list of variables and corners in the given session.

maeDeleteTest.name: maeDeleteTest
maeDeleteTest.syntax:
maeDeleteTest(
t_testName 
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?session t_session ]
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteTest.desc: Deletes the given test from the active setup or the specified run in the run plan.

maeDeleteVar.name: maeDeleteVar
maeDeleteVar.desc: Deletes the specified variable from the setup database.

maeEnableCorner.name: maeEnableCorner
maeEnableCorner.syntax:
maeEnableCorner(
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?enable g_enable ]
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?varList l_varList]
[ ?all g_all ]
)
=> t / nil
maeEnableCorner.desc: Enables or disables corners for a run in the run plan or in the active setup of ADE Assembler.

maeEnableGlobalVar.name: maeEnableGlobalVar
maeEnableGlobalVar.syntax:
maeEnableGlobalVar(
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?enable g_enable ]
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?varList l_varList ]
[ ?all g_all ]
)
=> t / nil
maeEnableGlobalVar.desc: Enables or disables the global variables for the specified run in the run plan or in the active setup of ADE Assembler.

maeEnableParameter.name: maeEnableParameter
maeEnableParameter.syntax:
maeEnableParameter(
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?enable g_enable ]
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?varList l_varList ]
[ ?all g_all ]
)
=> t / nil
maeEnableParameter.desc: Enables or disables all of the given parameters for the given run in the run plan or in the active setup of ADE Assembler.

maeEnableTests.name: maeEnableTests
maeEnableTests.syntax:
maeEnableTests(
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?testNames l_testNames ]
[ ?enable g_enable ]
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?all g_all ]
)
=> t / nil
maeEnableTests.desc: Enables or disables the specified tests for the specified run in the run plan or in the active setup of ADE Assembler.

maeExportCornersToCSV.name: maeExportCornersToCSV
maeExportCornersToCSV.desc: Exports corners from a maestro cellview to the given file in CSV format.

maeExportCornersToSDB.name: maeExportCornersToSDB
maeExportCornersToSDB.desc: Exports corners from a maestro cellview to the given file in SDB format.

maeExportGlobalVariablesToCSV.name: maeExportGlobalVariablesToCSV
maeExportGlobalVariablesToCSV.desc: Exports global variables from Virtuoso ADE Assembler to the given CSV file.

maeExportRunPreview.name: maeExportRunPreview
maeExportRunPreview.desc: Exports the Run Preview table to the specified CSV file. The default location of this file is path-to-cellview/documents.

maeExportSetupForExplorer.name: maeExportSetupForExplorer
maeExportSetupForExplorer.desc: Displays the Save A Copy form in ADE Explorer, which you can use to save the current setup. It is a callback function.

maeGetAllExplorerHistoryNames.name: maeGetAllExplorerHistoryNames
maeGetAllExplorerHistoryNames.desc: Returns a list of names of all the ADE Explorer histories for the specified maestro session.

maeGetAnalysis.name: maeGetAnalysis
maeGetAnalysis.syntax:
maeGetAnalysis(
t_testName
t_analysis
[ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ]
[ ?option t_option ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> l_options / nil
maeGetAnalysis.desc: Returns a list containing name-value pairs of the options set for the given analysis. By default, the function returns only those options for which the value is not empty. If the g_includeEmpty argument is set to t, it returns all the options. You can also specify the name of a specific option for which you want to know the value.

maeGetCornerEditingOptions.name: maeGetCornerEditingOptions
maeGetCornerEditingOptions.desc: Returns a disembodied property list containing the arguments specified through maeSetCornerEditingOptions.

maeGetCurrentRunMode.name: maeGetCurrentRunMode
maeGetCurrentRunMode.syntax:
maeGetCurrentRunMode(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?run t_runName ]
[ ?Abbreviations g_abbreviation ]
)
=> t_runModeName / nil
maeGetCurrentRunMode.desc: Returns the name of the run mode set in the given session or the given run.

maeGetEnabledAnalysis.name: maeGetEnabledAnalysis
maeGetEnabledAnalysis.desc: Returns a list containing names of all the analyses enabled for the given test.

maeGetEnvOption.name: maeGetEnvOption
maeGetEnvOption.syntax:
maeGetEnvOption(
t_testName
[ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ]
[ ?option t_option ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> l_optionList / nil
maeGetEnvOption.desc: Returns a list of name-value pairs for all the environment option for the given test. By default, it returns all the environment options whose value is not nil. If the includeEmpty argument is set to t, the function returns all the environment options. If a specific option is given, it returns the value of only that option.

maeGetExplorerTestName.name: maeGetExplorerTestName
maeGetExplorerTestName.desc: Returns the name of the test opened in ADE Explorer. If you descend into ADE Explorer from ADE Assembler, use this function to get the name of the current test.

maeGetSetup.name: maeGetSetup
maeGetSetup.syntax:
maeGetSetup(
[ ?typeName t_typeName ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?run t_runName ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> l_setupDetails / nil
maeGetSetup.desc: Returns the required setup details of variables, parameters, corners, and tests from the given session.

maeGetSimOption.name: maeGetSimOption
maeGetSimOption.syntax:
maeGetSimOption(
t_testName
[ ?option t_optionName ]
[ ?includeEmpty g_includeEmpty ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> l_options / nil
maeGetSimOption.desc: Returns a list containing name-value pairs for the simulator options for the given test. By default, it returns all the simulator options whose value is not nil. If the includeEmpty argument is set to t, it returns all the simulator options. If a specific option is specified, the function returns the value of only that option.

maeGetSessions.name: maeGetSessions
maeGetSessions.desc: Returns a list of valid ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler sessions that are currently open.

maeGetSetupLibrary.name: maeGetSetupLibrary
maeGetSetupLibrary.desc: Retrieves the setup library view from the current or specified session.

maeGetTags.name: maeGetTags
maeGetTags.desc: Returns a list of tags assigned to the specified corners or variables in the given session.

maeGetTestEnvVar.name: maeGetTestEnvVar
maeGetTestEnvVar.syntax:
maeGetTestEnvVar(
t_testName
t_varName
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> g_value / nil
maeGetTestEnvVar.desc: Returns the value of the specified environment variable for the given test. This function can be used to get the value set for a particular test using the maeSetTestEnvVar function.

maeGetTestSession.name: maeGetTestSession
maeGetTestSession.desc: Returns session handle to the given test. You can use this handle to view or modify the test details.

maeGetVar.name: maeGetVar
maeGetVar.syntax:
maeGetVar(
t_varname
[ ?typeName t_typeName ]
[ ?typeValue t_typeValue ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> t_value / nil
maeGetVar.desc: Returns value of the given variable. Use this function to get the global, test-level, or corner value for the given variable.

maeImportSetupForExplorer.name: maeImportSetupForExplorer
maeImportSetupForExplorer.desc: Displays the Import Setup form in ADE Explorer, which you can use to import a saved maestro cellview in the current setup. This is a callback function.

maeIsPrerunScriptEnabled.name: maeIsPrerunScriptEnabled
maeIsPrerunScriptEnabled.desc: Checks whether pre-run scripts are enabled for a test in the given maestro session.

maeIsSetupModified.name: maeIsSetupModified
maeIsSetupModified.desc: Checks whether the setup has been modified after the last time it was saved in the given maestro session.

maeIsSingleTest.name: maeIsSingleTest
maeIsSingleTest.syntax:
maeIsSingleTest(
t_libraryName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName
)
=> t / nil
maeIsSingleTest.desc: Returns t if the given cellview contains a single test or multiple tests.

maeIsValidMaestroSession.name: maeIsValidMaestroSession
maeIsValidMaestroSession.desc: Confirms if the given session is valid for ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler.

maeLoadCorners.name: maeLoadCorners
maeLoadCorners.syntax:
maeLoadCorners(
t_fileName 
[?operation t_operation]
[?session t_session]
)
=> t / nil
maeLoadCorners.desc: Loads corners from the given file into the corner setup of the current session or the specified session.

maeMakeEditable.name: maeMakeEditable
maeMakeEditable.desc: Changes the mode of an already open cellview from read-only to editable.

maeMakeReadonly.name: maeMakeReadonly
maeMakeReadonly.desc: Changes the mode of an already open cellview from editable to read-only.

maeOpenSetup.name: maeOpenSetup
maeOpenSetup.syntax:
maeOpenSetup(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?application t_applicationName ]
[ ?histName t_historyName ]
[ ?mode t_mode ]
)
=> t_sessionName / nil
maeOpenSetup.desc: Loads the given cellview and restores the setup details from the specified history. If no history name is specified, the active setup is loaded. If the specified view is already opened in the current Virtuoso session, it is not opened again. However, if the view is already open in some other Virtuoso session, it is opened in read mode in the current session. If the given cellview does not exist, the function creates a new cellview with the same name.

maeLoadSetupState.name: maeLoadSetupState
maeLoadSetupState.syntax:
maeLoadSetupState(
t_stateName
[ ?tags l_tagNames ] 
[ ?operation s_operationName ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ])
)
=> t_sessionName / nil
maeLoadSetupState.desc: Loads the given setup state into the given session.

maeLoadStateForTest.name: maeLoadStateForTest
maeLoadStateForTest.syntax:
maeLoadStateForTest(
t_testName
t_stateName
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?loadFrom s_loadFrom ]
[ ?statePath s_statePath ]
[ ?libName t_libName ]
[ ?cellName t_cellName ]
[ ?simulator t_simulatorName ]
[ ?component l_componentList ]
)
=> t_sessionName / nil
maeLoadStateForTest.desc: Loads the saved ADE state for the given test.

maeResetCornerEditingOptions.name: maeResetCornerEditingOptions
maeResetCornerEditingOptions.desc: Resets the Corners Setup form to its state before maeSetCornerEditingOptions was applied.

maeRegTimer.name: maeRegTimer
maeRegTimer.desc: Registers or sets a timer to initialize the specified SKILL function after the given time has elapsed during simulation. This timer can be used in ADE interface job customization.

maeRunDspfChecker.name: maeRunDspfChecker
maeRunDspfChecker.desc: Runs the Spf Checker utility for the tests that have DSPF files in the setup.

maeSaveSetup.name: maeSaveSetup
maeSaveSetup.syntax:
maeSaveSetup(
[ ?lib t_libName ] 
[ ?cell t_cellName ]
[ ?view t_viewName ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ])
=> t / nil
maeSaveSetup.desc: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current session in the library, cell, view format. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. It is recommended to run this function after making changes in the setup.

maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization.name: maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization
maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization.syntax:
maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization(
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
[ ?run t_runName ]
[ ?setupState t_setupState ]
[ ?pointID x_pointID ]
[ ?historyName t_historyName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSaveSetupStateForOptimization.desc: Saves the setup state for optimization from the best design point of a run or the given history. You can use this saved state as the starting point for an optimization run in a run plan.

maeSetCornerEditingOptions.name: maeSetCornerEditingOptions
maeSetCornerEditingOptions.syntax:
maeSetCornerEditingOptions(
[ ?cornerNameFilter g_FilterName ]
[ ?session g_sessionName ]
[ ?removeVarList g_VarList ]
[ ?removeDuplicates {t|nil}]
[ ?removeUndefined {t|nil}]

)
=> t / nil
maeSetCornerEditingOptions.desc: Specifies the options for editing the corners setup. These settings are reflected in the Corners Setup form, when the options Import Corners from CSV File and Import Corners from SDB File are used.

maeSetStartingPointForOptimization.name: maeSetStartingPointForOptimization
maeSetStartingPointForOptimization.syntax:
maeSetStartingPointForOptimization(
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
[ ?run t_runName ]
[ ?setupState t_setupState ]
[ ?runMode t_runMode ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetStartingPointForOptimization.desc: Sets the given setup state as the starting point for the Local Optimization or Global Optimization run mode in the specified run.

maeSetTags.name: maeSetTags
maeSetTags.syntax:
maeSetTags(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?variables l_variables ]
[ ?corners l_corners ]
[ ?tags l_tags ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetTags.desc: Assigns the given tags to the specified corners and variables. You can also append to or overwrite the existing tags.

maeStmConsolidateStimuli.name: maeStmConsolidateStimuli
maeStmConsolidateStimuli.syntax:
maeStmConsolidateStimuli(
t_libName 
t_cellName
t_viewName
?reportFile t_reportFile
)
=> t / nil
maeStmConsolidateStimuli.desc: Removes duplicate stimuli definitions from the given cellview. For this, ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler reviews each test in the cellview and, if required, reassigns pins and globals by removing duplicates.

maeStmGenerateWaveforms.name: maeStmGenerateWaveforms
maeStmGenerateWaveforms.syntax:
maeStmGenerateWaveforms(
t_libName 
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?test t_testName ]
[ ?reportFile t_reportFile ]
[ ?force g_force ]
)
=> t / nil
maeStmGenerateWaveforms.desc: Generates preview stimuli waveforms for the stimuli added for a maestro cellview that contains stimuli definitions added through the Stimuli Assignment form. These stimuli definitions are saved in the file lib-name/cell-name/view-name/namedStimuli/stimuli.xml.

maeSaveSetupState.name: maeSaveSetupState
maeSaveSetupState.syntax:
maeSaveSetupState(
t_stateName
[ ?tags l_tagNames ] 
[ ?inReadOnly s_readOnlyAction ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ])
=> t / nil
maeSaveSetupState.desc: Saves a setup state for the given session.

maeSetAnalysis.name: maeSetAnalysis
maeSetAnalysis.syntax:
maeSetAnalysis(
t_testName
t_analysis
[ ?enable g_enabled ]
[ ?options l_options ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetAnalysis.desc: Adds or removes an analysis for the given test. The function can also be used to set the value of different options for the analysis.

maeSetCorner.name: maeSetCorner
maeSetCorner.syntax:
maeSetCorner(
t_cornerName
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?enableTests l_enableTests ]
[ ?disableTests l_disableTests ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetCorner.desc: Adds a new corner and enables/disables it for the given test.

maeSetCurrentRunMode.name: maeSetCurrentRunMode
maeSetCurrentRunMode.desc: Updates the current run mode in ADE Assembler.

maeSetDesign.name: maeSetDesign
maeSetDesign.syntax:
maeSetDesign(
t_testName
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t_testName / nil
maeSetDesign.desc: Sets a design for the given test. Use this function to change the design associated to a test.

maeSetEnableTestVar.name: maeSetEnableTestVar
maeSetEnableTestVar.syntax:
maeSetEnableTestVar(
t_testName
l_variableNames
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetEnableTestVar.desc: Enables or disables the specified variables or local sweeps for the given test.

maeSetEnvOption.name: maeSetEnvOption
maeSetEnvOption.syntax:
maeSetEnvOption(
t_testName
[ ?options l_options ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetEnvOption.desc: Sets values for one or more environment options for the given test.

maeSetHistoryLock.name: maeSetHistoryLock
maeSetHistoryLock.syntax:
maeSetHistoryLock(
t_historyName 
g_lock
[ ?session t_sessionName ])
=> t / nil
maeSetHistoryLock.desc: Locks or unlocks the given history for the given ADE Assembler session.

maeSetParameter.name: maeSetParameter
maeSetParameter.syntax:
maeSetParameter(
t_parameterName
g_parameterValue
[ ?typeName t_typeName ]
[ ?typeValue l_typeValue ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetParameter.desc: Adds a new parameter at the global level or corner level. If the parameter already exists, its value is updated.

maeSetSpec.name: maeSetSpec
maeSetSpec.syntax:
maeSetSpec (
t_outputName
t_testName
[ ?minimum g_minValue ]
[ ?maximum g_maxValue ]
[ ?gt g_greaterThanValue ]
[ ?lt g_lessThanValue ]
[ ?range g_rangeValues ]
[ ?tolerance g_toleranceValue ]
[ ?info g_info ]
[ ?weight g_weightingFactor ]
[ ?corner g_cornerName ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetSpec.desc: Adds a specification to an output defined for a test. You can also use this function to modify an existing specification for an output.

maeSetSetup.name: maeSetSetup
maeSetSetup.syntax:
maeSetSetup(
[ ?tests l_testNames ]
[ ?variables l_variables ]
[ ?parameters l_params ]
[ ?corners l_corners ]
[ ?enabled g_enabled ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> t / nil
maeSetSetup.desc: Enables or disables the tests, global variables, parameters, and corners.

maeSetSetupLibrary.name: maeSetSetupLibrary
maeSetSetupLibrary.syntax:
maeSetSetupLibrary(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeSetSetupLibrary.desc: Connects the provided setup library view to the maestro view.

maeSetSimOption.name: maeSetSimOption
maeSetSimOption.syntax:
maeSetSimOption(
t_testName 
[ ?options l_options ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> t / nil
maeSetSimOption.desc: Sets values for the specified simulator options of the given test. Multiple options can be specified in a single command.

maeSetTestEnvVar.name: maeSetTestEnvVar
maeSetTestEnvVar.syntax:
maeSetTestEnvVar(
t_testName
t_varName
g_varValue
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t_value / nil
maeSetTestEnvVar.desc: Sets the value for the given environment variable at the test level. The value is used only by the specified test. Other tests in the session use the value set at the global level or specific values set for them, if any.

maeSetVar.name: maeSetVar
maeSetVar.syntax:
maeSetVar(
t_varname
g_valValue
[ ?typeName t_typeName ]
[ ?typeValue l_typeValue ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> t / nil
maeSetVar.desc: Adds a variable to the given test or corner in the given ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler session. If the variable already exists, its value is updated.

maeUpdateImplicitSignals.name: maeUpdateImplicitSignals
maeUpdateImplicitSignals.desc: Updates the implicit signals for the tests in the specified maestro session.

getSimRunInfo.name: getSimRunInfo
getSimRunInfo.desc: Returns the value of the specified type of simulation information for a given ADE output expression by accessing the related psf directory.

maeCloseResults.name: maeCloseResults
maeCloseResults.desc: Closes the results opened by the maeOpenResults function.

maeDeleteSimulationData.name: maeDeleteSimulationData
maeDeleteSimulationData.syntax:
maeDeleteSimulationData(
t_historyName
?session t_sessionName
?keepNetlist g_keepNetlist
?keepQuickPlot g_keepQuickPlot
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteSimulationData.desc: Deletes the simulation results data for the given history.

maeDisplayLogDiagnostics.name: maeDisplayLogDiagnostics
maeDisplayLogDiagnostics.desc: Displays the ADE diagnostics report for the diagnostics run associated with the specified ID. The diagnostics report is generated in the background without freezing the maestro session.

maeExportOutputView.name: maeExportOutputView
maeExportOutputView.syntax:
maeExportOutputView(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?fileName t_fileName ]
[ ?view t_viewType ]
[ ?historyName t_historyName ]
[ ?testName t_testName ]
[ ?filterName t_filterName ]
[ ?clearAllFilters g_clearAllFilters ]
)
=> t / nil
maeExportOutputView.desc: Exports the output or results view to the specified .csv or .html file.

maeForceRdbStatus.name: maeForceRdbStatus
maeForceRdbStatus.syntax:
maeForceRdbStatus(
t_sessionName
t_historyName
?pointID x_pointID
?designPointID x_designPointID
?cornerName t_cornerName
?toStatus t_toStatus
)
=> t / nil
maeForceRdbStatus.desc: Forcefully sets the status of results for a history or a selected point in a history.

maeGetNBestDesignPoints.name: maeGetNBestDesignPoints
maeGetNBestDesignPoints.desc: Returns the best design points for the opened results.

maeGetOutputValue.name: maeGetOutputValue
maeGetOutputValue.syntax:
maeGetOutputValue(
t_outputName
t_testName
[ ?cornerName t_cornerName ]
[ ?pointId x_pointId ]
[ ?evalType t_evalType ]
)
=> x_value / nil
maeGetOutputValue.desc: Returns value of the given output.

maeGetParamConditions.name: maeGetParamConditions
maeGetParamConditions.desc: Returns the design parameter conditions for the given design point ID.

maeGetParameter.name: maeGetParameter
maeGetParameter.syntax:
maeGetParameter(
t_paramName
[ ?typeName t_typeName ]
[ ?typeValue t_typeValue ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t_value / nil
maeGetParameter.desc: Returns value of the given parameter for the given test or corner.

maeGetResultOutputs.name: maeGetResultOutputs
maeGetResultOutputs.desc: Returns the list of outputs for the opened result.

maeGetResultTests.name: maeGetResultTests
maeGetResultTests.desc: Returns a list of tests for the opened result.

maeGetResultsViewSelectedCellsDetails.name: maeGetResultsViewSelectedCellsDetails
maeGetResultsViewSelectedCellsDetails.desc: Returns a list of data point ID, test name, and output name for each result value selected in the Detail, Detail-Transpose, or Fault results view of the currently visible run history. If the selected cell is in the column that does not show any results value, for example, Test or Output, no data is returned from that.

maeGetSpecStatus.name: maeGetSpecStatus
maeGetSpecStatus.syntax:
maeGetSpecStatus(
t_outputName
t_testName
[ ?pointId n_pointId ]
)
=> pass / fail / undefined
maeGetSpecStatus.desc: Returns the specification status for the given output, test and point id.

maeGetTestOutputs.name: maeGetTestOutputs
maeGetTestOutputs.desc: Returns the list of outputs for the specified test in the current session or a specific maestro session.

maeGetOverallSpecStatus.name: maeGetOverallSpecStatus
maeGetOverallSpecStatus.desc: Returns the overall specification status for the current history.

maeGetOverallYield.name: maeGetOverallYield
maeGetOverallYield.desc: Returns the overall yield for the given history.

maeImportHistory.name: maeImportHistory
maeImportHistory.syntax:
maeImportHistory(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?history t_historyName ]
[ ?copyPSF g_copyPSF ]
[ ?overwrite g_overwrite ]
)
=> t / nil
maeImportHistory.desc: Imports the zip file for the given history from one cellview into the current cellview.

maeOpenResults.name: maeOpenResults
maeOpenResults.syntax:
maeOpenResults(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?history t_historyName ]
[ ?run t_runName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeOpenResults.desc: Opens the result for the given history or run plan, and sets the result pointer to be used by other functions.

maeReadResDB.name: maeReadResDB
maeReadResDB.syntax:
maeReadResDB(
[ ?historyName t_historyName ] 
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
[ ?run t_runName ]
)
=> h_resultsDBObj / nil
maeReadResDB.desc: Returns a handle to the results database for the given history.

maeRestoreHistory.name: maeRestoreHistory
maeRestoreHistory.desc: Restores the given history as the active setup.

maeRunLogDiagnostics.name: maeRunLogDiagnostics
maeRunLogDiagnostics.syntax:
maeRunLogDiagnostics(
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?lib t_libName ]
[ ?cell t_cellName ]
[ ?view t_viewName ]
[ ?directory t_directory ]
[ ?historyName t_historyName ]
[ ?points l_points ]
[ ?testNames l_testNames ]
[ ?checks l_checks ]
[ ?jobs x_jobs ]
[ ?tolerance x_tolerance ] 
[ ?display g_display ] 
[ ?log t_log ] 
)
=> x_ID / nil
maeRunLogDiagnostics.desc: Runs a list of checks on the log files for the specified history and generates the ADE Diagnostics report. Troubleshooting simulation errors using log files can be a difficult task because ADE Assembler saves multiple log files that are generated by different components of the LSCS architecture. The ADE diagnostics reports provides a detailed analysis of such errors and helps in debugging.

maeWriteDatasheet.name: maeWriteDatasheet
maeWriteDatasheet.syntax:
maeWriteDatasheet(
[ ?directory t_directory ]
[ ?resultsSummary g_resultsSummary ]
[ ?testsSummary g_testsSummary ]
[ ?detailedResults g_detailedResults ]
[ ?plots g_points ]
[ ?designVarsSummary g_designVarsSummary ]
[ ?paramsSummary g_paramsSummary ]
[ ?cornersSummary g_cornersSummary ]
[ ?setupSummary g_setupSummary ]
[ ?launchBrowser g_launchBrowser ]
[ ?name t_name ] 
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
[ ?historyName t_historyName ] 
)
=> t / nil
maeWriteDatasheet.desc: Writes the results for the given history in a datasheet.

maeCloseViolationDb.name: maeCloseViolationDb
maeCloseViolationDb.desc: Closes an open checks and asserts database using the database ID returned by maeOpenViolationDb.

maeOpenViolationDb.name: maeOpenViolationDb
maeOpenViolationDb.syntax:
maeOpenViolationDb(
t_sessionName
t_testName
t_historyName
)
=> x_dbId / nil
maeOpenViolationDb.desc: Opens a connection to the checks and asserts database for the given maestro cellview and returns a unique ID for the connection. You can use this ID to read or modify the database and its attached waiver SQL database using other SKILL functions. You must close this connection using maeCloseViolationDb to release the connection and complete the transactions on the database.

maeRefreshViolationDisplay.name: maeRefreshViolationDisplay
maeRefreshViolationDisplay.desc: Refreshes the Checks/Asserts results view. When it is already open and the database is modified, use this function to refresh the displayed results.

maeWaiveViolation.name: maeWaiveViolation
maeWaiveViolation.syntax:
maeWaiveViolation(
x_dbId
[?objectName t_objectName]
[?objectType t_objectType]
[?checkerName t_checkerName]
[?analysisName t_analysisName]
[?time t_time]
[?comment t_comment]
[?historyName t_historyName]
[?designPoint x_designPoint]
[?corner t_cornerName]

)
=> t / nil
maeWaiveViolation.desc: Adds a rule to the waivers SQL database that waives a check and assert for the given object.

maeUnWaiveViolation.name: maeUnWaiveViolation
maeUnWaiveViolation.syntax:
maeUnWaiveViolation(
x_dbId
[?objectName t_objectName]
[?objectType t_objectType]
[?checkerName t_checkerName]
[?analysisName t_analysisName]
[?time t_time]
)
=> t / nil
maeUnWaiveViolation.desc: Removes from the waivers SQL database a waive rule matching the given criteria.

maeAddPostRunScript.name: maeAddPostRunScript
maeAddPostRunScript.syntax:
maeAddPostRunScript(
t_runName
t_postRunScriptFileName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeAddPostRunScript.desc: Adds the given post-run script to the specified run in the run plan.

maeAddPreRunScript.name: maeAddPreRunScript
maeAddPreRunScript.syntax:
maeAddPreRunScript(
t_runName
t_preRunScriptFileName
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeAddPreRunScript.desc: Adds the pre-run script to the specified run in the run plan.

maeCopySimulationOptions.name: maeCopySimulationOptions
maeCopySimulationOptions.syntax:
maeCopySimulationOptions(
t_srcRun
[ ?destRun t_destRun ] | [ ?all g_all ]
[ ?session t_session ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCopySimulationOptions.desc: Copies the simulation options from the source run to the destination run. Different run modes have different simulation options, therefore, It is mandatory that the source and destination runs have the same run mode. Otherwise, the function reports an error.

maeCreateNewRun.name: maeCreateNewRun
maeCreateNewRun.syntax:
maeCreateNewRun(
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?runName t_runName ]
[ ?newRunFromActiveSetup g_newRunFromActiveSetup ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCreateNewRun.desc: Creates a new run in the run plan.

maeCreateRunCondition.name: maeCreateRunCondition
maeCreateRunCondition.syntax:
maeCreateRunCondition(
t_sourceRunName
[ ?name t_name ]
[ ?run t_run ]
[ ?test t_test ]
[ ?output t_output ]
[ ?status t_status ]
[ ?session t_session ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCreateRunCondition.desc: Adds a run condition to the specified run in the run plan.

maeCreateRunCopy.name: maeCreateRunCopy
maeCreateRunCopy.syntax:
maeCreateRunCopy(
?run t_run 
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?copyName g_copyName ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCreateRunCopy.desc: Creates a copy of the specified run in the run plan.

maeCopyTestToRun.name: maeCopyTestToRun
maeCopyTestToRun.syntax:
maeCopyTestToRun(
t_testName
[ ?session t_session ]
[ ?run t_run ] | [ ?all g_all ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCopyTestToRun.desc: Copies one or more tests from the active setup to a run in the run plan.

maeDeleteRun.name: maeDeleteRun
maeDeleteRun.syntax:
maeDeleteRun(
[ ?run l_run ] | [ ?all g_all ]
[ ?session t_session ]
)
=> t / nil
maeDeleteRun.desc: Deletes the specified runs from the run plan.

maeDeleteRunCondition.name: maeDeleteRunCondition
maeDeleteRunCondition.syntax:
maeDeleteRunCondition(

maeGetNumberOfExecutedRuns.desc: Returns the number of runs executed in the flow. It only counts a run that has been completed, partial runs are not included. This is exclusive for the fault dropping flow.

maeGetHistoryNameForCurrentRunInRunPlan.desc: Returns the history name for the current run in the run plan.

maeSensDeleteModel.desc: Deletes the specified model from the setup for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensDeleteModelGroup.name: maeSensDeleteModelGroup
maeSensDeleteModelGroup.desc: Deletes all the model groups specified in the Model Groups setting on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensDeleteParameter.name: maeSensDeleteParameter
maeSensDeleteParameter.desc: Deletes the specified parameter from the setup for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensDeleteVar.name: maeSensDeleteVar
maeSensDeleteVar.desc: Deletes the specified variable from the setup for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session. You can also use this function to delete the value for the Temperature field in the Sensitivity form.

maeSensEnableDesignVariation.name: maeSensEnableDesignVariation
maeSensEnableDesignVariation.desc: Selects or deselects the Enable Design and PVT Variation check box on the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensEnableStatVariation.name: maeSensEnableStatVariation
maeSensEnableStatVariation.desc: Selects or deselects the Enable Variation of Statistical Parameters check box in the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetModel.name: maeSensGetModel
maeSensGetModel.desc: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified model from the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetModelGroup.name: maeSensGetModelGroup
maeSensGetModelGroup.desc: Returns a list of values specified in the Model Groups setting on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetModels.name: maeSensGetModels
maeSensGetModels.desc: Returns a list containing the names of all enabled models on the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetParameter.name: maeSensGetParameter
maeSensGetParameter.desc: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified parameter from the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetParameters.name: maeSensGetParameters
maeSensGetParameters.desc: Returns a list of all enabled parameters on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetVar.name: maeSensGetVar
maeSensGetVar.desc: Returns a list of valid values and the nominal value for the specified global variable from the Sensitivity form for sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensGetVars.name: maeSensGetVars
maeSensGetVars.desc: Returns a list containing the names of all enabled global variables, including Temperature, on the Sensitivity form for the Sensitivity Analysis run mode in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeSensSetMethod.name: maeSensSetMethod
maeSensSetMethod.desc: Sets the value in the Method field on the Sensitivity form for Sensitivity analysis in the current or the specified maestro session.

maeGetFaultGroups.name: maeGetFaultGroups
maeGetFaultGroups.desc: Returns a list of fault groups that exist in the active fault setup.

maeGetFaultSamplingOptions.desc: Returns the sampling options set for fault simulation.

maeGetGlobalFaultOptions.name: maeGetGlobalFaultOptions
maeGetGlobalFaultOptions.desc: Returns the global fault options set in the Virtuoso ADE Fault Setup Global Preferences form. These options are applicable to all faults unless overridden in individual faults or fault rules.

maeRunFaultSimulationWithFaultDroppingFo.name: maeRunFaultSimulationWithFaultDroppingForActiveTests
maeRunFaultSimulationWithFaultDroppingFo.desc: Runs the fault dropping flow in batch mode for the enabled tests in the given session.

maeSwitchActiveFaultGroupForCurrentRun.name: maeSwitchActiveFaultGroupForCurrentRun
maeSwitchActiveFaultGroupForCurrentRun.desc: Sets the fault group to run for the current run in run plan. This is exclusive to the fault dropping flow.

maeSetFaultGroupToRun.name: maeSetFaultGroupToRun
maeSetFaultGroupToRun.desc: Sets the fault group to run for the active fault setup.

axlGetMainSetupDB.name: axlGetMainSetupDB
axlGetMainSetupDB.desc: Returns a handle to the working setup database of the named session.

axlGetSessionCellName.name: axlGetSessionCellName
axlGetSessionCellName.desc: Returns the cell name associated with the session or setup database.

axlGetSessionLibName.name: axlGetSessionLibName
axlGetSessionLibName.desc: Returns the library name associated with the given session or setup database.

axlGetSessionViewName.name: axlGetSessionViewName
axlGetSessionViewName.desc: Returns the view name associated with the given session or setup database.

axlGetSessionWindowNumber.name: axlGetSessionWindowNumber

axlGetCurrentResultSimulationHost.desc: This is a callback function that runs from a Results table context menu.

axlIsSessionReadOnly.name: axlIsSessionReadOnly

axlIsValidAXLSession.name: axlIsValidAXLSession
axlIsValidAXLSession.desc: Checks the validity of the specified session.

axlNoSession.name: axlNoSession

axlRemoveSetupState.name: axlRemoveSetupState

axlSessionSignalSignature.desc: Returns the signature of a given signal that is emitted by a session. This function serves as a utility function to determine how to implement the slot or callback function in SKILL.

axlSetMainSetupDB.desc: Sets the working setup database for a session to the setup database specified by the given setupDBPath. This function is useful when you create a new session in a SKILL script and then you want to setup a database for that.

axlGetHistoryGroupChildren.desc: Returns a list containing a handle to all history children entries in the history group and a list of names of all the history children entries.

axlGetActiveSetup.desc: Returns a handle to the active setup. You can use this handle to get or set setup details for the active setup.

axlGetHistoryGroupChildrenEntry.name: axlGetHistoryGroupChildrenEntry
axlGetHistoryGroupChildrenEntry.desc: Finds a history entry in a group run by name and returns the handle to it.

axlGetResultsLocation.desc: Returns the results location for the specified setup database.

axlGetReuseNetlist.name: axlGetReuseNetlist
axlGetReuseNetlist.desc: Checks if the option to use reference netlist is enabled for the setup database. This option helps in reusing the netlist of the reference history for the incremental simulation run.

axlGetScript.name: axlGetScript
axlGetScript.desc: Finds a script by name and returns a handle to it.

axlGetScriptPath.name: axlGetScriptPath
axlGetScriptPath.desc: Returns the path of a script.

axlGetScripts.name: axlGetScripts
axlGetScripts.desc: Returns a list containing the handle to all scripts for this database entry and a list of all script names.

axlGetSessionFromSetupDB.name: axlGetSessionFromSetupDB
axlGetSessionFromSetupDB.desc: Determines the session associated with the provided setup database handle.

axlGetSetupDBDir.name: axlGetSetupDBDir
axlGetSetupDBDir.desc: Returns the path to the directory of the specified setup database.

axlGetSetupInfo.name: axlGetSetupInfo
axlGetSetupInfo.desc: Returns the setup information for the complete setup or a specific test. This includes the number of corners, sweep points, and data points in the setup.

axlGetTopLevel.name: axlGetTopLevel
axlGetTopLevel.desc: Returns the handle to the setup database containing the specified element.

axlGetUseIncremental.name: axlGetUseIncremental
axlGetUseIncremental.desc: Checks if using reference results as cache during incremental run is enabled for the active setup or checkpoint.

axlPutScript.desc: Inserts or finds a script by name, sets its path, and returns a handle to that script.

axlPutTest.desc: Finds or inserts a test into the setup database and returns a handle to that test.

axlRemoveElement.desc: Removes an element and all its children from the setup database.

axlSaveSetup.desc: Saves the setup database file and test state files for the current window. The behavior of this function is similar to File - Save. If the cellview was opened in the read-only mode, a new library, cell, and view value must be provided for which you need to save the setup details.

t_libName 
t_cellName 
t_viewName 
)

axlSaveSetupToLib.desc: Saves the setup database to the specified lib/cell/view.

axlSDBDebugPrint.name: axlSDBDebugPrint
axlSDBDebugPrint.desc: Prints the in-memory database rooted at the supplied handle. Useful for debugging so that SDB modifications can be seen without saving the XML to disk.

)

axlSDBGetChildVal.name: axlSDBGetChildVal
axlSDBGetChildVal.desc: Works as a wrapper around axlSDBGetChild and returns the value for a single child element.

axlSDBGetExtension.name: axlSDBGetExtension
axlSDBGetExtension.desc: Returns the named setup database extension.

axlSDBGetName.name: axlSDBGetName
axlSDBGetName.desc: Returns the name of the provided setup database handle.

axlSDBGetValue.name: axlSDBGetValue
axlSDBGetValue.desc: Returns the value of the provided setup database handle.

axlSDBHp.name: axlSDBHp
axlSDBHp.desc: Returns whether the supplied argument is a valid setup database handle.

axlSDBPutExtension.name: axlSDBPutExtension
axlSDBPutExtension.desc: Adds an extension to the ADE setup database under which customization can be created.

x_SDBH

t_value
)

axlSDBSetChild.desc: Creates a new child element under the provided setup database handle.

axlSDBSetMultipleEntry.name: axlSDBSetMultipleEntry
axlSDBSetMultipleEntry.desc: Sets a setup database name to be a multiple entry name. By default, a setup database handle is a single entry name.  A single-entry element is differentiated only by its name, whereas a multi-entry element is differentiated by both name and value.

axlSDBSetValue.name: axlSDBSetValue
axlSDBSetValue.desc: Sets the value of the provided setup database handle.

axlSetAllSweepsEnabled.name: axlSetAllSweepsEnabled
axlSetAllSweepsEnabled.desc: Sets the selection status of the Point Sweeps check box in the Run Summary assistant pane.

axlSetCopyRefResultsOption.name: axlSetCopyRefResultsOption
axlSetCopyRefResultsOption.desc: Specifies whether the simulation results need to be copied or moved from the reference history.

axlSetEnabled.name: axlSetEnabled
axlSetEnabled.desc: Enables or disables a setup database element, such as a test or a variable.

axlSetReferenceHistoryItemName.name: axlSetReferenceHistoryItemName
axlSetReferenceHistoryItemName.desc: Sets the reference history name for the active setup or checkpoint. You can reuse the results or netlist from the reference history during an incremental simulation run. The reference history name set using this function also appears in the Reference field on the Reference History toolbar.

axlSetReuseNetlistOption.name: axlSetReuseNetlistOption
axlSetReuseNetlistOption.desc: Enables or disables the option to use the reference netlist for the active setup or checkpoint. If this option is enabled, netlist of the design is reused for the incremental run. Otherwise, the design in renetlisted.

axlSetUseIncremental.name: axlSetUseIncremental
axlSetUseIncremental.desc: Enables or disables the setup database option in active setup or checkpoint for using reference results as cache during incremental run. This function selects or clears the Use reference netlist check box on the Reference History form.

axlSetScriptPath.name: axlSetScriptPath
axlSetScriptPath.desc: Sets the path of a script.

axlWriteDatasheetForm.name: axlWriteDatasheetForm
axlWriteDatasheetForm.desc: Causes a form to appear so that you can specify various options for generating a datasheet.

maeGetReferenceHistories.name: maeGetReferenceHistories
maeGetReferenceHistories.desc: Returns a list of names of the reference histories used in the active setup or the given history.

axlGetVar.desc: Finds a variable associated with the specified database element and returns a handle to it.

axlGetVars.desc: Returns a list containing a handle to all variables associated with the given database element (the setup database, a corner, or a history checkpoint) and a list of all variable names.

axlGetVarValue.name: axlGetVarValue
axlGetVarValue.desc: Returns value of the given variable.

x_element

)

axlPutVar.desc: Creates or finds a variable by the given name for the specified database element and sets its value.

axlGetAllVarsDisabled.name: axlGetAllVarsDisabled
axlGetAllVarsDisabled.desc: Returns the status for inclusion of the global variables in a simulation. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Global Variables check box in the Data View assistant pane of ADE Assembler.

axlSetAllVarsDisabled.name: axlSetAllVarsDisabled
axlSetAllVarsDisabled.desc: Sets the selection status of the option to include the global variables in simulations. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Global Variables check box in the Data View assistant pane of ADE Assembler.

axlSetDefaultVariables.name: axlSetDefaultVariables
axlSetDefaultVariables.desc: Creates a set of default variables in the Global Variables tree on the Data View pane and in the Parameters and Variables assistant of ADE Assembler.

axlSetDesignVariablePerTest.name: axlSetDesignVariablePerTest
axlSetDesignVariablePerTest.syntax:
axlSetDesignVariablePerTest( 
x_mainSDB
t_varName
t_testName

) 
=> t / nil
axlSetDesignVariablePerTest.desc: Enables or disables a design variable for a specific test. In the Setup assistant of ADE Explorer or the Data View assistant of ADE Assembler, it selects or clears the check box next to a design variable under a test.

axlGetParameters.name: axlGetParameters
axlGetParameters.desc: Returns a list of paths to all the device parameters found in the given database.

axlGetParameter.name: axlGetParameter
axlGetParameter.desc: Returns the database handle to the given device parameter in the setup database.

axlGetParameterValue.name: axlGetParameterValue
axlGetParameterValue.desc: Returns value of the specified device parameter in the setup database.

axlGetAllParametersDisabled.name: axlGetAllParametersDisabled
axlGetAllParametersDisabled.desc: Returns the selection status of the option to include the device parameters in simulations. In the GUI, this is the selection status of the Parameters check box in the Data View assistant pane.

axlRegisterCustomDeviceFilter.name: axlRegisterCustomDeviceFilter
axlRegisterCustomDeviceFilter.desc: Adds a custom filter for device instance parameters on the Variables and Parameters assistant pane in ADE Explorer and ADE Assembler.

axlSetParameter.syntax:
axlSetParameter(
x_mainSDB
t_parameterPath
t_value
)
=> t / nil
axlSetParameter.desc: Sets a value for the specified device parameter.

axlSetAllParametersDisabled.name: axlSetAllParametersDisabled
axlSetAllParametersDisabled.desc: Sets the status of the Parameters check box in the Data View assistant pane in ADE Explorer and ADE Assembler.

axlAddModelPermissibleSectionLists.name: axlAddModelPermissibleSectionLists
axlAddModelPermissibleSectionLists.desc: Creates a new list or adds new section names to the existing list of permissible section names for the given model imported from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, the tool checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names. If you specify a section name that is not included in the permissible list, the tool shows appropriate errors.

axlGetModel.name: axlGetModel
axlGetModel.desc: Returns a handle to the specified model file associated with the given corner.

axlGetModelBlock.name: axlGetModelBlock
axlGetModelBlock.desc: Returns the block name with which the specified model is associated. By default, a model file is associated with a test and therefore, the block name is set to Global. However, in MTS mode, a model can be associated with a specific block in the design. Using this function, you can get the name of the block with which a model file is associated.

axlGetModelFile.name: axlGetModelFile
axlGetModelFile.desc: Returns the model file path for the specified model.

axlGetModelGroup.name: axlGetModelGroup
axlGetModelGroup.desc: Returns a handle to the specified model group in the setup database.

axlGetModelGroupName.name: axlGetModelGroupName
axlGetModelGroupName.desc: Returns the name of the model group associated with the specified corner.

axlGetModelGroups.name: axlGetModelGroups
axlGetModelGroups.desc: Returns a list of the model group names in a given setup database.

axlGetModelPermissibleSectionLists.name: axlGetModelPermissibleSectionLists
axlGetModelPermissibleSectionLists.desc: Returns a list of permissible section names for the given model extracted from a PCF file.

axlGetModelSection.name: axlGetModelSection
axlGetModelSection.desc: Returns the model section being used for the corner with which the model file is associated.

axlGetModelSections.name: axlGetModelSections
axlGetModelSections.desc: Returns a list of simulator sections in the specified model file.

axlGetModelTest.name: axlGetModelTest
axlGetModelTest.desc: Returns the name of the test associated with the specified model. By default, a model file is associated with a test. However, in MTS mode, a model can be associated with a specific block in the design. Using this function, you can get the name of the test with which a model file is associated.

axlGetModels.name: axlGetModels
axlGetModels.desc: Returns a list of model files associated with the givne corner.

axlPutModel.name: axlPutModel
axlPutModel.syntax:
axlPutModel( 
x_cornerHandle 
t_modelFileName 
[ ?testName t_testName ] 
[ ?blockName t_blockName ] 
)

axlPutModel.desc: Adds a model file to the specified corner.

axlPutModelGroup.name: axlPutModelGroup
axlPutModelGroup.desc: Adds a model group to the setup database or returns the handle to the model group if it already exists.

axlSetModelBlock.name: axlSetModelBlock
axlSetModelBlock.desc: Sets the name of the block for the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the design blocks and is set as Global. In the MTS mode, a model is associated with a specific MTS block, so you need to use this function to specify the name of that block.

axlSetModelFile.name: axlSetModelFile
axlSetModelFile.desc: Sets the model file for the specified model.

axlSetModelGroupName.name: axlSetModelGroupName
axlSetModelGroupName.desc: Sets or associates the given model group with the specified corner.

axlSetModelPermissibleSectionLists.name: axlSetModelPermissibleSectionLists
axlSetModelPermissibleSectionLists.desc: Sets a permissible section list for the given model extracted from a PCF file. If a model file includes many sections out of which only a limited number of sections are of relevance to your testbench, you can create a permissible section list for that model file. If the LimitModelSections environment variable is set to LimitedList, while displaying the list of section names in the Corners Setup UI, the tool checks the permissible section list for a model file and shows only the relevant names.

axlSetModelSection.name: axlSetModelSection
axlSetModelSection.desc: Sets the section name for the specified model.

axlSetModelTest.name: axlSetModelTest
axlSetModelTest.desc: Sets the name of the test to be associated with the specified model. By default, a model is associated with all the tests. In case of MTS mode, you need to associate the model with a specific test. Alternatively, you can use the axlPutModel function to specify the test name while adding a model.

ALIAS.name: ALIAS
ALIAS.desc: Can be used in two scenarios- to give alias or alternate names to long net names or instance name paths, and to return the first value of a waveform result, for non-swept variables.

axlDeleteOutputsColumn.desc: Deletes a user-defined column from the Outputs table.

axlGetCustomOutputResultMenu.desc: A callback function that you can use to add custom commands in the shortcut menu of the Results tab of Virtuoso ADE Explorer and Virtuoso ADE Assembler. These products call this function to get the custom command names and the associated callback functions to be added to the menu.

axlGetOutputSignificantDigits.name: axlGetOutputSignificantDigits

axlGetUserDefinedOutputsColumns.name: axlGetUserDefinedOutputsColumns
axlGetUserDefinedOutputsColumns.desc: Returns a list of names of the user-defined columns in the specified setup database.

axlOutputResult.name: axlOutputResult
axlOutputResult.desc: Specifies the value of an output in an OCEAN script file. This function only assigns a value to a measure, but does not add it to the script. You need to use the axlAddOutputs function to add or define output measures in an OCEAN script.

x_sdb

x_value
)

axlPutOutputUnits.desc: Sets the unit to the specified output of the test.

Use this function only when you are creating expressions for outputs that can be evaluated across any dimension. These expressions have their eval type as any. If you specify this expression for other eval types, the parameter list is ignored.

axlGetCornersForATest.name: axlGetCornersForATest
axlGetCornersForATest.desc: Returns a list of corners enabled for the given test.

axlGetEnabledGlobalVarPerTest.syntax:
axlGetEnabledGlobalVarPerTest( 
x_hsdb

axlSetTestToolArgs.name: axlSetTestToolArgs

axlGetAllCornersEnabled.name: axlGetAllCornersEnabled
axlGetAllCornersEnabled.desc: Returns the selection status of the Corners check box in the Run Summary assistant in ADE Assembler or the Explorer Run Summary assistant in ADE Explorer.

axlGetCorner.desc: Finds a corner by its name and returns a handle to that corner.

axlGetCorners.name: axlGetCorners

axlGetCornerDisabledTests.name: axlGetCornerDisabledTests

axlGetCornerCountForName.name: axlGetCornerCountForName

axlGetCornerNameForCurrentPointInRun.name: axlGetCornerNameForCurrentPointInRun
axlGetCornerNameForCurrentPointInRun.desc: Returns the name of the corner for the current point being simulated. This function is useful for customized processing or debugging in the OCEAN script-based measures.

axlGetNominalCornerEnabled.desc: Checks whether the nominal corner is enabled in the specified setup database. This is same as the status of the Nominal check box in the Run Summary assistant.

axlGetNominalCornerTestEnabled.desc: Returns the status of the check box corresponding to the given test in the Nominal column on the Corners Setup form.

axlGetStatVars.name: axlGetStatVars
axlGetStatVars.desc: Returns a list of the names of statistical variables that use the statistical::mismatch or statistical::global prefix for the given statistical corner.

axlLoadCorners.name: axlLoadCorners
axlLoadCorners.desc: Loads a set of corners from the specified XML file in which the corners were saved earlier.

axlPlotAcrossDesignPoints.desc: Plots an output across all the design points for a particular corner.

axlPutCorner.name: axlPutCorner
axlPutCorner.desc: Adds a new corner by the given name and returns a handle to that corner. If a corner already exists with the same name, the function returns the handle to that corner.

axlPutDisabledCorner.name: axlPutDisabledCorner
axlPutDisabledCorner.desc: Adds a new corner by the given name and returns a handle to that corner. If a corner already exists with the same name, the function returns the handle to that corner. In addition, the corner is disabled for the specified test name, but enabled for other tests in the session.

axlSetDefaultCornerEnabled.name: axlSetDefaultCornerEnabled
axlSetDefaultCornerEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the default (nominal) corner for the specified test. The program creates a nominal corner when you create a test. This corner represents the absence of corner-specific information.

axlSetAllCornersEnabled.name: axlSetAllCornersEnabled
axlSetAllCornersEnabled.desc: Enables or disables all the corners for simulation. This changes the selection status of the Corners check box in the Run Summary assistant.

axlSetCornerName.name: axlSetCornerName
axlSetCornerName.desc: Sets or updates the name of the given corner.

axlSetCornerTestEnabled.name: axlSetCornerTestEnabled
axlSetCornerTestEnabled.syntax:
axlSetCornerTestEnabled(
x_cornerHandle 
t_testName
g_enableFlag
)

axlSetCornerTestEnabled.desc: Enables or disables simulation of a test for the given corner. This function changes the status of the check box corresponding to a test in the column for the given corner.

axlSetNominalCornerEnabled.name: axlSetNominalCornerEnabled
axlSetNominalCornerEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the nominal corner in the specified setup database.

axlSetNominalCornerTestEnabled.name: axlSetNominalCornerTestEnabled
axlSetNominalCornerTestEnabled.desc: Sets the status of the check box corresponding to the given test in the Nominal column on the Corners Setup form.

axlSetWCCTime.name: axlSetWCCTime
axlSetWCCTime.desc: Sets the time information for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCCorner.name: axlGetWCCCorner
axlGetWCCCorner.desc: Gets the corner name for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCHistory.name: axlGetWCCHistory
axlGetWCCHistory.desc: Returns name of the history for a specification of a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCResult.name: axlGetWCCResult
axlGetWCCResult.desc: Returns result of a specification of a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCSpec.name: axlGetWCCSpec
axlGetWCCSpec.desc: Returns handle to a specification for the specified worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCSpecs.name: axlGetWCCSpecs
axlGetWCCSpecs.desc: Returns a list of specifications for the given worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCTest.name: axlGetWCCTest
axlGetWCCTest.desc: Returns the name of the test of the specification associated with a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCTime.name: axlGetWCCTime
axlGetWCCTime.desc: Returns the generated time information for the given specification handle of a worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCRangeBound.name: axlGetWCCRangeBound
axlGetWCCRangeBound.desc: Returns an integer value that specifies whether the worst-case corner corresponds to the minimum or the maximum value of the spec.

axlGetWCCVar.name: axlGetWCCVar
axlGetWCCVar.desc: Finds the specified variable by name and returns a handle to it.

axlGetWCCVarMonotonicity.name: axlGetWCCVarMonotonicity
axlGetWCCVarMonotonicity.desc: Gets the monotonicity of a specific variable or parameter of the worst-case corner.

axlGetWCCVars.name: axlGetWCCVars
axlGetWCCVars.desc: Returns a list containing a handle to all variables and a list of all variable names in a worst-case corner.

axlGetWYCSigmaTargetLimit.name: axlGetWYCSigmaTargetLimit
axlGetWYCSigmaTargetLimit.desc: Gets the sigma-to-target limit for the Improve Yield flow using worst yield corners. If this value is not set, the flow internally sets it to 100.

axlSetWYCSigmaTargetLimit.name: axlSetWYCSigmaTargetLimit
axlSetWYCSigmaTargetLimit.desc: Sets the sigma-to-target limit for Improve Yield flow using worst yield corners.

maeGetSimulationMessages.name: maeGetSimulationMessages

maeGetMappingForJobAndPoint.name: maeGetMappingForJobAndPoint
maeGetMappingForJobAndPoint.desc: Returns a list containing the mapping of job IDs to the point IDs allocated to them for all the simulations run in the current ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler session. After starting a simulation run, you can use this information to debug incomplete simulations.

maeOpenLogViewer.name: maeOpenLogViewer
maeOpenLogViewer.desc: Opens the Log Viewer window, where you can view the messages loaded from a database.

maeResumeSimulation.name: maeResumeSimulation
maeResumeSimulation.desc: Resumes the simulations that were earlier suspended automatically by ADE Explorer or ADE Assembler according to the settings specified on the Resources tab of the Job Policy Setup form.

axlGetCurrentRunMode.name: axlGetCurrentRunMode
axlGetCurrentRunMode.desc: Returns the current simulation run mode of a given session.

axlGetRunMode.desc: Returns a handle to the named run mode in the specified setup database.

axlGetRunModes.name: axlGetRunModes

axlGetRunOptionValue.desc: Returns the value associated with the provided run option.

axlGetRunStatus.desc: Returns the completion status in terms of the number of points, tests, or corners completed for all histories running in the given session or for the specified history.

axlIsSimUsingStatParams.name: axlIsSimUsingStatParams
axlIsSimUsingStatParams.desc: Returns t if statistical variables are being set or varied for a particular simulation run. For example, statistical parameters in a Monte Carlo run or a statistical corner for Improve Yield.
