axlPutRunOption.desc: Adds a run option to the setup database or edits an existing one and returns the handle to the option. The list of valid option names (t_runoptName) depends on the run mode (t_mode).

axlRunAllTests.name: axlRunAllTests
axlRunAllTests.desc: Starts a run with all enabled tests.

axlRunAllTestsWithCallback.desc: Starts a simulation run with all enabled tests and specifies a SKILL expression to call upon their completion.

axlSetParasiticRunMode.name: axlSetParasiticRunMode

axlStop.name: axlStop

axlStopAll.name: axlStopAll
axlStopAll.desc: Stops all runs currently evaluating in the session.

axlSetRunOptionValue.name: axlSetRunOptionValue

UUID is the unique identifier used by ADE Assembler for the histories saved on the cloud. You can use this function when the simulation was run using the Cloud distribution method.

axlGetCurrentHistory.name: axlGetCurrentHistory
axlGetCurrentHistory.desc: Returns the internal integer value representing the current history entry in active use.

axlGetDataViewHistoryUserMenu.name: axlGetDataViewHistoryUserMenu
axlGetDataViewHistoryUserMenu.desc: This callback function is called when you right-click a history item in the History tab of the Data View assistant. You can override this function in .cdsinit to add customized menu items in the popup menus of the history items.

axlGetHistory.name: axlGetHistory
axlGetHistory.desc: Returns a list containing a handle to all history entries in the setup database and a list of all the history entries.

axlGetHistoryCheckpoint.name: axlGetHistoryCheckpoint
axlGetHistoryCheckpoint.desc: Returns the handle to the checkpoint of a history entry.

axlGetHistoryEntry.name: axlGetHistoryEntry
axlGetHistoryEntry.desc: Finds the specified history entry in the setup database and returns the handle to that entry.

axlGetHistoryGroup.name: axlGetHistoryGroup
axlGetHistoryGroup.desc: Returns a handle to the specified history group in the setup database.

axlGetHistoryLock.name: axlGetHistoryLock
axlGetHistoryLock.desc: Returns the lock status of the given history. When a history item is locked, the corresponding setup details and results cannot be deleted.

axlGetHistoryName.name: axlGetHistoryName
axlGetHistoryName.desc: Returns the name of the history item that holds the data for the latest simulation run.

axlGetHistoryPrefix.name: axlGetHistoryPrefix
axlGetHistoryPrefix.desc: Returns the current history prefix value from the given session. The prefix value depends on the run mode selected in the session.

axlGetHistoryResults.name: axlGetHistoryResults
axlGetHistoryResults.desc: Gets the results database from a history entry. This function calls axlGetResultsLocation to get the results location.

axlGetOverwriteHistory.name: axlGetOverwriteHistory
axlGetOverwriteHistory.desc: Returns a Boolean value specifying the status of the Overwrite History check box in the Save Options form for the active setup.

axlGetOverwriteHistoryName.name: axlGetOverwriteHistoryName
axlGetOverwriteHistoryName.desc: Returns the name of the history that is set to be overwritten for the active setup.

axlLoadHistory.name: axlLoadHistory
axlLoadHistory.desc: Copies the setup database branch and returns the handle to the copy.

axlSetHistoryLock.name: axlSetHistoryLock
axlSetHistoryLock.desc: Locks the specified checkpoint history. After it is locked, you cannot delete the history or the simulation data saved for it.

axlSetHistoryName.name: axlSetHistoryName
axlSetHistoryName.desc: Sets a new name for the specified history.

axlSetOverwriteHistory.name: axlSetOverwriteHistory
axlSetOverwriteHistory.desc: Enables or disables the Overwrite History check box in the Save Options form for the active setup.

axlSetOverwriteHistoryName.name: axlSetOverwriteHistoryName
axlSetOverwriteHistoryName.desc: Sets the name of the history to be overwritten for the specified active setup.

axlRestoreHistory.name: axlRestoreHistory

axlViewHistoryResults.name: axlViewHistoryResults
axlViewHistoryResults.desc: Display the results for the specified history item on the Results tab of the given session.

axlJobIntfcDebugToFile.desc: Enables the interface job debugging and sets the output to a file.

axlJobIntfcDebugp.name: axlJobIntfcDebugp
axlJobIntfcDebugp.desc: Specifies whether interface debugging is enabled.

axlJobIntfcExitMethod.name: axlJobIntfcExitMethod
axlJobIntfcExitMethod.desc: Job Interface member function used to exit a job. The application usually attempts to call exit(0) on remote job cleanup the job's resources properly. However, if this fails or if the tool is forced to kill all jobs, the exit method will be called on every remote job. This method may be called after the job has already exited. This job can also be called multiple times.

axlJobIntfcHealthMethod.name: axlJobIntfcHealthMethod
axlJobIntfcHealthMethod.desc: Job Interface member function used to return the current health of the job. The application calls this function regularly (currently, every 5 seconds) on each job in order to recognize health changes. The available health types are: unknown, alive, or dead.

axlJobIntfcSetDebug.name: axlJobIntfcSetDebug
axlJobIntfcSetDebug.desc: Enables or disables printing of the job interface diagnostics to the CIW.

x_startIndex
x_endIndex
)
=> t / nil
axlJobIntfcStartJobArrayMethod.desc: Job interface member function to start a job array where the job IDs are set between the range of the specified start and end indexes for the array. For example, if the start and end indexes are set to 4 and 10 respectively, the jobs with IDs 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 would be launched.

axlJobIntfcStartMethod.name: axlJobIntfcStartMethod
axlJobIntfcStartMethod.desc: Job Interface member function to start a job. For each new job ID, a new instance of the selected interface class will be created. After some basic properties are set on the instance, it will be passed to the start method of the class.

axlJPGUICustDiffer.name: axlJPGUICustDiffer
axlJPGUICustDiffer.syntax:
axlJPGUICustDiffer(
g_inst
l_propList1
l_propList2
)
=> t / nil
axlJPGUICustDiffer.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function that determines whether l_propList1 and l_propList2 differ. The Job Policy GUI uses this method to determine if the GUI settings differ from those already attached to the tool.

axlJPGUICustHiddenSections.name: axlJPGUICustHiddenSections
axlJPGUICustHiddenSections.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function that returns a list of sections or fields to be hidden from the Job Policy Setup form.

axlJPGUICustHIFields.name: axlJPGUICustHIFields
axlJPGUICustHIFields.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to create the HI field displayed for a particular JP GUI customization. The Job Policy GUI calls this method once during initialization. If no customizations are desired, the function does not need to be specialized.

axlJPGUICustOffset.name: axlJPGUICustOffset
axlJPGUICustOffset.desc: Job policy GUI customization member function to return the y size of the HI field customizations provided with the axlJPGUICustHIFields method. The value is obtained by adding 10 to the y position of the last HI element. The Job Policy form uses this value as the y offset for the form elements underneath the customization area.

axlJPGUICusReadFromForm.name: axlJPGUICusReadFromForm
axlJPGUICusReadFromForm.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to read any HI customization into a property list that will be saved as a job policy.

axlJPGUICustSelected.name: axlJPGUICustSelected
axlJPGUICustSelected.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to enable or disable any HI customizations. The Job Policy GUI calls this function every time the job policy type is changed.

axlRegisterJobIntfc.name: axlRegisterJobIntfc
axlRegisterJobIntfc.syntax:
axlRegisterJobIntfc(
s_displayName
s_className
[ ?isInitializedFun u_isInitFun ]
[ ?displayInGUI g_shouldDisplay ]
)
=> t
axlRegisterJobIntfc.desc: Registers a job interface class into the application. Job interfaces should be registered before use, preferably during virtuoso initialization.

axlJPGUICustWriteToForm.name: axlJPGUICustWriteToForm
axlJPGUICustWriteToForm.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to load a property list that is saved as a job policy into HI customizations.

axlRegisteredJPGUICust.name: axlRegisteredJPGUICust
axlRegisteredJPGUICust.desc: Job Policy GUI Customization member function to register a customization into the Job Policy Setup form. Any registered customizations will appear the next time the job policy Setup form is displayed.

axlGetAttachedJobPolicy.name: axlGetAttachedJobPolicy
axlGetAttachedJobPolicy.syntax:
axlGetAttachedJobPolicy( 
[ t_sessionName ]
[ t_toolType ]
[ t_testName ]
) 
=> l_jobPolicyProperties / nil
axlGetAttachedJobPolicy.desc: Returns the current job policy attached to the setup or to the given test.

axlGetJobPolicy.name: axlGetJobPolicy
axlGetJobPolicy.desc: Returns a disembodied property list containing property-value pairs for the job policy.

axlGetJobPolicyTypes.name: axlGetJobPolicyTypes
axlGetJobPolicyTypes.desc: Returns a list containing names of all available job policies.

axlIsICRPProcess.name: axlIsICRPProcess
axlIsICRPProcess.desc: Returns t if the code is currently running in a remote child process for the tool. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

axlSaveJobPolicy.name: axlSaveJobPolicy
axlSaveJobPolicy.desc: Saves the policy given by the t_policyName argument.

axlSetJobPolicyProperty.name: axlSetJobPolicyProperty
axlSetJobPolicyProperty.syntax:
axlSetJobPolicyProperty( 
t_jobPolicyName 
t_jobPropertyName 
t_jobPropertyValue 
) 
=> t / nil
axlSetJobPolicyProperty.desc: Sets a property name-value pair for the specified job policy. You can use this function to update the properties of an existing policy. To apply the updated properties to all the sessions, set the updated policy as the default policy for the tool by using the defaultJobPolicy environment variable.

axlStopAllJobs.name: axlStopAllJobs
axlStopAllJobs.desc: Stops all jobs you started during the current or specified session, regardless of their state (started, getting configured, running)

axlStopJob.name: axlStopJob
axlStopJob.syntax:
axlStopJob( 
t_sessionName
x_jobId
[ g_forceFlag ]
) 
=> t / nil

maeClearAllTestJobPolicies.name: maeClearAllTestJobPolicies
maeClearAllTestJobPolicies.desc: Clears the test-level job policy setup for each test in the setup. The job policy setup at the global level is not removed.

maeClearTestJobPolicy.name: maeClearTestJobPolicy
maeClearTestJobPolicy.desc: Clears the job setup of a given test and applies the global job setup.

maeCreateNetlistForCorner.name: maeCreateNetlistForCorner
maeCreateNetlistForCorner.syntax:
maeCreateNetlistForCorner(
t_testName
t_cornerName 
t_netlistDir
[ ?session t_session ]
)
=> t / nil
maeCreateNetlistForCorner.desc: Generates a netlist for the specified corner. In case the setup contains a corner sweep, the netlist will be created for the first sweep point of the specified corner.

maeGetAllJobPolicies.name: maeGetAllJobPolicies
maeGetAllJobPolicies.desc: Returns the job policies of all the tests in the specified session.

maeGetJobControlMode.name: maeGetJobControlMode
maeGetJobControlMode.desc: Returns the job control mode currently set in the given session.

maeGetJobPolicy.name: maeGetJobPolicy
maeGetJobPolicy.syntax:
maeGetJobPolicy(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?testName t_testName ]
[ ?jobType t_jobType ]
)
=> l_jobPolicyProperties / nil
maeGetJobPolicy.desc: Returns the details of the job policy attached to the given test. If no test name is given, the function returns the policy attached to the current setup.

maeGetJobPolicyByName.name: maeGetJobPolicyByName
maeGetJobPolicyByName.desc: Returns a disembodied property list containing property-value pairs for the given job policy.

maeHasTestJobPolicy.name: maeHasTestJobPolicy
maeHasTestJobPolicy.desc: Checks if the given test has a test-specific job policy setup.

maeIsEvaluatorProcess.name: maeIsEvaluatorProcess
maeIsEvaluatorProcess.desc: Returns t if currently the expression evaluator service process is running for ADE Assembler or ADE Explorer. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

maeIsNetlistProcess.name: maeIsNetlistProcess
maeIsNetlistProcess.desc: Returns t if currently the netlister service process is running for ADE Assembler or ADE Explorer. You can use this function in your .cdsinit file or in custom SKILL code.

maeSetJobControlMode.name: maeSetJobControlMode
maeSetJobControlMode.desc: Sets the job control mode in the given session.

maeSetJobPolicy.name: maeSetJobPolicy
maeSetJobPolicy.syntax:
maeSetJobPolicy (
g_jobPolicyDPL
[ ?testName t_testName ]
[ ?jobType t_jobType ]
[ ?session t_sessionName ] 
)
=> t / nil
maeSetJobPolicy.desc: Sets the given job policy to the specified setup for the given test.

maeStopAllJobs.name: maeStopAllJobs
maeStopAllJobs.syntax:
maeStopAllJobs(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?jobType t_jobType ]
[ ?force g_force ]
[ ?exitCode t_exitCode ]
)
=> t / nil
maeStopAllJobs.desc: Stops all the simulation or netlisting jobs you started during the current session regardless of their state (started, getting configured, running).

maeStopJob.name: maeStopJob
maeStopJob.syntax:
maeStopJob(
[ ?session t_sessionName ]
[ ?jobType t_jobType ]
[ ?force g_force ]
[ ?exitCode t_exitCode ]
)
=> t / nil
maeStopJob.desc: Stops the job for the specified job ID regardless of its state.

asiRegisterTool.name: asiRegisterTool
asiRegisterTool.syntax:
asiRegisterTool(
'<simulatorName>
[ ?class			s_className ]
[ ?private			s_private ]
[ ?initFunc			s_initFunc ]
[ ?mixedSig			s_mixedSig ]
)
=> t
asiRegisterTool.desc: Registers your simulator and your initialization function.

asiInitDataAccessFunction.name: asiInitDataAccessFunction
asiInitDataAccessFunction.desc: Initializes the data access function for the tool. This function can be used by a third-party integrator to define their own data access functions.

asiInitEnvOption.name: asiInitEnvOption
asiInitEnvOption.desc: Initializes the tool-specific environment options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own environment options.

asiInitAnalysis.name: asiInitAnalysis
asiInitAnalysis.desc: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options.

asiInitAdvAnalysis.name: asiInitAdvAnalysis
asiInitAdvAnalysis.desc: Initializes the tool-specific analysis options for the tools derived from the asiAnalog class. This method can be used by third-party integrators to define their own analysis options in ADE XL.

asiInitSimOption.name: asiInitSimOption
asiInitSimOption.desc: Initializes the simulation options for the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This is not applicable for tools derived from the asiSocket class. This function can be used by third-party integrators to define their own simulation options.

asiGetPageCallBack.name: asiGetPageCallBack
asiGetPageCallBack.desc: Returns the callback function name when changing tabs in a form.

asiSetPageCallBack.name: asiSetPageCallBack
asiSetPageCallBack.desc: Returns the status (whether successful or failed) of the specified callback function, when changing tabs in a form.

asiGetNetlistFormatterClass.name: asiGetNetlistFormatterClass
asiGetNetlistFormatterClass.desc: Returns the netlist formatter class for the specified tool.

asiSetNetlistFormatterClass.name: asiSetNetlistFormatterClass
asiSetNetlistFormatterClass.desc: Registers the netlist formatter class with the tool. This function is normally called from the asiInitFormatter method and should be defined for the interface.

asiCreateFormatter.name: asiCreateFormatter
asiCreateFormatter.desc: Creates a design object with the nlCreateDesign call, using the information on the OASIS session. Subsequently, the formatter is created with a call to nlCreateFormatter, using the information on the session. The formatter is added to the session and can be obtained with asiGetFormatter. This is a convenience function that you cannot redefine, and the interface should not call it.

asiCreateCdsenvFile.name: asiCreateCdsenvFile
asiCreateCdsenvFile.desc: Creates a .cdsenv file for the specified tool and dumps it to the current working directory. This is meant as a development utility for integrators only.

asiGetFormatter.name: asiGetFormatter
asiGetFormatter.desc: Returns the formatter created with the last asiCreateFormatter call. This is a convenience function that you should not redefine and the interface should not call.

asiGetSimInputFileName.name: asiGetSimInputFileName
asiGetSimInputFileName.desc: Returns the name of the simulator input file. For the asiAnalog_session class, this is input followed by the return value of asiGetSimInputFileSuffix.

asiGetSimInputFileSuffix.name: asiGetSimInputFileSuffix
asiGetSimInputFileSuffix.desc: Returns the suffix used for the simulator input file. This method can be redefined, and must return a string, or a SKILL error will result.

nlGetNetlister.name: nlGetNetlister
nlGetNetlister.desc: Returns an object representing the netlister.

nlGetPCellParamSource.name: nlGetPCellParamSource
nlGetPCellParamSource.desc: Identifies the source of value of the Pcell parameters of the given cellview.

nlGetScratchInstance.name: nlGetScratchInstance
nlGetScratchInstance.syntax:
nlGetScratchInstance(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_instanceName
)
=> d_databaseID / nil
nlGetScratchInstance.desc: Returns the database ID of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

nlGetScratchInstPcellParamValue.name: nlGetScratchInstPcellParamValue
nlGetScratchInstPcellParamValue.desc: Returns the parameter value of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

nlGetSwitchMaster.name: nlGetSwitchMaster
nlGetSwitchMaster.syntax:
nlGetSwitchMaster(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_instanceName
t_deviceParamName
)
=> d_databaseID / nil
nlGetSwitchMaster.desc: Returns the database ID of the switch master.

nlGetToolName.name: nlGetToolName
nlGetToolName.desc: Returns a symbol representing the simulator. It returns the value of the tool name. This name is used for the selection of the simulator information on the library component.

nlInitialize.name: nlInitialize
nlInitialize.desc: For the nlFormatter class, this method initializes the netlister. This method can be redefined for the simulator-specific netlister and is called by nlCreateFormatter. This method initializes all simulator-specific aspects of netlisting such as name mapping. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, this method sets a number of netlist options. These options and their values are shown in the table below.

nlPrintHeader.name: nlPrintHeader
nlPrintHeader.desc: This method writes the beginning comment, adds .GLOBAL, and prints header comments.

nlIncludePspiceFile.name: nlIncludePspiceFile
nlIncludePspiceFile.syntax:
nlIncludePspiceFile( 
o_formatter 
t_fileName 
t_masterName
) 
=> t / nil
nlIncludePspiceFile.desc: Prints the include statement for pspice cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all pspice modules. If your simulator does not support pspice views, call nlError function in this method.

nlIncludeVerilogaFile.name: nlIncludeVerilogaFile
nlIncludeVerilogaFile.syntax:
nlIncludeVerilogaFile( 
o_formatter 
t_filename 
t_master
) 
=> t / nil
nlIncludeVerilogaFile.desc: Prints the include statement for Verilog-a cell views in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog-a modules. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

nlIncludeVerilogFile.name: nlIncludeVerilogFile
nlIncludeVerilogFile.syntax:
nlIncludeVerilogFile( 
o_formatter 
t_filename 
t_master
) 
=> t / nil
nlIncludeVerilogFile.desc: Prints the include statement for Verilog type text cell view in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog text cell views. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile.name: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile
nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile.syntax:
nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile(
o_formatter
t_filename
t_master
)
=> t / nil
nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile.desc: Prints the dspf_include statement for the DSPF type text cellview in the design.

nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile.name: nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile
nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile.desc: Prints the include statement for SPICEMODEL cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all SPICEMODEL modules. If your simulator does not support SPICEMODEL views, call the nlError function in this method.

nlIsPcellInstance.name: nlIsPcellInstance
nlIsPcellInstance.syntax:
nlIsPcellInstance(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_instanceName
)
=> t / nil
nlIsPcellInstance.desc: Checks if the specified instance name represents a schematic Pcell instance.

nlIsPcellParam.name: nlIsPcellParam
nlIsPcellParam.syntax:
nlIsPcellParam(
t_libName
t_cellName
t_viewName
t_instanceName
t_deviceParamName
)
=> t / nil
nlIsPcellParam.desc: Checks if the specified device parameter represents a Pcell parameter.

nlIsSmartExtractedView.name: nlIsSmartExtractedView
nlIsSmartExtractedView.desc: Identifies if the currently netlisted cellview is of the type smart_view. You can use this function in custom netlist procedures to modify the syntax printed to the netlist as required. For example, you can modify the syntax to determine if the printing of parenthesis needs to be enabled or disabled when printing the port connections of the instance.

nlPrintFooter.name: nlPrintFooter
nlPrintFooter.desc: This method is called at the end of netlisting. It does not print anything at the end of the netlist for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments.name: nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments
nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments.desc: Prints the comments for the subcircuit header and the mapping information when the printSubcktComments option is set.

nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.name: nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments
nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.desc: Calls nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.name: nlPrintTopCellFooterComments
nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.desc: Returns t at the analogFormatter level.

nlPrintTopCellHeader.name: nlPrintTopCellHeader
nlPrintTopCellHeader.desc: Prints the header of the top-level circuit by calling nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.

nlPrintTopCellFooter.name: nlPrintTopCellFooter
nlPrintTopCellFooter.desc: Writes the top cell view footer. This function prints an empty line and calls nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.

nlPrintSubcktHeader.name: nlPrintSubcktHeader
nlPrintSubcktHeader.desc: Writes the header for a subcircuit following these steps: prints comments by calling nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments; prints the subckt begin keyword by calling nlPrintSubcktBegin; prints the subckt name by calling nlPrintSubcktName; prints the subckt terminal list by calling nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.

nlPrintSubcktFooter.name: nlPrintSubcktFooter
nlPrintSubcktFooter.desc: Writes the footer for the subcircuit. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, it prints .ends.

nlPrintSubcktFooterComments.name: nlPrintSubcktFooterComments
nlPrintSubcktFooterComments.desc: Prints the comments for the subcircuit footer by printing the string 'End of subcircuit definition.' preceded by the comment begin string.

nlPrintInstComments.name: nlPrintInstComments
nlPrintInstComments.desc: Prints the comments for an instance.

nlPrintInst.name: nlPrintInst
nlPrintInst.desc: Prints the netlist statement for an instance. This is the default netlist procedure for a component.

nlPrintInstEnd.name: nlPrintInstEnd
nlPrintInstEnd.desc:
Prints the end of the instance statement, which is a return (
). This method is called by the netlister after the netlist procedure or by nlPrintInst.

nlPrintSubcktBegin.name: nlPrintSubcktBegin
nlPrintSubcktBegin.desc: Prints the .subckt keyword for the nlAnalogFormatter class. This method is called by nlSubcktHeader.

nlPrintSubcktName.name: nlPrintSubcktName
nlPrintSubcktName.desc: Prints a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit. This method is used by nlSubcktHeader.

nlPrintSubcktEnd.name: nlPrintSubcktEnd
nlPrintSubcktEnd.desc: For the nlAnalogFormatter class, prints the .ends keyword, followed by a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit, to mark the end of the subcircuit definition. It is called by nlPrintSubcktFooter.

nlPrintHeaderComments.name: nlPrintHeaderComments
nlPrintHeaderComments.desc: Prints the comments for the netlist file, including the library, cell, and view names of the top-level cellview of the design netlisted. This method only has effect when the printFileComments netlist option is set.

nlPrintSubcktParameters.name: nlPrintSubcktParameters
nlPrintSubcktParameters.desc: Prints the passed parameters for the subcircuit definition.

nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.name: nlPrintSubcktTerminalList
nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.desc: Prints the simulator names of the signals connected to the terminals for a subcircuit definition and handles the signals resulting from inherited connections at a lower level .

nlPrintInstName.name: nlPrintInstName
nlPrintInstName.desc: Prints the simulator name of the instance, taking the instance name prefix specified on the component into account when the simulator so requires. This is determined with the useInstNamePrefix netlist option.

nlPrintInstSignals.name: nlPrintInstSignals
nlPrintInstSignals.desc: Prints the simulator names of the signals according to the terminal order specified on the component, using the nlGetSignalList method of the instance.

nlPrintModelName.name: nlPrintModelName
nlPrintModelName.desc: Prints the model name. The nlGetModelName for the instance is used for the model name.

nlPrintInstParameters.name: nlPrintInstParameters
nlPrintInstParameters.desc: Prints the instance parameters in name=value pairs.

nlError.name: nlError
nlError.desc: Issues a user error. The error is printed immediately and it is collected on the object. In this way, if netlisting is interrupted, the user is aware of any errors that occurred during netlisting. All errors are printed to the netlist log file.

nlObjError.name: nlObjError
nlObjError.desc: Similar to nlError, but prints a description of the object along with the error message. The description includes the library name, the cell name, the view name, and the instance name in case the object is an instance.

nlGetGlobalNets.name: nlGetGlobalNets
nlGetGlobalNets.desc: Returns a list of global nets. This method should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter.

nlDisplayOption.name: nlDisplayOption
nlDisplayOption.desc: Prints the option names available on this object along with their values.

nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster.name: nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster
nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster.desc: This function returns the database ID for the current switch master for the instance in hierarchical incremental netlisting. This function should only be used while printing the instance statement. Avoid using this function if possible.

nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList.name: nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList
nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList.desc: Returns a list of cellview objects treated as stop cells for the specified netlister object.

nlGetOption.name: nlGetOption
nlGetOption.desc: Returns the value of the option.

nlGetOptionNameList.name: nlGetOptionNameList
nlGetOptionNameList.desc: Returns a list of option names available on this object.

nlMapGlobalNet.name: nlMapGlobalNet
nlMapGlobalNet.desc: Maps a global net (signal) to the simulator name. This should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter. Use at any other time is an error.

nlInfo.name: nlInfo
nlInfo.desc: Sends an informational message to the calling application.

nlSetOption.name: nlSetOption
nlSetOption.syntax:
nlSetOption( 
o_netlister 
s_option 
g_value 
) 
=> t / nil

nlWarning.name: nlWarning
nlWarning.desc: Issue a warning to the user.

nlPrintComment.name: nlPrintComment
nlPrintComment.syntax:
nlPrintComment( 
o_netlister 
[ t_arg1 t_arg2 ... ] 
) 
=> t / nil

nlPrintIndentString.name: nlPrintIndentString
nlPrintIndentString.desc: Prints the indent string for the instance statement. When inside the top-level circuit, the empty string is printed. When inside subcircuit definitions, the value of the subcktIndentString netlist option is printed.

nlPrintString.name: nlPrintString
nlPrintString.desc: Prints the string arguments to the file. This function does the required line folding, prefixing, and, postfixing.

nlPrintStringNoFold.name: nlPrintStringNoFold
nlPrintStringNoFold.desc: Prints the string arguments to the file, like the function nlPrintString. This function does the required prefixing and postfixing, but does not fold the line until a newline character or maxLineLength is encountered. While in a 'no fold' print mode, calls cannot be made to nlPrintString.

nlIsModelNameInherited.name: nlIsModelNameInherited
nlIsModelNameInherited.desc: Returns t if the model name for the stopping instance is passed through the hierarchy through parameters.

nlGetSimName.name: nlGetSimName
nlGetSimName.desc: If the input type is cellview object, then returns the simulator name of the subcircuit. If the input type is instance object, then returns the mapped name of the instance. The name returned depends on the useInstNamePrefix netlist option. When it is not set, the name prefix is not taken into account. However, for instances representing interface elements, the name prefix is always taken into account. No mapping is performed for interface elements.

nlGetSignalList.name: nlGetSignalList
nlGetSignalList.desc: Returns a list of mapped signal names for the instance according to the terminal order specified for the cellview.

nlGetTerminalList.name: nlGetTerminalList
nlGetTerminalList.desc: Returns a list of terminal names in the order specified on the pin order property on the schematic, or on the termOrder property on the CDF, or on the cellview of the instance, in that order.

nlGetTerminalSignalName.name: nlGetTerminalSignalName
nlGetTerminalSignalName.desc: Returns the name of the signal connected to the terminal.

nlGetNumberOfBits.name: nlGetNumberOfBits
nlGetNumberOfBits.desc: Returns the number of bits on the instance and terminal specified.

nlGetModelName.name: nlGetModelName
nlGetModelName.desc: This method must be used to obtain the model name of an instance. Use of this method assures consistency in netlisting across interfaces. For instances that represent subcircuits, this method returns a name chosen by the netlister, using the modulePrefix netlist option.

nlGetParamList.name: nlGetParamList
nlGetParamList.desc: Returns the list of parameters of the specified instance or cellview.

nlGetParamStringValue.name: nlGetParamStringValue
nlGetParamStringValue.desc: Returns a string representing the parameter value for the instance and parameter name.

nlGetId.name: nlGetId
nlGetId.desc: Returns the database ID for the instance. If the instance represents a cdba instance, this is a database ID.

nlIncludeSrcFile.name: nlIncludeSrcFile
nlIncludeSrcFile.desc: Prints the include statement for instances bound to source files using Hierarchy Editor. This is called while printing the footer for the netlist for all the source files to which any instance in the design is bound. If your simulator does not support source file bindings, call nlError in this method.

nlPrintComments.name: nlPrintComments
nlPrintComments.desc: Prints the comments for the instance being netlisted.

nlGetCellName.name: nlGetCellName
nlGetCellName.desc: Gets the cell name of the specified instance.

nlGetLibName.name: nlGetLibName
nlGetLibName.desc: Gets the library name of the specified instance.

nlGetSimTerminalNets.name: nlGetSimTerminalNets
nlGetSimTerminalNets.desc: Returns the list of mapped names of signals connecting to the terminals of the cellview based on the terminal order specified for the cellview. Several signals may come from inherited connections.  Signal buses are handled in scalar form.

nlGetTerminalNets.name: nlGetTerminalNets
nlGetTerminalNets.desc: Returns the schematic names of the signals connected to the terminals. Many of the signals may come from inherited connections.

nlGetSwitchViewList.name: nlGetSwitchViewList
nlGetSwitchViewList.desc: Returns the switch view list for the cellView.

nlGetViewName.name: nlGetViewName
nlGetViewName.desc: Returns the view name of the specified cellview object.

nlGetTopLibName.name: nlGetTopLibName
nlGetTopLibName.desc: Returns the library name of the design.

nlGetTopCellName.name: nlGetTopCellName
nlGetTopCellName.desc: Returns the cell name of the design.

nlGetTopViewName.name: nlGetTopViewName
nlGetTopViewName.desc: Returns the view name of the design.

nlTranslateFlatIEPathName.name: nlTranslateFlatIEPathName
nlTranslateFlatIEPathName.desc: Parses a hierachical IE instance path and returns the path of the IE instance that is to be printed in the digital netlist.

nlSetPcellName.name: nlSetPcellName
nlSetPcellName.syntax:
nlSetPcellName(
S_cv
t_paramNames
g_paramValues
)
=> t / nil
nlSetPcellName.desc: Define this function if the default generic OSS naming convention for Pcells needs to be customized.

ansCdlCompPrim.name: ansCdlCompPrim
ansCdlCompPrim.desc: Enables printing of device information for primitives in the auCdl netlist. Specify this function as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the primitive devices for which you want the device information to be printed in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlHnlPrintInst.name: ansCdlHnlPrintInst
ansCdlHnlPrintInst.desc: Customizes how device information is written in the auCdl netlist. Specify this function as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the devices for which you want to customize the device information in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlPrintString.name: ansCdlPrintString
ansCdlPrintString.desc: Prints comment strings in the device information for instances in the auCdl netlist. To print comment strings in the device information, you must also use the 'string argument in the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable defined in the .simrc file. For more information about the auCdlInstPrintOrder variable, see the Virtuoso ADE Explorer User Guide.

ansCdlPrintInheritedParams.name: ansCdlPrintInheritedParams
ansCdlPrintInheritedParams.desc: Customizes how inherited parameters are written in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlPrintInstParams.name: ansCdlPrintInstParams
ansCdlPrintInstParams.desc: Customizes how instance parameters are written in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlPrintInstProps.name: ansCdlPrintInstProps
ansCdlPrintInstProps.desc: Enables printing of user-defined instance properties and also customizes the format in which the properties are printed in the netlist.

ansCdlPrintInstName.name: ansCdlPrintInstName
ansCdlPrintInstName.syntax:
ansCdlPrintInstName(
&_fp 
t_prefix 
t_name 
t_mappedName 
g_isPrimitive 
S_inst 
S_master
)
ansCdlPrintInstName.desc: Customizes how instance names are written in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlPrintModelName.name: ansCdlPrintModelName
ansCdlPrintModelName.syntax:
ansCdlPrintModelName(
&_fp 
g_isAPrimitive 
g_definedPropVal 
g_modelPropInstVal 
g_componentPropInstVal 
g_cdfModelName 
g_cdfComponentName
)
ansCdlPrintModelName.desc: Customizes the order in which auCdl looks for model names for primitives and the format in which the model information is written in the netlist.

ansCdlPrintModuleName.name: ansCdlPrintModuleName
ansCdlPrintModuleName.syntax:
ansCdlPrintModuleName(
&_fp 
g_isAPrimitive 
S_inst 
S_master 
S_parent 
t_appedModuleName
)
ansCdlPrintModuleName.desc: Customizes how module names are written in the auCdl netlist for subcircuits.

ansCdlPrintConnections.name: ansCdlPrintConnections
ansCdlPrintConnections.desc: Customizes how the nets connected to a device are written in the auCdl netlist.

ansCdlGetSegmentConnections.name: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections
ansCdlGetSegmentConnections.syntax:
ansCdlGetSegmentConnections( 
S_inst 
l_connectionPairs 
n_iterSeg 
n_iterMult 
n_numSegments 
n_multiplicityFactor 
t_segmentConnType 
n_netCount 
)
ansCdlGetSegmentConnections.desc:
This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It controls how connectivity information is written in the netlist for instances for which a multiplicity factor is specified using the m or M property. For example, if an instance with a connection list like ((termA netA) (termB netB)) has to be converted into two segments connected in series, the modified connection list for the first segment will be 
((termA netA) (termB tempnet_0)) and ((termA tempnet_0) (termB netB)) for the second segment. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInst.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInst
ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInst.desc: Writes the switch Pcell instance in the auCdl netlist based on the size and input values of the instance.

ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInstParam.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInstParam
ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellInstParam.desc: Writes into the auCdl netlist the list of CDF parameters and values defined for switch Pcell instances.

ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubcktConn.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubcktConn
ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubcktConn.desc: Writes into the auCdl netlist the switch Pcell connections specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubCircuit.name: ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubCircuit
ansCdlPrintSwitchPCellSubCircuit.desc: Writes into the auCdl netlist the subckt definitions specified by hnlSpecialPCellLibCell in the .simrc file.

ansCdlGetSegmentInfo.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInfo
ansCdlGetSegmentInfo.desc: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It returns the number of segments for an instance and the connection type (series, parallel, or user defined connection type name) between the segments. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams
ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams.syntax:
ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams( 
S_inst 
l_propsList 
n_iterSeg 
n_iterMult 
n_numSegments 
n_multiplicityFactor 
t_segmentConnType 
)
=> l_segment
ansCdlGetSegmentInstParams.desc: Customizes the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device.

ansCdlGetSimPropValue.name: ansCdlGetSimPropValue
ansCdlGetSimPropValue.desc: Returns the value of a specified property on the current instance being netlisted when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device.

ansCdlGetMultiplicity.name: ansCdlGetMultiplicity
ansCdlGetMultiplicity.desc: Controls how multiplicity (converting an instance into multiple instances connected in parallel) is handled for an instance in the design when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the master of the instance.

auCdl.name: auCdl
auCdl.desc: This function sets defaults of all the variables defined in si.env like preserveRES, shortRES as well as other global variables like cdlSimViewList, cdlPrintComments etc. The function also sets the list of functions and variables that must be unbound when environments(simulators) are changed.

acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist.name: acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist
acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist.desc: Controls how an included netlist is included in the main netlist file. This function can be overridden by user settings. If user-override is not specified, the included netlist is copied without any modification. However, if both acdlPrintIncludedNetlist and acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist are defined, acdlPrintIncludedNetlist is called. acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist is preferred because the file pointer is not closed and re-initialized.

acdlCurrentInstName.name: acdlCurrentInstName
acdlCurrentInstName.desc: Maps instance names during hierarchical or flat netlisting.

auLvs.name: auLvs
auLvs.desc: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS (for comparison) itself.

auProbeAddDevsForNet.name: auProbeAddDevsForNet
auProbeAddDevsForNet.desc: This procedure enables you to select nets using the cursor or by typing the names in the CIW to add probes for all devices connected to the selected net. The function displays the prompt, Point to net or enter net name in CIW. On pointing to the net or typing the net name in CIW, probes would be added on all the devices connected to the selected net.

LVS.name: LVS
LVS.desc: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS itself.

hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal.name: hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal
hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal.desc: This procedure returns the value of the property specified by propName if it exists on the current instance. If the value of this property has the syntax specifying an inherited value it returns the name of the property whose value is being inherited without the surrounding syntax.

hnlHspiceInstPropVal.name: hnlHspiceInstPropVal
hnlHspiceInstPropVal.desc: This procedure prints a list of property values to the netlist.

hnlHspicePrintInstPropEqVal.name: hnlHspicePrintInstPropEqVal
hnlHspicePrintInstPropEqVal.desc: This procedure prints a list of property values to the netlist. It is similar to the procedure hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal except that the property name and the symbol, = is included before the value.

hnlHspicePrintMOSfetModel.name: hnlHspicePrintMOSfetModel
hnlHspicePrintMOSfetModel.desc: This function prints out the line for a MOSFET model.

hnlHspicePrintNMOSfetElement.name: hnlHspicePrintNMOSfetElement
hnlHspicePrintNMOSfetElement.desc: This function prints out the line for a n-MOSFET model.

asiDisplayNetlistOption.name: asiDisplayNetlistOption
asiDisplayNetlistOption.desc: Displays the current set of netlist options and values. Use this function only to determine which netlist options you can modify.

asiGetNetlistOption.name: asiGetNetlistOption
asiGetNetlistOption.desc: Gets the value of the specified netlist option.

asiSetNetlistOption.name: asiSetNetlistOption

asiVerilogNetlistMoreCB.name: asiVerilogNetlistMoreCB
asiVerilogNetlistMoreCB.desc: Displays the Verilog HNL Netlisting Option form.

asiGetDigitalNetlistFileName.name: asiGetDigitalNetlistFileName
asiGetDigitalNetlistFileName.desc: Returns the digital netlist file name.

asiConstructDigitalNetlist.name: asiConstructDigitalNetlist
asiConstructDigitalNetlist.desc: Constructs the digital netlist file for viewing.

asiInitializeNetlisterMixed.name: asiInitializeNetlisterMixed
asiInitializeNetlisterMixed.desc: Initializes the mixed-signal netlister. Partitions the design and then calls nlCreateDesign to get the design object. Does not re-partition if the design has not changed since last partition.

asiNetlistMixed.name: asiNetlistMixed
asiNetlistMixed.desc: This method performs mixed netlisting. It creates a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter, after which the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist.

asiGetVerilogCommandLineOption.name: asiGetVerilogCommandLineOption
asiGetVerilogCommandLineOption.desc: Returns the Verilog simulator command line options.

asiGetDigitalCommandLineOption.name: asiGetDigitalCommandLineOption
asiGetDigitalCommandLineOption.desc: Returns the digital part of the mixed simulation command line options.

asiPrepareDigitalSimulation.name: asiPrepareDigitalSimulation
asiPrepareDigitalSimulation.desc: Performs digital run directory clean up. It removes the file that stores the exit code for any previous digital simulation and cleans up the digital simulator old log file.

asiCheckDigitalSimulationSuccess.name: asiCheckDigitalSimulationSuccess
asiCheckDigitalSimulationSuccess.desc: Reports the success or failure of the simulation by looking at the digital simulator status file. Further, if no digital signals are saved by the user, this function updates the logFileVerilog file to indicate that no digital waveforms are available for viewing.

asiGetNetworkId.name: asiGetNetworkId
asiGetNetworkId.desc: Returns the network ID of a mixed-signal design.

asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName.name: asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName
asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName.desc: Returns the digital stimulus file name. This file name is the concatenated path string of the digital netlist run directory followed by testfixture.verimix.

asiEditDigitalStimulus.name: asiEditDigitalStimulus
asiEditDigitalStimulus.desc: This method edits the digital stimulus file. It gets the full path to the stimulus file by calling asiGetDigitalStimulusFileName. If the stimulus file does not exist, the asiNetlist flowchart step is executed to run the netlister and create a digital stimulus file. Finally the stimulus file is opened in an editor.

asiPartitionDesign.name: asiPartitionDesign
asiPartitionDesign.desc: This method partitions a mixed-signal design into analog and digital parts.

asiGetDigitalSimulatorLogFileName.name: asiGetDigitalSimulatorLogFileName
asiGetDigitalSimulatorLogFileName.desc: Retrieves the digital simulator log file name for the given design.

asiSetVerilogHost.name: asiSetVerilogHost
asiSetVerilogHost.desc: Sets the digital simulator host name for mixed-signal simulation.

asiSetVerilogHostMode.name: asiSetVerilogHostMode
asiSetVerilogHostMode.desc: Specifies whether the digital simulator will run locally or on a remote host. If you specify remote, you must specify the host name by using the asiSetVerilogHost command.

asiGetVerilogHost.name: asiGetVerilogHost
asiGetVerilogHost.desc: Returns the digital simulator host name for mixed-signal simulation. This method first verifies if host name was set using asiSetVerilogHost. If yes, it returns that host name. Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHost in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

asiGetVerilogHostMode.name: asiGetVerilogHostMode
asiGetVerilogHostMode.desc: Returns the digital simulator host mode for mixed-signal simulation. This method first verifies if host mode was set using asiSetVerilogHostMode. If yes, it returns that mode. Otherwise, it returns the default value of digitalHostMode in the .cdsenv file for tool asimenv and partition startup.

asiGetAnalogRunDir.name: asiGetAnalogRunDir
asiGetAnalogRunDir.desc: Returns the analog simulator run directory.

asiGetDigitalRunDir.name: asiGetDigitalRunDir
asiGetDigitalRunDir.desc: Returns the digital simulator run directory.

asiGetAnalogKeepList.name: asiGetAnalogKeepList
asiGetAnalogKeepList.desc: Returns a list of user-selected output signals that are analog. This method first checks if the current simulation session is mixed-signal. If yes, then it returns all the user-selected output signals within the analog partition of the mixed-signal design. Otherwise, it calls asiGetKeepList to get the list of signals and currents to be saved during simulation.

asiGetDigitalKeepList.name: asiGetDigitalKeepList
asiGetDigitalKeepList.desc: Returns a list of user-selected output signals that are digital.

asiInitMixedKeepOption.name: asiInitMixedKeepOption
asiInitMixedKeepOption.desc: Initializes the mixed-signal keep options variables.

asiInitVerilogEnvOption.name: asiInitVerilogEnvOption
asiInitVerilogEnvOption.desc: Initializes the base Verilog environment options.

asiInitVerilogFNLEnvOption.name: asiInitVerilogFNLEnvOption
asiInitVerilogFNLEnvOption.desc: Initializes the Verilog FNL netlisting options.

asiInitVerilogHNLEnvOption.name: asiInitVerilogHNLEnvOption
asiInitVerilogHNLEnvOption.desc: Initializes the Verilog HNL netlisting options.

asiInitVerilogSimOption.name: asiInitVerilogSimOption
asiInitVerilogSimOption.desc: Initializes the simulation options for Verilog.

mspDisplaySetPartSetupForm.name: mspDisplaySetPartSetupForm
mspDisplaySetPartSetupForm.desc: This function displays the Partitions Options form, which can be used to edit and set the values for the Analog Stop View Set and Digital Stop View Set.

mspEditIEProps.name: mspEditIEProps
mspEditIEProps.desc: This is the main entry procedure for the Interface Element property editor. It takes an object type. The object type can be one of instTerm, instance, terminal, cellView, lib, or default.

hnlVerilogPrintNmosPmos.name: hnlVerilogPrintNmosPmos
hnlVerilogPrintNmosPmos.desc: Used by netlister to print pmos, rpmos, nmos, or rnmos gates.

hnlVerilogPrintCmos.name: hnlVerilogPrintCmos
hnlVerilogPrintCmos.desc: Used by netlister to print cmos, rcmos gates.

nlGetCdf.name: nlGetCdf
nlGetCdf.desc: Obtains the CDF information of the IE cell. CDF information contains the default IE parameter, default IE macro model file name and parameter mapping from CDF to simulator specific names.

[ ?columns x_columns ]
)
=> o_formObj / nil
asiChangeEnvOptionFormProperties.desc: Changes the display characteristics of the Environment Options form.

asiDisplayEnvOption.name: asiDisplayEnvOption
asiDisplayEnvOption.desc: Displays the current set of simulation environment option names and values. Use this function only to determine which environment options you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiDisplayEnvOptionFormProperties.name: asiDisplayEnvOptionFormProperties
asiDisplayEnvOptionFormProperties.desc: Displays the form characteristics for the Environment Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify.

asiGetEnvOptionChoices.name: asiGetEnvOptionChoices
asiGetEnvOptionChoices.desc: Gets the list of choices for an environment option that is set up as a list box.

asiGetEnvOptionVal.name: asiGetEnvOptionVal
asiGetEnvOptionVal.desc: Gets the value for the specified simulation environment option.

asiSetEnvOptionChoices.name: asiSetEnvOptionChoices
asiSetEnvOptionChoices.desc: Specifies the list of choices to appear in the list box field for the specified environment option.

asiSetEnvOptionVal.name: asiSetEnvOptionVal
asiSetEnvOptionVal.desc: Sets the value of the specified simulation environment option.

asiExtractQRCTechPathFromDSPF.name: asiExtractQRCTechPathFromDSPF
asiExtractQRCTechPathFromDSPF.desc: Extracts the path to the QRC technology directory from the specified DSPF file.

asiExtractQRCTechPathFromSession.name: asiExtractQRCTechPathFromSession
asiExtractQRCTechPathFromSession.desc: Extracts the path to the QRC technology directory from the DSPF file defined in the EMIR setup for the specified session.

asiGetAnalogSimulator.name: asiGetAnalogSimulator
asiGetAnalogSimulator.desc: Gets the value of the analog simulator for a tool or session object.

asiGetAdvAnalysis.name: asiGetAdvAnalysis
asiGetAdvAnalysis.desc: Returns the object of advanced analyses, such as Monte Carlo. This function is similar to the asiGetAnalysis function and is normally used by third party integrator to implement the simulator interface for their simulators.

asiGetDesignVarListWithOriginalExpressio.name: asiGetDesignVarListWithOriginalExpressions
asiGetDesignVarListWithOriginalExpressio.desc: Returns a list of name-value pairs for design variables specified in the given session.

asiGetEMIROptionVal.name: asiGetEMIROptionVal
asiGetEMIROptionVal.desc: Returns the value of the specified EMIR option from the EMIR Analysis Setup form.

asiGetNetlistFileListToSymLink.name: asiGetNetlistFileListToSymLink
asiGetNetlistFileListToSymLink.desc: Returns the list of files present in the netlist directory and created by the asiNetlist procedure.

asiGetDigitalSimulator.name: asiGetDigitalSimulator
asiGetDigitalSimulator.desc: Gets the value of the digital simulator for a tool or session object.

asiAnalogAutoloadProc.name: asiAnalogAutoloadProc
asiAnalogAutoloadProc.desc: Called by OASIS for the purpose of autoloading the context. This is done so that the classes are defined before the tool is created and initialization is started.

ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo.name: ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo
ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo.desc: This is a utility function used to create a CDF for the <yourSimulator> simulator.The ansAnalogRegCDFsimInfo functions are called by the CDF editor. These functions are used to provide data type information for all the simInfo attributes.

asiCheckAcEnabledWhenNoiseEnabled.name: asiCheckAcEnabledWhenNoiseEnabled
asiCheckAcEnabledWhenNoiseEnabled.desc: This method verifies that an AC analysis is enabled when a noise analysis is selected. If this is not the case, it displays an error message in the error dialog box of thw analysis form and sets the error status of the form. It is called during the form apply callback.

asiCheckAnalysis.name: asiCheckAnalysis
asiCheckAnalysis.desc: Checking function for the analysis class. e.g. for Spectre simulator object it checks each field value in the environment, highlights any errors, returns t or nil. Can be used for different analog simulator analysis objects.

asiCheckBlank.name: asiCheckBlank
asiCheckBlank.syntax:
asiCheckBlank( 
o_obj 
r_form 
s_fieldName 
) 
=> t / nil
asiCheckBlank.desc: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is non-blank.

asiCreateIncludeStatementFile.name: asiCreateIncludeStatementFile
asiCreateIncludeStatementFile.syntax:
asiCreateIncludeStatementFile( 
o_simulatorSession 
t_netlistFile
t_includeNetlistFile 
) 
=> t_includeNetlistFile / nil
asiCreateIncludeStatementFile.desc: Creates a file that contains a statement to include netlist for simulation. Override this function to create a customized include statement according to the the simulator netlisting procedure and syntax.

asiGetAnalysisField.name: asiGetAnalysisField
asiGetAnalysisField.desc: Returns the specified analysis field object.

asiGetHighPerformanceOptionVal.name: asiGetHighPerformanceOptionVal
asiGetHighPerformanceOptionVal.desc: Returns the field value of the High Performance form with the passed session object.

asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal.name: asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal
asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal.syntax:
asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal( 
s_sessionName 
s_varName 
s_varValue 
)  
=> t_Value / nil
asiSetHighPerformanceOptionVal.desc: Sets the value for the specified High Performance option variable.

asiDisplayHighPerformanceOption.name: asiDisplayHighPerformanceOption
asiDisplayHighPerformanceOption.desc: Displays a list of variable and values of the High Performance Simulation Option form.

asiGetDesignCellName.name: asiGetDesignCellName
asiGetDesignCellName.desc: Returns the cell name of the design associated with the passed session object.

asiGetDesignLibName.name: asiGetDesignLibName
asiGetDesignLibName.desc: Returns the library name of the design associated with the passed object.

asiGetDesignViewName.name: asiGetDesignViewName
asiGetDesignViewName.desc: Returns the view name of the design associated with the passed object.

asiGetDrlData.name: asiGetDrlData
asiGetDrlData.syntax:
asiGetDrlData( 
t_anaType 
l_specifier 
t_dataDir 
) 
=> g_familyOrWaveform / nil
asiGetDrlData.desc: Returns the results data for the given specifier from the given data directory.

asiGetId.name: asiGetId
asiGetId.desc: Returns the name of the session ID associated with the given OASIS session.

asiGetIterationUpdateFile.name: asiGetIterationUpdateFile
asiGetIterationUpdateFile.desc: Returns the name and path to the simulator-specific file in which the iteration number and the corresponding PSF data location is written after each Monte Carlo iteration completes. This file is used to monitor the progress of the Monte Carlo run and to get the directory path from where the PSF data corresponding to an iteration is read.

asiGetResultsPsfDir.name: asiGetResultsPsfDir
asiGetResultsPsfDir.desc: Returns the name of the PSF directory for the current or last-run simulation.

asiGetResultsNetlistDir.name: asiGetResultsNetlistDir
asiGetResultsNetlistDir.desc: Returns the name of the netlist directory for the current or last-run simulation.

asiGetSimulatorList.name: asiGetSimulatorList
asiGetSimulatorList.desc: The function returns a list of all simulation interfaces within the specified simulator subclass.

asiGetSimCommandLineOrder.name: asiGetSimCommandLineOrder
asiGetSimCommandLineOrder.desc: Returns the order of options used in the simulator run command. By default, it returns the options in the following order:

asiGetStimulusGlobals.name: asiGetStimulusGlobals
asiGetStimulusGlobals.desc: This method retrieves the list of global stimuli from the session.

asiGetStimulusInputs.name: asiGetStimulusInputs
asiGetStimulusInputs.desc: This method retrieves the list of input stimuli from the session.

asiIsConfigDesign.name: asiIsConfigDesign
asiIsConfigDesign.desc: The function returns t if the design associated with the session is a Cadence 5.x configuration.

asiSetValid.name: asiSetValid
asiSetValid.desc: The functions sets valid analysis in the current simulation environment. The call to asiSetValid should be used with asiCheck/asiCheckAnalysis method for the analysis.

asiCheckBlankNumericLeq.name: asiCheckBlankNumericLeq
asiCheckBlankNumericLeq.syntax:
asiCheckBlankNumericLeq( 
o_obj 
r_form 
s_fieldName 
g_value 
) 
=> t / nil
asiCheckBlankNumericLeq.desc: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value less than or equal to g_value.

asiCheckBlankNumericGeq.name: asiCheckBlankNumericGeq
asiCheckBlankNumericGeq.syntax:
asiCheckBlankNumericGeq( 
o_obj 
r_form 
s_fieldName 
g_value 
) 
=> t / nil
asiCheckBlankNumericGeq.desc: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value greater than or equal to g_value.

asiFormatGraphicalStimuli.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimuli
asiFormatGraphicalStimuli.desc: Formats the graphical stimuli statements to send to Cadence SPICE.

asiFormatGraphicalStimulusFileList.name: asiFormatGraphicalStimulusFileList
asiFormatGraphicalStimulusFileList.desc: Formats the statement that includes the graphical stimulus files.

asiAddOceanAlias.name: asiAddOceanAlias
asiAddOceanAlias.syntax:
asiAddOceanAlias( 
s_simulatorName 
s_alias 
s_analysisName 
)
=> t / nil
asiAddOceanAlias.desc: Adds an ocean alias to the current simulator. This is useful for defining ocean related data access aliases for third party simulator integration.

asiGetAvailableMCOptions.name: asiGetAvailableMCOptions
asiGetAvailableMCOptions.desc: Returns a list of Monte Carlo analysis options along with their description. The supported Monte Carlo analysis options are displayed in the <OptionName, Description> format.

asiGetSupportedMCOptions.name: asiGetSupportedMCOptions
asiGetSupportedMCOptions.desc: Returns a list of Monte Carlo analysis options supported by your simulator. Ensure that the option names returned by this method match with the option names returned by asiGetAvailableMCOptions.

asiSetEMIROptionVal.name: asiSetEMIROptionVal
asiSetEMIROptionVal.syntax:
asiSetEMIROptionVal(
o_session 
s_name
g_value
) 
=> t / nil
asiSetEMIROptionVal.desc: Sets the given value for the specified EMIR option.

asiDisplaySimOptionFormProperties.desc: Displays the characteristics of the Simulator Options form. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiGetReservedWordList.name: asiGetReservedWordList
asiGetReservedWordList.desc: Returns the simulator specific reserved keyword list. All the keywords specified by asiGetReservedWordList will be taken as keywords and not design variables. This process will ensure that the design parameters are not printed in the simulation control file under `parameters' statement. By default, this function returns nil.

asiIsCaseSensitive.name: asiIsCaseSensitive
asiIsCaseSensitive.desc: Determines whether the simulator is case sensitive or not. Returns t, if the simulator is case sensitive, else returns nil. The default value for this function is t.

asiGetSimOptionChoices.name: asiGetSimOptionChoices
asiGetSimOptionChoices.desc: Gets the list of choices for a simulator option that is set up as a list box.

asiGetSimOptionNameList.name: asiGetSimOptionNameList
asiGetSimOptionNameList.desc: Returns the list of simulator option names.

asiGetSimOptionSendMethod.name: asiGetSimOptionSendMethod
asiGetSimOptionSendMethod.desc: Gets the sendMethod for the specified simulator option. The sendMethod indicates how the simulator option is sent to Cadence SPICE.

asiGetSimOptionVal.name: asiGetSimOptionVal
asiGetSimOptionVal.desc: Gets the value for the specified simulator option.

asiGetSimulationRunCommand.name: asiGetSimulationRunCommand
asiGetSimulationRunCommand.desc: Gets the simulation run command. For direct simulators, it also creates the runSimulation file.

asiIsICLPSupported.name: asiIsICLPSupported
asiIsICLPSupported.desc: Specifies whether the simulator supports ICLP simulations that are enabled by the Optimize Single Job Run option on the Job Policy Setup form.

asiSetSimOptionVal.name: asiSetSimOptionVal

asiGetSimulatorSrcList.name: asiGetSimulatorSrcList
asiGetSimulatorSrcList.desc: Customizes the values in the Function drop-down list of the Setup Analog Stimuli form.

asiDeleteAnalysis.name: asiDeleteAnalysis
asiDeleteAnalysis.desc: Deletes an analysis from the given simulation tool.

asiDeleteAnalysisField.name: asiDeleteAnalysisField
asiDeleteAnalysisField.desc: Deletes an analysis field from an existing analysis.

asiDisableAnalysis.name: asiDisableAnalysis
asiDisableAnalysis.desc: Disables an analysis while keeping it in the analysis list. The analysis remains in the UI, but it is not sent to the simulator.

asiDisplayAnalysis.name: asiDisplayAnalysis
asiDisplayAnalysis.desc: Displays the analyses for a tool. Use this function to determine which analyses you need to add or modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiDisplayAnalysisField.name: asiDisplayAnalysisField
asiDisplayAnalysisField.desc: Displays the analysis field names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis field you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiDisplayAnalysisOption.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOption
asiDisplayAnalysisOption.desc: Displays the analysis option names for an analysis. Use this function to determine which analysis option you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiDisplayAnalysisOptionFormProperties.name: asiDisplayAnalysisOptionFormProperties
asiDisplayAnalysisOptionFormProperties.desc: Displays the characteristics for one of the analysis options forms. Use this function only to determine which form characteristics you want to modify. Do not use this function as part of another procedure.

asiEnableAnalysis.name: asiEnableAnalysis
asiEnableAnalysis.desc: Enables an analysis, which means the analysis is selected and sent to the simulator.

asiGetAnalysis.name: asiGetAnalysis

asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices
asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices.desc: Gets the list of choices for an analysis field that is set up as a list box.

asiGetAnalysisFieldList.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldList
asiGetAnalysisFieldList.desc: Returns a list of analysis field objects defined for a particular analysis object.

asiGetAnalysisFieldVal.name: asiGetAnalysisFieldVal
asiGetAnalysisFieldVal.desc: Gets the value of an analysis field from the environment.

This procedure can be used within the asiCheck method to get the list of choices for an analysis field from the form for subsequent value checking. You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

asiGetAnalysisFormObj.name: asiGetAnalysisFormObj
asiGetAnalysisFormObj.desc: Returns the current analysis selected in the Choosing Analysis form for the simulation session.

You can also use this procedure in an expression that controls whether a field is displayed in the form.

asiGetAnalysisName.name: asiGetAnalysisName

asiGetAnalysisNameList.name: asiGetAnalysisNameList
asiGetAnalysisNameList.desc: Returns a list of analysis names defined for a tool.

asiGetAnalysisOptionList.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionList
asiGetAnalysisOptionList.desc: Gets a list of analysis option objects defined for a particular analysis object.

asiGetAnalysisOptionSendMethod.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionSendMethod
asiGetAnalysisOptionSendMethod.desc: Gets the sendMethod for an option in an analysis. The sendMethod indicates how the analysis option is sent to Cadence SPICE.

asiGetAnalysisOptionVal.name: asiGetAnalysisOptionVal
asiGetAnalysisOptionVal.desc: Gets the value for the given option in an analysis.

asiGetAnalysisParamNameList.name: asiGetAnalysisParamNameList
asiGetAnalysisParamNameList.desc: Returns a concatenated list of fields and options defined for an analysis object.

asiGetEnabledAnalysisList.name: asiGetEnabledAnalysisList
asiGetEnabledAnalysisList.desc: Returns a list of all the enabled analyses.

asiIsAnalysisEnabled.name: asiIsAnalysisEnabled
asiIsAnalysisEnabled.desc: Determines whether an analysis is enabled.

asiInitialize.name: asiInitialize
asiInitialize.desc: Initializes the tools that are derived from the asiAnalog class. This function is not called for tools that are derived from the asiSocket class.

asiNetlist.name: asiNetlist
asiNetlist.desc: Creates a design object and then a formatter object with nlCreateFormatter. After this, the netlister is run and a netlist is generated with nlNetlist. Netlist statistics are then printed. The netlister also provides a component count, as well as the addition of design variables found during netlisting.

asiInterruptSim.name: asiInterruptSim
asiInterruptSim.desc: This method provides an interrupt to the simulation run process for a session. It is associated with the Simulation->Stop action in the user interface. This method is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

asiSetProjectDirChangeSetup.name: asiSetProjectDirChangeSetup
asiSetProjectDirChangeSetup.desc: Enables you to modify the simulator settings for the given session after changing the project directory. This function is called by the environment. Therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface.

asiQuitSimulator.name: asiQuitSimulator
asiQuitSimulator.desc: This function quits the simulator run process based on the ipc signal being sent to the specified process. By default, the direct integration code sends a hard-kill signal to the simulator process. To change this option and send a soft-kill signal, the ?mode option should be set to true and overloaded for yourSimulator session. This method is called by the environment, therefore, you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be re-defined for the interface. Use, callNextMethod in its definition.

asiRunSimulation.name: asiRunSimulation
asiRunSimulation.desc: This function runs the simulation for the session. It is called by the environment, so you should not call it directly from the interface. This method can be redefined for the interface. Use callNextMethod in this definition.

asiGetPredefinedCommandLineOption.name: asiGetPredefinedCommandLineOption
asiGetPredefinedCommandLineOption.desc: Gets the predefined simulation command-line options. This function returns an empty string at the asiAnalog class. Overload this method for your simulator.

asiGetCommandFooter.name: asiGetCommandFooter
asiGetCommandFooter.desc: Specifies the footer of the simulation run command.

asiFormatControlStmts.name: asiFormatControlStmts
asiFormatControlStmts.desc: Creates and formats all control statements. It formats the following in the given order:

asiFormatDesignVarList.name: asiFormatDesignVarList
asiFormatDesignVarList.desc: Formats and prints the design variable statements to the design variable file. This routine first prints the string.PARAM followed by the design variables in name=value pairs. The design variables are obtained by calling asiGetDesignVarList.

asiFormatInitCond.name: asiFormatInitCond
asiFormatInitCond.desc: Formats and prints the initial condition commands to the control statement file. This routine prints the string .IC followed by the initial conditions in V(net)=voltage pairs.

asiFormatNodeSet.name: asiFormatNodeSet
asiFormatNodeSet.desc: Formats and prints the nodeset commands to the control statement file. This routine prints .NODESET and then the nodesets in V(net)=voltage pairs.

asiFormatKeepList.name: asiFormatKeepList
asiFormatKeepList.desc: Formats and prints the signal save commands to the control statement file. At the asiAnalog class this routine returns t. You need to create your own asiFormatKeepList routine.

asiFormatSimulatorOptions.name: asiFormatSimulatorOptions
asiFormatSimulatorOptions.desc: Formats and prints the simulator option statements to the designated file. This routine prints .OPTIONS followed by name=value pairs.

asiFormatAnalysisList.name: asiFormatAnalysisList
asiFormatAnalysisList.desc: Formats all enabled analyses by calling asiFormatAnalysis.

asiFormatAnalysis.name: asiFormatAnalysis
asiFormatAnalysis.desc: Formats and prints analysis statements to the control file. For the general asiAnalog class, it follows this routine: prints the analysis name by calling asiGetAnalysisName; prints the list of signals by calling asiGetAnalysisSigList and formats them in parentheses [for example: (net1 net2)]; prints the analysis field list in name=value pairs; prints the analysis options in name=value pairs; uses asiGetFormattedVal() to obtain the print string for an analysis field value or an analysis option value. Please see the description of asiGetFormattedVal routine for more details.

asiFormatModelLibSelectionList.name: asiFormatModelLibSelectionList
asiFormatModelLibSelectionList.desc: Formats the statement which specifies the model library information.

asiFormatDefinitionFileList.name: asiFormatDefinitionFileList
asiFormatDefinitionFileList.desc: Formats the statement which includes the specified definition files.

asiFormatTextStimulusFileList.name: asiFormatTextStimulusFileList
asiFormatTextStimulusFileList.desc: Formats the statement which includes the textual stimulus files.

asiNeedSuffixEvaluation.name: asiNeedSuffixEvaluation
asiNeedSuffixEvaluation.desc: Specify whether the interface needs suffix evaluation or not. When this method returns t, the numeric suffixes specified in a numericString field will be evaluated. For example, suppose the start frequency field for the AC analysis has a value of 10M, asiGetFormattedVal(ac_start_fieldObj ) returns 1e7 provided it is created as a `numericString field.

asiInvalidateControlStmts.name: asiInvalidateControlStmts
asiInvalidateControlStmts.desc: The asiInvalidateControlStmts function is a wrapper to asiInvalidateFlowchartStep, which invalidates the asiSendControlStmts flowchart step.

asiGetSimExecName.name: asiGetSimExecName
asiGetSimExecName.desc: Gets the name of the simulator executable by calling asiGetSimName.

asiGetCommandLineOption.name: asiGetCommandLineOption
asiGetCommandLineOption.desc: Gets the simulation command line options. At the asiAnalog class this method returns the value of the environment option `userComdLineOption.

asiGetAnalysisSigList.name: asiGetAnalysisSigList
asiGetAnalysisSigList.desc: Gets a list of analysis field objects which are of the type net. For example, the p and n nodes for the Spectre noise analysis.

asiGetAnalysisType.name: asiGetAnalysisType
asiGetAnalysisType.desc: Gets the type of the analysis.

asiGetAnalysisSimFieldList.name: asiGetAnalysisSimFieldList
asiGetAnalysisSimFieldList.desc: Gets a list of simulator analysis field objects that need to be netlisted.

asiGetModelLibSelectionList.name: asiGetModelLibSelectionList
asiGetModelLibSelectionList.desc: Formats the statement which specifies the model library information.

asiGetModelLibFile.name: asiGetModelLibFile
asiGetModelLibFile.desc: Gets the file name of a model library selection object.

asiGetModelLibSection.name: asiGetModelLibSection
asiGetModelLibSection.desc: Gets the section name of a model library selection object.

asiGetDefinitionFileList.name: asiGetDefinitionFileList
asiGetDefinitionFileList.desc: Gets the list of definition file names associated with the given simulation session.

asiGetTextStimulusFileList.name: asiGetTextStimulusFileList
asiGetTextStimulusFileList.desc: Gets the list of textual stimulus file names associated with the given simulation session.

asiGetFormattedVal.name: asiGetFormattedVal
asiGetFormattedVal.syntax:
asiGetFormattedVal( 
o_anaField | o_anaOption | o_simOption 
) 
=> t_formattedVal / nil
asiGetFormattedVal.desc: Gets the string value of an analysis field object, an analysis option object, or a simulator option object. The format of the string values are based on the object types which are specified with functions such as asiCreateAnalysisField, asiCreateAnalysisOption, asiAddSimOption. A number of examples can be found in the example section.

asiGetSelObjName.name: asiGetSelObjName
asiGetSelObjName.desc: Returns the schematic name of the selected signal object.

asiGetSelObjType.name: asiGetSelObjType
asiGetSelObjType.desc: Returns the type of the selected signal object.

ahdlUpdateViewInfo.name: ahdlUpdateViewInfo
ahdlUpdateViewInfo.desc: Updates cells and cellviews created with releases earlier than 4.4.2 so that the cells and cellviews can use cellview-specific parameters and parameter values. During the update, ahdlUpdateViewInfo, parses the Verilog-A or SpectreHDL modules that define the specified cellviews, issues any necessary error messages and updates the cellview CDF information.

amseGeneralSetupForm.name: amseGeneralSetupForm
amseGeneralSetupForm.desc: Opens the General Setup form in Virtuoso AMS Designer. The General Setup form appears when you choose Detailed Setup and then General Setup from the AMS menu in Hierarchy Editor.

amseQuickSetupForm.name: amseQuickSetupForm
amseQuickSetupForm.desc: Opens the Quick Setup form in Virtuoso AMS Designer. The Quick Setup form appears when you choose Quick Setup from the AMS menu in Hierarchy Editor.

amsOSSUnlExecutePostNetlistTrigger.name: amsOSSUnlExecutePostNetlistTrigger
amsOSSUnlExecutePostNetlistTrigger.desc: This is a callback function that gets triggered after AMS UNL netlisting.
